# AndroGuard

Android APK analysis backend. The API lives in [`backend/`](backend/README.md).

```bash
cd backend
docker compose up --build
```

Then `POST /api/v1/analyze` with an `.apk` file.

Production deploy: [backend/DEPLOY.md](backend/DEPLOY.md).

from pydantic_settings import BaseSettings, SettingsConfigDict


class Settings(BaseSettings):
    model_config = SettingsConfigDict(env_file=".env", extra="ignore")

    database_url: str = "sqlite:///./androguard.db"
    secret_key: str = "change-me-to-a-long-random-string"
    algorithm: str = "HS256"
    access_token_expire_minutes: int = 60 * 24


settings = Settings()

from collections.abc import Generator

from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import DeclarativeBase, Session, sessionmaker

from app.config import settings

# check_same_thread only applies to SQLite, which serves single-threaded connections.
connect_args = (
    {"check_same_thread": False} if settings.database_url.startswith("sqlite") else {}
)

engine = create_engine(settings.database_url, pool_pre_ping=True, connect_args=connect_args)
SessionLocal = sessionmaker(bind=engine, autoflush=False, autocommit=False)


class Base(DeclarativeBase):
    pass


def get_db() -> Generator[Session, None, None]:
    db = SessionLocal()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()

from contextlib import asynccontextmanager

from fastapi import FastAPI
from fastapi.middleware.cors import CORSMiddleware

from app.database import Base, engine
from app.routers import auth


@asynccontextmanager
async def lifespan(app: FastAPI):
    Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
    yield


app = FastAPI(title="AndroGuard API", version="0.1.0", lifespan=lifespan)

app.add_middleware(
    CORSMiddleware,
    allow_origins=["*"],
    allow_credentials=True,
    allow_methods=["*"],
    allow_headers=["*"],
)

app.include_router(auth.router)


@app.get("/health", tags=["health"])
def health() -> dict[str, str]:
    return {"status": "ok"}

from datetime import datetime, timezone

from sqlalchemy import DateTime, String, func
from sqlalchemy.orm import Mapped, mapped_column

from app.database import Base


class User(Base):
    __tablename__ = "users"

    id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(primary_key=True)
    full_name: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(120))
    company_name: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(120))
    email: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(255), unique=True, index=True)
    hashed_password: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(255))
    created_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(
        DateTime(timezone=True), server_default=func.now()
    )

from datetime import datetime

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, EmailStr, Field


class SignupRequest(BaseModel):
    full_name: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=120)
    company_name: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=120)
    email: EmailStr
    password: str = Field(min_length=8, max_length=128)


class LoginRequest(BaseModel):
    email: EmailStr
    password: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=128)


class UserResponse(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(from_attributes=True)

    id: int
    full_name: str
    company_name: str
    email: EmailStr
    created_at: datetime


class TokenResponse(BaseModel):
    access_token: str
    token_type: str = "bearer"
    expires_in: int
    user: UserResponse

FILE: app/security.py
================================================================================
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
from typing import Any

import bcrypt
from jose import JWTError, jwt

from app.config import settings

# bcrypt only reads the first 72 bytes of a password and silently ignores the rest.
BCRYPT_MAX_PASSWORD_BYTES = 72


def hash_password(password: str) -> str:
    return bcrypt.hashpw(_encode(password), bcrypt.gensalt()).decode()


def verify_password(password: str, hashed_password: str) -> bool:
    try:
        return bcrypt.checkpw(_encode(password), hashed_password.encode())
    except ValueError:
        return False


def create_access_token(subject: str, expires_minutes: int | None = None) -> str:
    minutes = expires_minutes or settings.access_token_expire_minutes
    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
    payload = {
        "sub": subject,
        "iat": now,
        "exp": now + timedelta(minutes=minutes),
    }
    return jwt.encode(payload, settings.secret_key, algorithm=settings.algorithm)


def decode_access_token(token: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
    try:
        return jwt.decode(token, settings.secret_key, algorithms=[settings.algorithm])
    except JWTError:
        return None


def _encode(password: str) -> bytes:
    return password.encode()[:BCRYPT_MAX_PASSWORD_BYTES]

FILE: app/routers/auth.py

from typing import Annotated

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, status
from fastapi.security import HTTPAuthorizationCredentials, HTTPBearer
from sqlalchemy import select
from sqlalchemy.exc import IntegrityError
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.config import settings
from app.database import get_db
from app.models import User
from app.schemas import LoginRequest, SignupRequest, TokenResponse, UserResponse
from app.security import create_access_token, decode_access_token, hash_password, verify_password

router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/auth", tags=["auth"])
bearer_scheme = HTTPBearer(auto_error=False)
DECOY_PASSWORD_HASH = hash_password("decoy-password-for-constant-time-login")

DbSession = Annotated[Session, Depends(get_db)]


def _token_response(user: User) -> TokenResponse:
    return TokenResponse(
        access_token=create_access_token(str(user.id)),
        expires_in=settings.access_token_expire_minutes * 60,
        user=UserResponse.model_validate(user),
    )


def get_current_user(
    credentials: Annotated[HTTPAuthorizationCredentials | None, Depends(bearer_scheme)],
    db: DbSession,
) -> User:
    unauthorized = HTTPException(
        status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
        detail="Invalid or expired token",
        headers={"WWW-Authenticate": "Bearer"},
    )
    if credentials is None:
        raise unauthorized

    payload = decode_access_token(credentials.credentials)
    if payload is None or not payload.get("sub"):
        raise unauthorized

    user = db.get(User, int(payload["sub"]))
    if user is None:
        raise unauthorized
    return user


@router.post("/signup", response_model=TokenResponse, status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
def signup(payload: SignupRequest, db: DbSession) -> TokenResponse:
    email = payload.email.lower()

    user = User(
        full_name=payload.full_name.strip(),
        company_name=payload.company_name.strip(),
        email=email,
        hashed_password=hash_password(payload.password),
    )
    db.add(user)
    try:
        db.commit()
    except IntegrityError:
        db.rollback()
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_409_CONFLICT,
            detail="An account with this email already exists",
        ) from None
    db.refresh(user)

    return _token_response(user)


@router.post("/login", response_model=TokenResponse)
def login(payload: LoginRequest, db: DbSession) -> TokenResponse:
    user = db.scalar(select(User).where(User.email == payload.email.lower()))

    # Hash against a decoy when the email is unknown so unregistered emails
    # can't be identified by the faster response.
    password_ok = verify_password(
        payload.password, user.hashed_password if user else DECOY_PASSWORD_HASH
    )

    if user is None or not password_ok:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
            detail="Incorrect email or password",
        )

    return _token_response(user)


@router.get("/me", response_model=UserResponse)
def me(current_user: Annotated[User, Depends(get_current_user)]) -> User:
    return current_user

# DigitalOcean deployment

The API is a single Docker service. HTTPS terminates at DigitalOcean (App Platform) or at nginx on a droplet. Do not expose Uvicorn on port 80 without a proxy.

Recommended size: **2 GB RAM**, 1 vCPU. Androguard can use a few hundred MB per large APK. Keep **one Uvicorn worker** unless you have 4 GB+.

## Environment

Set these in the App Platform / droplet environment. Copy from `.env.example`. Never commit `.env`.

| Variable | Production |
|---|---|
| `DATABASE_URL` | Supabase pooler URL (`6543`) |
| `TEMP_ROOT` | `/app/tmp` |
| `LOG_LEVEL` | `INFO` |
| `MAX_APK_SIZE_MB` | `80` |
| `ANALYSIS_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` | `90` |
| `UVICORN_WORKERS` | `1` |
| `AAPT_PATH` | leave empty (image includes `aapt`) |

Health check path: `GET /api/v1/health`  
Expect `database.ready: true` and `aapt_available: true` in the container.

Upload and analysis timeouts at the proxy must be **greater than** `ANALYSIS_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` (use 120s). Body size must be **at least** `MAX_APK_SIZE_MB` (use 80m).

## Option A — App Platform (simplest HTTPS)

1. Push this repo to GitHub.
2. DigitalOcean → **Apps** → Create → GitHub → this repo.
3. Set **source directory** to `backend` so the Dockerfile and `requirements.txt` resolve.
4. HTTP port **8000**.
5. Health check **HTTP**, path `/api/v1/health`.
6. Add env vars from the table above. Mark `DATABASE_URL` as **secret**.
7. Instance: at least `basic-xs` / 1 GB; prefer 2 GB if you analyze 50 MB+ APKs.
8. After deploy, open `https://<app>.ondigitalocean.app/api/v1/health`.

App Platform already provides HTTPS. Point a domain at the app in **Settings → Domains**.

If APK uploads fail with 413, raise the App Platform / CDN body limit or upload through a droplet with nginx (`client_max_body_size 80m`).

A sample spec is in [`.do/app.yaml`](../.do/app.yaml) at the repo root (`doctl apps create --spec .do/app.yaml`).

## Option B — Droplet + Docker Compose + nginx

### 1. Droplet

- Image: Ubuntu 24.04
- Size: 2 GB RAM
- Region: closest to users (e.g. Bangalore `blr1`)
- Add your SSH key
- Enable a firewall: allow 22, 80, 443 only

```bash
apt-get update
apt-get install -y docker.io docker-compose-plugin nginx certbot python3-certbot-nginx
```

### 2. App

```bash
git clone <your-repo> /opt/androguard
cd /opt/androguard/backend
cp .env.example .env
# edit .env — set DATABASE_URL
export TEMP_ROOT=/app/tmp
docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.prod.yml up -d --build
```

Confirm:

```bash
curl -sS http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/v1/health
```

### 3. nginx

Replace `api.example.com`. The compose file binds Uvicorn to localhost in prod.

```nginx
server {
    listen 80;
    server_name api.example.com;
    client_max_body_size 80m;

    location / {
        proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1:8000;
        proxy_set_header Host $host;
        proxy_set_header X-Request-ID $request_id;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;
        proxy_read_timeout 120s;
        proxy_send_timeout 120s;
    }
}
```

```bash
ln -s /etc/nginx/sites-available/androguard /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/
nginx -t && systemctl reload nginx
certbot --nginx -d api.example.com
```

Certbot enables HTTPS. Android clients should call `https://api.example.com`.

### 4. Firewall

```bash
ufw allow OpenSSH
ufw allow 'Nginx Full'
ufw enable
```

Do not publish port 8000 on the public interface. `docker-compose.prod.yml` maps `127.0.0.1:8000:8000`.

## Checks after deploy

```bash
curl -sS https://api.example.com/api/v1/health
curl -sS -F "file=@app.apk" https://api.example.com/api/v1/analyze
```

- `aapt_available` should be `true` (Debian `aapt` in the image).
- `database.ready` should be `true` if `DATABASE_URL` is set.
- Screenshots persist in Postgres (`screenshot_files`).

## Operations

- Logs: `docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.prod.yml logs -f api`
- Restart: `docker compose ... restart api`
- Disk: APK temp files are deleted after analyze; keep a volume on `/app/tmp` for in-flight jobs only.

No Kubernetes. One container is enough.

================================================================================
FILE: backend/Dockerfile
================================================================================
FROM python:3.11-slim

WORKDIR /app

ENV PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
ENV PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
ENV PYTHONPATH=/app

RUN apt-get update \
    && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends aapt \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt

COPY app ./app

RUN mkdir -p /app/tmp/jobs \
    && useradd --create-home --uid 10001 appuser \
    && chown -R appuser:appuser /app

USER appuser

EXPOSE 8000

HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=5s --start-period=20s --retries=3 \
  CMD python -c "import urllib.request; urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/v1/health')"

CMD ["sh", "-c", "uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --workers ${UVICORN_WORKERS:-1} --timeout-keep-alive 75"]

FILE: backend/README.md
================================================================================
# AndroGuard APK Analyzer

FastAPI backend that accepts an Android APK and returns structured JSON:

- Manifest, permissions, metadata, SDK
- Activities and services (including intent filters)
- DEX static code analysis (sensitive API call sites, network/WebView/file/telephony usage, SDKs)
- Raster image assets extracted from `res/` and `assets/`

This service reports what the APK contains. It does not score policy violations, run the APK, or use AI.

## Quick start

```bash
cd backend
python -m venv .venv
# Windows: .venv\Scripts\activate
# Linux/macOS: source .venv/bin/activate
pip install -r requirements-dev.txt
uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
```

Open http://127.0.0.1:8000/docs for Swagger UI.

Supported runtimes: Python 3.11+ (Docker image uses 3.11). Python 3.14 works locally with current wheels.

## Docker

```bash
cd backend
docker compose up --build
```

Production (localhost bind + restart policy):

```bash
docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.prod.yml up -d --build
```

DigitalOcean (App Platform or droplet + nginx/HTTPS): see [DEPLOY.md](DEPLOY.md).

## API

### `GET /api/v1/health`

Liveness check.

### `POST /api/v1/auth/signup`

JSON body `full_name`, `company_name`, `email`, `password` (min 8 chars). Returns `201` with a
bearer token and the created user. `409 EMAIL_ALREADY_REGISTERED` if the email is taken.

### `POST /api/v1/auth/login`

JSON body `email`, `password`. Returns a bearer token, or `401 INVALID_CREDENTIALS`.

### `GET /api/v1/auth/me`

Requires `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Returns the current user profile.

### `POST /api/v1/analyze`

`multipart/form-data` field `file` (`.apk`), plus these optional submission fields:

| Field | Notes |
| --- | --- |
| `app_name` | Submitter-supplied app name (max 200 chars). |
| `app_description` | App description / purpose (max 4000 chars). |
| `privacy_policy` | Either an `http(s)` link or a file path; echoed back with `privacy_policy_kind` of `url` or `file_path`. |
| `play_store_url` | Must start with `http://` or `https://`. |

Blank values are treated as omitted. An invalid value returns `400 INVALID_SUBMISSION`. The
values are echoed back under `data.submission` and stored with the analysis history.

Success envelope:

```json
{
  "schema_version": "1.0.0",
  "status": "completed",
  "data": {
    "apk": {},
    "submission": {
      "app_name": "Photo Editor",
      "app_description": "Edits and filters photos.",
      "privacy_policy": "https://example.com/privacy",
      "privacy_policy_kind": "url",
      "play_store_url": "https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.example"
    },
    "manifest": {},
    "permissions": [],
    "metadata": [],
    "sdk": {},
    "activities": [],
    "services": [],
    "screenshots": [],
    "code_analysis": {
      "summary": {},
      "classes": [],
      "methods": [],
      "api_calls": [
        {
          "class_name": "com.example.CallFunction",
          "method_name": "makeCall",
          "api_class": "android.telecom.TelecomManager",
          "api_method": "placeCall",
          "risk_category": "PHONE",
          "evidence": "method invocation detected",
          "confidence": "HIGH"
        }
      ],
      "sensitive_api_calls": [],
      "network_calls": [],
      "webview_usage": [],
      "file_storage_operations": [],
      "telephony_calls": [],
      "data_access_indicators": [],
      "dynamic_code_loading": [],
      "third_party_sdk_usage": [],
      "code_findings": []
    },
    "analysis": {}
  }
}
```

### `GET /api/v1/files/{job_id}/{file_name}`

Download an extracted image. When `DATABASE_URL` is set, screenshot bytes are stored in PostgreSQL (`screenshot_files`) so they survive process restarts. Local `tmp/jobs` is only a cache.

### Errors

```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "INVALID_APK",
    "message": "The uploaded file is not a valid Android APK."
  }
}
```

Codes include `INVALID_FILE`, `INVALID_APK`, `CORRUPT_APK`, `UNSUPPORTED_APK`, `APK_TOO_LARGE`, `MANIFEST_INVALID`, `ANALYSIS_TIMEOUT`, `ANALYZER_ERROR`.

## Configuration

Copy `.env.example` to `.env`. Important limits:

| Variable | Default |
|---|---|
| `MAX_APK_SIZE_MB` | 80 |
| `ANALYSIS_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` | 90 |
| `MAX_SCREENSHOTS` | 40 |
| `DEX_ANALYSIS_ENABLED` | `true`. Set `false` to skip DEX/code analysis. |
| `MAX_CODE_CLASSES` / `MAX_CODE_METHODS` / `MAX_CODE_FINDINGS` | Caps for `code_analysis` lists (defaults 200 / 300 / 200). |
| `MAX_IMAGE_BYTES` | 8388608 |
| `DATABASE_URL` | unset (optional). Supabase pooler URL persists analysis history and user accounts. |
| `JWT_SECRET` | signing key for auth tokens. Set a long random value in production. |
| `JWT_ALGORITHM` / `ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES` | `HS256` / `1440` (24h). |
| `AAPT_PATH` | optional path to `aapt`. Docker installs Debian `aapt`. Host without aapt still analyzes via Androguard. |
| `UVICORN_WORKERS` | `1` in production (memory). |
| `S3_ENDPOINT_URL` / `S3_ACCESS_KEY` / `S3_SECRET_KEY` | Supabase S3-compatible storage for screenshot files. |

## Tests

```bash
cd backend
pytest
```

The suite covers invalid uploads, size/timeout limits, AAB rejection, zip-slip, and PNG/JPEG/WebP extraction. To also run a live Androguard parse, place a small `.apk` at `tests/fixtures/apks/sample.apk`.

## Out of scope

Google policy checks, authentication, Redis, emulator screenshots. DEX analysis reports referenced APIs and strings, not runtime behavior or policy verdicts.

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
import uuid
from contextlib import asynccontextmanager

from fastapi import FastAPI, Request
from fastapi.exceptions import RequestValidationError
from fastapi.responses import JSONResponse

from app.api.v1.router import api_router
from app.core.config import settings
from app.core.errors import AppError, app_error_handler, error_body, unhandled_error_handler
from app.core.logging import setup_logging
from app.db.session import init_db

setup_logging()
logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


@asynccontextmanager
async def lifespan(_app: FastAPI):
    try:
        init_db()
    except Exception:
        logger.exception("Failed to initialize PostgreSQL schema.")
    yield


app = FastAPI(
    title=settings.app_name,
    version=settings.analyzer_version,
    description="Upload an Android APK and receive structured manifest, component, DEX code-analysis, and image metadata.",
    lifespan=lifespan,
)

app.include_router(api_router, prefix="/api/v1")


@app.middleware("http")
async def request_id_middleware(request: Request, call_next):
    request_id = request.headers.get("x-request-id") or str(uuid.uuid4())
    request.state.request_id = request_id
    response = await call_next(request)
    response.headers["x-request-id"] = request_id
    return response


@app.exception_handler(AppError)
async def handle_app_error(request: Request, exc: AppError):
    return await app_error_handler(request, exc)


@app.exception_handler(RequestValidationError)
async def handle_validation(request: Request, exc: RequestValidationError):
    request_id = getattr(request.state, "request_id", None)
    if request.url.path.endswith(("/analyze", "/analyze-apk")):
        return JSONResponse(
            status_code=400,
            content=error_body("INVALID_FILE", "The request is missing a valid APK upload.", request_id),
        )
    body = error_body("VALIDATION_ERROR", "The request payload is invalid.", request_id)
    body["error"]["details"] = [
        {
            "field": ".".join(str(part) for part in error["loc"][1:]) or "body",
            "message": error["msg"],
        }
        for error in exc.errors()
    ]
    return JSONResponse(status_code=422, content=body)


@app.exception_handler(Exception)
async def handle_unhandled(request: Request, exc: Exception):
    return await unhandled_error_handler(request, exc)


def _cli(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    """Lightweight CLI entry for debug commands (does not start the API server).

    Examples::

        python -m app.main --inspect-ui
        python -m app.main --screenshot
        python -m app.main --compare-screenshot
        python -m app.main --explore --package com.example.app
        python -m app.main --explore-ads --package com.example.app
        python -m app.main --detect-ad --image path/to/shot.png
    """
    import argparse
    import sys

    from app.workers.detect_ad_cli import run_detect_ad_cli
    from app.workers.explore_cli import run_explore_cli
    from app.workers.inspect_ui import inspect_ui
    from app.workers.screenshot_cli import run_screenshot_cli

    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        prog="python -m app.main",
        description="AndroGuard backend helpers (API is started via uvicorn).",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--inspect-ui",
        action="store_true",
        help="Dump the UI hierarchy of a connected Android device via UIAutomator.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--screenshot",
        action="store_true",
        help="Capture a device screenshot (Phase 3).",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--compare-screenshot",
        action="store_true",
        help="Compare two screenshots / visual states (Phase 3).",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--explore",
        action="store_true",
        help="Run deterministic UI exploration (Phase 4).",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--explore-ads",
        action="store_true",
        help="Run multi-pass advertisement placement discovery (Phase 5).",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--detect-ad",
        action="store_true",
        help="Detect advertisements in a screenshot (Phase 6).",
    )
    args, remainder = parser.parse_known_args(argv)
    if args.inspect_ui:
        return inspect_ui(["--inspect-ui", *remainder])
    if args.screenshot:
        return run_screenshot_cli(["--screenshot", *remainder])
    if args.compare_screenshot:
        return run_screenshot_cli(["--compare-screenshot", *remainder])
    if args.detect_ad:
        return run_detect_ad_cli(["--detect-ad", *remainder])
    if args.explore_ads:
        return run_explore_cli(["--explore-ads", *remainder])
    if args.explore:
        return run_explore_cli(["--explore", *remainder])
    parser.print_help()
    print("\nStart the API with: uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000")
    return 0 if argv in (None, []) else 2

if __name__ == "__main__":
    import sys

    sys.exit(_cli())

from __future__ import annotations

from fastapi import Depends
from fastapi.security import HTTPAuthorizationCredentials, HTTPBearer

from app.core.errors import AppError
from app.core.security import decode_access_token
from app.db.session import engine
from app.db.user_repository import get_user_by_id
from app.schemas.auth import UserProfile

bearer_scheme = HTTPBearer(auto_error=False)


def require_database() -> None:
    if engine is None:
        raise AppError(
            "DATABASE_UNAVAILABLE",
            "PostgreSQL is not configured.",
            http_status=503,
        )


def get_current_user(
    credentials: HTTPAuthorizationCredentials | None = Depends(bearer_scheme),
) -> UserProfile:
    unauthorized = AppError(
        "UNAUTHORIZED",
        "A valid bearer token is required.",
        http_status=401,
    )
    if credentials is None or not credentials.credentials:
        raise unauthorized
    payload = decode_access_token(credentials.credentials)
    if payload is None or not payload.get("sub"):
        raise unauthorized
    require_database()
    user = get_user_by_id(str(payload["sub"]))
    if user is None:
        raise unauthorized
    return user

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import logging
from pathlib import Path

from fastapi import APIRouter, File, Form, UploadFile
from pydantic import ValidationError

from app.core.config import settings
from app.core.errors import AppError
from app.schemas.analysis import AppSubmission
from app.services.analysis_service import analyze_apk
from app.services.artifacts import publish_static_artifacts
from app.storage.local import LocalTempStorage
from app.utils.files import new_job_id, safe_filename
from app.utils.hashing import stream_to_file

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
router = APIRouter()
storage = LocalTempStorage()

ALLOWED_SUFFIXES = {".apk"}


def _validate_filename(filename: str | None) -> str:
    if not filename:
        raise AppError("INVALID_FILE", "The uploaded file is missing a name.")
    name = safe_filename(filename, fallback="upload.apk")
    suffix = Path(name).suffix.lower()
    if suffix not in ALLOWED_SUFFIXES:
        raise AppError("INVALID_FILE", "The uploaded file is not a valid Android APK.")
    return name


def _build_submission(
    app_name: str | None,
    app_description: str | None,
    privacy_policy: str | None,
    play_store_url: str | None,
) -> AppSubmission:
    try:
        return AppSubmission(
            app_name=app_name,
            app_description=app_description,
            privacy_policy=privacy_policy,
            play_store_url=play_store_url,
        )
    except ValidationError as exc:
        field = ".".join(str(part) for part in exc.errors()[0]["loc"]) or "submission"
        raise AppError(
            "INVALID_SUBMISSION",
            f"Field '{field}' is invalid: {exc.errors()[0]['msg']}",
        ) from exc


@router.post("/analyze")
async def analyze(
    file: UploadFile = File(...),
    app_name: str | None = Form(default=None),
    app_description: str | None = Form(default=None),
    privacy_policy: str | None = Form(default=None),
    play_store_url: str | None = Form(default=None),
) -> dict:
    original_name = _validate_filename(file.filename)
    submission = _build_submission(app_name, app_description, privacy_policy, play_store_url)
    job_id = new_job_id()
    apk_path = storage.apk_path(job_id)
    try:
        size, sha256 = await stream_to_file(
            file.read,
            apk_path,
            settings.max_apk_size_bytes,
        )
        logger.info("Accepted APK job=%s size=%s sha256=%s", job_id, size, sha256)
        try:
            result = await asyncio.wait_for(
                asyncio.to_thread(
                    analyze_apk,
                    apk_path,
                    file_name=original_name,
                    file_size=size,
                    sha256=sha256,
                    job_id=job_id,
                    storage=storage,
                    submission=submission,
                ),
                timeout=settings.analysis_timeout_seconds,
            )
        except asyncio.TimeoutError as exc:
            raise AppError(
                "ANALYSIS_TIMEOUT",
                "APK analysis exceeded the allowed time limit.",
                http_status=504,
            ) from exc
        publish_static_artifacts(job_id, result, storage)
        return result.model_dump()
    finally:
        await file.close()
        storage.delete_apk(job_id)

FILE: backend/app/api/v1/analyze_jobs.py

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
from pathlib import Path

from fastapi import APIRouter, File, Form, UploadFile

from app.api.v1.analyze import _build_submission, _validate_filename
from app.core.config import settings
from app.core.errors import AppError
from app.jobs.models import JobRecord, JobStatus
from app.jobs.store import get_job_store
from app.storage.local import LocalTempStorage
from app.utils.files import is_uuid, new_job_id
from app.utils.hashing import stream_to_file
from app.workers.pool import get_worker_pool
from app.workers.registry import get_worker_registry

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
router = APIRouter()
storage = LocalTempStorage()


@router.post("/analyze-apk")
async def create_analysis_job(
    file: UploadFile = File(...),
    app_name: str | None = Form(default=None),
    app_description: str | None = Form(default=None),
    privacy_policy: str | None = Form(default=None),
    play_store_url: str | None = Form(default=None),
    explore: bool = Form(default=True),
) -> dict:
    """Accept an APK and enqueue analysis+exploration on the worker pool.

    Returns immediately with a job id; poll ``GET /analyze-apk/{job_id}``.
    The uploaded APK is kept on disk for the worker and removed when the job ends.
    """
    original_name = _validate_filename(file.filename)
    submission = _build_submission(app_name, app_description, privacy_policy, play_store_url)
    job_id = new_job_id()
    apk_path = storage.apk_path(job_id)

    try:
        size, sha256 = await stream_to_file(
            file.read,
            apk_path,
            settings.max_apk_size_bytes,
        )
    except Exception:
        storage.delete_job(job_id)
        raise
    finally:
        await file.close()

    logger.info("Queued analysis job=%s size=%s explore=%s", job_id, size, explore)
    store = get_job_store()
    record = JobRecord(
        id=job_id,
        status=JobStatus.QUEUED,
        file_name=original_name,
        file_size=size,
        sha256=sha256,
        exploration_requested=bool(explore),
    )
    try:
        store.create(record)
    except Exception:
        storage.delete_job(job_id)
        logger.exception("Could not create job record %s", job_id)
        raise AppError(
            "JOB_CREATE_FAILED",
            "The analysis job could not be created.",
            http_status=500,
        )

    pool = get_worker_pool()
    ok = pool.enqueue(
        job_id,
        apk_path=Path(apk_path),
        file_name=original_name,
        file_size=size,
        sha256=sha256,
        submission=submission,
        explore=bool(explore),
        storage=storage,
    )
    if not ok:
        logger.warning("Job %s was not newly enqueued (duplicate or draining)", job_id)

    snap = pool.snapshot()
    return {
        "success": True,
        "job_id": job_id,
        "status": "processing",
        "status_url": f"/api/v1/analyze-apk/{job_id}",
        "queue": {
            "queued": snap["queued"],
            "active": snap["active"],
            "concurrency": snap["concurrency"],
        },
    }


@router.get("/analyze-apk/{job_id}")
def get_analysis_job(job_id: str) -> dict:
    """Poll job progress; returns the unified result once completed."""
    if not is_uuid(job_id):
        raise AppError("NOT_FOUND", "Unknown job.", http_status=404)
    record = get_job_store().get(job_id)
    if record is None:
        raise AppError("NOT_FOUND", "Unknown job.", http_status=404)
    payload = record.public_payload()
    worker = get_worker_registry().snapshot_for_job(job_id)
    if worker:
        payload["worker"] = worker
    return payload


@router.post("/analyze-apk/{job_id}/cancel")
def cancel_analysis_job(job_id: str) -> dict:
    """Request cooperative cancellation of a running/queued analysis job."""
    if not is_uuid(job_id):
        raise AppError("NOT_FOUND", "Unknown job.", http_status=404)
    store = get_job_store()
    record = store.get(job_id)
    if record is None:
        raise AppError("NOT_FOUND", "Unknown job.", http_status=404)
    if record.status in {
        JobStatus.COMPLETED,
        JobStatus.FAILED,
        JobStatus.CANCELLED,
        JobStatus.TIMEOUT,
        JobStatus.PARTIAL,
    }:
        return {
            "success": True,
            "job_id": job_id,
            "status": record.status.value,
            "message": "Job already finished.",
        }
    pool = get_worker_pool()
    pool.request_cancel(job_id)
    snap = pool.snapshot()
    if job_id in snap.get("queued_job_ids", []):
        with pool._lock:
            pool._queue = [q for q in pool._queue if q.job_id != job_id]
        from datetime import datetime, timezone

        store.update(
            job_id,
            status=JobStatus.CANCELLED,
            error_code="CANCELLED",
            error_message="Cancelled while queued.",
            finished_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc),
        )
        return {
            "success": True,
            "job_id": job_id,
            "status": "cancelled",
            "message": "Queued job cancelled.",
        }
    return {
        "success": True,
        "job_id": job_id,
        "status": "cancelling",
        "message": "Cancel signal sent to worker.",
    }


@router.get("/workers/health")
def workers_health() -> dict:
    """Lightweight worker/queue health snapshot (no secrets)."""
    pool = get_worker_pool()
    return {
        "success": True,
        "pool": pool.snapshot(),
    }

from __future__ import annotations

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends

from app.api.deps import get_current_user, require_database
from app.core.errors import AppError
from app.core.security import create_access_token, hash_password, verify_password
from app.db.user_repository import (
    EmailAlreadyRegistered,
    create_user,
    get_credentials_by_email,
)
from app.schemas.auth import AuthResponse, LoginRequest, SignupRequest, UserProfile

router = APIRouter(prefix="/auth")


def _auth_response(user: UserProfile) -> AuthResponse:
    token, expires_in = create_access_token(user.id)
    return AuthResponse(access_token=token, expires_in=expires_in, user=user)


@router.post("/signup", response_model=AuthResponse, status_code=201)
def signup(payload: SignupRequest) -> AuthResponse:
    require_database()
    try:
        user = create_user(
            full_name=payload.full_name,
            company_name=payload.company_name,
            email=str(payload.email),
            password_hash=hash_password(payload.password),
        )
    except EmailAlreadyRegistered as exc:
        raise AppError(
            "EMAIL_ALREADY_REGISTERED",
            "An account with this email address already exists.",
            http_status=409,
        ) from exc
    return _auth_response(user)


@router.post("/login", response_model=AuthResponse)
def login(payload: LoginRequest) -> AuthResponse:
    require_database()
    found = get_credentials_by_email(str(payload.email))
    if found is None or not verify_password(payload.password, found[1]):
        raise AppError(
            "INVALID_CREDENTIALS",
            "Email address or password is incorrect.",
            http_status=401,
        )
    return _auth_response(found[0])


@router.get("/me", response_model=UserProfile)
def current_user(user: UserProfile = Depends(get_current_user)) -> UserProfile:
    return user

from __future__ import annotations

from fastapi import APIRouter
from fastapi.responses import Response

from app.core.errors import AppError
from app.storage.images import load_screenshot
from app.storage.local import LocalTempStorage
from app.utils.files import is_uuid, safe_filename

router = APIRouter()
storage = LocalTempStorage()


@router.get("/files/{job_id}/{file_name}")
def get_file(job_id: str, file_name: str) -> Response:
    if not is_uuid(job_id):
        raise AppError("INVALID_FILE", "Unknown file.")
    name = safe_filename(file_name)
    if name != file_name or "/" in file_name or "\\" in file_name or ".." in file_name:
        raise AppError("INVALID_FILE", "Unknown file.")
    loaded = load_screenshot(job_id, name, storage)
    if loaded is None:
        raise AppError("INVALID_FILE", "Unknown file.", http_status=404)
    data, content_type = loaded
    return Response(content=data, media_type=content_type)

from fastapi import APIRouter

from app.core.config import settings
from app.db.session import database_ready, engine
from app.jobs.store import store_backend
from app.modules.apk_analyzer.aapt import aapt_available
from app.modules.exploration.adb import capability_report
from app.storage.s3 import s3_ready

router = APIRouter()


@router.get("/health")
def health() -> dict:
    db_configured = engine is not None
    db_ok = database_ready() if db_configured else False
    return {
        "status": "ok",
        "analyzer_version": settings.analyzer_version,
        "schema_version": settings.schema_version,
        "aapt_available": aapt_available(),
        "dex_analysis_enabled": settings.dex_analysis_enabled,
        "database": {
            "configured": db_configured,
            "ready": db_ok,
        },
        "screenshots": {
            "backend": (
                "s3" if settings.s3_enabled else "postgres" if db_ok else "local"
            ),
            "s3_configured": settings.s3_enabled,
            "s3_ready": s3_ready() if settings.s3_enabled else False,
        },
        "jobs": {"backend": store_backend()},
        "exploration": _exploration_status(),
    }


def _exploration_status() -> dict:
    """Never let a missing adb binary break the liveness check."""
    if not settings.exploration_enabled:
        return {"enabled": False, "adb_available": False, "ready": False}
    try:
        return capability_report()
    except Exception:
        return {"enabled": True, "adb_available": False, "ready": False}

"""HITL intervention actions for async analysis jobs (Phase 7)."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import logging
import time
from pathlib import Path

from fastapi import APIRouter
from fastapi.responses import FileResponse, HTMLResponse, Response

from app.core.config import settings
from app.core.errors import AppError
from app.jobs.models import JobStatus
from app.jobs.store import get_job_store
from app.modules.hitl import get_intervention_store, get_manager
from app.modules.hitl.intervention_types import InterventionStatus
from app.utils.files import is_uuid

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
router = APIRouter()


def _job_or_404(job_id: str):
    if not is_uuid(job_id):
        raise AppError("NOT_FOUND", "Unknown job.", http_status=404)
    record = get_job_store().get(job_id)
    if record is None:
        raise AppError("NOT_FOUND", "Unknown job.", http_status=404)
    return record


def _intervention_or_404(job_id: str, intervention_id: str):
    store = get_intervention_store()
    intervention = store.get(intervention_id)
    if intervention is None or intervention.job_id != job_id:
        raise AppError("NOT_FOUND", "Unknown intervention.", http_status=404)
    return intervention


@router.get("/analyze-apk/{job_id}/intervention/{intervention_id}/screenshot")
def get_intervention_screenshot(job_id: str, intervention_id: str):
    """Serve the screenshot captured when HITL paused.

    Prefers the local artifact file; falls back to S3 or common hitl folders so
    the operator popup keeps working even when the public S3 URL is broken.
    """
    from app.storage.s3 import download_object_bytes

    _job_or_404(job_id)
    intervention = _intervention_or_404(job_id, intervention_id)

    candidates: list[Path] = []
    if intervention.screenshot_path:
        candidates.append(Path(intervention.screenshot_path))
    package = (intervention.package or "").strip()
    if package:
        candidates.append(
            Path(settings.temp_root)
            / "screenshots"
            / package
            / job_id
            / "hitl"
            / f"{intervention_id}.png"
        )
    candidates.extend(
        [
            Path(settings.temp_root) / "jobs" / job_id / "hitl" / f"{intervention_id}.png",
            Path(settings.temp_root)
            / "screenshots"
            / job_id
            / job_id
            / "hitl"
            / f"{intervention_id}.png",
        ]
    )

    seen: set[str] = set()
    for path in candidates:
        resolved = str(path)
        if resolved in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(resolved)
        if path.is_file():
            return FileResponse(path, media_type="image/png")

    key = intervention.screenshot_s3_key
    if key:
        data = download_object_bytes(key)
        if data:
            return Response(content=data, media_type="image/png")

    raise AppError("NOT_FOUND", "Intervention screenshot not found.", http_status=404)


@router.post("/analyze-apk/{job_id}/intervention/{intervention_id}/continue")
def continue_intervention(job_id: str, intervention_id: str) -> dict:
    """Human already performed the action in the emulator — resume exploration."""
    record = _job_or_404(job_id)
    intervention = _intervention_or_404(job_id, intervention_id)
    if record.status is not JobStatus.WAITING_FOR_HUMAN:
        raise AppError(
            "INVALID_STATE",
            f"Job is not waiting for human (status={record.status.value}).",
            http_status=409,
        )
    if intervention.status is not InterventionStatus.WAITING:
        raise AppError(
            "INVALID_STATE",
            f"Intervention is not waiting (status={intervention.status.value}).",
            http_status=409,
        )

    manager = get_manager(job_id)
    if manager is None:
        raise AppError(
            "NO_WORKER",
            "No exploration worker is attached to this job.",
            http_status=409,
        )

    signaled = manager.signal_continue(intervention_id)
    if not signaled.get("success"):
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": signaled.get("message") or "Could not continue.",
        }

    deadline = time.monotonic() + 20.0
    while time.monotonic() < deadline:
        fresh = get_job_store().get(job_id)
        if fresh is None:
            break
        if fresh.status is JobStatus.WAITING_FOR_HUMAN:
            active = get_intervention_store().get_active_for_job(job_id)
            if active and active.intervention_id == intervention_id:
                time.sleep(0.25)
                continue
            return {
                "success": False,
                "message": "Human intervention is still required.",
                "job_id": job_id,
                "status": fresh.status.value,
                "intervention": fresh.intervention,
            }
        if fresh.status is JobStatus.RUNNING:
            return {
                "success": True,
                "message": "Exploration resumed.",
                "job_id": job_id,
                "status": fresh.status.value,
            }
        return {
            "success": True,
            "message": f"Job status is now {fresh.status.value}.",
            "job_id": job_id,
            "status": fresh.status.value,
        }

    fresh = get_job_store().get(job_id)
    if fresh and fresh.status is JobStatus.WAITING_FOR_HUMAN:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "Human intervention is still required.",
            "job_id": job_id,
            "status": fresh.status.value,
            "intervention": fresh.intervention,
        }
    return {
        "success": True,
        "message": "Continue signal accepted.",
        "job_id": job_id,
        "status": fresh.status.value if fresh else None,
    }


@router.post("/analyze-apk/{job_id}/intervention/{intervention_id}/skip")
def skip_intervention(job_id: str, intervention_id: str) -> dict:
    """Skip the intervention and resume exploration without treating it as completed."""
    record = _job_or_404(job_id)
    _intervention_or_404(job_id, intervention_id)
    if record.status is not JobStatus.WAITING_FOR_HUMAN:
        raise AppError(
            "INVALID_STATE",
            f"Job is not waiting for human (status={record.status.value}).",
            http_status=409,
        )
    manager = get_manager(job_id)
    if manager is None:
        raise AppError(
            "NO_WORKER",
            "No exploration worker is attached to this job.",
            http_status=409,
        )
    signaled = manager.signal_skip(intervention_id)
    return {
        "success": bool(signaled.get("success")),
        "message": signaled.get("message")
        or "Skipped; exploration will resume without completing consent/permission.",
        "job_id": job_id,
        "decision": "skip",
    }


@router.post("/analyze-apk/{job_id}/intervention/{intervention_id}/stop")
def stop_intervention(job_id: str, intervention_id: str) -> dict:
    """Stop screenshot exploration; keep static APK JSON analysis."""
    record = _job_or_404(job_id)
    _intervention_or_404(job_id, intervention_id)
    if record.status is not JobStatus.WAITING_FOR_HUMAN:
        raise AppError(
            "INVALID_STATE",
            f"Job is not waiting for human (status={record.status.value}).",
            http_status=409,
        )
    manager = get_manager(job_id)
    if manager is None:
        raise AppError(
            "NO_WORKER",
            "No exploration worker is attached to this job.",
            http_status=409,
        )
    signaled = manager.signal_stop(intervention_id)
    return {
        "success": bool(signaled.get("success")),
        "message": signaled.get("message")
        or "Stop accepted; exploration will end with a partial result.",
        "job_id": job_id,
        "decision": "stop",
    }

  <script>
    const jobId = {job_id_json};
    const statusEl = document.getElementById("statusBadge");
    const progressBar = document.getElementById("progressBar");
    const stageLine = document.getElementById("stageLine");
    const idleHint = document.getElementById("idleHint");
    const overlay = document.getElementById("hitlOverlay");
    const resultPanel = document.getElementById("resultPanel");
    const resultLine = document.getElementById("resultLine");
    const toast = document.getElementById("toast");
    let interventionId = null;
    let lastInterventionId = null;
    let pollTimer = null;

    function badgeClass(status) {{
      if (status === "waiting_for_human") return "waiting";
      if (status === "running" || status === "processing" || status === "queued") return "running";
      return "done";
    }}

    function showToast(text, isErr) {{
      toast.textContent = text || "";
      toast.className = "toast show" + (isErr ? " err" : "");
      clearTimeout(showToast._t);
      showToast._t = setTimeout(() => {{ toast.className = "toast"; }}, 4500);
    }}

    function openModal(intervention) {{
      interventionId = intervention.id;
      document.getElementById("hitlType").textContent =
        intervention.type_label || intervention.type || "—";
      document.getElementById("hitlTitle").textContent = intervention.title || "—";
      document.getElementById("hitlSuggested").textContent =
        intervention.suggested_action
        || "Complete the required step in the emulator, then click Continue.";
      document.getElementById("hitlMessage").textContent = intervention.message || "";
      const stepsEl = document.getElementById("hitlSteps");
      const steps = Array.isArray(intervention.steps) ? intervention.steps.filter(Boolean) : [];
      if (steps.length) {{
        stepsEl.innerHTML = steps.map((s) => "<li>" + escapeHtml(String(s)) + "</li>").join("");
      }} else {{
        stepsEl.innerHTML =
          "<li>Look at the emulator window (screenshot below for reference).</li>" +
          "<li>Complete the action (tap, type with keyboard, or select an option).</li>" +
          "<li>Come back here and click <strong>Continue</strong>.</li>";
      }}
      const img = document.getElementById("hitlShot");
      const caption = document.getElementById("hitlShotCaption");
      const localShot =
        `/api/v1/analyze-apk/${{jobId}}/intervention/${{intervention.id}}/screenshot`;
      // Prefer same-origin API screenshot (reliable). Fall back to S3 URL if needed.
      const primary =
        (intervention.screenshot && String(intervention.screenshot).startsWith("/"))
          ? intervention.screenshot
          : localShot;
      const secondary = intervention.screenshot_s3_url || null;
      img.onload = () => {{
        img.hidden = false;
        caption.hidden = false;
      }};
      img.onerror = () => {{
        if (secondary && img.dataset.triedS3 !== "1") {{
          img.dataset.triedS3 = "1";
          img.src = secondary + (secondary.includes("?") ? "&" : "?") + "t=" + Date.now();
          return;
        }}
        if (img.dataset.triedLocal !== "1" && img.src.indexOf(localShot) === -1) {{
          img.dataset.triedLocal = "1";
          img.src = localShot + "?t=" + Date.now();
          return;
        }}
        img.hidden = true;
        caption.hidden = true;
      }};
      img.dataset.triedS3 = "";
      img.dataset.triedLocal = "";
      img.src = primary + (primary.includes("?") ? "&" : "?") + "t=" + Date.now();
      // Show immediately; hide again only if both sources fail.
      img.hidden = false;
      caption.hidden = false;
      overlay.classList.add("open");
      idleHint.hidden = true;
      if (intervention.id !== lastInterventionId) {{
        lastInterventionId = intervention.id;
        try {{
          if (window.Notification && Notification.permission === "granted") {{
            new Notification("AndroGuard needs your approval", {{
              body: intervention.suggested_action || intervention.title || "Human intervention required",
            }});
          }}
        }} catch (_) {{}}
      }}
    }}

    function escapeHtml(text) {{
      return String(text)
        .replace(/&/g, "&amp;")
        .replace(/</g, "&lt;")
        .replace(/>/g, "&gt;")
        .replace(/"/g, "&quot;");
    }}

    function closeModal() {{
      overlay.classList.remove("open");
      interventionId = null;
      idleHint.hidden = false;
    }}

    async function refresh() {{
      const res = await fetch(`/api/v1/analyze-apk/${{jobId}}`);
      const body = await res.json();
      const status = body.status || "unknown";
      statusEl.textContent = status;
      statusEl.className = "badge " + badgeClass(status);
      progressBar.style.width = (body.progress || 0) + "%";
      stageLine.textContent = "Stage: " + (body.stage || "—") + " · Progress: " + (body.progress || 0) + "%";

      if (status === "waiting_for_human" && body.intervention) {{
        openModal(body.intervention);
      }} else if (overlay.classList.contains("open") && status !== "waiting_for_human") {{
        closeModal();
      }}

      if (["completed", "failed", "cancelled", "timeout", "partial"].includes(status)) {{
        resultPanel.hidden = false;
        resultLine.textContent = "Job finished with status: " + status;
        closeModal();
        if (pollTimer) clearInterval(pollTimer);
      }}
    }}

    async function act(kind) {{
      if (!interventionId) return;
      ["btnContinue", "btnSkip", "btnStop"].forEach(id => document.getElementById(id).disabled = true);
      try {{
        const res = await fetch(
          `/api/v1/analyze-apk/${{jobId}}/intervention/${{interventionId}}/${{kind}}`,
          {{ method: "POST" }}
        );
        const body = await res.json();
        if (!res.ok || body.success === false) {{
          showToast(body.message || (body.error && body.error.message) || "Action failed", true);
          if (body.intervention) openModal(body.intervention);
        }} else {{
          showToast(body.message || "OK");
          if (kind !== "continue" || body.status !== "waiting_for_human") {{
            closeModal();
          }}
        }}
        await refresh();
      }} catch (err) {{
        showToast(String(err), true);
      }} finally {{
        ["btnContinue", "btnSkip", "btnStop"].forEach(id => document.getElementById(id).disabled = false);
      }}
    }}

    document.getElementById("btnContinue").onclick = () => act("continue");
    document.getElementById("btnSkip").onclick = () => act("skip");
    document.getElementById("btnStop").onclick = () => act("stop");

    if (window.Notification && Notification.permission === "default") {{
      Notification.requestPermission().catch(() => {{}});
    }}

    refresh();
    pollTimer = setInterval(refresh, 1500);
  </script>
</body>
</html>
"""


@router.get("/analyze-apk/{job_id}/ui", response_class=HTMLResponse)
def analysis_job_ui(job_id: str) -> HTMLResponse:
    """Operator UI: job progress + auto popup for HITL Continue/Skip/Stop."""
    _job_or_404(job_id)
    html = _HITL_PANEL_HTML.format(job_id=job_id, job_id_json=json.dumps(job_id))
    return HTMLResponse(html)

================================================================================
FILE: backend/app/core/emulator_lock.py
================================================================================
"""Process-wide emulator exclusivity (Phase 12I: multi-slot device pool).

A single AVD must never be driven by two analysis jobs at once. When multiple
emulator serials are configured, each job gets an exclusive slot. HITL pause
paths share the same pool so waiting for a human does not free the device
for another job.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
from contextlib import contextmanager
from typing import Iterator

from app.workers.device_pool import DeviceSlot, get_device_pool

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


def try_acquire_emulator(job_id: str) -> bool:
    """Non-blocking acquire. Returns False if no slot is available."""
    pool = get_device_pool()
    if pool.holder(job_id) is not None:
        return True
    slot = pool.acquire(job_id, timeout=0.0)
    return slot is not None


def acquire_emulator(job_id: str, *, blocking: bool = True, timeout: float | None = None) -> bool:
    """Acquire a device slot for ``job_id``."""
    pool = get_device_pool()
    if pool.holder(job_id) is not None:
        return True
    if not blocking and timeout is None:
        timeout = 0.0
    slot = pool.acquire(job_id, timeout=timeout)
    return slot is not None


def release_emulator(job_id: str | None = None) -> None:
    """Release the device slot held by ``job_id``."""
    if not job_id:
        return
    get_device_pool().release(job_id)


def current_emulator_holder() -> str | None:
    snap = get_device_pool().snapshot()
    held = snap.get("held_jobs") or []
    return held[0] if held else None


def emulator_is_locked() -> bool:
    return get_device_pool().active_count() > 0


def current_slot(job_id: str) -> DeviceSlot | None:
    return get_device_pool().holder(job_id)


@contextmanager
def emulator_session(job_id: str) -> Iterator[None]:
    """Hold an exclusive device slot for the duration of a job's device stage.

    If the worker pool already reserved a slot for this job, reuse it (do not
    double-acquire).
    """
    pool = get_device_pool()
    owned = pool.holder(job_id) is not None
    if not owned:
        slot = pool.acquire(job_id, timeout=None)
        if slot is None:
            raise RuntimeError(f"Could not acquire emulator slot for job {job_id}")
    try:
        yield
    finally:
        if not owned:
            pool.release(job_id)

from typing import Any

from fastapi import Request
from fastapi.responses import JSONResponse


class AppError(Exception):
    def __init__(self, code: str, message: str, http_status: int = 400) -> None:
        super().__init__(message)
        self.code = code
        self.message = message
        self.http_status = http_status


def error_body(code: str, message: str, request_id: str | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    error: dict[str, Any] = {"code": code, "message": message}
    if request_id:
        error["request_id"] = request_id
    return {"error": error}


async def app_error_handler(request: Request, exc: AppError) -> JSONResponse:
    request_id = getattr(request.state, "request_id", None)
    return JSONResponse(
        status_code=exc.http_status,
        content=error_body(exc.code, exc.message, request_id),
    )


async def unhandled_error_handler(request: Request, exc: Exception) -> JSONResponse:
    request_id = getattr(request.state, "request_id", None)
    return JSONResponse(
        status_code=500,
        content=error_body(
            "ANALYZER_ERROR",
            "An internal analyzer error occurred.",
            request_id,
        ),
    )

import logging
import sys

from app.core.config import settings


def setup_logging() -> None:
    level = getattr(logging, settings.log_level.upper(), logging.INFO)
    logging.basicConfig(
        level=level,
        format="%(asctime)s %(levelname)s [%(name)s] %(message)s",
        stream=sys.stdout,
        force=True,
    )
    logging.getLogger("androguard").setLevel(logging.ERROR)
    logging.getLogger("PIL").setLevel(logging.WARNING)
    try:
        from loguru import logger as loguru_logger

        loguru_logger.disable("androguard")
    except Exception:
        pass

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
from typing import Any

import bcrypt
import jwt

from app.core.config import settings


def hash_password(password: str) -> str:
    return bcrypt.hashpw(password.encode("utf-8"), bcrypt.gensalt()).decode("utf-8")


def verify_password(password: str, password_hash: str) -> bool:
    try:
        return bcrypt.checkpw(password.encode("utf-8"), password_hash.encode("utf-8"))
    except ValueError:
        return False


def create_access_token(subject: str) -> tuple[str, int]:
    expires_in = settings.access_token_expire_minutes * 60
    issued_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
    payload = {
        "sub": subject,
        "iat": issued_at,
        "exp": issued_at + timedelta(seconds=expires_in),
    }
    token = jwt.encode(payload, settings.jwt_secret, algorithm=settings.jwt_algorithm)
    return token, expires_in


def decode_access_token(token: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
    try:
        return jwt.decode(token, settings.jwt_secret, algorithms=[settings.jwt_algorithm])
    except jwt.PyJWTError:
        return None

FILE: backend/app/core/xmlutil.py

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any
from xml.etree.ElementTree import Element

ANDROID_NS = "http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android"
NS = f"{{{ANDROID_NS}}}"


def android_attr(el: Element, name: str) -> str | None:
    value = el.get(f"{NS}{name}")
    if value is None:
        value = el.get(name)
    return value


def parse_bool(value: str | None) -> bool | None:
    if value is None:
        return None
    lowered = value.strip().lower()
    if lowered in {"true", "1"}:
        return True
    if lowered in {"false", "0"}:
        return False
    return None


def parse_int(value: str | None) -> int | None:
    if value is None or value == "":
        return None
    text = value.strip()
    try:
        if text.startswith("0x") or text.startswith("0X"):
            return int(text, 16)
        return int(text, 10)
    except ValueError:
        return None


def resolve_component_name(package: str, raw: str | None) -> str | None:
    if not raw:
        return None
    if raw.startswith("."):
        return f"{package}{raw}"
    if "." not in raw:
        return f"{package}.{raw}"
    return raw


def local_tag(el: Element) -> str:
    tag = el.tag
    if isinstance(tag, str) and tag.startswith("{"):
        return tag.split("}", 1)[1]
    return str(tag)


def find_application(manifest: Element) -> Element | None:
    app = manifest.find("application")
    if app is not None:
        return app
    for child in list(manifest):
        if local_tag(child) == "application":
            return child
    return None


def children_by_tag(parent: Element, tag: str) -> list[Element]:
    matches: list[Element] = []
    for child in list(parent):
        if local_tag(child) == tag:
            matches.append(child)
    return matches


def iter_descendants(root: Element) -> list[Element]:
    return list(root.iter())


def typed_value(raw: str | None) -> tuple[Any, str]:
    if raw is None:
        return None, "null"
    if raw.startswith("@") or raw.startswith("res/"):
        return raw, "resource"
    lowered = raw.strip().lower()
    if lowered in {"true", "false"}:
        return lowered == "true", "boolean"
    as_int = parse_int(raw)
    if as_int is not None and str(as_int) == raw.strip().lstrip("+"):
        return as_int, "integer"
    if raw.strip().isdigit() or (raw.strip().startswith("-") and raw.strip()[1:].isdigit()):
        return int(raw.strip()), "integer"
    return raw, "string"

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime

from sqlalchemy import (
    BigInteger,
    Boolean,
    DateTime,
    Float,
    ForeignKey,
    Integer,
    LargeBinary,
    String,
    Text,
    UniqueConstraint,
    func,
)
from sqlalchemy.dialects.postgresql import JSONB
from sqlalchemy.orm import DeclarativeBase, Mapped, mapped_column


class Base(DeclarativeBase):
    pass


class User(Base):
    __tablename__ = "users"

    id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(36), primary_key=True)
    full_name: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(120))
    company_name: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(160))
    email: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(320), unique=True, index=True)
    password_hash: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(255))
    created_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(
        DateTime(timezone=True),
        server_default=func.now(),
        nullable=False,
    )


class AnalysisRecord(Base):
    __tablename__ = "analyses"

    id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(36), primary_key=True)
    sha256: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(64), index=True)

"""Phase 11 persistence helpers for screenshot runs, screenshots, and HITL."""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Any, Iterable, Sequence

from sqlalchemy import select

from app.db.models import HumanIntervention, Screenshot, ScreenshotRun
from app.db.session import SessionLocal, engine

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

# Public DB statuses for human_interventions (Phase 11 contract).
HITL_DB_STATUSES = frozenset({"waiting", "continued", "skipped", "stopped", "timeout"})


def _utcnow() -> datetime:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc)


def _db_ready() -> bool:
    return engine is not None and SessionLocal is not None


def map_hitl_status_to_db(status: Any, *, decision: Any = None) -> str:
    """Map in-memory HITL enums/strings onto Phase 11 DB statuses."""
    raw = getattr(status, "value", status)
    text = str(raw or "").strip().lower()
    if text in {"resolved", "continue", "continued"}:
        return "continued"
    if text in HITL_DB_STATUSES:
        return text
    decision_raw = getattr(decision, "value", decision)
    decision_text = str(decision_raw or "").strip().lower()
    if decision_text == "continue":
        return "continued"
    if decision_text in {"skip", "skipped"}:
        return "skipped"
    if decision_text in {"stop", "stopped"}:
        return "stopped"
    if decision_text == "timeout":
        return "timeout"
    return "waiting"


def start_screenshot_run(
    *,
    run_id: str,
    app_id: str,
    job_id: str,
    status: str = "running",
) -> ScreenshotRun | None:
    """Create or refresh a screenshot run row. No-op when DB is unavailable."""
    if not _db_ready():
        return None
    assert SessionLocal is not None
    session = SessionLocal()
    try:
        row = session.get(ScreenshotRun, run_id)
        if row is None:
            row = ScreenshotRun(
                run_id=run_id,
                app_id=app_id,
                job_id=job_id,
                status=status,
                started_at=_utcnow(),
            )
            session.add(row)
        else:
            row.app_id = app_id
            row.job_id = job_id
            if row.status in {"failed", "completed"} and status == "running":
                row.status = "running"
                row.completed_at = None
        session.commit()
        session.refresh(row)
        return row
    except Exception:
        session.rollback()
        logger.exception("Failed to start screenshot_run %s", run_id)
        return None
    finally:
        session.close()


def complete_screenshot_run(
    *,
    run_id: str,
    status: str = "completed",
    total_screenshots: int = 0,
    total_pages: int = 0,
    total_ad_variations: int = 0,
) -> ScreenshotRun | None:
    if not _db_ready():
        return None
    assert SessionLocal is not None
    session = SessionLocal()
    try:
        row = session.get(ScreenshotRun, run_id)
        if row is None:
            logger.warning("complete_screenshot_run: missing run %s", run_id)
            return None
        row.status = status
        row.completed_at = _utcnow()
        row.total_screenshots = int(total_screenshots)
        row.total_pages = int(total_pages)
        row.total_ad_variations = int(total_ad_variations)
        session.commit()
        session.refresh(row)
        return row
    except Exception:
        session.rollback()
        logger.exception("Failed to complete screenshot_run %s", run_id)
        return None
    finally:
        session.close()


def _parse_created_at(value: Any) -> datetime:
    if isinstance(value, datetime):
        return value if value.tzinfo else value.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
    if isinstance(value, str) and value.strip():
        try:
            parsed = datetime.fromisoformat(value.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
            return parsed if parsed.tzinfo else parsed.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
        except ValueError:
            pass
    return _utcnow()


def persist_screenshots_for_run(
    *,
    run_id: str,
    items: Sequence[Any],
) -> int:
    """Upsert Phase 11 ``screenshots`` rows from ScreenshotMetadata-like objects."""
    if not _db_ready() or not items:
        return 0
    assert SessionLocal is not None
    session = SessionLocal()
    saved = 0
    try:
        if session.get(ScreenshotRun, run_id) is None:
            logger.warning("persist_screenshots_for_run: missing run %s", run_id)
            return 0
        for item in items:
            if isinstance(item, dict):
                data = item
            else:
                data = {
                    "id": getattr(item, "screenshot_id", None),
                    "page": getattr(item, "page", "unknown"),
                    "state_id": getattr(item, "state_id", None),
                    "s3_key": getattr(item, "s3_key", None),
                    "width": getattr(item, "width", None),
                    "height": getattr(item, "height", None),
                    "trigger_action": getattr(item, "triggering_action", None)
                    or getattr(item, "trigger_action", None),
                    "ad_detected": bool(getattr(item, "ad_detected", False)),
                    "ad_type": getattr(item, "ad_type", None),
                    "ad_position": getattr(item, "ad_position", None),
                    "confidence": getattr(item, "confidence", None),
                    "created_at": getattr(item, "created_at", None),
                    "kind": getattr(item, "kind", "state"),
                }
            if str(data.get("kind") or "state") == "hitl":
                continue
            state_id = str(data.get("state_id") or "").strip()
            if not state_id:
                continue
            shot_id = str(data.get("id") or data.get("screenshot_id") or "").strip()
            if not shot_id:
                shot_id = f"{run_id}:{state_id}"[:64]

            existing = session.get(Screenshot, shot_id)
            if existing is None:
                stmt = select(Screenshot).where(
                    Screenshot.run_id == run_id,
                    Screenshot.state_id == state_id,
                )
                existing = session.scalars(stmt).first()

            payload = {
                "run_id": run_id,
                "page": str(data.get("page") or "unknown")[:256],
                "state_id": state_id[:128],
                "s3_key": data.get("s3_key"),
                "width": data.get("width"),
                "height": data.get("height"),
                "trigger_action": (str(data["trigger_action"])[:128] if data.get("trigger_action") else None),
                "ad_detected": bool(data.get("ad_detected")),
                "ad_type": (str(data["ad_type"])[:64] if data.get("ad_type") else None),
                "ad_position": (
                    str(data["ad_position"])[:64] if data.get("ad_position") else None
                ),
                "confidence": (
                    float(data["confidence"])
                    if isinstance(data.get("confidence"), (int, float))
                    else None
                ),
                "created_at": _parse_created_at(data.get("created_at")),
            }
            if existing is None:
                session.add(Screenshot(id=shot_id[:64], **payload))
            else:
                for key, value in payload.items():
                    setattr(existing, key, value)
            saved += 1
        session.commit()
        return saved
    except Exception:
        session.rollback()
        logger.exception("Failed to persist screenshots for run %s", run_id)
        return 0
    finally:
        session.close()


def upsert_human_intervention(
    *,
    intervention_id: str,
    job_id: str,
    run_id: str | None,
    type: str,
    title: str,
    message: str,
    screenshot_s3_key: str | None = None,
    status: str = "waiting",
    created_at: datetime | None = None,
    resolved_at: datetime | None = None,
    resolution: str | None = None,
    timeout_at: datetime | None = None,
    decision: Any = None,
) -> HumanIntervention | None:
    if not _db_ready():
        return None
    assert SessionLocal is not None
    db_status = map_hitl_status_to_db(status, decision=decision)
    session = SessionLocal()
    try:
        # Avoid FK failure if the run row is missing (best-effort soft link).
        linked_run = run_id
        if linked_run and session.get(ScreenshotRun, linked_run) is None:
            linked_run = None

        row = session.get(HumanIntervention, intervention_id)
        if row is None:
            row = HumanIntervention(
                intervention_id=intervention_id,
                job_id=job_id,
                run_id=linked_run,
                type=str(type)[:64],
                title=(title or "Human action required")[:256],
                message=message or "",
                screenshot_s3_key=screenshot_s3_key,
                status=db_status,
                created_at=created_at or _utcnow(),
                resolved_at=resolved_at,
                resolution=resolution,
                timeout_at=timeout_at,
            )
            session.add(row)
        else:
            row.job_id = job_id
            row.run_id = linked_run
            row.type = str(type)[:64]
            row.title = (title or row.title)[:256]
            row.message = message if message is not None else row.message
            if screenshot_s3_key is not None:
                row.screenshot_s3_key = screenshot_s3_key
            row.status = db_status
            if resolved_at is not None:
                row.resolved_at = resolved_at
            if resolution is not None:
                row.resolution = resolution
            if timeout_at is not None:
                row.timeout_at = timeout_at
        session.commit()
        session.refresh(row)
        return row
    except Exception:
        session.rollback()
        logger.exception("Failed to upsert human_intervention %s", intervention_id)
        return None
    finally:
        session.close()


def persist_intervention_from_dataclass(intervention: Any) -> HumanIntervention | None:
    """Persist an in-memory HITL Intervention dataclass."""
    decision = getattr(intervention, "decision", None)
    status = getattr(intervention, "status", "waiting")
    db_status = map_hitl_status_to_db(status, decision=decision)
    resolution = None
    if decision is not None:
        resolution = str(getattr(decision, "value", decision))
    elif db_status != "waiting":
        resolution = db_status
    return upsert_human_intervention(
        intervention_id=str(getattr(intervention, "intervention_id")),
        job_id=str(getattr(intervention, "job_id")),
        run_id=getattr(intervention, "run_id", None),
        type=str(getattr(getattr(intervention, "type", None), "value", getattr(intervention, "type", "unknown"))),
        title=str(getattr(intervention, "title", "") or "Human action required"),
        message=str(getattr(intervention, "message", "") or ""),
        screenshot_s3_key=getattr(intervention, "screenshot_s3_key", None),
        status=db_status,
        created_at=getattr(intervention, "created_at", None),
        resolved_at=getattr(intervention, "resolved_at", None),
        resolution=resolution,
        timeout_at=getattr(intervention, "timeout_at", None),
        decision=decision,
    )


def summarize_publish_metadata(items: Iterable[Any]) -> dict[str, int]:
    """Derive run totals from published screenshot metadata."""
    pages: set[str] = set()
    total = 0
    ads = 0
    for item in items:
        kind = getattr(item, "kind", None)
        if isinstance(item, dict):
            kind = item.get("kind", "state")
            page = str(item.get("page") or "unknown")
            ad = bool(item.get("ad_detected"))
        else:
            if kind == "hitl":
                continue
            page = str(getattr(item, "page", None) or "unknown")
            ad = bool(getattr(item, "ad_detected", False))
        if kind == "hitl":
            continue
        total += 1
        pages.add(page)
        if ad:
            ads += 1
    return {
        "total_screenshots": total,
        "total_pages": len(pages),
        "total_ad_variations": ads,
    }
