from __future__ import annotations

import logging

from sqlalchemy import select

from app.db.models import AnalysisRecord, ScreenshotFile
from app.db.session import SessionLocal, engine
from app.schemas.analysis import AnalysisResponse, ScreenshotInfo

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


def persist_analysis(job_id: str, response: AnalysisResponse) -> None:
    if engine is None or SessionLocal is None:
        return
    payload = response.model_dump()
    record = AnalysisRecord(
        id=job_id,
        sha256=response.data.apk.sha256,
        package_name=response.data.apk.package_name,
        file_name=response.data.apk.file_name,
        file_size=response.data.apk.file_size,
        status=response.status,
        analyzer_version=response.data.analysis.analyzer_version,
        result=payload,
    )
    session = SessionLocal()
    try:
        session.merge(record)
        session.commit()
    except Exception:
        session.rollback()
        logger.exception("Failed to persist analysis %s", job_id)
        raise
    finally:
        session.close()


def get_analysis(job_id: str) -> dict | None:
    if engine is None or SessionLocal is None:
        return None
    session = SessionLocal()
    try:
        record = session.get(AnalysisRecord, job_id)
        if record is None:
            return None
        return record.result
    finally:
        session.close()


def _submitted_app_name(result: dict | None) -> str | None:
    if not isinstance(result, dict):
        return None
    submission = result.get("data", {}).get("submission")
    return submission.get("app_name") if isinstance(submission, dict) else None


def list_analyses(limit: int = 20) -> list[dict]:
    if engine is None or SessionLocal is None:
        return []
    session = SessionLocal()
    try:
        stmt = (
            select(AnalysisRecord)
            .order_by(AnalysisRecord.created_at.desc())
            .limit(min(limit, 100))
        )
        rows = session.scalars(stmt).all()
        return [
            {
                "id": row.id,
                "sha256": row.sha256,
                "package_name": row.package_name,
                "file_name": row.file_name,
                "file_size": row.file_size,
                "app_name": _submitted_app_name(row.result),
                "status": row.status,
                "created_at": row.created_at.isoformat() if row.created_at else None,
            }
            for row in rows
        ]
    finally:
        session.close()


CONTENT_TYPES = {
    "png": "image/png",
    "jpg": "image/jpeg",
    "jpeg": "image/jpeg",
    "webp": "image/webp",
    "gif": "image/gif",
}


def persist_screenshots(job_id: str, screenshots: list[ScreenshotInfo], files: dict[str, bytes]) -> int:
    if engine is None or SessionLocal is None or not files:
        return 0
    session = SessionLocal()
    saved = 0
    try:
        for item in screenshots:
            data = files.get(item.file_name)
            if not data:
                continue
            stmt = select(ScreenshotFile).where(
                ScreenshotFile.analysis_id == job_id,
                ScreenshotFile.file_name == item.file_name,
            )
            row = session.scalars(stmt).first()
            content_type = CONTENT_TYPES.get((item.format or "").lower(), "application/octet-stream")
            if row is None:
                session.add(
                    ScreenshotFile(
                        analysis_id=job_id,
                        file_name=item.file_name,
                        original_path=item.original_path,
                        content_type=content_type,
                        width=item.width,
                        height=item.height,
                        byte_size=len(data),
                        data=data,
                    )
                )
            else:
                row.original_path = item.original_path
                row.content_type = content_type
                row.width = item.width
                row.height = item.height
                row.byte_size = len(data)
                row.data = data
            saved += 1
        session.commit()
        return saved
    except Exception:
        session.rollback()
        logger.exception("Failed to persist screenshots for %s", job_id)
        raise
    finally:
        session.close()


def get_screenshot(job_id: str, file_name: str) -> tuple[bytes, str] | None:
    if engine is None or SessionLocal is None:
        return None
    session = SessionLocal()
    try:
        stmt = select(ScreenshotFile).where(
            ScreenshotFile.analysis_id == job_id,
            ScreenshotFile.file_name == file_name,
        )
        row = session.scalars(stmt).first()
        if row is None:
            return None
        return row.data, row.content_type
    finally:
        session.close()

from __future__ import annotations

import logging

from sqlalchemy import create_engine, text
from sqlalchemy.engine import Engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session, sessionmaker
from sqlalchemy.pool import NullPool

from app.core.config import settings

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

engine: Engine | None = None
SessionLocal: sessionmaker[Session] | None = None


def _sqlalchemy_url(url: str) -> str:
    if url.startswith("postgres://"):
        url = "postgresql://" + url[len("postgres://") :]
    if url.startswith("postgresql://") and "+psycopg" not in url and "+psycopg2" not in url:
        return "postgresql+psycopg://" + url[len("postgresql://") :]
    return url


def init_engine() -> Engine | None:
    global engine, SessionLocal
    url = (settings.database_url or "").strip()
    if not url:
        logger.info("DATABASE_URL is not set; analysis history will not be persisted.")
        engine = None
        SessionLocal = None
        return None
    engine = create_engine(
        _sqlalchemy_url(url),
        poolclass=NullPool,
        connect_args={"prepare_threshold": None},
    )
    SessionLocal = sessionmaker(bind=engine, autoflush=False, autocommit=False)
    return engine


def init_db() -> None:
    from app.db.migrations import apply_migrations
    from app.db.models import Base

    if engine is None:
        return
    Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
    # Best-effort additive columns for Phase 7 HITL on existing deployments.
    for stmt in (
        "ALTER TABLE analysis_jobs ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS intervention JSONB",
        "ALTER TABLE analysis_jobs ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS exploration_checkpoint JSONB",
    ):
        try:
            with engine.begin() as conn:
                conn.execute(text(stmt))
        except Exception:
            logger.debug("Optional schema alter skipped: %s", stmt, exc_info=True)
    try:
        apply_migrations(engine)
    except Exception:
        logger.exception("Phase 11 schema migrations failed")
    logger.info("PostgreSQL schema is ready.")


def get_session() -> Session:
    if SessionLocal is None:
        raise RuntimeError("Database is not configured.")
    return SessionLocal()


def database_ready() -> bool:
    if engine is None:
        return False
    try:
        with engine.connect() as conn:
            conn.execute(text("SELECT 1"))
        return True
    except Exception:
        logger.warning("PostgreSQL health check failed", exc_info=True)
        return False


init_engine()

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
import uuid

from sqlalchemy import select
from sqlalchemy.exc import IntegrityError

from app.db.models import User
from app.db.session import SessionLocal, engine
from app.schemas.auth import UserProfile

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class EmailAlreadyRegistered(Exception):
    pass


def normalize_email(email: str) -> str:
    return email.strip().lower()


def _to_profile(row: User) -> UserProfile:
    return UserProfile(
        id=row.id,
        full_name=row.full_name,
        company_name=row.company_name,
        email=row.email,
        created_at=row.created_at,
    )


def create_user(full_name: str, company_name: str, email: str, password_hash: str) -> UserProfile:
    if engine is None or SessionLocal is None:
        raise RuntimeError("Database is not configured.")
    session = SessionLocal()
    try:
        row = User(
            id=str(uuid.uuid4()),
            full_name=full_name,
            company_name=company_name,
            email=normalize_email(email),
            password_hash=password_hash,
        )
        session.add(row)
        session.commit()
        session.refresh(row)
        return _to_profile(row)
    except IntegrityError as exc:
        session.rollback()
        raise EmailAlreadyRegistered(email) from exc
    except Exception:
        session.rollback()
        logger.exception("Failed to create user")
        raise
    finally:
        session.close()


def get_credentials_by_email(email: str) -> tuple[UserProfile, str] | None:
    if engine is None or SessionLocal is None:
        return None
    session = SessionLocal()
    try:
        stmt = select(User).where(User.email == normalize_email(email))
        row = session.scalars(stmt).first()
        if row is None:
            return None
        return _to_profile(row), row.password_hash
    finally:
        session.close()


def get_user_by_id(user_id: str) -> UserProfile | None:
    if engine is None or SessionLocal is None:
        return None
    session = SessionLocal()
    try:
        row = session.get(User, user_id)
        return None if row is None else _to_profile(row)
    finally:
        session.close()

"""Versioned SQLAlchemy schema migrations (Phase 11+).

Applied by :func:`app.db.session.init_db` after ``create_all``. Tracks applied
versions in ``schema_migrations`` so additive DDL is idempotent.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
from collections.abc import Callable

from sqlalchemy import text
from sqlalchemy.engine import Connection, Engine

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

MigrationFn = Callable[[Connection], None]


def _ensure_migrations_table(conn: Connection) -> None:
    conn.execute(
        text(
            """
            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS schema_migrations (
                version VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY,
                applied_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
            )
            """
        )
    )


def _applied_versions(conn: Connection) -> set[str]:
    rows = conn.execute(text("SELECT version FROM schema_migrations")).fetchall()
    return {str(row[0]) for row in rows}


def apply_migrations(engine: Engine | None) -> list[str]:
    """Apply pending migrations. Returns list of newly applied version ids."""
    if engine is None:
        return []

    from app.db.migrations.versions import MIGRATIONS

    applied_now: list[str] = []
    with engine.begin() as conn:
        _ensure_migrations_table(conn)
        done = _applied_versions(conn)
        for version, upgrade in MIGRATIONS:
            if version in done:
                continue
            logger.info("Applying DB migration %s", version)
            upgrade(conn)
            conn.execute(
                text("INSERT INTO schema_migrations (version) VALUES (:v)"),
                {"v": version},
            )
            applied_now.append(version)
    if applied_now:
        logger.info("Applied migrations: %s", ", ".join(applied_now))
    return applied_now


def list_migration_versions() -> list[str]:
    from app.db.migrations.versions import MIGRATIONS

    return [version for version, _ in MIGRATIONS]

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from enum import Enum
from typing import Any


class JobStatus(str, Enum):
    QUEUED = "queued"
    RUNNING = "running"
    # Alias kept so older call sites / DB rows using "processing" still work.
    PROCESSING = "running"
    WAITING_FOR_HUMAN = "waiting_for_human"
    COMPLETED = "completed"
    PARTIAL = "partial"
    FAILED = "failed"
    CANCELLED = "cancelled"
    TIMEOUT = "timeout"


def coerce_job_status(value: str | JobStatus) -> JobStatus:
    """Parse status strings, including legacy ``processing``."""
    if isinstance(value, JobStatus):
        return value
    raw = (value or "").strip().lower()
    if raw == "processing":
        return JobStatus.RUNNING
    return JobStatus(raw)


class JobStage(str, Enum):
    """Ordered pipeline stages, each mapped to a coarse progress percentage."""

    QUEUED = "queued"
    STATIC_ANALYSIS = "static_analysis"
    EMULATOR_BOOT = "emulator_boot"
    APK_INSTALL = "apk_install"
    APP_LAUNCH = "app_launch"
    EXPLORING = "exploring"
    WAITING_FOR_HUMAN = "waiting_for_human"
    AD_ANALYSIS = "ad_analysis"
    UPLOADING = "uploading"
    PERSISTING = "persisting"
    DONE = "done"


# Progress is reported as a percentage so clients can render a bar without
# knowing anything about our internal stage names.
STAGE_PROGRESS: dict[JobStage, int] = {
    JobStage.QUEUED: 0,
    JobStage.STATIC_ANALYSIS: 10,
    JobStage.EMULATOR_BOOT: 25,
    JobStage.APK_INSTALL: 35,
    JobStage.APP_LAUNCH: 45,
    JobStage.EXPLORING: 55,
    JobStage.WAITING_FOR_HUMAN: 55,
    JobStage.AD_ANALYSIS: 80,
    JobStage.UPLOADING: 88,
    JobStage.PERSISTING: 95,
    JobStage.DONE: 100,
}


def progress_for(stage: JobStage) -> int:
    return STAGE_PROGRESS.get(stage, 0)


def _now() -> datetime:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc)


@dataclass
class JobRecord:
    id: str
    status: JobStatus = JobStatus.QUEUED
    stage: JobStage = JobStage.QUEUED
    progress: int = 0
    file_name: str | None = None
    file_size: int | None = None
    sha256: str | None = None
    package_name: str | None = None
    exploration_requested: bool = False
    result: dict[str, Any] | None = None
    error_code: str | None = None
    error_message: str | None = None
    intervention: dict[str, Any] | None = None
    exploration_checkpoint: dict[str, Any] | None = None
    created_at: datetime = field(default_factory=_now)
    updated_at: datetime = field(default_factory=_now)
    started_at: datetime | None = None
    finished_at: datetime | None = None

    def public_payload(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """The shape returned by GET /analyze-apk/{job_id} (Phase 9 unified)."""
        from app.services.unified_result import enrich_job_public_payload, public_job_status

        status = self.status
        status_value = status.value if isinstance(status, JobStatus) else str(status)
        if status_value == "processing":
            status_value = JobStatus.RUNNING.value
        body: dict[str, Any] = {
            "job_id": self.id,
            "status": public_job_status(status_value),
            "stage": self.stage.value if isinstance(self.stage, JobStage) else str(self.stage),
            "progress": self.progress,
        }
        if self.package_name:
            body["package_name"] = self.package_name
        if self.file_name:
            body["file_name"] = self.file_name

        if (
            self.intervention is not None
            and status_value == JobStatus.WAITING_FOR_HUMAN.value
        ):
            body["intervention"] = self.intervention
        if (
            self.exploration_checkpoint is not None
            and status_value == JobStatus.WAITING_FOR_HUMAN.value
        ):
            body["exploration_checkpoint"] = {
                "current_state_id": self.exploration_checkpoint.get("current_state_id"),
                "parent_state_id": self.exploration_checkpoint.get("parent_state_id"),
                "current_activity": self.exploration_checkpoint.get("current_activity"),
                "current_package": self.exploration_checkpoint.get("current_package"),
                "depth": self.exploration_checkpoint.get("depth"),
                "intervention_id": self.exploration_checkpoint.get("intervention_id"),
            }

        terminal_with_result = {
            JobStatus.COMPLETED.value,
            JobStatus.PARTIAL.value,
            JobStatus.CANCELLED.value,
            JobStatus.TIMEOUT.value,
        }
        if status_value in terminal_with_result and self.result is not None:
            body = enrich_job_public_payload(
                body,
                result=self.result,
                file_name=self.file_name,
                package_name=self.package_name,
            )
        if status_value == JobStatus.FAILED.value:
            body["success"] = False
            body["error"] = {
                "code": self.error_code or "ANALYZER_ERROR",
                "message": self.error_message or "Analysis failed.",
            }
            # Static analysis may still be present on some failure paths.
            if self.result is not None:
                body["json_analysis"] = self.result
        return body

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
import threading
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
from typing import Any, Protocol

from app.core.config import settings
from app.db.session import SessionLocal, engine
from app.jobs.models import JobRecord, JobStage, JobStatus, coerce_job_status, progress_for

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class JobStore(Protocol):
    """Storage contract for async job lifecycle.

    Two drivers ship today: Postgres (durable, survives restarts) and in-memory
    (single process, used when DATABASE_URL is unset). A Redis driver can be added
    behind this same interface without touching call sites.
    """

    def create(self, record: JobRecord) -> JobRecord: ...

    def get(self, job_id: str) -> JobRecord | None: ...

    def update(self, job_id: str, **changes: Any) -> JobRecord | None: ...

    def mark_stage(self, job_id: str, stage: JobStage) -> JobRecord | None: ...

    def mark_completed(self, job_id: str, result: dict[str, Any]) -> JobRecord | None: ...

    def mark_failed(self, job_id: str, code: str, message: str) -> JobRecord | None: ...

    def purge_expired(self) -> int: ...


def _apply(record: JobRecord, changes: dict[str, Any]) -> JobRecord:
    for key, value in changes.items():
        if hasattr(record, key):
            setattr(record, key, value)
    record.updated_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
    return record


class InMemoryJobStore:
    """Thread-safe fallback used when PostgreSQL is not configured."""

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._jobs: dict[str, JobRecord] = {}
        self._lock = threading.Lock()

    def create(self, record: JobRecord) -> JobRecord:
        with self._lock:
            self._jobs[record.id] = record
            return record

    def get(self, job_id: str) -> JobRecord | None:
        with self._lock:
            return self._jobs.get(job_id)

    def update(self, job_id: str, **changes: Any) -> JobRecord | None:
        with self._lock:
            record = self._jobs.get(job_id)
            if record is None:
                return None
            return _apply(record, changes)

    def mark_stage(self, job_id: str, stage: JobStage) -> JobRecord | None:
        status = JobStatus.RUNNING
        if stage is JobStage.WAITING_FOR_HUMAN:
            status = JobStatus.WAITING_FOR_HUMAN
        return self.update(
            job_id,
            stage=stage,
            progress=progress_for(stage),
            status=status,
        )

    def mark_completed(self, job_id: str, result: dict[str, Any]) -> JobRecord | None:
        return self.update(
            job_id,
            status=JobStatus.COMPLETED,
            stage=JobStage.DONE,
            progress=100,
            result=result,
            finished_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc),
        )

    def mark_failed(self, job_id: str, code: str, message: str) -> JobRecord | None:
        return self.update(
            job_id,
            status=JobStatus.FAILED,
            error_code=code,
            error_message=message,
            finished_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc),
        )

    def purge_expired(self) -> int:
        cutoff = datetime.now(timezone.utc) - timedelta(seconds=settings.job_retention_seconds)
        with self._lock:
            stale = [key for key, value in self._jobs.items() if value.updated_at < cutoff]
            for key in stale:
                self._jobs.pop(key, None)
            return len(stale)


class PostgresJobStore:
    """Durable driver backed by the ``analysis_jobs`` table."""

    def _to_record(self, row: Any) -> JobRecord:
        return JobRecord(
            id=row.id,
            status=coerce_job_status(row.status),
            stage=JobStage(row.stage),
            progress=row.progress or 0,
            file_name=row.file_name,
            file_size=row.file_size,
            sha256=row.sha256,
            package_name=row.package_name,
            exploration_requested=bool(row.exploration_requested),
            result=row.result,
            error_code=row.error_code,
            error_message=row.error_message,
            intervention=getattr(row, "intervention", None),
            exploration_checkpoint=getattr(row, "exploration_checkpoint", None),
            created_at=row.created_at,
            updated_at=row.updated_at,
            started_at=row.started_at,
            finished_at=row.finished_at,
        )

    def create(self, record: JobRecord) -> JobRecord:
        from app.db.models import AnalysisJob

        session = SessionLocal()  # type: ignore[misc]
        try:
            session.add(
                AnalysisJob(
                    id=record.id,
                    status=record.status.value,
                    stage=record.stage.value,
                    progress=record.progress,
                    file_name=record.file_name,
                    file_size=record.file_size,
                    sha256=record.sha256,
                    package_name=record.package_name,
                    exploration_requested=record.exploration_requested,
                )
            )
            session.commit()
            return record
        except Exception:
            session.rollback()
            raise
        finally:
            session.close()

    def get(self, job_id: str) -> JobRecord | None:
        from app.db.models import AnalysisJob

        session = SessionLocal()  # type: ignore[misc]
        try:
            row = session.get(AnalysisJob, job_id)
            return self._to_record(row) if row is not None else None
        finally:
            session.close()

    def update(self, job_id: str, **changes: Any) -> JobRecord | None:
        from app.db.models import AnalysisJob

        session = SessionLocal()  # type: ignore[misc]
        try:
            row = session.get(AnalysisJob, job_id)
            if row is None:
                return None
            for key, value in changes.items():
                if isinstance(value, (JobStatus, JobStage)):
                    value = value.value
                if hasattr(row, key):
                    setattr(row, key, value)
            session.commit()
            session.refresh(row)
            return self._to_record(row)
        except Exception:
            session.rollback()
            logger.exception("Failed to update job %s", job_id)
            raise
        finally:
            session.close()

    def mark_stage(self, job_id: str, stage: JobStage) -> JobRecord | None:
        status = JobStatus.RUNNING
        if stage is JobStage.WAITING_FOR_HUMAN:
            status = JobStatus.WAITING_FOR_HUMAN
        changes: dict[str, Any] = {
            "stage": stage,
            "progress": progress_for(stage),
            "status": status,
        }
        if stage is JobStage.STATIC_ANALYSIS:
            changes["started_at"] = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
        return self.update(job_id, **changes)

    def mark_completed(self, job_id: str, result: dict[str, Any]) -> JobRecord | None:
        return self.update(
            job_id,
            status=JobStatus.COMPLETED,
            stage=JobStage.DONE,
            progress=100,
            result=result,
            finished_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc),
        )

    def mark_failed(self, job_id: str, code: str, message: str) -> JobRecord | None:
        return self.update(
            job_id,
            status=JobStatus.FAILED,
            error_code=code,
            error_message=message,
            finished_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc),
        )

    def purge_expired(self) -> int:
        from sqlalchemy import delete

        from app.db.models import AnalysisJob

        cutoff = datetime.now(timezone.utc) - timedelta(seconds=settings.job_retention_seconds)
        session = SessionLocal()  # type: ignore[misc]
        try:
            result = session.execute(
                delete(AnalysisJob).where(AnalysisJob.updated_at < cutoff)
            )
            session.commit()
            return int(result.rowcount or 0)
        except Exception:
            session.rollback()
            return 0
        finally:
            session.close()


_memory_store = InMemoryJobStore()
_postgres_store = PostgresJobStore()


def get_job_store() -> JobStore:
    """Pick the most durable driver currently available."""
    if engine is not None and SessionLocal is not None:
        return _postgres_store
    return _memory_store


def store_backend() -> str:
    return "postgres" if (engine is not None and SessionLocal is not None) else "memory"

FILE: backend/app/modules/activities/extract.py

from __future__ import annotations

from app.core.xmlutil import (
    android_attr,
    children_by_tag,
    find_application,
    parse_bool,
    resolve_component_name,
)
from app.modules.apk_analyzer.context import ApkContext
from app.modules.components.exported import resolve_exported
from app.modules.components.intent_filters import extract_intent_filters


def extract_activities(ctx: ApkContext, target_sdk: int | None) -> list[dict]:
    app = find_application(ctx.manifest_xml)
    if app is None:
        return []
    package = android_attr(ctx.manifest_xml, "package") or ""
    results: list[dict] = []
    for tag in ("activity", "activity-alias"):
        for el in children_by_tag(app, tag):
            raw_name = android_attr(el, "name") or android_attr(el, "targetActivity")
            name = resolve_component_name(package, raw_name)
            if not name:
                continue
            filters = extract_intent_filters(el)
            exported, inferred, warning = resolve_exported(
                parse_bool(android_attr(el, "exported")),
                bool(filters),
                target_sdk,
            )
            if warning:
                ctx.warnings.append(f"{name}: {warning}")
            enabled = parse_bool(android_attr(el, "enabled"))
            results.append(
                {
                    "name": name,
                    "exported": exported,
                    "exported_inferred": inferred,
                    "enabled": True if enabled is None else enabled,
                    "permission": android_attr(el, "permission"),
                    "direct_boot_aware": parse_bool(android_attr(el, "directBootAware")),
                    "process": android_attr(el, "process"),
                    "launch_mode": android_attr(el, "launchMode"),
                    "theme": android_attr(el, "theme"),
                    "intent_filters": filters,
                }
            )
    return results

================================================================================
FILE: backend/app/modules/ad_detection/detector.py

"""AdDetector facade — screenshot in, AdDetectionResult out. No emulator control."""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Sequence

from app.modules.ad_detection.models import AdDetectionResult
from app.modules.ad_detection.providers.base import AdVisionProvider, pick_best

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class AdDetector:
    """Analyzes unique screenshots for visible advertisements.

    Architecture::

        Screenshot
            ↓
        AdDetector.detect(image_path)
            ↓
        AdVisionProvider.analyze(...)
            ↓
        AdDetectionResult

    The selected provider is injectable so OpenAI / Gemini / Claude / local /
    object-detection backends can be swapped without touching exploration code.
    """

    def __init__(self, provider: AdVisionProvider, *, min_confidence: float = 0.0) -> None:
        self.provider = provider
        self.min_confidence = min_confidence

    @property
    def provider_name(self) -> str:
        return getattr(self.provider, "name", type(self.provider).__name__)

    def detect(self, image_path: str | Path) -> AdDetectionResult:
        """Detect the primary advertisement on ``image_path``."""
        path = Path(image_path)
        logger.info("[AD_DETECT] provider=%s image=%s", self.provider_name, path)
        results = self.detect_all(path)
        primary = pick_best(results, provider=self.provider_name, image_path=str(path))
        if primary.detected and primary.confidence < self.min_confidence:
            logger.info(
                "[AD_DETECT] below min_confidence=%.2f (got %.2f) — treating as none",
                self.min_confidence,
                primary.confidence,
            )
            return AdDetectionResult.none(
                provider=self.provider_name,
                image_path=str(path),
                image_width=primary.image_width,
                image_height=primary.image_height,
                evidence=[
                    *primary.evidence,
                    f"filtered:min_confidence={self.min_confidence}",
                ],
            )
        logger.info(
            "[AD_DETECT] detected=%s type=%s conf=%.3f pos=%s",
            primary.detected,
            primary.type,
            primary.confidence,
            primary.position,
        )
        return primary

    def detect_all(self, image_path: str | Path) -> list[AdDetectionResult]:
        """Return every detection the provider reports for the screenshot."""
        results = self.provider.analyze(image_path)
        if self.min_confidence <= 0:
            return list(results)
        filtered = [
            item
            for item in results
            if (not item.detected) or item.confidence >= self.min_confidence
        ]
        return filtered or list(results)

    def detect_many(self, image_paths: Sequence[str | Path]) -> list[AdDetectionResult]:
        """Run ``detect`` on each path (one primary result per screenshot)."""
        return [self.detect(path) for path in image_paths]

FILE: backend/app/modules/ad_detection/factory.py

"""Build an :class:`AdDetector` from settings / explicit provider name."""

from __future__ import annotations

from app.core.config import settings
from app.modules.ad_detection.detector import AdDetector
from app.modules.ad_detection.providers import (
    AdVisionProvider,
    ClaudeVisionProvider,
    GeminiVisionProvider,
    HeuristicAdProvider,
    LocalVisionProvider,
    ObjectDetectionProvider,
    OpenAIVisionProvider,
)


def build_provider(name: str | None = None) -> AdVisionProvider:
    """Instantiate the configured vision backend (no emulator coupling)."""
    provider_name = (name or settings.ad_detection_provider or "heuristic").strip().lower()
    timeout = settings.ad_detection_timeout_seconds

    if provider_name in {"heuristic", "offline", "default"}:
        return HeuristicAdProvider(min_confidence=settings.ad_detection_min_confidence)

    if provider_name in {"openai", "gpt"}:
        return OpenAIVisionProvider(
            api_key=settings.ad_detection_openai_api_key or settings.openai_api_key,
            model=settings.ad_detection_openai_model,
            api_base=settings.ad_detection_openai_api_base,
            timeout_seconds=timeout,
        )

    if provider_name in {"gemini", "google"}:
        return GeminiVisionProvider(
            api_key=settings.ad_detection_gemini_api_key or settings.gemini_api_key,
            model=settings.ad_detection_gemini_model,
            timeout_seconds=timeout,
        )

    if provider_name in {"claude", "anthropic"}:
        return ClaudeVisionProvider(
            api_key=settings.ad_detection_anthropic_api_key or settings.anthropic_api_key,
            model=settings.ad_detection_claude_model,
            api_base=settings.ad_detection_anthropic_api_base,
            timeout_seconds=timeout,
        )

    if provider_name in {"local", "local_vision"}:
        return LocalVisionProvider(
            model_path=settings.ad_detection_local_model_path,
            allow_heuristic_fallback=settings.ad_detection_local_fallback_heuristic,
        )

    if provider_name in {"object_detection", "od", "yolo"}:
        return ObjectDetectionProvider(model_path=settings.ad_detection_od_model_path)

    raise ValueError(
        f"Unknown ad detection provider '{provider_name}'. "
        "Use heuristic|openai|gemini|claude|local|object_detection."
    )


def build_ad_detector(provider_name: str | None = None) -> AdDetector:
    """Factory used by CLI / future pipeline stages."""
    if not settings.ad_detection_enabled and provider_name is None:
        # Still allow explicit CLI override; default path respects the flag by
        # falling back to heuristic so offline analysis always works.
        provider = HeuristicAdProvider(min_confidence=settings.ad_detection_min_confidence)
    else:
        provider = build_provider(provider_name)
    return AdDetector(provider, min_confidence=settings.ad_detection_min_confidence)

FILE: backend/app/modules/ad_detection/models.py

"""Phase 6 advertisement detection result models.

Screenshot analysis only — these types never drive emulator input.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field
from typing import Any, Literal

AdTypeName = Literal["banner", "native", "interstitial", "rewarded", "unknown"]
AdPositionName = Literal["top", "bottom", "middle", "fullscreen", "unknown"]


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class BoundingBox:
    """Pixel box on the screenshot: origin top-left."""

    x: int
    y: int
    width: int
    height: int

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, int]:
        return {"x": self.x, "y": self.y, "width": self.width, "height": self.height}

    @classmethod
    def from_dict(cls, data: dict[str, Any] | None) -> "BoundingBox | None":
        if not data:
            return None
        return cls(
            x=int(data.get("x", 0)),
            y=int(data.get("y", 0)),
            width=int(data.get("width", 0)),
            height=int(data.get("height", 0)),
        )


@dataclass
class AdDetectionResult:
    """Outcome of analyzing one screenshot for visible advertisements."""

    detected: bool
    type: AdTypeName = "unknown"
    confidence: float = 0.0
    bounding_box: BoundingBox | None = None
    position: AdPositionName = "unknown"
    provider: str = ""
    image_path: str | None = None
    image_width: int | None = None
    image_height: int | None = None
    evidence: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    raw: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        payload = {
            "detected": self.detected,
            "type": self.type,
            "confidence": round(float(self.confidence), 4),
            "bounding_box": self.bounding_box.to_dict() if self.bounding_box else None,
            "position": self.position,
            "provider": self.provider,
            "image_path": self.image_path,
            "image_width": self.image_width,
            "image_height": self.image_height,
            "evidence": list(self.evidence),
        }
        if self.raw:
            payload["raw"] = dict(self.raw)
        return payload

    @classmethod
    def none(
        cls,
        *,
        provider: str = "",
        image_path: str | None = None,
        image_width: int | None = None,
        image_height: int | None = None,
        evidence: list[str] | None = None,
    ) -> "AdDetectionResult":
        return cls(
            detected=False,
            type="unknown",
            confidence=0.0,
            bounding_box=None,
            position="unknown",
            provider=provider,
            image_path=image_path,
            image_width=image_width,
            image_height=image_height,
            evidence=list(evidence or []),
        )


def infer_position(
    box: BoundingBox,
    *,
    image_width: int,
    image_height: int,
) -> AdPositionName:
    """Map a pixel box onto a coarse screen band."""
    if image_width <= 0 or image_height <= 0:
        return "unknown"
    coverage = (box.width * box.height) / float(image_width * image_height)
    top_ratio = box.y / float(image_height)
    bottom_ratio = (box.y + box.height) / float(image_height)
    height_ratio = box.height / float(image_height)
    if coverage >= 0.55 or (box.width / image_width >= 0.85 and height_ratio >= 0.55):
        return "fullscreen"
    if top_ratio <= 0.15 and height_ratio <= 0.30:
        return "top"
    if bottom_ratio >= 0.85 or top_ratio >= 0.70:
        return "bottom"
    if 0.20 <= top_ratio <= 0.70:
        return "middle"
    return "unknown"


def normalize_ad_type(value: str | None) -> AdTypeName:
    key = (value or "unknown").strip().lower().replace("-", "_").replace(" ", "_")
    mapping = {
        "banner": "banner",
        "native": "native",
        "native_ad": "native",
        "interstitial": "interstitial",
        "fullscreen": "interstitial",
        "full_screen": "interstitial",
        "rewarded": "rewarded",
        "reward": "rewarded",
        "rewarded_video": "rewarded",
        "unknown": "unknown",
    }
    return mapping.get(key, "unknown")  # type: ignore[return-value]

================================================================================
FILE: backend/app/modules/ad_detection/providers/base.py
================================================================================
"""Provider interface for screenshot advertisement vision backends."""

from __future__ import annotations

from abc import ABC, abstractmethod
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Sequence

from app.modules.ad_detection.models import AdDetectionResult


class AdVisionProvider(ABC):
    """Analyzes a screenshot. Never issues emulator / adb commands."""

    name: str = "base"

    @abstractmethod
    def analyze(self, image_path: str | Path) -> list[AdDetectionResult]:
        """Return zero or more ad detections for ``image_path``."""

    def analyze_primary(self, image_path: str | Path) -> AdDetectionResult:
        results = self.analyze(image_path)
        if not results:
            return AdDetectionResult.none(provider=self.name, image_path=str(image_path))
        # Highest confidence first; prefer detected=True.
        ranked = sorted(
            results,
            key=lambda item: (item.detected, item.confidence),
            reverse=True,
        )
        return ranked[0]


class ProviderNotConfiguredError(RuntimeError):
    """Raised when a vision provider is selected but credentials/models are missing."""


def ensure_image_exists(image_path: str | Path) -> Path:
    path = Path(image_path)
    if not path.is_file():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"Screenshot not found: {path}")
    return path


def pick_best(results: Sequence[AdDetectionResult], *, provider: str, image_path: str) -> AdDetectionResult:
    if not results:
        return AdDetectionResult.none(provider=provider, image_path=image_path)
    return max(results, key=lambda item: (item.detected, item.confidence))

"""Anthropic Claude vision provider (optional — requires ANTHROPIC_API_KEY)."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import logging
import urllib.error
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path

from app.modules.ad_detection.models import AdDetectionResult
from app.modules.ad_detection.providers.base import AdVisionProvider, ProviderNotConfiguredError
from app.modules.ad_detection.providers.vision_common import (
    VISION_SYSTEM_PROMPT,
    encode_image_base64,
    load_image_meta,
    parse_vision_json,
)

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class ClaudeVisionProvider(AdVisionProvider):
    name = "claude"

    def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        api_key: str | None,
        model: str = "claude-3-5-sonnet-latest",
        api_base: str = "https://api.anthropic.com",
        timeout_seconds: float = 60.0,
    ) -> None:
        self.api_key = (api_key or "").strip()
        self.model = model
        self.api_base = api_base.rstrip("/")
        self.timeout_seconds = timeout_seconds

    def analyze(self, image_path: str | Path) -> list[AdDetectionResult]:
        if not self.api_key:
            raise ProviderNotConfiguredError(
                "Claude vision provider requires ANTHROPIC_API_KEY "
                "(or AD_DETECTION_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY)."
            )
        path, width, height = load_image_meta(image_path)
        mime, b64 = encode_image_base64(path)
        media = "image/png" if "png" in mime else "image/jpeg" if "jpeg" in mime or "jpg" in mime else mime
        body = {
            "model": self.model,
            "max_tokens": 1024,
            "temperature": 0,
            "system": VISION_SYSTEM_PROMPT,
            "messages": [
                {
                    "role": "user",
                    "content": [
                        {
                            "type": "image",
                            "source": {
                                "type": "base64",
                                "media_type": media,
                                "data": b64,
                            },
                        },
                        {
                            "type": "text",
                            "text": f"Image size: {width}x{height}px. Detect advertisements and return JSON.",
                        },
                    ],
                }
            ],
        }
        request = urllib.request.Request(
            f"{self.api_base}/v1/messages",
            data=json.dumps(body).encode("utf-8"),
            headers={
                "x-api-key": self.api_key,
                "anthropic-version": "2023-06-01",
                "Content-Type": "application/json",
            },
            method="POST",
        )
        try:
            with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=self.timeout_seconds) as response:
                payload = json.loads(response.read().decode("utf-8"))
        except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc:
            detail = exc.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")[:400]
            raise RuntimeError(f"Claude vision HTTP {exc.code}: {detail}") from exc
        except urllib.error.URLError as exc:
            raise RuntimeError(f"Claude vision request failed: {exc}") from exc

        blocks = payload.get("content") or []
        text = ""
        for block in blocks:
            if isinstance(block, dict) and block.get("type") == "text":
                text += str(block.get("text") or "")
        return parse_vision_json(
            text or "{}",
            provider=self.name,
            image_path=str(path),
            image_width=width,
            image_height=height,
        )

"""Google Gemini vision provider (optional — requires GEMINI_API_KEY)."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import logging
import urllib.error
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path

from app.modules.ad_detection.models import AdDetectionResult
from app.modules.ad_detection.providers.base import AdVisionProvider, ProviderNotConfiguredError
from app.modules.ad_detection.providers.vision_common import (
    VISION_SYSTEM_PROMPT,
    encode_image_base64,
    load_image_meta,
    parse_vision_json,
)

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class GeminiVisionProvider(AdVisionProvider):
    name = "gemini"

    def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        api_key: str | None,
        model: str = "gemini-1.5-flash",
        timeout_seconds: float = 60.0,
    ) -> None:
        self.api_key = (api_key or "").strip()
        self.model = model
        self.timeout_seconds = timeout_seconds

    def analyze(self, image_path: str | Path) -> list[AdDetectionResult]:
        if not self.api_key:
            raise ProviderNotConfiguredError(
                "Gemini vision provider requires GEMINI_API_KEY (or AD_DETECTION_GEMINI_API_KEY)."
            )
        path, width, height = load_image_meta(image_path)
        mime, b64 = encode_image_base64(path)
        url = (
            f"https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/"
            f"{self.model}:generateContent?key={self.api_key}"
        )
        body = {
            "contents": [
                {
                    "parts": [
                        {
                            "text": (
                                f"{VISION_SYSTEM_PROMPT}\n"
                                f"Image size: {width}x{height}px."
                            )
                        },
                        {"inline_data": {"mime_type": mime, "data": b64}},
                    ]
                }
            ],
            "generationConfig": {"temperature": 0, "responseMimeType": "application/json"},
        }
        request = urllib.request.Request(
            url,
            data=json.dumps(body).encode("utf-8"),
            headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"},
            method="POST",
        )
        try:
            with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=self.timeout_seconds) as response:
                payload = json.loads(response.read().decode("utf-8"))
        except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc:
            detail = exc.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")[:400]
            raise RuntimeError(f"Gemini vision HTTP {exc.code}: {detail}") from exc
        except urllib.error.URLError as exc:
            raise RuntimeError(f"Gemini vision request failed: {exc}") from exc

        candidates = payload.get("candidates") or []
        parts = (
            candidates[0].get("content", {}).get("parts", []) if candidates else []
        )
        text = ""
        for part in parts:
            if isinstance(part, dict) and part.get("text"):
                text += str(part["text"])
        return parse_vision_json(
            text or "{}",
            provider=self.name,
            image_path=str(path),
            image_width=width,
            image_height=height,
        )

FILE: backend/app/modules/ad_detection/providers/heuristic.py

"""Offline heuristic ad detector (no cloud / no LLM).

Uses image geometry + simple band energy to guess banner / interstitial
placements. Intentionally conservative — vision providers should override when
configured.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
from pathlib import Path

from PIL import Image, ImageStat, UnidentifiedImageError

from app.modules.ad_detection.models import (
    AdDetectionResult,
    BoundingBox,
    infer_position,
    normalize_ad_type,
)
from app.modules.ad_detection.providers.base import AdVisionProvider, ensure_image_exists

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class HeuristicAdProvider(AdVisionProvider):
    """Deterministic screenshot heuristics — never talks to an API."""

    name = "heuristic"

    def __init__(self, *, min_confidence: float = 0.45) -> None:
        self.min_confidence = min_confidence

    def analyze(self, image_path: str | Path) -> list[AdDetectionResult]:
        path = ensure_image_exists(image_path)
        try:
            with Image.open(path) as image:
                rgb = image.convert("RGB")
                width, height = rgb.size
                bands = self._scan_bands(rgb)
        except UnidentifiedImageError as exc:
            raise ValueError(f"Not a readable image: {path}") from exc

        results: list[AdDetectionResult] = []
        for candidate in bands:
            box, ad_type, confidence, evidence = candidate
            if confidence < self.min_confidence:
                continue
            results.append(
                AdDetectionResult(
                    detected=True,
                    type=normalize_ad_type(ad_type),
                    confidence=confidence,
                    bounding_box=box,
                    position=infer_position(box, image_width=width, image_height=height),
                    provider=self.name,
                    image_path=str(path),
                    image_width=width,
                    image_height=height,
                    evidence=evidence,
                )
            )
        if not results:
            return [
                AdDetectionResult.none(
                    provider=self.name,
                    image_path=str(path),
                    image_width=width,
                    image_height=height,
                    evidence=["heuristic:no_ad_band"],
                )
            ]
        return results

    def _scan_bands(
        self, image: Image.Image
    ) -> list[tuple[BoundingBox, str, float, list[str]]]:
        width, height = image.size
        if width < 32 or height < 32:
            return []

        found: list[tuple[BoundingBox, str, float, list[str]]] = []

        # Top / bottom banner strips.
        for label, y0, y1 in (
            ("top", 0, max(1, int(height * 0.14))),
            ("bottom", int(height * 0.82), height),
        ):
            band = image.crop((0, y0, width, y1))
            score = self._band_score(band)
            band_h = y1 - y0
            if score >= 0.55 and band_h / height <= 0.22:
                box = BoundingBox(x=0, y=y0, width=width, height=band_h)
                confidence = min(0.85, 0.45 + score * 0.4)
                found.append(
                    (
                        box,
                        "banner",
                        confidence,
                        [f"heuristic:band_{label}", f"heuristic:score={score:.2f}"],
                    )
                )

        # Near-fullscreen interstitial: high coverage mid-frame contrast.
        mid = image.crop((int(width * 0.05), int(height * 0.08), int(width * 0.95), int(height * 0.92)))
        mid_score = self._band_score(mid)
        if mid_score >= 0.72:
            box = BoundingBox(
                x=int(width * 0.05),
                y=int(height * 0.08),
                width=int(width * 0.90),
                height=int(height * 0.84),
            )
            found.append(
                (
                    box,
                    "interstitial",
                    min(0.80, 0.50 + mid_score * 0.3),
                    [f"heuristic:fullscreen_score={mid_score:.2f}"],
                )
            )

        # Middle native-ish band.
        native = image.crop((int(width * 0.05), int(height * 0.30), int(width * 0.95), int(height * 0.62)))
        native_score = self._band_score(native)
        if native_score >= 0.62 and not any(item[1] == "interstitial" for item in found):
            box = BoundingBox(
                x=int(width * 0.05),
                y=int(height * 0.30),
                width=int(width * 0.90),
                height=int(height * 0.32),
            )
            found.append(
                (
                    box,
                    "native",
                    min(0.75, 0.40 + native_score * 0.35),
                    [f"heuristic:native_score={native_score:.2f}"],
                )
            )

        return found

    def _band_score(self, band: Image.Image) -> float:
        """Rough saliency: higher when the region is colorful / contrasty."""
        stat = ImageStat.Stat(band)
        # Mean channel spread + std-dev energy, normalized loosely to 0..1.
        means = stat.mean or [0, 0, 0]
        stdevs = stat.stddev or [0, 0, 0]
        colorfulness = abs(means[0] - means[1]) + abs(means[1] - means[2]) + abs(means[0] - means[2])
        energy = sum(stdevs) / 3.0
        score = (colorfulness / 120.0) * 0.45 + (energy / 80.0) * 0.55
        return max(0.0, min(1.0, score))

class LocalVisionProvider(AdVisionProvider):
    """Reserved for a future local VLM. Falls back to heuristic when enabled loosely."""

    name = "local"

    def __init__(self, *, model_path: str | None = None, allow_heuristic_fallback: bool = True) -> None:
        self.model_path = (model_path or "").strip()
        self.allow_heuristic_fallback = allow_heuristic_fallback
        self._heuristic = HeuristicAdProvider()

    def analyze(self, image_path: str | Path) -> list[AdDetectionResult]:
        if not self.model_path:
            if self.allow_heuristic_fallback:
                results = self._heuristic.analyze(image_path)
                for item in results:
                    item.provider = self.name
                    item.evidence = [*item.evidence, "local:heuristic_fallback"]
                return results
            raise ProviderNotConfiguredError(
                "Local vision provider requires AD_DETECTION_LOCAL_MODEL_PATH."
            )
        # Future: load ONNX/VLM weights from model_path.
        raise ProviderNotConfiguredError(
            f"Local vision model loading is not implemented yet (path={self.model_path}). "
            "Use provider=heuristic|openai|gemini|claude for now."
        )


class ObjectDetectionProvider(AdVisionProvider):
    """Reserved for a future object-detection model (YOLO / custom ad boxes)."""

    name = "object_detection"

    def __init__(self, *, model_path: str | None = None) -> None:
        self.model_path = (model_path or "").strip()

            f"Object-detection inference is not implemented yet (path={self.model_path}). "
            f"Image OK: {path.name} ({width}x{height})."
        )

"""OpenAI vision provider (optional — requires OPENAI_API_KEY)."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import logging
import urllib.error
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path

from app.modules.ad_detection.models import AdDetectionResult
from app.modules.ad_detection.providers.base import AdVisionProvider, ProviderNotConfiguredError
from app.modules.ad_detection.providers.vision_common import (
    VISION_SYSTEM_PROMPT,
    encode_image_base64,
    load_image_meta,
    parse_vision_json,
)

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class OpenAIVisionProvider(AdVisionProvider):
    name = "openai"

    def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        api_key: str | None,
        model: str = "gpt-4o-mini",
        api_base: str = "https://api.openai.com/v1",
        timeout_seconds: float = 60.0,
    ) -> None:
        self.api_key = (api_key or "").strip()
        self.model = model
        self.api_base = api_base.rstrip("/")
        self.timeout_seconds = timeout_seconds

    def analyze(self, image_path: str | Path) -> list[AdDetectionResult]:
        if not self.api_key:
            raise ProviderNotConfiguredError(
                "OpenAI vision provider requires OPENAI_API_KEY (or AD_DETECTION_OPENAI_API_KEY)."
            )
        path, width, height = load_image_meta(image_path)
        mime, b64 = encode_image_base64(path)
        body = {
            "model": self.model,
            "temperature": 0,
            "response_format": {"type": "json_object"},
            "messages": [
                {"role": "system", "content": VISION_SYSTEM_PROMPT},
                {
                    "role": "user",
                    "content": [
                        {
                            "type": "text",
                            "text": (
                                f"Image size: {width}x{height}px. "
                                "Detect advertisements and return JSON."
                            ),
                        },
                        {
                            "type": "image_url",
                            "image_url": {"url": f"data:{mime};base64,{b64}"},
                        },
                    ],
                },
            ],
        }
        request = urllib.request.Request(
            f"{self.api_base}/chat/completions",
            data=json.dumps(body).encode("utf-8"),
            headers={
                "Authorization": f"Bearer {self.api_key}",
                "Content-Type": "application/json",
            },
            method="POST",
        )
        try:
            with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=self.timeout_seconds) as response:
                payload = json.loads(response.read().decode("utf-8"))
        except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc:
            detail = exc.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")[:400]
            raise RuntimeError(f"OpenAI vision HTTP {exc.code}: {detail}") from exc
        except urllib.error.URLError as exc:
            raise RuntimeError(f"OpenAI vision request failed: {exc}") from exc

        text = (
            payload.get("choices", [{}])[0]
            .get("message", {})
            .get("content", "")
        )
        return parse_vision_json(
            text or "{}",
            provider=self.name,
            image_path=str(path),
            image_width=width,
            image_height=height,
        )

FILE: backend/app/modules/ad_detection/providers/vision_common.py

"""Shared vision-provider helpers (prompt + JSON parse). No emulator access."""

from __future__ import annotations

import base64
import json
import logging
import mimetypes
import re
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from PIL import Image, UnidentifiedImageError

from app.modules.ad_detection.models import (
    AdDetectionResult,
    BoundingBox,
    infer_position,
    normalize_ad_type,
)
from app.modules.ad_detection.providers.base import ensure_image_exists

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

VISION_SYSTEM_PROMPT = """You analyze Android app screenshots for advertisement placements.
Return ONLY valid JSON (no markdown) with this shape:
{
  "ads": [
    {
      "detected": true,
      "type": "banner|native|interstitial|rewarded|unknown",
      "confidence": 0.0-1.0,
      "bounding_box": {"x": int, "y": int, "width": int, "height": int},
      "position": "top|bottom|middle|fullscreen|unknown"
    }
  ]
}
Rules:
- bounding_box uses pixel coordinates with origin at the top-left of the image.
- If no ad is visible, return {"ads": [{"detected": false, "type": "unknown", "confidence": 0.0, "bounding_box": null, "position": "unknown"}]}.
- Do not invent ads. Prefer fewer high-confidence detections.
- Never suggest UI actions or emulator commands.
"""


def image_dimensions(path: Path) -> tuple[int, int]:
    with Image.open(path) as image:
        return image.size


def encode_image_base64(path: Path) -> tuple[str, str]:
    mime, _ = mimetypes.guess_type(str(path))
    if not mime:
        mime = "image/png"
    data = base64.b64encode(path.read_bytes()).decode("ascii")
    return mime, data


def parse_vision_json(
    text: str,
    *,
    provider: str,
    image_path: str,
    image_width: int,
    image_height: int,
) -> list[AdDetectionResult]:
    payload = _extract_json_object(text)
    ads = payload.get("ads")
    if ads is None and "detected" in payload:
        ads = [payload]
    if not isinstance(ads, list) or not ads:
        return [
            AdDetectionResult.none(
                provider=provider,
                image_path=image_path,
                image_width=image_width,
                image_height=image_height,
                evidence=["vision:empty_ads"],
            )
        ]

    results: list[AdDetectionResult] = []
    for item in ads:
        if not isinstance(item, dict):
            continue
        detected = bool(item.get("detected", False))
        box = BoundingBox.from_dict(item.get("bounding_box") if isinstance(item.get("bounding_box"), dict) else None)
        ad_type = normalize_ad_type(str(item.get("type") or "unknown"))
        try:
            confidence = float(item.get("confidence") or 0.0)
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            confidence = 0.0
        confidence = max(0.0, min(1.0, confidence))
        position = str(item.get("position") or "unknown").lower()
        if box and position in {"", "unknown"}:
            position = infer_position(box, image_width=image_width, image_height=image_height)
        if position not in {"top", "bottom", "middle", "fullscreen", "unknown"}:
            position = "unknown"
        results.append(
            AdDetectionResult(
                detected=detected and confidence > 0,
                type=ad_type,
                confidence=confidence,
                bounding_box=box if detected else None,
                position=position,  # type: ignore[arg-type]
                provider=provider,
                image_path=image_path,
                image_width=image_width,
                image_height=image_height,
                evidence=[f"vision:{provider}"],
                raw=dict(item),
            )
        )
    if not results:
        return [
            AdDetectionResult.none(
                provider=provider,
                image_path=image_path,
                image_width=image_width,
                image_height=image_height,
                evidence=["vision:parse_miss"],
            )
        ]
    return results


def load_image_meta(image_path: str | Path) -> tuple[Path, int, int]:
    path = ensure_image_exists(image_path)
    try:
        width, height = image_dimensions(path)
    except UnidentifiedImageError as exc:
        raise ValueError(f"Not a readable image: {path}") from exc
    return path, width, height


def _extract_json_object(text: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    cleaned = text.strip()
    if cleaned.startswith("```"):
        cleaned = re.sub(r"^```(?:json)?\s*", "", cleaned)
        cleaned = re.sub(r"\s*```$", "", cleaned)
    try:
        data = json.loads(cleaned)
        if isinstance(data, dict):
            return data
    except json.JSONDecodeError:
        pass
    match = re.search(r"\{.*\}", cleaned, re.DOTALL)
    if not match:
        logger.warning("Vision provider returned non-JSON text")
        return {}
    try:
        data = json.loads(match.group(0))
    except json.JSONDecodeError:
        return {}
    return data if isinstance(data, dict) else {}

"""AI exploration advisor: goal-aware selection among deterministic candidates."""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
from typing import Any, Sequence

from app.core.config import settings
from app.modules.ai_explorer.context import AIPlanningContext
from app.modules.ai_explorer.llm import AIAdvisorError, chat_json
from app.modules.ai_explorer.policy import should_invoke_ai
from app.modules.ai_explorer.prompts import SYSTEM_PROMPT, build_user_prompt
from app.modules.ai_explorer.schema import AIActionDecision
from app.modules.ai_explorer.validator import (
    ActionValidationError,
    candidate_summaries,
    map_decision_to_planned,
    parse_ai_decision,
)
from app.modules.exploration.action_planner import PlannedAction

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


def _log_ai(message: str, *args: object) -> None:
    logger.info("[AI-PLANNER] " + message, *args)


class ExplorationAdvisor:
    """Decide the next PlannedAction using AI only when policy says so.

    HITL must already have been handled by the caller. This class never talks
    to ADB / the shell / the filesystem / UIController.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        enabled: bool | None = None,
        min_confidence: float | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self.enabled = (
            bool(settings.ai_explorer_enabled) if enabled is None else bool(enabled)
        )
        self.min_confidence = (
            float(settings.ai_explorer_min_confidence)
            if min_confidence is None
            else float(min_confidence)
        )

    def choose(
        self,
        candidates: Sequence[PlannedAction],
        *,
        activity: str | None = None,
        package_name: str | None = None,
        visited_keys: Sequence[str] | None = None,
        stagnation_count: int = 0,
        force: bool = False,
        plan_notes: str | None = None,
        planning_context: AIPlanningContext | dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> tuple[PlannedAction | None, dict[str, Any]]:
        """Return (action, meta). On any AI failure, returns (None, meta) so
        the caller falls back to deterministic ordering.
        """
        meta: dict[str, Any] = {
            "ai_used": False,
            "ai_reason": None,
            "policy": None,
            "planner_source": None,
        }
        if not candidates and not force:
            return None, meta

        use_ai, policy_reason = should_invoke_ai(
            candidates,
            stagnation_count=stagnation_count,
            force=force,
            min_candidates=int(settings.ai_explorer_min_candidates or 3),
        )
        meta["policy"] = policy_reason
        if not self.enabled or not use_ai:
            meta["planner_source"] = "DETERMINISTIC"
            return None, meta

        ctx_dict: dict[str, Any] = {}
        if isinstance(planning_context, AIPlanningContext):
            ctx_dict = planning_context.to_dict()
        elif isinstance(planning_context, dict):
            ctx_dict = dict(planning_context)

        goal = (ctx_dict.get("goal") or {}).get("goal_type") or "GENERAL_EXPLORATION"
        _log_ai("Goal=%s candidates=%s", goal, len(candidates))

        summaries = candidate_summaries(candidates)
        user_prompt = build_user_prompt(
            activity=activity or ctx_dict.get("current_activity"),
            package_name=package_name or ctx_dict.get("package_name"),
            candidates=summaries,
            visited_summary=list(visited_keys or [])[:30],
            notes=policy_reason,
            plan_notes=plan_notes,
            planning_context=ctx_dict,
        )
        try:
            raw = chat_json(system=SYSTEM_PROMPT, user=user_prompt)
            decision = parse_ai_decision(raw)
            planned = self._accept_decision(decision, candidates, meta)
            return planned, meta
        except (AIAdvisorError, ActionValidationError) as exc:
            _log_ai("Invalid AI decision; deterministic fallback (%s)", exc)
            meta["ai_error"] = str(exc)
            meta["fallback"] = "deterministic_after_ai_failure"
            meta["planner_source"] = "DETERMINISTIC_FALLBACK"
            return None, meta
        except Exception as exc:
            _log_ai("LLM unavailable; deterministic fallback (%s)", type(exc).__name__)
            meta["ai_error"] = type(exc).__name__
            meta["fallback"] = "deterministic_after_ai_failure"
            meta["planner_source"] = "DETERMINISTIC_FALLBACK"
            return None, meta

    def _accept_decision(
        self,
        decision: AIActionDecision,
        candidates: Sequence[PlannedAction],
        meta: dict[str, Any],
    ) -> PlannedAction:
        if decision.confidence is not None and decision.confidence < self.min_confidence:
            raise ActionValidationError(
                f"low confidence {decision.confidence:.2f} < {self.min_confidence:.2f}"
            )
        planned = map_decision_to_planned(decision, candidates)
        meta["ai_used"] = True
        meta["ai_reason"] = decision.reason
        meta["ai_key"] = planned.key
        meta["ai_confidence"] = decision.confidence
        meta["planner_source"] = "AI"
        _log_ai(
            "Selected action=%s target=%s confidence=%s",
            decision.action,
            (decision.target or planned.key)[:80],
            decision.confidence if decision.confidence is not None else "n/a",
        )
        if decision.reason:
            _log_ai("Reason=%s", decision.reason[:160])
        return planned

"""Auto-assist for gates the explorer can clear without a human.

Handles permissions, default-app, terms/privacy Agree, form/select/create,
and ad close/skip. Login / OTP / CAPTCHA / verification stay on HITL.

Actions are always chosen from allow-listed PlannedAction candidates.
When AI is enabled it may rank candidates; otherwise the highest-priority
deterministic candidate is used.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
import re
from typing import Any, Sequence

from app.core.config import settings
from app.modules.exploration.action_planner import (
    PlannedAction,
    _element_action_key,
    _is_ad_cta,
    _is_ad_surface,
    _is_banner_ad_slot,
    _is_close_control,
    _is_home_hijack_cta,

    looks_like_interstitial_ad,

from app.modules.exploration.actions import BackAction, TapAction, TypeTextAction

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

# Screens we try to clear automatically (AI + deterministic).
AI_ASSISTABLE_TYPES: frozenset[InterventionType] = frozenset(
    {
        InterventionType.FORM_INPUT,
        InterventionType.SELECTION,
        InterventionType.CREATE_CONTENT,
        InterventionType.PERMISSION,
        InterventionType.DEFAULT_APP,
        InterventionType.TERMS_CONSENT,
        InterventionType.PRIVACY_CONSENT,
        InterventionType.SYSTEM_SETTINGS,
        InterventionType.UNKNOWN_BLOCKING_SCREEN,
    }
)

# True human-only: secrets / challenges.
HITL_ONLY_TYPES: frozenset[InterventionType] = frozenset(
    {
        InterventionType.LOGIN,
        InterventionType.OTP,
        InterventionType.CAPTCHA,
        InterventionType.VERIFICATION,
    }
)

_FORM_TYPES = frozenset(
    {
        InterventionType.FORM_INPUT,
        InterventionType.CREATE_CONTENT,
    }
)

_ALLOW_RX = re.compile(
    r"^(allow|allow all|while using the app|only this time|allow once|"
    r"accept|agree|i agree|agree and continue|continue|ok|got it|next)$",
    re.I,
)
_DENY_RX = re.compile(
    r"^(don'?t allow|deny|reject|decline|cancel|no|not now)$",
    re.I,
)
_CONSENT_RX = re.compile(
    r"^(agree|accept|i agree|agree and continue|continue|ok|got it|next|start)$",
    re.I,
)
_DEFAULT_RX = re.compile(
    r"(set as default|set default|always|use this app|make default)",
    re.I,
)
# Never grant HOME/launcher during exploration — dismiss these gates.
_DEFAULT_DISMISS_RX = re.compile(
    r"^(cancel|not now|no thanks|skip|dismiss|close|don'?t ask again)$",
    re.I,
)
_CTA_RX = re.compile(

_SKIP_AD_RX = re.compile(

_PLACEHOLDER_RX = re.compile(
