"""Validate AI decisions and map them onto deterministic PlannedAction objects."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import logging
import re
from typing import Any, Sequence

from pydantic import ValidationError

from app.modules.ai_explorer.schema import ALLOWED_ACTIONS, AIActionDecision
from app.modules.exploration.action_planner import PlannedAction, back_action
from app.modules.exploration.actions import MenuAction, TypeTextAction, WaitAction, sanitize_type_text

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

_JSON_BLOCK = re.compile(r"\{[^{}]*\}", re.DOTALL)


class ActionValidationError(ValueError):
    """Raised when an AI response cannot be safely mapped to an allowed action."""


def extract_json_object(raw: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    text = (raw or "").strip()
    if not text:
        raise ActionValidationError("empty AI response")
    # Strip common markdown fences without executing anything.
    if text.startswith("```"):
        text = re.sub(r"^```(?:json)?\s*", "", text)
        text = re.sub(r"\s*```$", "", text)
    data: Any = None
    try:
        data = json.loads(text)
    except json.JSONDecodeError:
        match = _JSON_BLOCK.search(text)
        if not match:
            raise ActionValidationError("AI response is not a JSON object")
        try:
            data = json.loads(match.group(0))
        except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
            raise ActionValidationError("AI JSON parse failed") from exc
    if not isinstance(data, dict):
        raise ActionValidationError("AI JSON root must be an object")
    # Reject unexpected executable-looking keys.
    banned_keys = {
        "command",
        "shell",
        "adb",
        "code",
        "python",
        "script",
        "env",
        "credentials",
        "aws",
    }
    lowered = {str(k).lower() for k in data.keys()}
    if lowered & banned_keys:
        raise ActionValidationError("AI response contains disallowed keys")
    return data


def parse_ai_decision(raw: str | dict[str, Any]) -> AIActionDecision:
    if isinstance(raw, dict):
        data = raw
        banned_keys = {
            "command",
            "shell",
            "adb",
            "code",
            "python",
            "script",
            "env",
            "credentials",
            "aws",
        }
        lowered = {str(k).lower() for k in data.keys()}
        if lowered & banned_keys:
            raise ActionValidationError("AI response contains disallowed keys")
    else:
        data = extract_json_object(raw)
    # Keep only known fields.
    filtered = {
        "action": data.get("action"),
        "target": data.get("target"),
        "text": data.get("text"),
        "confidence": data.get("confidence"),
        "reason": data.get("reason") or "",
    }
    try:
        return AIActionDecision.model_validate(filtered)
    except ValidationError as exc:
        raise ActionValidationError(str(exc)) from exc


def candidate_summaries(candidates: Sequence[PlannedAction]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    return [
        {
            "key": item.key,
            "action": _normalize_kind(item.kind),
            "label": item.label,
            "priority": item.priority,
            "default_text": (item.meta or {}).get("default_text"),
        }
        for item in candidates
    ]


def _normalize_kind(kind: str) -> str:
    raw = (kind or "").strip().lower()
    if raw == "menu":
        return "open_menu"
    if raw == "swipe":
        return "swipe_up"
    return raw


def map_decision_to_planned(
    decision: AIActionDecision,
    candidates: Sequence[PlannedAction],
) -> PlannedAction:
    """Map a validated decision onto a concrete PlannedAction from candidates.

    Rejects decisions that do not match an allow-listed candidate (except
    ``back`` / ``stop`` / ``wait`` / ``open_menu`` synthetics when needed).
    """
    action = decision.action
    if action not in ALLOWED_ACTIONS:
        raise ActionValidationError(f"disallowed action: {action}")

    if action == "stop":
        return PlannedAction(
            key="stop:ai",
            action=WaitAction(seconds=0),
            kind="stop",
            priority=0,
            label="stop exploration (AI)",
            meta={"reason": decision.reason, "source": "ai"},
        )

    if action == "back":
        planned = back_action()
        return PlannedAction(
            key=planned.key,
            action=planned.action,
            kind=planned.kind,
            priority=planned.priority,
            label=planned.label,
            meta={**planned.meta, "reason": decision.reason, "source": "ai"},
        )

    # Prefer exact key match.
    if decision.target:
        for item in candidates:
            if item.key == decision.target and _normalize_kind(item.kind) == action:
                return _with_ai_meta(item, decision)
        # Target key exists but kind mismatch — still allow if key matches uniquely.
        for item in candidates:
            if item.key == decision.target:
                if _normalize_kind(item.kind) not in ALLOWED_ACTIONS and action == "tap":
                    pass
                if _normalize_kind(item.kind) == action or (
                    action == "tap" and _normalize_kind(item.kind) == "tap"
                ):
                    return _with_ai_meta(item, decision)
        raise ActionValidationError(
            f"target '{decision.target}' is not an allowed candidate for action={action}"
        )

    # No target: first candidate of that action kind.
    for item in candidates:
        if _normalize_kind(item.kind) == action:
            return _with_ai_meta(item, decision)

    if action == "wait":
        return PlannedAction(
            key="wait:ai",
            action=WaitAction(seconds=2.0),
            kind="wait",
            priority=10,
            label="wait (AI)",
            meta={"reason": decision.reason, "source": "ai", "seconds": 2.0},
        )
    if action == "open_menu":
        return PlannedAction(
            key="menu:ai",
            action=MenuAction(),
            kind="menu",
            priority=15,
            label="open menu (AI)",
            meta={"reason": decision.reason, "source": "ai"},
        )

    raise ActionValidationError(f"no candidate available for action={action}")


def _with_ai_meta(item: PlannedAction, decision: AIActionDecision) -> PlannedAction:
    meta = dict(item.meta)
    meta["reason"] = decision.reason
    meta["source"] = "ai"
    meta["planner_source"] = "AI"
    if decision.confidence is not None:
        meta["confidence"] = decision.confidence
    action = item.action
    # Allow AI to override typed text on type_text candidates only.
    if decision.action == "type_text" and isinstance(item.action, TypeTextAction):
        override = sanitize_type_text(decision.text or item.action.text)
        if not override:
            override = sanitize_type_text(item.action.text) or "Test"
        action = TypeTextAction(
            text=override,
            element=item.action.element,
            x=item.action.x,
            y=item.action.y,
            clear_first=item.action.clear_first,
        )
        meta["default_text"] = override
    return PlannedAction(
        key=item.key,
        action=action,
        kind=item.kind,
        priority=item.priority,
        label=item.label,
        meta=meta,
    )


def validate_and_map(
    raw: str | dict[str, Any],
    candidates: Sequence[PlannedAction],
) -> PlannedAction:
    decision = parse_ai_decision(raw)
    planned = map_decision_to_planned(decision, candidates)
    logger.info(
        "AI decision accepted action=%s key=%s reason=%s",
        decision.action,
        planned.key,
        (decision.reason or "")[:120],
    )
    return planned

FILE: backend/app/modules/apk_analyzer/aapt.py

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
import os
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
from functools import lru_cache
from pathlib import Path

from app.core.config import settings
from app.core.xmlutil import parse_int

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

_PACKAGE_NAME = re.compile(r"package:\s*name='([^']+)'")
_VERSION_CODE = re.compile(r"versionCode='([^']*)'")
_VERSION_NAME = re.compile(r"versionName='([^']*)'")
_COMPILE_SDK = re.compile(r"compileSdkVersion='([^']*)'")
_SDK_VERSION = re.compile(r"^sdkVersion:'([^']+)'", re.MULTILINE)
_TARGET_SDK = re.compile(r"^targetSdkVersion:'([^']+)'", re.MULTILINE)
_LABEL = re.compile(r"^application-label:'(.*)'$", re.MULTILINE)
_PERMISSION = re.compile(
    r"^uses-permission(?:-sdk-\d+)?: name='([^']+)'(?: maxSdkVersion='([^']+)')?",
    re.MULTILINE,
)


@lru_cache(maxsize=1)
def find_aapt() -> str | None:
    configured = (settings.aapt_path or "").strip()
    if configured:
        path = Path(configured)
        if path.is_file():
            return str(path)
    for name in ("aapt", "aapt.exe"):
        found = shutil.which(name)
        if found:
            return found
    home = os.environ.get("ANDROID_HOME") or os.environ.get("ANDROID_SDK_ROOT")
    if not home:
        return None
    tools = Path(home) / "build-tools"
    if not tools.is_dir():
        return None
    for version_dir in sorted(tools.iterdir(), reverse=True):
        for exe in ("aapt.exe", "aapt"):
            candidate = version_dir / exe
            if candidate.is_file():
                return str(candidate)
    return None


def aapt_available() -> bool:
    return find_aapt() is not None


def parse_badging(output: str) -> dict:
    package = _first(_PACKAGE_NAME, output)
    version_code = parse_int(_first(_VERSION_CODE, output))
    version_name = _first(_VERSION_NAME, output)
    compile_sdk = parse_int(_first(_COMPILE_SDK, output))
    min_sdk = parse_int(_first(_SDK_VERSION, output))
    target_sdk = parse_int(_first(_TARGET_SDK, output))
    label = _first(_LABEL, output)
    permissions: list[dict] = []
    seen: set[str] = set()
    for match in _PERMISSION.finditer(output):
        name = match.group(1)
        if not name or name in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(name)
        permissions.append({"name": name, "max_sdk_version": parse_int(match.group(2))})
    return {
        "package": package,
        "version_code": version_code,
        "version_name": version_name,
        "compile_sdk": compile_sdk,
        "min_sdk": min_sdk,
        "target_sdk": target_sdk,
        "app_label": label,
        "permissions": permissions,
        "raw": False,
    }


def dump_badging(apk_path: Path) -> dict | None:
    binary = find_aapt()
    if binary is None:
        return None
    try:
        completed = subprocess.run(
            [binary, "dump", "badging", str(apk_path)],
            check=False,
            capture_output=True,
            text=True,
            timeout=30,
        )
    except (OSError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired) as exc:
        logger.warning("aapt dump badging failed: %s", type(exc).__name__)
        return None
    if completed.returncode != 0:
        logger.warning("aapt dump badging exited %s", completed.returncode)
        return None
    parsed = parse_badging(completed.stdout or "")
    parsed["raw"] = True
    return parsed


def prefer(aapt_value, other_value, field: str, warnings: list[str]):
    if aapt_value is not None and other_value is not None and str(aapt_value) != str(other_value):
        warnings.append(
            f"{field} mismatch: aapt={aapt_value} androguard={other_value}; using aapt."
        )
    if aapt_value is not None:
        return aapt_value
    return other_value


def _first(pattern: re.Pattern[str], text: str) -> str | None:
    match = pattern.search(text)
    if not match:
        return None
    value = match.group(1)
    return value if value != "" else None

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
import zipfile
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any
from xml.etree.ElementTree import Element

from app.core.errors import AppError
from app.modules.apk_analyzer.aapt import dump_badging

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


@dataclass
class ApkContext:
    path: Path
    file_name: str
    file_size: int
    sha256: str
    job_id: str
    apk: Any
    manifest_xml: Element
    zip_names: list[str]
    aapt: dict | None = None
    warnings: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)


def _load_apk_class():
    try:
        from androguard.core.apk import APK

        return APK
    except ImportError:  # pragma: no cover
        from androguard.core.bytecodes.apk import APK

        return APK


def _validate_zip(path: Path) -> list[str]:
    if path.stat().st_size < 4:
        raise AppError("INVALID_FILE", "The uploaded file is empty.")
    header = path.read_bytes()[:4]
    if header[:2] != b"PK":
        raise AppError("INVALID_APK", "The uploaded file is not a valid Android APK.")
    try:
        with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as archive:
            names = archive.namelist()
    except AppError:
        raise
    except zipfile.BadZipFile as exc:
        raise AppError("CORRUPT_APK", "The uploaded APK appears to be corrupted.") from exc
    except Exception as exc:
        raise AppError("CORRUPT_APK", "The uploaded APK could not be read as a ZIP archive.") from exc

    lowered = {name.lower() for name in names}
    if "bundleconfig.pb" in lowered or "base/manifest/androidmanifest.xml" in lowered:
        raise AppError(
            "UNSUPPORTED_APK",
            "Android App Bundles (.aab) and split packages are not supported.",
        )
    if "AndroidManifest.xml" not in names:
        raise AppError("INVALID_APK", "The uploaded file is not a valid Android APK.")
    return names


def open_apk(
    path: Path,
    *,
    file_name: str,
    file_size: int,
    sha256: str,
    job_id: str,
) -> ApkContext:
    zip_names = _validate_zip(path)
    apk_cls = _load_apk_class()
    try:
        apk = apk_cls(str(path))
    except AppError:
        raise
    except Exception as exc:
        logger.warning("Androguard failed to parse APK: %s", type(exc).__name__)
        raise AppError("CORRUPT_APK", "The APK could not be parsed.") from exc

    try:
        manifest_xml = apk.get_android_manifest_xml()
    except Exception as exc:
        raise AppError("MANIFEST_INVALID", "The Android manifest could not be parsed.") from exc

    if manifest_xml is None:
        raise AppError("MANIFEST_INVALID", "The Android manifest could not be parsed.")

    aapt = dump_badging(path)
    warnings: list[str] = []
    if aapt is None:
        warnings.append("aapt is unavailable; using Androguard-only metadata.")

    return ApkContext(
        path=path,
        file_name=file_name,
        file_size=file_size,
        sha256=sha256,
        job_id=job_id,
        apk=apk,
        manifest_xml=manifest_xml,
        zip_names=zip_names,
        aapt=aapt,
        warnings=warnings,
    )

"""Build ApplicationIntelligence from existing static APK analysis output.

Reuses AnalysisResponse / analysis data dict — does NOT re-parse the APK.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
import re
from typing import Any

from app.modules.apk_intelligence.models import (
    ActivityIntel,
    AdFormatSignal,
    AdSdkSignal,
    AdTriggerHypothesis,
    AdTriggerSignal,
    ApplicationIntelligence,
    DeepLinkSignal,
    FeatureSignal,
    StaticEvidence,
)

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

# Known ad SDK name → provider (matched against existing third_party_sdk_usage names).
_AD_SDK_ALIASES: dict[str, tuple[str, str]] = {
    "google admob": ("Google Mobile Ads", "Google"),
    "google mobile ads": ("Google Mobile Ads", "Google"),
    "admob": ("Google Mobile Ads", "Google"),
    "facebook audience network": ("Meta Audience Network", "Meta"),
    "facebook ads": ("Meta Audience Network", "Meta"),
    "ironsource": ("ironSource / LevelPlay", "ironSource"),
    "unity ads": ("Unity Ads", "Unity"),
    "applovin": ("AppLovin", "AppLovin"),
    "vungle": ("Vungle / Liftoff", "Liftoff"),
    "chartboost": ("Chartboost", "Chartboost"),
    "mintegral": ("Mintegral", "Mintegral"),
    "pangle": ("Pangle", "ByteDance"),
}

_AD_FORMAT_CLASS_RX: list[tuple[re.Pattern[str], str, float]] = [
    (re.compile(r"RewardedAd|RewardedInterstitial|RewardedVideo", re.I), "REWARDED", 0.92),
    (re.compile(r"InterstitialAd|Interstitial", re.I), "INTERSTITIAL", 0.85),
    (re.compile(r"AppOpenAd|AppOpen", re.I), "APP_OPEN", 0.88),
    (re.compile(r"NativeAd|NativeAds", re.I), "NATIVE", 0.82),
    (re.compile(r"BannerAd|AdView|BannerView", re.I), "BANNER", 0.80),
]

_AD_TRIGGER_METHOD_RX: list[tuple[re.Pattern[str], str, float]] = [
    (re.compile(r"showRewarded|loadRewarded|showReward", re.I), "REWARDED", 0.84),
    (re.compile(r"showInterstitial|loadInterstitial", re.I), "INTERSTITIAL", 0.82),
    (re.compile(r"showAppOpen|loadAppOpen", re.I), "APP_OPEN", 0.80),
    (re.compile(r"loadAd|showAd|requestAd|initializeAds|MobileAds\.initialize", re.I), "UNKNOWN", 0.55),
]

_FEATURE_PERMISSIONS: dict[str, tuple[str, float]] = {
    "android.permission.CAMERA": ("CAMERA", 0.96),
    "android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO": ("AUDIO", 0.94),
    "android.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION": ("LOCATION", 0.96),
    "android.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION": ("LOCATION", 0.90),
    "android.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS": ("NOTIFICATIONS", 0.92),
    "android.permission.READ_CONTACTS": ("CONTACTS", 0.94),
    "android.permission.READ_PHONE_STATE": ("PHONE", 0.88),
    "android.permission.READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE": ("STORAGE", 0.80),
    "android.permission.WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE": ("STORAGE", 0.80),
    "com.android.vending.BILLING": ("IN_APP_PURCHASE", 0.95),
}

_AUTH_RX = re.compile(r"login|signin|sign_in|auth|otp|register|signup", re.I)
_SETTINGS_RX = re.compile(r"settings|preference|option|config", re.I)
_WEB_RX = re.compile(r"webview|browser|webactivity|chrome", re.I)
_MAIN_RX = re.compile(r"main|home|dashboard|launcher", re.I)
_LAUNCHER = "android.intent.action.MAIN"
_LAUNCHER_CAT = "android.intent.category.LAUNCHER"


def _as_dict(value: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if value is None:
        return {}
    if hasattr(value, "model_dump"):
        try:
            return value.model_dump()
        except Exception:
            pass
    return value if isinstance(value, dict) else {}


def _analysis_data(analysis: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    payload = _as_dict(analysis)
    data = _as_dict(payload.get("data"))
    return data or payload


def build_application_intelligence(analysis: Any) -> ApplicationIntelligence:
    """Normalize existing static analysis into ApplicationIntelligence (once per job)."""
    logger.info("[APK-INTELLIGENCE] Building application intelligence")
    warnings: list[str] = []
    try:
        data = _analysis_data(analysis)
        if not data:
            intel = ApplicationIntelligence(status="empty", warnings=["no_analysis_data"])
            logger.info("[APK-INTELLIGENCE] Intelligence empty (no analysis data)")
            return intel

        apk = _as_dict(data.get("apk"))
        manifest = _as_dict(data.get("manifest"))
        sdk = _as_dict(data.get("sdk"))
        code = _as_dict(data.get("code_analysis"))

        application = {
            "package_name": apk.get("package_name") or manifest.get("package"),
            "version_name": apk.get("version_name") or manifest.get("version_name"),
            "version_code": apk.get("version_code") or manifest.get("version_code"),
            "min_sdk": sdk.get("min_sdk"),
            "target_sdk": sdk.get("target_sdk"),
            "app_label": manifest.get("app_label"),
        }

        activities_raw = data.get("activities") or []
        services_raw = data.get("services") or []
        activities, entry_points, deep_links = _build_activities(activities_raw)
        components = {
            "activity_count": len(activities),
            "service_count": len(services_raw) if isinstance(services_raw, list) else 0,
            "receiver_count": 0,
            "provider_count": 0,
        }

        permissions = _build_permissions(data.get("permissions") or [])
        ui_signals, webview_ok = _build_ui_signals(code)
        if not webview_ok:
            warnings.append("webview_detection_partial")

        libraries, libs_ok = _build_libraries(code)
        if not libs_ok:
            warnings.append("library_detection_partial")

        ads, ads_ok = _build_ads(code, libraries)
        if not ads_ok:
            warnings.append("ad_detection_partial")

        features = _build_features(permissions, ads, ui_signals, code)
        hypotheses = _build_ad_hypotheses(ads)

        signals = {
            "interesting_components": [
                a.name for a in activities if a.launcher or a.exported or a.kind != "UNKNOWN"
            ][:20],
            "navigation_signals": list(entry_points.get("launcher_activities") or [])[:8],
            "risk_signals": [
                f.feature for f in features if f.feature in {"CAMERA", "LOCATION", "PHONE", "CONTACTS"}
            ],
        }

        status = "ready" if not warnings else "partial"
        intel = ApplicationIntelligence(
            status=status,
            application=application,
            components=components,
            permissions=permissions,
            entry_points=entry_points,
            ui_signals=ui_signals,
            libraries=libraries,
            ads=ads,
            features=features,
            signals=signals,
            deep_links=deep_links,
            activities=activities,
            ad_trigger_hypotheses=hypotheses,
            warnings=warnings,
        )
        logger.info(
            "[APK-INTELLIGENCE] Activities=%s services=%s",
            components["activity_count"],
            components["service_count"],
        )
        logger.info(
            "[APK-INTELLIGENCE] WebView detected=%s",
            bool(ui_signals.get("webview_present")),
        )
        logger.info(
            "[APK-INTELLIGENCE] Ad SDK signals=%s",
            len(ads.get("sdk_candidates") or []),
        )
        formats = ads.get("ad_formats") or []
        fmt_bits = []
        for item in formats[:6]:
            if isinstance(item, dict):
                fmt_bits.append(f"{item.get('format')}={item.get('confidence')}")
        if fmt_bits:
            logger.info("[APK-INTELLIGENCE] Ad format signals %s", " ".join(fmt_bits))
        logger.info("[APK-INTELLIGENCE] Features inferred=%s", len(features))
        logger.info("[APK-INTELLIGENCE] Intelligence ready status=%s", status)
        return intel
    except Exception as exc:
        logger.warning("[APK-INTELLIGENCE] Build failed (%s); returning empty", type(exc).__name__)
        return ApplicationIntelligence(
            status="empty",
            warnings=[f"build_failed:{type(exc).__name__}"],
        )


def _build_activities(
    activities_raw: Any,
) -> tuple[list[ActivityIntel], dict[str, Any], list[DeepLinkSignal]]:
    activities: list[ActivityIntel] = []
    launchers: list[str] = []
    exported: list[str] = []
    deep_links: list[DeepLinkSignal] = []

    if not isinstance(activities_raw, list):
        return activities, {
            "launcher_activities": [],
            "exported_activities": [],
            "deep_links": 0,
        }, deep_links

    for raw in activities_raw:
        entry = _as_dict(raw)
        name = str(entry.get("name") or "")
        if not name:
            continue
        filters = entry.get("intent_filters") or []
        is_launcher = False
        for filt in filters:
            f = _as_dict(filt)
            actions = [str(a) for a in (f.get("actions") or [])]
            cats = [str(c) for c in (f.get("categories") or [])]
            if _LAUNCHER in actions and _LAUNCHER_CAT in cats:
                is_launcher = True
            for data_el in f.get("data") or []:
                d = _as_dict(data_el)
                scheme = d.get("scheme")
                host = d.get("host")
                path = d.get("path") or d.get("path_prefix") or d.get("path_pattern")
                if scheme or host:
                    uri = None
                    if scheme:
                        uri = f"{scheme}://"
                        if host:
                            uri += str(host)
                        if path:
                            uri += str(path)
                    deep_links.append(
                        DeepLinkSignal(
                            scheme=scheme,
                            host=host,
                            path=path,
                            activity=name,
                            uri_pattern=uri,
                        )
                    )
        is_exported = bool(entry.get("exported"))
        kind = _classify_activity(name, is_launcher)
        activities.append(
            ActivityIntel(
                name=name,
                exported=is_exported,
                enabled=entry.get("enabled") is not False,
                launcher=is_launcher,
                kind=kind,
                permission=entry.get("permission"),
                intent_filter_count=len(filters) if isinstance(filters, list) else 0,
            )
        )
        if is_launcher:
            launchers.append(name)
        if is_exported:
            exported.append(name)

    entry_points = {
        "launcher_activities": launchers,
        "exported_activities": exported[:40],
        "deep_links": len(deep_links),
    }
    return activities, entry_points, deep_links[:40]


def _classify_activity(name: str, is_launcher: bool) -> str:
    short = name.rsplit(".", 1)[-1]
    if is_launcher:
        return "ENTRY_POINT"
    if _AUTH_RX.search(short):
        return "AUTHENTICATION"
    if _SETTINGS_RX.search(short):
        return "SETTINGS"
    if _WEB_RX.search(short) or _WEB_RX.search(name):
        return "WEB"
    if _MAIN_RX.search(short):
        return "MAIN"
    if "Activity" in short or short:
        return "CONTENT"
    return "UNKNOWN"


def _build_permissions(permissions_raw: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    requested: list[str] = []
    dangerous: list[str] = []
    special: list[str] = []
    normal: list[str] = []
    if not isinstance(permissions_raw, list):
        return {
            "requested": [],
            "dangerous": [],
            "special": [],
            "normal": [],
            "unknown": [],
        }
    unknown: list[str] = []
    for raw in permissions_raw:
        entry = _as_dict(raw) if not isinstance(raw, str) else {"name": raw}
        name = str(entry.get("name") or "")
        if not name:
            continue
        requested.append(name)
        level = str(entry.get("protection_level") or entry.get("protection") or "").lower()
        if level == "dangerous":
            dangerous.append(name)
        elif level in {"signature", "signatureorsystem", "privileged", "special"}:
            special.append(name)
        elif level == "normal":
            normal.append(name)
        else:
            # Fall back to AOSP map if present in entry category.
            cat = str(entry.get("category") or "").lower()
            if "dangerous" in cat:
                dangerous.append(name)
            elif "normal" in cat:
                normal.append(name)
            else:
                unknown.append(name)
    return {
        "requested": requested[:120],
        "dangerous": dangerous[:60],
        "special": special[:40],
        "normal": normal[:80],
        "unknown": unknown[:40],
    }


def _build_ui_signals(code: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], bool]:
    try:
        webview_usage = code.get("webview_usage") or []
        present = bool(webview_usage)
        evidence: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
        for item in (webview_usage if isinstance(webview_usage, list) else [])[:6]:
            entry = _as_dict(item)
            evidence.append(
                {
                    "source": "code_analysis.webview_usage",
                    "value": str(
                        entry.get("label")
                        or entry.get("api")
                        or entry.get("class")
                        or entry.get("name")
                        or "webview"
                    )[:160],
                    "confidence": 0.95,
                }
            )
        # Also scan class names for WebViewClient / WebChromeClient.
        for raw in (code.get("classes") or [])[:200]:
            entry = _as_dict(raw) if not isinstance(raw, str) else {"name": raw}
            cname = str(entry.get("name") or "")
            if "WebView" in cname or "WebViewClient" in cname or "WebChromeClient" in cname:
                present = True
                evidence.append(
                    {
                        "source": "class",
                        "value": cname[:160],
                        "confidence": 0.90,
                    }
                )
                if len(evidence) >= 8:
                    break
        return {
            "webview_present": present,
            "webview_evidence": evidence[:8],
            "browser_intents": False,
        }, True
    except Exception:
        return {"webview_present": False, "webview_evidence": [], "browser_intents": False}, False


def _build_libraries(code: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], bool]:
    try:
        out: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
        seen: set[str] = set()
        for raw in code.get("third_party_sdk_usage") or []:
            entry = _as_dict(raw) if not isinstance(raw, str) else {"name": raw}
            name = str(entry.get("name") or entry.get("sdk") or entry.get("package") or "")
            if not name:
                continue
            key = name.lower()
            if key in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(key)
            evidence_val = str(entry.get("package") or entry.get("prefix") or name)
            out.append(
                {
                    "name": name,
                    "confidence": 0.92,
                    "evidence": [
                        {
                            "source": "third_party_sdk_usage",
                            "value": evidence_val[:160],
                            "confidence": 0.92,
                        }
                    ],
                }
            )
        return out[:40], True
    except Exception:
        return [], False


def _build_ads(
    code: dict[str, Any],
    libraries: list[dict[str, Any]],
) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], bool]:
    try:
        sdk_signals: list[AdSdkSignal] = []
        seen_sdk: set[str] = set()

        # From known third_party SDK names.
        for lib in libraries:
            name = str(lib.get("name") or "")
            key = name.lower()
            for alias, (canonical, provider) in _AD_SDK_ALIASES.items():
                if alias in key:
                    if canonical in seen_sdk:
                        break
                    seen_sdk.add(canonical)
                    ev = [
                        StaticEvidence(
                            source="third_party_sdk_usage",
                            value=name,
                            confidence=0.94,
                        )
                    ]
                    for e in lib.get("evidence") or []:
                        ed = _as_dict(e)
                        if ed.get("value"):
                            ev.append(
                                StaticEvidence(
                                    source=str(ed.get("source") or "sdk"),
                                    value=str(ed["value"]),
                                    confidence=float(ed.get("confidence") or 0.9),
                                )
                            )
                    sdk_signals.append(
                        AdSdkSignal(
                            name=canonical,
                            provider=provider,
                            confidence=0.94,
                            evidence=ev[:6],
                        )
                    )
                    break

        format_signals: dict[str, AdFormatSignal] = {}
        trigger_signals: list[AdTriggerSignal] = []
        related_classes: list[str] = []
        related_methods: list[str] = []

        # Class / method symbol scans (bounded).
        for raw in (code.get("classes") or [])[:400]:
            entry = _as_dict(raw) if not isinstance(raw, str) else {"name": raw}
            cname = str(entry.get("name") or "")
            if not cname:
                continue
            short = cname.rsplit(".", 1)[-1]
            for rx, fmt, conf in _AD_FORMAT_CLASS_RX:
                if rx.search(short) or rx.search(cname):
                    related_classes.append(cname)
                    existing = format_signals.get(fmt)
                    evidence = StaticEvidence(source="class", value=cname, confidence=conf)
                    if existing is None or conf > existing.confidence:
                        format_signals[fmt] = AdFormatSignal(
                            format=fmt,  # type: ignore[arg-type]
                            kind="LIKELY_FORMAT" if conf >= 0.85 else "POSSIBLE_FORMAT",
                            confidence=conf,
                            evidence=[evidence],
                        )
                    elif existing is not None:
                        existing.evidence.append(evidence)

        for raw in (code.get("methods") or [])[:600]:
            entry = _as_dict(raw) if not isinstance(raw, str) else {"name": raw}
            mname = str(entry.get("name") or entry.get("method") or "")
            cname = str(entry.get("class") or entry.get("class_name") or "")
            if not mname:
                continue
            for rx, fmt, conf in _AD_TRIGGER_METHOD_RX:
                if rx.search(mname):
                    related_methods.append(f"{cname}.{mname}" if cname else mname)
                    trigger_signals.append(
                        AdTriggerSignal(
                            type=fmt,  # type: ignore[arg-type]
                            symbol=mname,
                            class_name=cname or None,
                            confidence=conf,
                            evidence="static_symbol_match",
                        )
                    )
                    if fmt != "UNKNOWN":
                        evidence = StaticEvidence(
                            source="method",
                            value=f"{cname}.{mname}" if cname else mname,
                            confidence=conf,
                        )
                        existing = format_signals.get(fmt)
                        if existing is None or conf > existing.confidence:
                            format_signals[fmt] = AdFormatSignal(
                                format=fmt,  # type: ignore[arg-type]
                                kind="POSSIBLE_FORMAT",
                                confidence=conf,
                                evidence=[evidence],
                            )

        # SDK presence also implies possible formats (weaker).
        for sdk in sdk_signals:
            key = sdk.name.lower()
            implied: list[tuple[str, float]] = []
            if "google" in key or "admob" in key:
                implied = [
                    ("BANNER", 0.72),
                    ("INTERSTITIAL", 0.72),
                    ("REWARDED", 0.70),
                    ("NATIVE", 0.65),
                    ("APP_OPEN", 0.60),
                ]
            elif "unity" in key or "ironsource" in key or "applovin" in key or "vungle" in key:
                implied = [("INTERSTITIAL", 0.70), ("REWARDED", 0.72), ("BANNER", 0.65)]
            for fmt, conf in implied:
                if fmt not in format_signals:
                    format_signals[fmt] = AdFormatSignal(
                        format=fmt,  # type: ignore[arg-type]
                        kind="POSSIBLE_FORMAT",
                        confidence=conf,
                        evidence=[
                            StaticEvidence(
                                source="sdk_inference",
                                value=sdk.name,
                                confidence=conf,
                            )
                        ],
                    )

        ads = {
            "sdk_candidates": [s.to_dict() for s in sdk_signals],
            "ad_formats": [f.to_dict() for f in format_signals.values()],
            "ad_related_classes": related_classes[:30],
            "ad_related_methods": related_methods[:30],
            "ad_related_resources": [],
            "ad_triggers": [t.to_dict() for t in trigger_signals[:30]],
            "ad_analysis_status": "READY" if (sdk_signals or format_signals) else "EMPTY",
        }
        return ads, True
    except Exception:
        return {
            "sdk_candidates": [],
            "ad_formats": [],
            "ad_related_classes": [],
            "ad_related_methods": [],
            "ad_related_resources": [],
            "ad_triggers": [],
            "ad_analysis_status": "PARTIAL",
        }, False


def _build_features(
    permissions: dict[str, Any],
    ads: dict[str, Any],
    ui_signals: dict[str, Any],
    code: dict[str, Any],
) -> list[FeatureSignal]:
    features: list[FeatureSignal] = []
    seen: set[str] = set()

    def add(feature: str, confidence: float, evidence: list[str]) -> None:
        if feature in seen:
            return
        seen.add(feature)
        features.append(FeatureSignal(feature=feature, confidence=confidence, evidence=evidence))

    for name in permissions.get("requested") or []:
        mapped = _FEATURE_PERMISSIONS.get(str(name))
        if mapped:
            add(mapped[0], mapped[1], [str(name)])

    if ads.get("sdk_candidates"):
        add("ADS", 0.93, [s.get("name", "ad_sdk") for s in ads["sdk_candidates"][:4]])
    formats = {f.get("format") for f in (ads.get("ad_formats") or []) if isinstance(f, dict)}
    if "REWARDED" in formats:
        add("REWARDED_CONTENT", 0.85, ["static_rewarded_signal"])
    if ui_signals.get("webview_present"):
        add("WEB_CONTENT", 0.90, ["webview_usage"])

    # Billing / IAP from libraries
    for lib in code.get("third_party_sdk_usage") or []:
        entry = _as_dict(lib) if not isinstance(lib, str) else {"name": lib}
        name = str(entry.get("name") or "").lower()
        if "billing" in name or "play billing" in name:
            add("IN_APP_PURCHASE", 0.92, [str(entry.get("name"))])
        if "firebase" in name:
            add("NOTIFICATIONS", 0.55, [str(entry.get("name"))])

    return features


def _build_ad_hypotheses(ads: dict[str, Any]) -> list[AdTriggerHypothesis]:
    out: list[AdTriggerHypothesis] = []
    formats = ads.get("ad_formats") or []
    triggers = ads.get("ad_triggers") or []
    by_fmt: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
    for t in triggers:
        td = _as_dict(t)
        fmt = str(td.get("type") or "UNKNOWN")
        sym = str(td.get("symbol") or "")
        if sym:
            by_fmt.setdefault(fmt, []).append(sym)
    for f in formats:
        fd = _as_dict(f)
        fmt = str(fd.get("format") or "UNKNOWN")
        related = []
        if fmt == "REWARDED":
            related = ["reward", "coins", "video", "watch"]
        elif fmt == "INTERSTITIAL":
            related = ["continue", "next", "play"]
        out.append(
            AdTriggerHypothesis(
                ad_format=fmt,  # type: ignore[arg-type]
                static_symbols=by_fmt.get(fmt, [])[:8]
                or [e.get("value", "") for e in (fd.get("evidence") or [])[:4] if isinstance(e, dict)],
                possible_related_features=related,
                confidence=float(fd.get("confidence") or 0.5),
            )
        )
    return out[:12]

"""Phase 12F — Application Intelligence models (static evidence only).

Does not execute APK code, ADB, shell, or invent runtime confirmations.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Any, Literal

AdFormat = Literal[
    "BANNER",
    "INTERSTITIAL",
    "REWARDED",
    "NATIVE",
    "APP_OPEN",
    "UNKNOWN",
]

SignalKind = Literal["STATIC_SIGNAL", "POSSIBLE_FORMAT", "LIKELY_FORMAT"]

ActivityKind = Literal[
    "ENTRY_POINT",
    "AUTHENTICATION",
    "MAIN",
    "SETTINGS",
    "CONTENT",
    "WEB",
    "UNKNOWN",
]


@dataclass
class StaticEvidence:
    source: str
    value: str
    confidence: float = 0.5

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "source": self.source,
            "value": self.value[:240],
            "confidence": _clamp(self.confidence),
        }


@dataclass
class AdSdkSignal:
    name: str
    provider: str
    confidence: float
    evidence: list[StaticEvidence] = field(default_factory=list)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "name": self.name,
            "provider": self.provider,
            "confidence": _clamp(self.confidence),
            "evidence": [e.to_dict() for e in self.evidence[:8]],
        }


@dataclass
class AdFormatSignal:
    format: AdFormat
    kind: SignalKind = "STATIC_SIGNAL"
    confidence: float = 0.5
    evidence: list[StaticEvidence] = field(default_factory=list)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "format": self.format,
            "kind": self.kind,
            "confidence": _clamp(self.confidence),
            "evidence": [e.to_dict() for e in self.evidence[:8]],
        }


@dataclass
class AdTriggerSignal:
    """Hypothesis only — never executed."""

    type: AdFormat
    symbol: str
    class_name: str | None = None
    confidence: float = 0.5
    evidence: str = "static_symbol_match"

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "type": self.type,
            "symbol": self.symbol[:120],
            "class": self.class_name,
            "confidence": _clamp(self.confidence),
            "evidence": self.evidence,
        }


@dataclass
class AdTriggerHypothesis:
    ad_format: AdFormat
    static_symbols: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    possible_related_features: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    confidence: float = 0.5

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "ad_format": self.ad_format,
            "static_symbols": list(self.static_symbols)[:12],
            "possible_related_features": list(self.possible_related_features)[:12],
            "confidence": _clamp(self.confidence),
        }


@dataclass
class FeatureSignal:
    feature: str
    confidence: float
    evidence: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "feature": self.feature,
            "confidence": _clamp(self.confidence),
            "evidence": list(self.evidence)[:8],
        }


@dataclass
class DeepLinkSignal:
    scheme: str | None = None
    host: str | None = None
    path: str | None = None
    activity: str | None = None
    uri_pattern: str | None = None

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "scheme": self.scheme,
            "host": self.host,
            "path": self.path,
            "activity": self.activity,
            "uri_pattern": self.uri_pattern,
        }


@dataclass
class ActivityIntel:
    name: str
    exported: bool = False
    enabled: bool = True
    launcher: bool = False
    kind: ActivityKind = "UNKNOWN"
    permission: str | None = None
    intent_filter_count: int = 0

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "name": self.name,
            "exported": self.exported,
            "enabled": self.enabled,
            "launcher": self.launcher,
            "kind": self.kind,
            "permission": self.permission,
            "intent_filter_count": self.intent_filter_count,
        }


@dataclass
class ApplicationIntelligence:
    """Normalized static APK intelligence for AgentState / AI context."""

    status: str = "ready"  # ready | partial | empty
    application: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    components: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    permissions: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    entry_points: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    ui_signals: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    libraries: list[dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=list)
    ads: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    features: list[FeatureSignal] = field(default_factory=list)
    signals: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    deep_links: list[DeepLinkSignal] = field(default_factory=list)
    activities: list[ActivityIntel] = field(default_factory=list)
    ad_trigger_hypotheses: list[AdTriggerHypothesis] = field(default_factory=list)
    warnings: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "status": self.status,
            "application": dict(self.application),
            "components": dict(self.components),
            "permissions": dict(self.permissions),
            "entry_points": dict(self.entry_points),
            "ui_signals": dict(self.ui_signals),
            "libraries": list(self.libraries)[:40],
            "ads": dict(self.ads),
            "features": [f.to_dict() for f in self.features[:30]],
            "signals": dict(self.signals),
            "deep_links": [d.to_dict() for d in self.deep_links[:40]],
            "activities": [a.to_dict() for a in self.activities[:80]],
            "ad_trigger_hypotheses": [h.to_dict() for h in self.ad_trigger_hypotheses[:20]],
            "warnings": list(self.warnings)[:20],
        }

    def to_ai_summary(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Compact summary for AIPlanningContext — never full APK dumps."""
        ads = self.ads or {}
        sdk_names = [
            s.get("name")
            for s in (ads.get("sdk_candidates") or [])
            if isinstance(s, dict) and s.get("name")
        ]
        formats = [
            {"format": f.get("format"), "confidence": f.get("confidence"), "kind": f.get("kind")}
            for f in (ads.get("ad_formats") or [])
            if isinstance(f, dict)
        ]
        return {
            "package": self.application.get("package_name"),
            "version_name": self.application.get("version_name"),
            "activities": self.components.get("activity_count", len(self.activities)),
            "services": self.components.get("service_count", 0),
            "launcher_activity": (self.entry_points.get("launcher_activities") or [None])[0],
            "exported_activities": len(self.entry_points.get("exported_activities") or []),
            "webview_present": bool(self.ui_signals.get("webview_present")),
            "deep_links": len(self.deep_links),
            "libraries": [
                lib.get("name")
                for lib in self.libraries[:12]
                if isinstance(lib, dict) and lib.get("name")
            ],
            "ad_sdk_signals": sdk_names[:8],
            "ad_format_signals": formats[:8],
            "features": [
                {"feature": f.feature, "confidence": f.confidence}
                for f in self.features[:12]
            ],
            "status": self.status,
            "note": "STATIC_EVIDENCE_ONLY — not runtime confirmation",
        }


def _clamp(value: float) -> float:
    try:
        v = float(value)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return 0.0
    return max(0.0, min(1.0, v))

from __future__ import annotations


def resolve_exported(
    explicit: bool | None,
    has_intent_filters: bool,
    target_sdk: int | None,
) -> tuple[bool | None, bool, str | None]:
    """Return (exported, inferred, warning)."""
    if explicit is not None:
        return explicit, False, None
    if target_sdk is not None and target_sdk >= 31 and has_intent_filters:
        return (
            None,
            False,
            "android:exported is missing on a component with intent filters and targetSdk >= 31.",
        )
    return has_intent_filters, True, None

from __future__ import annotations

from xml.etree.ElementTree import Element

from app.core.xmlutil import android_attr, children_by_tag


def extract_intent_filters(parent: Element) -> list[dict]:
    filters: list[dict] = []
    for intent in children_by_tag(parent, "intent-filter"):
        actions = [android_attr(el, "name") for el in children_by_tag(intent, "action")]
        categories = [android_attr(el, "name") for el in children_by_tag(intent, "category")]
        data_entries = []
        for data_el in children_by_tag(intent, "data"):
            entry = {
                "scheme": android_attr(data_el, "scheme"),
                "host": android_attr(data_el, "host"),
                "port": android_attr(data_el, "port"),
                "path": android_attr(data_el, "path"),
                "path_prefix": android_attr(data_el, "pathPrefix"),
                "path_pattern": android_attr(data_el, "pathPattern"),
                "mime_type": android_attr(data_el, "mimeType"),
            }
            if any(value is not None for value in entry.values()):
                data_entries.append(entry)
        filters.append(
            {
                "actions": [name for name in actions if name],
                "categories": [name for name in categories if name],
                "data": data_entries,
            }
        )
    return filters

@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class CatalogEntry:
    class_prefix: str
    method: str | None
    category: str
    label: str
    risk_category: str

    "telephony": "PHONE",

    _entry("Landroid/media/AudioRecord;", "startRecording", "data_access", "AudioRecord.startRecording"),
    _entry("Landroid/content/ClipboardManager;", "getPrimaryClip", "data_access", "ClipboardManager.getPrimaryClip"),
    _entry("Landroid/content/pm/PackageManager;", "getInstalledPackages", "data_access", "PackageManager.getInstalledPackages"),
    _entry("Landroid/content/pm/PackageManager;", "getInstalledApplications", "data_access", "PackageManager.getInstalledApplications"),
    _entry("Lcom/google/android/gms/ads/identifier/AdvertisingIdClient;", "getAdvertisingIdInfo", "data_access", "AdvertisingIdClient.getAdvertisingIdInfo"),
    _entry("Landroid/telephony/TelephonyManager;", "getAllCellInfo", "data_access", "TelephonyManager.getAllCellInfo"),
    _entry("Landroid/net/wifi/WifiInfo;", "getMacAddress", "data_access", "WifiInfo.getMacAddress"),
    _entry("Landroid/provider/CallLog$Calls;", "CONTENT_URI", "data_access", "CallLog.Calls.CONTENT_URI"),
    # Dynamic code loading / reflection / native
    _entry("Ldalvik/system/DexClassLoader;", "<init>", "dynamic_code", "DexClassLoader.<init>"),
    _entry("Ldalvik/system/PathClassLoader;", "<init>", "dynamic_code", "PathClassLoader.<init>"),
    _entry("Ldalvik/system/InMemoryDexClassLoader;", "<init>", "dynamic_code", "InMemoryDexClassLoader.<init>"),
    _entry("Ljava/lang/Runtime;", "exec", "dynamic_code", "Runtime.exec"),
    _entry("Ljava/lang/Runtime;", "load", "dynamic_code", "Runtime.load"),
    _entry("Ljava/lang/Runtime;", "loadLibrary", "dynamic_code", "Runtime.loadLibrary"),
    _entry("Ljava/lang/System;", "load", "dynamic_code", "System.load"),
    _entry("Ljava/lang/System;", "loadLibrary", "dynamic_code", "System.loadLibrary"),
    _entry("Ljava/lang/Class;", "forName", "dynamic_code", "Class.forName"),
    _entry("Ljava/lang/ClassLoader;", "loadClass", "dynamic_code", "ClassLoader.loadClass"),
    _entry("Ljava/lang/reflect/Method;", "invoke", "dynamic_code", "Method.invoke"),
    _entry("Ljavax/script/ScriptEngine;", "eval", "dynamic_code", "ScriptEngine.eval"),
    _entry("Landroid/content/Context;", "createPackageContext", "dynamic_code", "Context.createPackageContext"),
)

# Class-prefix matches for any method on that type (used sparingly).
CLASS_ANY_METHOD: tuple[CatalogEntry, ...] = (
    _entry("Ldalvik/system/DexClassLoader;", None, "dynamic_code", "DexClassLoader"),
    _entry("Ldalvik/system/InMemoryDexClassLoader;", None, "dynamic_code", "InMemoryDexClassLoader"),
    _entry("Landroid/webkit/WebView;", None, "webview", "WebView"),
    _entry("Landroid/telephony/SmsManager;", None, "telephony", "SmsManager"),
)

SDK_PACKAGES: tuple[tuple[str, str], ...] = (
    ("Lcom/google/android/gms/ads/", "Google AdMob"),
    ("Lcom/google/android/gms/maps/", "Google Maps"),
    ("Lcom/google/android/gms/location/", "Google Play Location"),
    ("Lcom/google/android/gms/measurement/", "Google Analytics / Measurement"),

def _index_by_method() -> dict[str, tuple[CatalogEntry, ...]]:
    buckets: dict[str, list[CatalogEntry]] = {}
    for entry in API_CATALOG:
        if entry.method is None:
            continue
        buckets.setdefault(entry.method, []).append(entry)
    return {name: tuple(items) for name, items in buckets.items()}


BY_METHOD = _index_by_method()


def match_api(class_name: str, method_name: str) -> CatalogEntry | None:
    """Return the first catalog match for a Dalvik class + method, or None."""
    for entry in BY_METHOD.get(method_name, ()):
        if class_name.startswith(entry.class_prefix):
            return entry
    for entry in CLASS_ANY_METHOD:
        if class_name.startswith(entry.class_prefix):
            return entry
    return None


def match_sdk(dalvik_class: str) -> tuple[str, str] | None:
    for prefix, name in SDK_PACKAGES:
        if dalvik_class.startswith(prefix):
            return prefix, name
    return None


def dalvik_type_to_java(dalvik_name: str | None) -> str:
    if not dalvik_name:
        return ""
    text = str(dalvik_name)
    if text.startswith("L") and text.endswith(";"):
        return text[1:-1].replace("/", ".")
    if text.startswith("L") and "/" in text:
        return text[1:].rstrip(";").replace("/", ".")
    return text.replace("/", ".")


def api_class_name(dalvik_class: str, entry: CatalogEntry) -> str:
    """Prefer the catalog class_prefix type; fall back to the matched Dalvik class."""
    prefix = entry.class_prefix
    if prefix.endswith(";"):
        return dalvik_type_to_java(prefix)
    return dalvik_type_to_java(dalvik_class)


def api_method_name(method_name: str, entry: CatalogEntry) -> str:
    return entry.method or method_name or entry.label.split(".")[-1]
