from __future__ import annotations

import logging
import re
from collections import defaultdict
from typing import Any

from app.core.config import settings
from app.modules.apk_analyzer.context import ApkContext
from app.modules.dex.catalog import api_class_name, api_method_name, match_api, match_sdk

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

_URL_RE = re.compile(r"https?://[^\s\"'<>\\]{4,256}", re.IGNORECASE)
_HOST_HINT_RE = re.compile(
    r"(?:(?:[a-z0-9-]+\.)+(?:com|net|org|io|co|app|me|info|biz|dev)(?:/[^\s\"']*)?)",
    re.IGNORECASE,
)
_PAIRIP_MARKERS = ("pairip", "libpairip", "com.pairip")
_SKIP_CLASS_PREFIXES = (
    "Landroid/",
    "Landroidx/",
    "Lcom/google/android/",
    "Lcom/google/firebase/",
    "Lkotlin/",
    "Lkotlinx/",
    "Ljava/",
    "Ljavax/",
    "Lokhttp3/",
    "Lokio/",
    "Lretrofit2/",
)

CATEGORY_BUCKETS = {
    "telephony": "telephony_calls",
    "network": "network_calls",
    "webview": "webview_usage",
    "file_storage": "file_storage_operations",
    "data_access": "data_access_indicators",
    "dynamic_code": "dynamic_code_loading",
}


def empty_code_analysis(**overrides: Any) -> dict:
    payload = {
        "summary": {
            "dex_files": 0,
            "class_count": 0,
            "method_count": 0,
            "xref_built": False,
            "truncated": False,
        },
        "classes": [],
        "methods": [],
        "sensitive_api_calls": [],
        "api_calls": [],
        "network_calls": [],
        "webview_usage": [],
        "file_storage_operations": [],
        "telephony_calls": [],
        "data_access_indicators": [],
        "dynamic_code_loading": [],
        "third_party_sdk_usage": [],
        "network_strings": [],
        "code_findings": [],
    }
    payload.update(overrides)
    return payload


def dalvik_to_java(name: str | None) -> str:
    if not name:
        return ""
    text = str(name)
    if text.startswith("L") and text.endswith(";"):
        return text[1:-1].replace("/", ".")
    return text.replace("/", ".")


def _is_app_class(dalvik_name: str, package: str) -> bool:
    if not package:
        return False
    java = dalvik_to_java(dalvik_name)
    return java == package or java.startswith(package + ".")


def _caller_from_xref(item: Any) -> tuple[str, str, str | None, int | None]:
    offset: int | None = None
    if isinstance(item, (tuple, list)) and len(item) >= 2:
        cls, meth = item[0], item[1]
        if len(item) >= 3 and isinstance(item[2], int):
            offset = item[2]
    else:
        return "", "", None, None
    class_name = dalvik_to_java(getattr(cls, "name", None) or getattr(meth, "class_name", None))
    method_name = getattr(meth, "name", None) or ""
    descriptor = getattr(meth, "descriptor", None)
    if descriptor is None and hasattr(meth, "get_descriptor"):
        try:
            descriptor = meth.get_descriptor()
        except Exception:
            descriptor = None
    return (
        class_name,
        method_name,
        str(descriptor) if descriptor is not None else None,
        offset,
    )


def _format_method_signature(method_name: str, descriptor: str | None) -> str:
    if descriptor:
        return f"{method_name}{descriptor}"
    return f"{method_name}()"


def _build_mapped_call(
    *,
    caller_class: str,
    caller_method: str,
    caller_descriptor: str | None,
    api_dalvik_class: str,
    api_method: str,
    entry: Any,
    offset: int | None,
    package: str,
) -> dict:
    api_cls = api_class_name(api_dalvik_class, entry)
    api_meth = api_method_name(api_method, entry)
    evidence = "method invocation detected"
    if offset is not None:
        evidence = f"method invocation detected at bytecode offset 0x{offset:x}"
    is_app = bool(package and caller_class and (caller_class == package or caller_class.startswith(package + ".")))
    return {
        "class_name": caller_class,
        "method_name": caller_method,
        "method_signature": _format_method_signature(caller_method, caller_descriptor),
        "api_class": api_cls,
        "api_method": api_meth,
        "api": f"{api_cls}.{api_meth}",
        "risk_category": entry.risk_category,
        "category": entry.category,
        "evidence": evidence,
        "confidence": "HIGH",
        "is_app_code": is_app,
    }


def _cap(items: list, limit: int) -> tuple[list, bool]:
    if len(items) <= limit:
        return items, False
    return items[:limit], True


def _looks_protected(ctx: ApkContext) -> bool:
    names = " ".join(ctx.zip_names).lower()
    if any(marker in names for marker in _PAIRIP_MARKERS):
        return True
    if ctx.manifest_xml is None:
        return False
    from app.core.xmlutil import android_attr, find_application

    app = find_application(ctx.manifest_xml)
    app_class = android_attr(app, "name") if app is not None else ""
    return "pairip" in (app_class or "").lower()


def _load_dex_types():
    try:
        from androguard.core.dex import DEX
    except ImportError:  # pragma: no cover
        from androguard.core.bytecodes.dvm import DalvikVMFormat as DEX
    from androguard.core.analysis.analysis import Analysis

    return DEX, Analysis


def _quiet_androguard() -> None:
    logging.getLogger("androguard").setLevel(logging.ERROR)
    try:
        from loguru import logger as loguru_logger

        loguru_logger.disable("androguard")
    except Exception:
        pass


def _build_analysis(ctx: ApkContext) -> tuple[Any, int, bool] | None:
    dex_names = [name for name in ctx.zip_names if re.fullmatch(r"classes(\d*)\.dex", name or "")]
    if not dex_names:
        ctx.warnings.append("No classes.dex found; DEX code analysis was skipped.")
        return None

    DEX, Analysis = _load_dex_types()
    _quiet_androguard()
    analysis = Analysis()
    loaded = 0
    try:
        for blob in ctx.apk.get_all_dex():
            if not blob:
                continue
            analysis.add(DEX(blob))
            loaded += 1
    except Exception:
        logger.warning("Failed to parse DEX for job %s", ctx.job_id, exc_info=True)
        ctx.warnings.append("One or more DEX files could not be parsed.")
        if loaded == 0:
            return None

    xref_built = False
    try:
        analysis.create_xref()
        xref_built = True
    except Exception:
        logger.warning("DEX xref build failed for job %s", ctx.job_id, exc_info=True)
        ctx.warnings.append("DEX cross-references could not be built; API call sites may be incomplete.")
    return analysis, loaded, xref_built


def _scan_strings(analysis: Any, limit: int) -> tuple[list[dict], bool]:
    results: list[dict] = []
    truncated = False
    for item in analysis.get_strings() or []:
        if len(results) >= limit:
            truncated = True
            break
        try:
            value = item.get_value() if hasattr(item, "get_value") else str(item)
        except Exception:
            continue
        if not value or len(value) < 8:
            continue
        url_match = _URL_RE.search(value)
        host_match = None if url_match else _HOST_HINT_RE.search(value)
        if not url_match and not host_match:
            continue
        kind = "url" if url_match else "host"
        extracted = (url_match.group(0) if url_match else host_match.group(0)).rstrip(").,;")
        caller_class = caller_method = None
        try:
            xrefs = list(item.get_xref_from() or [])
        except Exception:
            xrefs = []
        if xrefs:
            caller_class, caller_method, _, _ = _caller_from_xref(next(iter(xrefs)))
        results.append(
            {
                "value": extracted[:256],
                "kind": kind,
                "caller_class": caller_class or None,
                "caller_method": caller_method or None,
            }
        )
    return results, truncated


def scan_analysis(
    analysis: Any,
    *,
    package: str = "",
    permission_names: list[str] | None = None,
    dex_files: int = 0,
    xref_built: bool = True,
    protected: bool = False,
    max_classes: int | None = None,
    max_methods: int | None = None,
    max_findings: int | None = None,
) -> dict:
    max_classes = max_classes if max_classes is not None else settings.max_code_classes
    max_methods = max_methods if max_methods is not None else settings.max_code_methods
    max_findings = max_findings if max_findings is not None else settings.max_code_findings
    permission_names = permission_names or []

    class_count = 0
    method_count = 0
    app_classes: list[dict] = []
    other_classes: list[dict] = []
    sdk_hits: dict[str, dict] = {}

    for cls in analysis.get_internal_classes() or []:
        class_count += 1
        dalvik_name = getattr(cls, "name", "") or ""
        try:
            n_methods = cls.get_nb_methods() if hasattr(cls, "get_nb_methods") else len(list(cls.get_methods()))
        except Exception:
            n_methods = 0
        method_count += n_methods
        java_name = dalvik_to_java(dalvik_name)
        record = {
            "name": java_name,
            "dalvik_name": dalvik_name,
            "method_count": n_methods,
            "is_app_code": _is_app_class(dalvik_name, package),
        }
        if record["is_app_code"]:
            app_classes.append(record)
        elif not any(dalvik_name.startswith(prefix) for prefix in _SKIP_CLASS_PREFIXES):
            other_classes.append(record)

        sdk = match_sdk(dalvik_name)
        if sdk:
            prefix, sdk_name = sdk
            bucket = sdk_hits.setdefault(
                sdk_name,
                {
                    "name": sdk_name,
                    "package_prefix": prefix[1:].rstrip("/").replace("/", "."),
                    "class_count": 0,
                    "sample_classes": [],
                },
            )
            bucket["class_count"] += 1
            if java_name not in bucket["sample_classes"] and len(bucket["sample_classes"]) < 5:
                bucket["sample_classes"].append(java_name)

    listed_classes = app_classes + other_classes
    listed_classes, classes_truncated = _cap(listed_classes, max_classes)

    buckets: dict[str, list[dict]] = {key: [] for key in CATEGORY_BUCKETS.values()}
    sensitive: list[dict] = []
    api_calls: list[dict] = []
    method_map: dict[tuple[str, str, str | None], set[str]] = defaultdict(set)
    seen_calls: set[tuple[str, str, str, str]] = set()
    seen_mapped: set[tuple[str, str, str, str, str]] = set()
    per_category_cap = max(20, max_findings // 6)
    findings_truncated = False

    for meth in analysis.get_external_methods() or []:
        class_name = getattr(meth, "class_name", "") or meth.get_class_name()
        method_name = getattr(meth, "name", "") or ""
        descriptor = getattr(meth, "descriptor", None)
        if descriptor is None and hasattr(meth, "get_descriptor"):
            descriptor = meth.get_descriptor()
        entry = match_api(class_name, method_name)
        if entry is None:
            continue
        bucket_name = CATEGORY_BUCKETS[entry.category]
        if len(buckets[bucket_name]) >= per_category_cap and len(api_calls) >= max_findings:
            findings_truncated = True
            continue
        try:
            xrefs = list(meth.get_xref_from() or [])
        except Exception:
            xrefs = []
        api = f"{class_name}->{method_name}{descriptor or ''}"
        api_cls = api_class_name(class_name, entry)
        api_meth = api_method_name(method_name, entry)

        if not xrefs:
            # API exists in DEX but no call-site xref — keep as unconfirmed indicator only.
            if len(buckets[bucket_name]) < per_category_cap:
                call = {
                    "api": api,
                    "api_label": entry.label,
                    "api_class": api_cls,
                    "api_method": api_meth,
                    "category": entry.category,
                    "risk_category": entry.risk_category,
                    "caller_class": None,
                    "caller_method": None,
                    "caller_descriptor": None,
                    "confidence": "LOW",
                    "evidence": "API referenced in DEX without a resolved call site",
                }
                buckets[bucket_name].append(call)
                sensitive.append(call)
            continue

        for xref in xrefs:
            if len(buckets[bucket_name]) >= per_category_cap and len(api_calls) >= max_findings:
                findings_truncated = True
                break
            caller_class, caller_method, caller_desc, offset = _caller_from_xref(xref)
            if not caller_class or not caller_method:
                continue
            dedupe_key = (api, caller_class, caller_method, caller_desc or "")
            if dedupe_key in seen_calls:
                continue
            seen_calls.add(dedupe_key)
            call = {
                "api": api,
                "api_label": entry.label,
                "api_class": api_cls,
                "api_method": api_meth,
                "category": entry.category,
                "risk_category": entry.risk_category,
                "caller_class": caller_class,
                "caller_method": caller_method,
                "caller_descriptor": caller_desc,
                "confidence": "HIGH",
                "evidence": (
                    f"method invocation detected at bytecode offset 0x{offset:x}"
                    if offset is not None
                    else "method invocation detected"
                ),
            }
            if len(buckets[bucket_name]) < per_category_cap:
                buckets[bucket_name].append(call)
                sensitive.append(call)
            method_map[(caller_class, caller_method, caller_desc)].add(entry.label)

            mapped_key = (caller_class, caller_method, api_cls, api_meth, entry.risk_category)
            if mapped_key in seen_mapped:
                continue
            seen_mapped.add(mapped_key)
            if len(api_calls) < max_findings:
                api_calls.append(
                    _build_mapped_call(
                        caller_class=caller_class,
                        caller_method=caller_method,
                        caller_descriptor=caller_desc,
                        api_dalvik_class=class_name,
                        api_method=method_name,
                        entry=entry,
                        offset=offset,
                        package=package,
                    )
                )
            else:
                findings_truncated = True

    # Prefer app-package call sites first for LLM/audit consumers.
    api_calls.sort(
        key=lambda item: (
            0 if item.get("is_app_code") else 1,
            item.get("risk_category") or "",
            item.get("class_name") or "",
            item.get("method_name") or "",
            item.get("api") or "",
        )
    )

    methods: list[dict] = []
    for (cls_name, meth_name, desc), labels in method_map.items():
        if not cls_name or not meth_name:
            continue
        methods.append(
            {
                "class_name": cls_name,
                "name": meth_name,
                "descriptor": desc,
                "api_labels": sorted(labels),
            }
        )
    methods, methods_truncated = _cap(methods, max_methods)

    network_strings, strings_truncated = _scan_strings(analysis, max_findings)
    sdk_list = sorted(sdk_hits.values(), key=lambda item: (-item["class_count"], item["name"]))

    truncated = classes_truncated or methods_truncated or findings_truncated or strings_truncated
    findings = _build_findings(
        buckets=buckets,
        api_calls=api_calls,
        sdk_list=sdk_list,
        network_strings=network_strings,
        permission_names=permission_names,
        protected=protected,
        xref_built=xref_built,
    )

    return {
        "summary": {
            "dex_files": dex_files,
            "class_count": class_count,
            "method_count": method_count,
            "xref_built": xref_built,
            "truncated": truncated,
        },
        "classes": listed_classes,
        "methods": methods,
        "api_calls": api_calls,
        "sensitive_api_calls": sensitive,
        "network_calls": buckets["network_calls"],
        "webview_usage": buckets["webview_usage"],
        "file_storage_operations": buckets["file_storage_operations"],
        "telephony_calls": buckets["telephony_calls"],
        "data_access_indicators": buckets["data_access_indicators"],
        "dynamic_code_loading": buckets["dynamic_code_loading"],
        "third_party_sdk_usage": sdk_list,
        "network_strings": network_strings,
        "code_findings": findings,
    }


def _build_findings(
    *,
    buckets: dict[str, list[dict]],
    api_calls: list[dict] | None = None,
    sdk_list: list[dict],
    network_strings: list[dict],
    permission_names: list[str],
    protected: bool,
    xref_built: bool,
) -> list[dict]:
    findings: list[dict] = []
    api_calls = api_calls or []

    def add(finding_id: str, category: str, title: str, detail: str, evidence: list[str]) -> None:
        findings.append(
            {
                "id": finding_id,
                "category": category,
                "title": title,
                "detail": detail,
                "evidence": evidence[:12],
            }
        )

    mapping = [
        ("telephony_calls", "TELEPHONY_API_REFERENCED", "telephony", "Telephony APIs are referenced in DEX"),
        ("network_calls", "NETWORK_API_REFERENCED", "network", "Network APIs are referenced in DEX"),
        ("webview_usage", "WEBVIEW_API_REFERENCED", "webview", "WebView APIs are referenced in DEX"),
        ("file_storage_operations", "FILE_STORAGE_API_REFERENCED", "file_storage", "File/storage APIs are referenced in DEX"),
        ("data_access_indicators", "DATA_ACCESS_API_REFERENCED", "data_access", "Identifier or data-access APIs are referenced in DEX"),
        ("dynamic_code_loading", "DYNAMIC_CODE_LOADING_REFERENCED", "dynamic_code", "Dynamic code loading or reflection APIs are referenced in DEX"),
    ]
    for key, finding_id, category, title in mapping:
        calls = buckets.get(key) or []
        if not calls:
            continue
        labels = []
        for call in calls:
            label = call.get("api_label") or call.get("api")
            if label and label not in labels:
                labels.append(label)
        add(
            finding_id,
            category,
            title,
            f"Static analysis found {len(calls)} call site(s) and {len(labels)} unique API(s).",
            labels,
        )

    if api_calls:
        add(
            "CONFIRMED_API_CALL_SITES",
            "code",
            "Confirmed class→method→API call sites were mapped",
            f"{len(api_calls)} HIGH-confidence invocation(s) with caller class and method.",
            [
                f"{item['class_name']}.{item['method_name']} → {item['api']}"
                for item in api_calls[:12]
            ],
        )

    if sdk_list:
        add(
            "THIRD_PARTY_SDK_PRESENT",
            "sdk",
            "Third-party SDK classes are present in DEX",
            f"{len(sdk_list)} SDK package prefix(es) matched internal class names.",
            [item["name"] for item in sdk_list],
        )
    if network_strings:
        add(
            "URL_STRINGS_PRESENT",
            "network",
            "URL or host strings are present in DEX",
            f"{len(network_strings)} HTTP(S) URL or host-like string(s) were found.",
            [item["value"] for item in network_strings[:12]],
        )

    declared = set(permission_names)
    phone_mapped = [
        item
        for item in api_calls
        if item.get("risk_category") == "PHONE"
    ]
    if "android.permission.CALL_PHONE" in declared and phone_mapped:
        add(
            "CALL_PHONE_DECLARED_AND_CONFIRMED",
            "telephony",
            "CALL_PHONE is declared and phone APIs have confirmed call sites",
            "Use code_analysis.api_calls for class/method evidence. Mark Confirmed only when mapped.",
            [
                f"{item['class_name']}.{item['method_name']} → {item['api']}"
                for item in phone_mapped[:8]
            ],
        )
    elif "android.permission.CALL_PHONE" in declared and buckets.get("telephony_calls"):
        add(
            "CALL_PHONE_DECLARED_AND_REFERENCED",
            "telephony",
            "CALL_PHONE is declared and telephony APIs are referenced",
            "Manifest requests CALL_PHONE and DEX contains telephony API references; call-site mapping may be incomplete.",
            ["android.permission.CALL_PHONE"],
        )
    if "android.permission.SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW" in declared:
        add(
            "SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW_DECLARED",
            "overlay",
            "SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW is declared in the manifest",
            "The permission is present in the manifest. This is not proof of overlay use at runtime.",
            ["android.permission.SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW"],
        )
    if protected:
        add(
            "PAIRIP_PROTECTION_DETECTED",
            "integrity",
            "Play PairIP / runtime protection markers were found",
            "Static DEX analysis may miss code that is decrypted or loaded only at runtime.",
            ["com.pairip"],
        )
    if not xref_built:
        add(
            "DEX_XREF_INCOMPLETE",
            "analysis",
            "DEX cross-references were not fully built",
            "API call-site lists may be incomplete.",
            [],
        )
    return findings


def extract_code_analysis(ctx: ApkContext, permission_names: list[str] | None = None) -> dict:
    if not settings.dex_analysis_enabled:
        ctx.warnings.append("DEX code analysis is disabled.")
        return empty_code_analysis()

    built = _build_analysis(ctx)
    if built is None:
        result = empty_code_analysis()
        if _looks_protected(ctx):
            result["code_findings"] = _build_findings(
                buckets={key: [] for key in CATEGORY_BUCKETS.values()},
                sdk_list=[],
                network_strings=[],
                permission_names=permission_names or [],
                protected=True,
                xref_built=False,
            )
        return result

    analysis, dex_files, xref_built = built
    try:
        package = ctx.apk.get_package() or ""
    except Exception:
        package = ""
    try:
        result = scan_analysis(
            analysis,
            package=package,
            permission_names=permission_names or [],
            dex_files=dex_files,
            xref_built=xref_built,
            protected=_looks_protected(ctx),
        )
    except Exception:
        logger.exception("DEX scan failed for job %s", ctx.job_id)
        ctx.warnings.append("DEX code analysis failed; code_analysis is incomplete.")
        return empty_code_analysis(
            summary={
                "dex_files": dex_files,
                "class_count": 0,
                "method_count": 0,
                "xref_built": xref_built,
                "truncated": False,
            }
        )

    if result["summary"]["truncated"]:
        ctx.warnings.append("DEX code analysis lists were truncated at the configured maximum.")
    return result

"""Dynamic analysis: run the APK on an Android emulator and inspect it.

Distinct from ``app.modules.screenshots``, which extracts static image assets from
the APK archive. Nothing here requires Android Studio; the device is driven purely
through adb and the emulator CLI, both located via ADB_PATH / EMULATOR_PATH /
ANDROID_SDK_ROOT.

Phase 1: device lifecycle (boot, install, launch, stop).
Phase 2: UIAutomator dump + deterministic input actions (no LLM).
Phase 3: screenshot capture + visual / ad-placement state fingerprints.
Phase 4: deterministic exploration engine + navigation graph (no LLM / no S3).
Phase 5: advertisement placement discovery across multiple runs (deterministic).
"""

"""Deterministic candidate actions for one UI dump (no LLM).

Produces ordered suggestions the explorer may try from the current state:

* tap (clickable / enabled), preferring close/X over ad Install CTAs
* swipe up / swipe down (scrollables; screen swipe only when interactive)
* open menu (only when interactive)
* wait (splash / empty clickable screens; repeatable)
* back (generated by the engine for backtracking, not listed as forward explore)
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import re
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Any, Sequence

from app.modules.exploration.actions import (
    Action,
    BackAction,
    CoordinateTapAction,
    MenuAction,
    SwipeAction,
    TapAction,
    WaitAction,
)
from app.modules.exploration.prior_knowledge import ExplorationPrior
from app.modules.exploration.ui_element import UIElement

# Lazy import avoided: ad_discovery imports UIElement only (no cycle through action_planner).
from app.modules.exploration.ad_discovery import is_ad_trigger_label

_DIALOG_LABELS = re.compile(
    r"^(allow|while using the app|only this time|don.?t allow|deny|ok|okay|yes|"
    r"accept|agree|continue|next|got it|i agree|allow all|allow once)$",
    re.IGNORECASE,
)

# Onboarding / gate CTAs that must be tapped to reach real app content.
# NOTE: "Set As Default" / home-role CTAs are intentionally excluded — granting
# HOME traps exploration on LauncherHomeActivity.
_ONBOARDING_CTA_LABELS = re.compile(
    r"(get started|start now|let.?s go|"
    r"enable|turn on|grant|finish|done|skip intro|continue to app|"
    r"open app|enter app|go to app|i understand|got it|continue|next)",
    re.IGNORECASE,
)

# These make the app the device Home launcher — never tap during exploration.
_HOME_HIJACK_CTA_LABELS = re.compile(
    r"(set as default|set default|set as home|make default|default home|"
    r"make us your default|set now)",
    re.IGNORECASE,
)
_DEFAULT_HOME_DIALOG_RX = re.compile(
    r"default home app|set .+ as your default home|choose.+home app",
    re.IGNORECASE,
)

# Home-shell / system widgets that yank focus out of the app under test.
_ESCAPE_CHROME_LABELS = re.compile(
    r"^(search|google|assistant|voice search|ok google|chrome|play store|"
    r"weather|clock|at a glance)$",
    re.IGNORECASE,
)
_ESCAPE_CHROME_IDS = re.compile(
    r"(ivlens|search_bar|search_button|google_search|qsb|assistant|weather_widget)",
    re.IGNORECASE,

# Prefer these so interstitial ads are dismissed instead of followed.
_CLOSE_LABELS = re.compile(
    r"^(close|close ad|dismiss|skip|skip ad|skip video|no thanks|not now|maybe later|"
    r"×|✕|x|︎x)$",

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class PlannedAction:
    """One concrete gesture plus a stable key for visited_actions tracking."""

    key: str
    action: Action
    kind: str
    priority: int = 0
    label: str = ""
    meta: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "key": self.key,
            "kind": self.kind,
            "priority": self.priority,
            "label": self.label,
            "meta": dict(self.meta),
            "action": self.action.to_dict(),
        }


def _quantize_bounds(bounds: tuple[int, int, int, int], step: int = 16) -> str:
    left, top, right, bottom = bounds
    return f"{left // step},{top // step},{right // step},{bottom // step}"


def _element_action_key(kind: str, element: UIElement) -> str:
    return (
        f"{kind}:{element.resource_id or '-'}:"
        f"{_quantize_bounds(element.bounds)}:"
        f"{(element.text or element.content_description or '')[:40]}"
    )


def _is_tiny(element: UIElement, *, min_area: int = 24 * 24) -> bool:
    return element.width * element.height < min_area


def _is_system_chrome(element: UIElement) -> bool:
    rid = (element.resource_id or "").lower()
    return rid.endswith("statusbarbackground") or rid.endswith("navigationbarbackground")


def _is_dialog_button(element: UIElement) -> bool:
    for value in (element.text, element.content_description):
        if value and _DIALOG_LABELS.match(value.strip()):
            return True
    rid = (element.resource_id or "").lower()
    return any(token in rid for token in ("permission_allow", "permission_deny", "btn_positive", "btn_allow"))


def _is_onboarding_cta(element: UIElement) -> bool:
    for value in (element.text, element.content_description):
        if value and _HOME_HIJACK_CTA_LABELS.search(value.strip()):
            return False
        if value and _ONBOARDING_CTA_LABELS.search(value.strip()):
            return True
    rid = (element.resource_id or "").lower()
    if "set_default" in rid or "setdefault" in rid or "btn_default" in rid:
        return False
    return any(
        token in rid
        for token in ("btn_continue", "btn_start", "get_started")
    )


def _is_home_hijack_cta(element: UIElement) -> bool:
    for value in (element.text, element.content_description):
        if value and _HOME_HIJACK_CTA_LABELS.search(value.strip()):
            return True
    rid = (element.resource_id or "").lower()
    return any(
        token in rid
        for token in ("set_default", "setdefault", "btn_default", "tvsetasdefault", "set_as_default")
    )


def looks_like_default_home_gate(
    elements: Sequence[UIElement], *, activity: str | None = None
) -> bool:
    """True for launcher 'Set as Default' pitches / system home-app pickers."""
    act = (activity or "").lower()
    if "defaultapp" in act or "default_app" in act or "launcherhome" in act:
        return True
    blob = " ".join(
        (el.text or el.content_description or "")
        for el in elements[:50]
        if (el.text or el.content_description)
    )
    if _DEFAULT_HOME_DIALOG_RX.search(blob):
        return True
    if _HOME_HIJACK_CTA_LABELS.search(blob) and any(
        "cancel" in (el.text or "").lower() for el in elements if el.clickable
    ):
        return True
    return False


def _is_escape_chrome(element: UIElement) -> bool:
    """Search / Google / assistant widgets that leave the app for system UI."""
    for value in (element.text, element.content_description):
        if value and _ESCAPE_CHROME_LABELS.match(value.strip()):
            return True
    rid = element.resource_id or ""
    if rid and _ESCAPE_CHROME_IDS.search(rid):
        return True
    return False


def _is_close_control(element: UIElement, *, screen_size: tuple[int, int] | None) -> bool:
    if _is_escape_chrome(element):
        return False
    for value in (element.text, element.content_description):
        if not value:
            continue
        stripped = value.strip()
        if _CLOSE_LABELS.match(stripped):
            return True
        # ImageButton "Close ad" / "Skip Ad" content-desc variants.
        if len(stripped) <= 24 and _CLOSE_LABEL_LOOSE.search(stripped):
            return True
    if element.resource_id and _CLOSE_ID.search(element.resource_id):
        return True
    # Interstitial "X" is often a small unlabeled tap target in the top-right header.
    if screen_size and element.width > 0 and element.height > 0:
        width, height = screen_size
        if width <= 0 or height <= 0:
            return False
        label = (element.text or element.content_description or "").strip()
        # Allow unlabeled or close-ish labels only for geometric X detection.
        if label and not _CLOSE_LABEL_LOOSE.search(label):
            return False
        area_ratio = (element.width * element.height) / float(width * height)
        near_top = element.top <= height * 0.22
        near_right = element.right >= width * 0.72
        near_left = element.left <= width * 0.28
        smallish = area_ratio <= 0.05 and element.width <= width * 0.25 and element.height <= height * 0.14
        if smallish and element.clickable and near_top and (near_right or near_left):
            return True
    return False


def _is_ad_cta(element: UIElement) -> bool:
    for value in (element.text, element.content_description):
        if value and _AD_CTA_LABELS.match(value.strip()):
            return True
    rid = (element.resource_id or "").lower()
    return any(
        token in rid
        for token in (
            "install_button",
            "btn_install",
            "ad_call_to_action",
            "btn_download",
            "cta_button",
            "store_button",
        )
    )


def _is_ad_surface(element: UIElement, *, screen_size: tuple[int, int] | None = None) -> bool:
    """True for ad creatives / WebViews we must not tap (opens Chrome / Play)."""
    if _is_close_control(element, screen_size=screen_size):
        return False
    pkg = element.package or ""
    if pkg and _AD_SURFACE_PKG.search(pkg):
        return True
    rid = element.resource_id or ""
    if rid and _AD_SURFACE_ID.search(rid):
        return True
    blob = f"{element.text} {element.content_description} {rid}".strip()
    if blob and _AD_COPY.search(blob):
        return True
    cls = (element.class_name or "").lower()
    if "webview" in cls:
        lower_blob = blob.lower()
        if any(token in lower_blob for token in ("ad", "ads", "banner", "sponsor", "test")):
            return True
        # Large nearly-fullscreen WebView is usually an interstitial creative.
        if screen_size and element.width > 0 and element.height > 0:
            width, height = screen_size
            if width > 0 and height > 0:
                area_ratio = (element.width * element.height) / float(width * height)
                if area_ratio >= 0.45 and element.clickable:
                    return True
    return False


def _bounds_overlap_ratio(
    a: tuple[int, int, int, int], b: tuple[int, int, int, int]
) -> float:
    ax1, ay1, ax2, ay2 = a
    bx1, by1, bx2, by2 = b
    ix1, iy1 = max(ax1, bx1), max(ay1, by1)
    ix2, iy2 = min(ax2, bx2), min(ay2, by2)
    iw, ih = max(0, ix2 - ix1), max(0, iy2 - iy1)
    inter = iw * ih
    if inter <= 0:
        return 0.0
    area_a = max(1, (ax2 - ax1) * (ay2 - ay1))
    return inter / float(area_a)


def _ad_text_regions(elements: Sequence[UIElement]) -> list[tuple[int, int, int, int]]:
    """Bounds of nodes that look like ad copy (e.g. Google 'Test Ad' banners)."""
    regions: list[tuple[int, int, int, int]] = []
    for el in elements:
        if not el.visible:
            continue
        blob = f"{el.text} {el.content_description}".strip()
        if blob and _AD_COPY.search(blob):
            regions.append(el.bounds)
    return regions


def _is_banner_ad_slot(
    element: UIElement,
    *,
    screen_size: tuple[int, int] | None,
    ad_regions: Sequence[tuple[int, int, int, int]] | None = None,
) -> bool:
    """Wide short top/bottom bands used by banner ads — never tap these."""
    if _is_close_control(element, screen_size=screen_size):
        return False
    if _is_bottom_nav_control(element):
        return False
    if not screen_size or element.width <= 0 or element.height <= 0:
        return False
    width, height = screen_size
    if width <= 0 or height <= 0:
        return False
    width_r = element.width / float(width)
    height_r = element.height / float(height)
    near_bottom = element.bottom >= height * 0.82
    near_top = element.top <= height * 0.14
    geo = width_r >= 0.55 and 0.035 <= height_r <= 0.22 and (near_bottom or near_top)
    if not geo:
        # Still treat any clickable that mostly covers known ad-copy region as ad.
        if ad_regions:
            for region in ad_regions:
                if _bounds_overlap_ratio(element.bounds, region) >= 0.45:
                    return True
        return False
    blob = f"{element.text} {element.content_description} {element.resource_id}".lower()
    if _AD_COPY.search(blob) or any(token in blob for token in ("adview", "banner", "ads")):
        return True
    cls = (element.class_name or "").lower()
    if "webview" in cls or "adview" in cls:
        return True
    if ad_regions:
        for region in ad_regions:
            if _bounds_overlap_ratio(element.bounds, region) >= 0.35:
                return True
            # Ad text sitting inside this slot.
            rx1, ry1, rx2, ry2 = region
            if (
                rx1 >= element.left - 8
                and ry1 >= element.top - 8
                and rx2 <= element.right + 8
                and ry2 <= element.bottom + 8
            ):
                return True
    return False


def _is_bottom_nav_control(element: UIElement) -> bool:
    rid = element.resource_id or ""
    if rid and _BOTTOM_NAV_ID.search(rid):
        return True
    cls = (element.class_name or "").lower()
    return "bottomnavigation" in cls


def _is_nav_back_control(
    element: UIElement, *, screen_size: tuple[int, int] | None = None
) -> bool:
    """Toolbar / circular back affordance (e.g. Settings top-left)."""
    for value in (element.content_description, element.text):
        if value and _NAV_BACK_LABELS.match(value.strip()):
            return True
    rid = (element.resource_id or "").lower()
    if any(token in rid for token in ("nav_back", "btn_back", "action_bar_back", "toolbar_back")):
        return True
    if "navigate_up" in rid or rid.endswith("/up") or rid.endswith(":id/up"):
        return True
    if not screen_size or not element.clickable:
        return False
    width, height = screen_size
    if width <= 0 or height <= 0:
        return False
    # Top-left compact control — typical circular back on modern app bars.
    near_top = element.top <= height * 0.14
    near_left = element.left <= width * 0.18
    compact = element.width <= width * 0.18 and element.height <= height * 0.11
    if not (near_top and near_left and compact):
        return False
    label = (element.text or element.content_description or "").strip()
    if label and not _NAV_BACK_LABELS.match(label):
        return False
    cls = (element.class_name or "").lower()
    return any(token in cls for token in ("imagebutton", "imageview", "button", "view"))


def _is_drawer_control(
    element: UIElement, *, screen_size: tuple[int, int] | None = None
) -> bool:
    """Hamburger / navigation drawer opener (sidebar entry)."""
    if _is_nav_back_control(element, screen_size=screen_size):
        return False
    if _is_overflow_control(element):
        return False
    for value in (element.content_description, element.text):
        if value and _DRAWER_LABELS.match(value.strip()):
            return True
    rid = element.resource_id or ""
    if rid and _DRAWER_ID.search(rid):
        return True
    if not screen_size or not element.clickable:
        return False
    width, height = screen_size
    if width <= 0 or height <= 0:
        return False
    # Top-left compact unlabeled control that is not back — often the hamburger.
    near_top = element.top <= height * 0.14
    near_left = element.left <= width * 0.18
    compact = element.width <= width * 0.18 and element.height <= height * 0.11
    if not (near_top and near_left and compact):
        return False
    label = (element.text or element.content_description or "").strip()
    if label:
        if _OVERFLOW_LABELS.match(label):
            return False
        return bool(_DRAWER_LABELS.match(label))
    cls = (element.class_name or "").lower()
    return any(token in cls for token in ("imagebutton", "imageview"))


def _is_overflow_control(element: UIElement) -> bool:
    """Per-item ⋮ / Edit / Delete — not navigation."""
    for value in (element.content_description, element.text):
        if value and _OVERFLOW_LABELS.match(value.strip()):
            return True
    rid = (element.resource_id or "").lower()
    return bool(rid and _OVERFLOW_ID.search(rid))


def _is_cancel_dialog_control(element: UIElement) -> bool:
    for value in (element.text, element.content_description):
        if value and _CANCEL_DIALOG_LABELS.match(value.strip()):
            return True
    rid = (element.resource_id or "").lower()
    return any(token in rid for token in ("btn_cancel", "action_cancel", "negative", "btn_no"))


def _is_destructive_confirm_control(element: UIElement) -> bool:
    for value in (element.text, element.content_description):
        if value and _DESTRUCTIVE_CONFIRM_LABELS.match(value.strip()):
            return True
    rid = (element.resource_id or "").lower()
    return any(token in rid for token in ("btn_delete", "action_delete", "btn_remove", "positive_delete"))


def _is_create_explore_control(
    element: UIElement, *, screen_size: tuple[int, int] | None = None
) -> bool:
    """FABs / Add / Create — primary creation entry (labels from live UI + prior)."""
    if _is_overflow_control(element):
        return False
    for value in (element.text, element.content_description):
        if not value:
            continue
        stripped = value.strip()
        if _CREATE_EXPLORE_LABELS.match(stripped) or (
            len(stripped) <= 24 and _CREATE_EXPLORE_LOOSE.search(stripped)
        ):
            return True
    rid = (element.resource_id or "").lower()
    if any(
        token in rid
        for token in ("fab", "btn_add", "btn_create", "action_add", "floating")
    ):
        return True
    # Bottom-right compact unlabeled FAB (common Material + button).
    if not screen_size or not element.clickable:
        return False
    width, height = screen_size
    if width <= 0 or height <= 0:
        return False
    near_bottom = element.bottom >= height * 0.72
    near_right = element.right >= width * 0.78
    compact = element.width <= width * 0.22 and element.height <= height * 0.14
    label = (element.text or element.content_description or "").strip()
    if label or not (near_bottom and near_right and compact):
        return False
    cls = (element.class_name or "").lower()
    return any(token in cls for token in ("imagebutton", "button", "floatingactionbutton"))


def _is_primary_submit_cta(element: UIElement) -> bool:
    for value in (element.text, element.content_description):
        if value and _PRIMARY_SUBMIT_LABELS.match(value.strip()):
            return True
    rid = (element.resource_id or "").lower()
    return any(token in rid for token in ("btn_save", "action_save", "btn_create", "btn_done", "btn_submit"))


def _has_edit_text(elements: Sequence[UIElement]) -> bool:
    for el in elements:
        if not el.visible or not el.enabled:
            continue
        cls = (el.class_name or "").lower()
        if any(token in cls for token in ("edittext", "autocompletetextview", "textinputedittext")):
            return True
    return False


def looks_like_interstitial_ad(
    elements: Sequence[UIElement],
    *,
    activity: str | None = None,
    screen_size: tuple[int, int] | None = None,
) -> bool:
    """Heuristic: fullscreen / AdActivity creative where we should Close or Back.

    Banner-only screens (Settings with a bottom test ad) are NOT interstitials —
    Back would leave the page incorrectly.
    """
    if activity and _INTERSTITIAL_ACTIVITY.search(activity):
        return True
    ad_surfaces = 0
    close_controls = 0
    banner_only = 0
    ad_regions = _ad_text_regions(elements)
    for el in elements:
        if not el.visible:
            continue
        if _is_close_control(el, screen_size=screen_size):
            close_controls += 1
        if _is_banner_ad_slot(el, screen_size=screen_size, ad_regions=ad_regions):
            banner_only += 1
            continue
        if _is_ad_surface(el, screen_size=screen_size) or _is_ad_cta(el):
            ad_surfaces += 1
    if ad_surfaces >= 1 and close_controls >= 1:
        return True
    if ad_surfaces >= 2:
        return True
    # Single large ad surface covering most of the screen.
    if screen_size and ad_surfaces == 1:
        width, height = screen_size
        if width > 0 and height > 0:
            for el in elements:
                if not el.visible or not _is_ad_surface(el, screen_size=screen_size):
                    continue
                if (el.width * el.height) / float(width * height) >= 0.5:
                    return True
    return False


def _is_explore_destination(element: UIElement) -> bool:
    blob = f"{element.text} {element.content_description}".strip()
    if blob and _EXPLORE_DEST_LABELS.search(blob):
        return True
    rid = (element.resource_id or "").lower()
    return any(token in rid for token in ("tab_", "nav_", "menu_"))


def _is_permission_package(package: str) -> bool:
    lowered = (package or "").lower()
    return "permissioncontroller" in lowered or lowered.endswith(".permissioncontroller")


def is_external_browser_or_store(activity: str | None, package: str | None = None) -> bool:
    """True when focus has left the target app into Chrome / Play Store / installer."""
    blob = f"{activity or ''} {package or ''}".lower()
    if any(p in blob for p in _BROWSER_OR_STORE_PACKAGES):
        return True
    if "chrome" in blob or "vending" in blob or "market" in blob:
        return True
    return False


def is_home_launcher(
    activity: str | None = None,
    package: str | None = None,
    *,
    target_package: str | None = None,
) -> bool:
    """True when the device is showing the *system* home / launcher screen.

    The target app may register its own ``LauncherHomeActivity`` after becoming
    the default Home app — that must NOT be treated as leaving the app.
    """
    pkg = package if isinstance(package, str) else ""
    pkg = pkg.strip()
    if not pkg and isinstance(activity, str) and "/" in activity:
        pkg = activity.split("/", 1)[0]
    target = target_package if isinstance(target_package, str) else ""
    if target and pkg and pkg == target:
        return False
    lowered = pkg.lower()
    if lowered in _HOME_LAUNCHER_PACKAGES:
        return True
    # Only treat unknown *packages* with launcher in the name as home shells —
    # never match on activity paths like ``.launcher.LauncherHomeActivity``.
    if lowered.endswith(".launcher") or lowered.endswith(".launcher3") or lowered.endswith(".launcher2"):
        return True
    blob = activity.lower() if isinstance(activity, str) else ""
    if target and target.lower() in blob:
        return False
    return "nexuslauncher" in blob or "android.launcher3" in blob or "apps.nexuslauncher" in blob


def is_transient_escape_package(package: str | None = None, activity: str | None = None) -> bool:
    """Packages we leave briefly (Search, Assistant) and should Back out of — not relaunch."""
    pkg = (package or "").strip()
    if not pkg and activity and "/" in activity:
        pkg = activity.split("/", 1)[0]
    lowered = pkg.lower()
    if lowered in {
        "com.google.android.googlequicksearchbox",
        "com.google.android.apps.googleassistant",
        "com.google.android.inputmethod.latin",
        "com.google.android.apps.messaging",
    }:
        return True
    blob = f"{activity or ''} {pkg}".lower()
    return "googlequicksearchbox" in blob or "googleassistant" in blob or "assistant" in lowered


def is_system_settings(activity: str | None = None, package: str | None = None) -> bool:
    pkg = (package or "").strip()
    if not pkg and activity and "/" in activity:
        pkg = activity.split("/", 1)[0]
    if pkg in _SETTINGS_PACKAGES:
        return True
    blob = f"{activity or ''} {pkg}".lower()
    return "android.settings" in blob or "settings.intelligence" in blob


def count_clickables(elements: Sequence[UIElement]) -> int:
    return sum(
        1
        for el in elements
        if el.clickable and el.enabled and el.visible and not _is_tiny(el) and not _is_system_chrome(el)
    )


def is_splash_like(elements: Sequence[UIElement], *, activity: str | None = None) -> bool:
    """True when the screen has no meaningful taps (typical splash / loader)."""
    if activity and "splash" in activity.lower():
        return True
    return count_clickables(elements) == 0


def plan_actions(
    elements: Sequence[UIElement],
    *,
    prior: ExplorationPrior | None = None,
    screen_size: tuple[int, int] | None = None,
    splash_wait_seconds: float = 3.0,
    wait_attempt: int = 0,
    include_menu: bool = True,
    include_wait_if_empty: bool = True,
    include_screen_swipes_when_empty: bool = False,
    include_center_tap_when_empty: bool = True,
    max_taps: int = 40,
    activity: str | None = None,
    prefer_ad_triggers: bool = False,
) -> list[PlannedAction]:
    """Return forward actions sorted by descending priority."""
    planned: list[PlannedAction] = []
    seen_keys: set[str] = set()
    idle = is_splash_like(elements, activity=activity)
    target_pkg = prior.package_name if prior else None

    active_kind: str | None = None
    if prior is not None and hasattr(prior, "active_goal"):
        try:
            active = prior.active_goal()
            active_kind = (active or {}).get("kind")
        except Exception:
            active_kind = None

    clickables = [
        el
        for el in elements
        if el.clickable
        and el.enabled
        and el.visible
        and not _is_tiny(el)
        and not _is_system_chrome(el)
    ]

    scored: list[tuple[int, UIElement, bool]] = []
    formish = _has_edit_text(elements)
    ad_regions = _ad_text_regions(elements)
    meaningful_taps = 0
    for el in clickables:
        # Never plan taps that open ad links / store — dismiss via close/Back only.
        if (
            _is_ad_cta(el)
            or _is_ad_surface(el, screen_size=screen_size)
            or _is_banner_ad_slot(el, screen_size=screen_size, ad_regions=ad_regions)
        ):
            continue

        bonus = prior.label_priority(el.text, el.resource_id, el.content_description) if prior else 0
        ad_trigger = False
        if el.text or el.content_description:
            bonus += 3
        if el.resource_id:
            bonus += 1

        if _is_close_control(el, screen_size=screen_size):
            bonus += 120
        elif _is_permission_package(el.package or "") or (
            el.resource_id and "permission_" in (el.resource_id or "").lower()
        ):
            # System permission / role dialogs must beat in-app Settings/Home chrome.
            bonus += 140
            meaningful_taps += 1
        elif _is_cancel_dialog_control(el):
            # Leave Delete/Edit confirm dialogs without destroying content.
            # Also dismiss default-home pickers (Cancel >> Set as default).
            bonus += 135
            meaningful_taps += 1
        elif _is_home_hijack_cta(el):
            # Never become device Home during exploration.
            bonus -= 200
        elif _is_drawer_control(el, screen_size=screen_size):
            # Sidebar / hamburger — highest when nav map says open drawer next.
            bonus += 145 if active_kind == "sidebar" else 110
            meaningful_taps += 1
        elif _is_create_explore_control(el, screen_size=screen_size):
            # Prefer create when that is the active map step; otherwise demote vs drawer.
            if active_kind == "create":
                bonus += 125
            elif active_kind == "sidebar":
                bonus += 40
            else:
                bonus += 115
            meaningful_taps += 1
        elif _is_nav_back_control(el, screen_size=screen_size):
            # Leave nested pages via toolbar back instead of swiping.
            bonus += 95
            meaningful_taps += 1
        elif _is_bottom_nav_control(el) or _is_explore_destination(el):
            dest_bonus = 70
            if active_kind == "home" and "home" in (
                f"{el.text} {el.content_description} {el.resource_id}".lower()
            ):
                dest_bonus = 120
            elif active_kind == "settings" and "setting" in (
                f"{el.text} {el.content_description} {el.resource_id}".lower()
            ):
                dest_bonus = 110
            bonus += dest_bonus
            meaningful_taps += 1
        elif _is_onboarding_cta(el):
            bonus += 130 if active_kind == "onboarding" else 110
        elif formish and _is_primary_submit_cta(el):
            bonus += 100
            meaningful_taps += 1
        elif _is_destructive_confirm_control(el) or _is_overflow_control(el):
            # Never prioritize ⋮ / Edit / Delete over real navigation or create.
            bonus -= 160
        elif _is_dialog_button(el):
            bonus += 50
        elif _is_escape_chrome(el):
            bonus -= 120
        elif el.text or el.content_description:
            meaningful_taps += 1

        if prefer_ad_triggers and is_ad_trigger_label(el.text, el.resource_id, el.content_description):
            bonus += 35
            ad_trigger = True

        if target_pkg and el.package and el.package != target_pkg:
            if _is_permission_package(el.package):
                bonus += 25
            elif is_external_browser_or_store(activity, el.package):
                bonus -= 100
            elif _is_escape_chrome(el):
                bonus -= 120
            else:
                bonus += 5

        # In the default-app / role picker, prefer rows that name our package.
        if target_pkg and is_system_settings(activity, el.package if el.package != target_pkg else None):
            label_blob = f"{el.text} {el.content_description} {el.resource_id}".lower()
            pkg_token = target_pkg.rsplit(".", 1)[-1].lower()
            if target_pkg.lower() in label_blob or (pkg_token and pkg_token in label_blob):
                bonus += 100
            elif prior and prior.package_name:
                # Match human app labels from preferred list loosely.
                for preferred in prior.preferred_labels[:8]:
                    if preferred and preferred.lower() in label_blob:
                        bonus += 80
                        break

        scored.append((bonus, el, ad_trigger))
    scored.sort(key=lambda item: (-item[0], item[1].top, item[1].left))

    for bonus, el, ad_trigger in scored[:max_taps]:
        if bonus < -40 and any(b >= 0 for b, _, _ in scored):
            continue
        key = _element_action_key("tap", el)
        if key in seen_keys:
            continue
        seen_keys.add(key)
        planned.append(
            PlannedAction(
                key=key,
                action=TapAction(element=el),
                kind="tap",
                priority=100 + bonus,
                label=el.label(),
                meta={
                    "text": el.text,
                    "content_description": el.content_description,
                    "resource_id": el.resource_id,
                    "bounds": list(el.bounds),
                    "package": el.package,
                    "prior_bonus": bonus,
                    "is_close": _is_close_control(el, screen_size=screen_size),
                    "is_onboarding_cta": _is_onboarding_cta(el),
                    "is_home_hijack_cta": _is_home_hijack_cta(el),
                    "is_escape_chrome": _is_escape_chrome(el),
                    "is_ad_cta": False,
                    "is_banner_ad": False,
                    "is_nav_back": _is_nav_back_control(el, screen_size=screen_size),
                    "is_drawer": _is_drawer_control(el, screen_size=screen_size),
                    "is_create_explore": _is_create_explore_control(
                        el, screen_size=screen_size
                    ),
                    "is_overflow": _is_overflow_control(el),
                    "is_cancel_dialog": _is_cancel_dialog_control(el),
                    "is_destructive_confirm": _is_destructive_confirm_control(el),
                    "is_primary_submit": _is_primary_submit_cta(el),
                    "ad_trigger": ad_trigger,
                },
            )
        )

    # Prefer labeled taps / create / back over blind swipes — but keep swipes
    # competitive so a screen with many taps still scrolls after a couple of taps.
    swipe_priority = 28 if meaningful_taps >= 2 else 48
    screen_swipe_priority = 22 if meaningful_taps >= 2 else 36
    if active_kind in {"home", "sidebar", "destination", "feature"}:
        swipe_priority = max(swipe_priority, 42)
        screen_swipe_priority = max(screen_swipe_priority, 38)
    elif active_kind == "onboarding":
        # Past gates the fallback list is full of taps; still try a scroll.
        screen_swipe_priority = max(screen_swipe_priority, 30)

    if idle:
        if include_wait_if_empty:
            key = f"wait:splash:{wait_attempt}"
            planned.append(
                PlannedAction(
                    key=key,
                    action=WaitAction(seconds=splash_wait_seconds),
                    kind="wait",
                    priority=200,
                    label=f"wait {splash_wait_seconds}s for splash/loading (poll {wait_attempt})",
                    meta={"seconds": splash_wait_seconds, "attempt": wait_attempt},
                )
            )
        if include_center_tap_when_empty and screen_size and wait_attempt == 0:
            width, height = screen_size
            if width > 0 and height > 0:
                key = "tap:center:splash"
                planned.append(
                    PlannedAction(
                        key=key,
                        action=CoordinateTapAction(x=width // 2, y=height // 2),
                        kind="tap",
                        priority=90,
                        label="tap center (dismiss splash)",
                        meta={"x": width // 2, "y": height // 2},
                    )
                )
        planned.sort(key=lambda item: (-item.priority, item.key))
        return planned

    scrollables = [el for el in elements if el.scrollable and el.visible and el.enabled]
    for direction in ("up", "down"):
        if scrollables:
            target = max(scrollables, key=lambda el: el.width * el.height)
            key = f"swipe:{direction}:scroll:{_quantize_bounds(target.bounds)}"
            if key not in seen_keys:
                seen_keys.add(key)
                cx, cy = target.center
                inset = max(20, target.height // 4)
                if direction == "up":
                    start, end = (cx, target.bottom - inset), (cx, target.top + inset)
                else:
                    start, end = (cx, target.top + inset), (cx, target.bottom - inset)
                planned.append(
                    PlannedAction(
                        key=key,
                        action=SwipeAction(start=start, end=end, direction=direction),
                        kind=f"swipe_{direction}",
                        priority=swipe_priority,
                        label=f"swipe {direction} on scrollable",
                        meta={"bounds": list(target.bounds), "direction": direction},
                    )
                )
        elif screen_size and (include_screen_swipes_when_empty or True):
            key = f"swipe:{direction}:screen"
            if key not in seen_keys:
                seen_keys.add(key)
                planned.append(
                    PlannedAction(
                        key=key,
                        action=SwipeAction(direction=direction),  # type: ignore[arg-type]
                        kind=f"swipe_{direction}",
                        priority=screen_swipe_priority,
                        label=f"swipe {direction} (screen)",
                        meta={"direction": direction},
                    )
                )

    if include_menu:
        key = "open_menu"
        if key not in seen_keys:
            seen_keys.add(key)
            # Soft-key MENU is a fallback when no hamburger node is exposed.
            # Prefer menu while on home/sidebar so we explore chrome instead of
            # low-value Back / wait that can leave the app.
            if active_kind == "sidebar":
                menu_priority = 85
            elif active_kind in {"home", "settings"}:
                menu_priority = 55
            else:
                menu_priority = 15
            planned.append(
                PlannedAction(
                    key=key,
                    action=MenuAction(),
                    kind="open_menu",
                    priority=menu_priority,
                    label="open menu",
                    meta={"active_goal_kind": active_kind},
                )
            )

    planned.sort(key=lambda item: (-item.priority, item.key))
    return planned


def back_action() -> PlannedAction:
    return PlannedAction(
        key="back",
        action=BackAction(),
        kind="back",
        priority=0,
        label="back",
    )


def relaunch_action(*, reason: str = "system_home") -> PlannedAction:
    """Synthetic action: engine soft-resumes the target package (no UI gesture)."""
    return PlannedAction(
        key=f"relaunch:{reason}",
        action=BackAction(),  # placeholder; explorer handles kind=relaunch specially
        kind="relaunch",
        priority=1000,
        label=f"relaunch ({reason})",
        meta={"reason": reason},
    )

"""Deterministic UI input actions executed through adb ``input`` / keyevents.

No LLM is involved: each action encodes a concrete gesture that
:class:`~app.modules.exploration.ui_controller.UIController` can perform.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import time
from abc import ABC, abstractmethod
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Any, Literal

from app.modules.exploration.errors import UiActionError
from app.modules.exploration.ui_element import UIElement

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from app.modules.exploration.adb import AndroidADB

SwipeDirection = Literal["up", "down", "left", "right"]

KEYCODE_HOME = 3
KEYCODE_BACK = 4
KEYCODE_MENU = 82


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ActionResult:
    """Outcome of a single :class:`Action` execution."""

    kind: str
    ok: bool
    detail: str = ""
    duration_ms: int = 0
    meta: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "kind": self.kind,
            "ok": self.ok,
            "detail": self.detail,
            "duration_ms": self.duration_ms,
            "meta": dict(self.meta),
        }


class Action(ABC):
    """Base class for device gestures."""

    @property
    @abstractmethod
    def kind(self) -> str:
        raise NotImplementedError

    @abstractmethod
    def execute(self, adb: "AndroidADB", *, screen_size: tuple[int, int] | None = None) -> ActionResult:
        raise NotImplementedError

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {"kind": self.kind}


def _run_input(adb: "AndroidADB", command: str, *, kind: str, meta: dict[str, Any] | None = None) -> ActionResult:
    started = time.perf_counter()
    result = adb.shell(command, timeout=30, check=False)
    duration_ms = int((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000)
    if not result.ok:
        raise UiActionError(result.fail_message(f"{kind} failed")).with_output(
            command=result.command, stdout=result.stdout, stderr=result.stderr
        )
    return ActionResult(
        kind=kind,
        ok=True,
        detail=command,
        duration_ms=duration_ms,
        meta=meta or {},
    )


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class TapAction(Action):
    """Tap the center of a :class:`UIElement`."""

    element: UIElement

    @property
    def kind(self) -> str:
        return "tap"

    def execute(self, adb: "AndroidADB", *, screen_size: tuple[int, int] | None = None) -> ActionResult:
        del screen_size  # unused; kept for a uniform Action.execute signature
        if not self.element.enabled:
            raise UiActionError(f"Cannot tap disabled element: {self.element.label()}")
        x, y = self.element.center
        if self.element.width <= 0 or self.element.height <= 0:
            raise UiActionError(f"Cannot tap element with empty bounds: {self.element.label()}")
        return _run_input(
            adb,
            f"input tap {x} {y}",
            kind=self.kind,
            meta={
                "x": x,
                "y": y,
                "text": self.element.text,
                "resource_id": self.element.resource_id,
                "class_name": self.element.class_name,
                "bounds": list(self.element.bounds),
            },
        )

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {"kind": self.kind, "element": self.element.to_dict()}


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class CoordinateTapAction(Action):
    """Tap absolute device coordinates."""

    x: int
    y: int

    @property
    def kind(self) -> str:
        return "coordinate_tap"

    def execute(self, adb: "AndroidADB", *, screen_size: tuple[int, int] | None = None) -> ActionResult:
        del screen_size
        return _run_input(
            adb,
            f"input tap {int(self.x)} {int(self.y)}",
            kind=self.kind,
            meta={"x": int(self.x), "y": int(self.y)},
        )

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {"kind": self.kind, "x": self.x, "y": self.y}


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class SwipeAction(Action):
    """Swipe across the screen in a cardinal direction, or between two points."""

    direction: SwipeDirection | None = None
    start: tuple[int, int] | None = None
    end: tuple[int, int] | None = None
    duration_ms: int = 300
    # Fraction of the shorter screen edge used as inset when deriving points.
    edge_inset: float = 0.2

    @property
    def kind(self) -> str:
        return "swipe"

    def _resolve_points(self, screen_size: tuple[int, int] | None) -> tuple[int, int, int, int]:
        if self.start is not None and self.end is not None:
            return (*self.start, *self.end)
        if self.direction is None:
            raise UiActionError("SwipeAction requires either direction or start/end points.")
        if not screen_size:
            raise UiActionError("Screen size is required to derive directional swipe points.")
        width, height = screen_size
        if width <= 0 or height <= 0:
            raise UiActionError(f"Invalid screen size for swipe: {screen_size}")
        inset_x = max(1, int(width * self.edge_inset))
        inset_y = max(1, int(height * self.edge_inset))
        cx, cy = width // 2, height // 2
        if self.direction == "up":
            return (cx, height - inset_y, cx, inset_y)
        if self.direction == "down":
            return (cx, inset_y, cx, height - inset_y)
        if self.direction == "left":
            return (width - inset_x, cy, inset_x, cy)
        if self.direction == "right":
            return (inset_x, cy, width - inset_x, cy)
        raise UiActionError(f"Unsupported swipe direction: {self.direction}")

    def execute(self, adb: "AndroidADB", *, screen_size: tuple[int, int] | None = None) -> ActionResult:
        x1, y1, x2, y2 = self._resolve_points(screen_size)
        duration = max(50, int(self.duration_ms))
        return _run_input(
            adb,
            f"input swipe {x1} {y1} {x2} {y2} {duration}",
            kind=self.kind,
            meta={
                "direction": self.direction,
                "x1": x1,
                "y1": y1,
                "x2": x2,
                "y2": y2,
                "duration_ms": duration,
            },
        )

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "kind": self.kind,
            "direction": self.direction,
            "start": list(self.start) if self.start else None,
            "end": list(self.end) if self.end else None,
            "duration_ms": self.duration_ms,
        }

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class WaitAction(Action):
    """Pause the worker thread. Useful between gestures for UI settle time."""

    seconds: float = 1.0

    @property
    def kind(self) -> str:
        return "wait"

    def execute(self, adb: "AndroidADB", *, screen_size: tuple[int, int] | None = None) -> ActionResult:
        del adb, screen_size
        delay = max(0.0, float(self.seconds))
        started = time.perf_counter()
        time.sleep(delay)
        duration_ms = int((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000)
        return ActionResult(
            kind=self.kind,
            ok=True,
            detail=f"waited {delay:.3f}s",
            duration_ms=duration_ms,
            meta={"seconds": delay},
        )

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {"kind": self.kind, "seconds": self.seconds}

def sanitize_type_text(value: str, *, max_len: int = 48) -> str:
    """Allow only safe printable characters for ``adb input text``."""
    import re

    text = str(value or "").strip()
    # Keep letters, numbers, spaces, and a small punctuation set.
    text = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9 _.\-@+]", "", text)
    text = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text).strip()
    return text[:max_len]


def _adb_input_text_payload(text: str) -> str:
    """Encode text for ``adb shell input text`` (spaces → %s)."""
    safe = sanitize_type_text(text)
    if not safe:
        raise UiActionError("type_text payload is empty after sanitization")
    return safe.replace(" ", "%s")


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class TypeTextAction(Action):
    """Tap an editable field (optional) then type sanitized text via adb.

    Used by the AI assist gate for create/form screens. Never executes shell
    beyond ``input tap`` / ``input text``.
    """

    text: str
    element: UIElement | None = None
    x: int | None = None
    y: int | None = None
    clear_first: bool = True

    @property
    def kind(self) -> str:
        return "type_text"

    def execute(self, adb: "AndroidADB", *, screen_size: tuple[int, int] | None = None) -> ActionResult:
        del screen_size
        started = time.perf_counter()
        payload = _adb_input_text_payload(self.text)
        meta: dict[str, Any] = {"text": sanitize_type_text(self.text)}

        # Focus the field first.
        if self.element is not None:
            x, y = self.element.center
            meta.update({"x": x, "y": y, "resource_id": self.element.resource_id})
            tap = adb.shell(f"input tap {x} {y}", timeout=30, check=False)
            if not tap.ok:
                raise UiActionError(tap.fail_message("type_text focus tap failed")).with_output(
                    command=tap.command, stdout=tap.stdout, stderr=tap.stderr
                )
            time.sleep(0.25)
        elif self.x is not None and self.y is not None:
            meta.update({"x": self.x, "y": self.y})
            tap = adb.shell(f"input tap {self.x} {self.y}", timeout=30, check=False)
            if not tap.ok:
                raise UiActionError(tap.fail_message("type_text focus tap failed")).with_output(
                    command=tap.command, stdout=tap.stdout, stderr=tap.stderr
                )
            time.sleep(0.25)

        if self.clear_first:
            # Select-all + delete is unreliable across OEMs; send a few DELs.
            adb.shell("input keyevent 123", timeout=10, check=False)  # move end
            for _ in range(24):
                adb.shell("input keyevent 67", timeout=10, check=False)  # DEL

        result = adb.shell(f"input text {payload}", timeout=30, check=False)
        duration_ms = int((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000)
        if not result.ok:
            raise UiActionError(result.fail_message("type_text failed")).with_output(
                command=result.command, stdout=result.stdout, stderr=result.stderr
            )
        return ActionResult(
            kind=self.kind,
            ok=True,
            detail=f"input text ({len(sanitize_type_text(self.text))} chars)",
            duration_ms=duration_ms,
            meta=meta,
        )

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "kind": self.kind,
            "text": sanitize_type_text(self.text),
            "element": self.element.to_dict() if self.element else None,
            "x": self.x,
            "y": self.y,
        }
