"""Phase 5: advertisement placement discovery (deterministic, no LLM).

A single app page can host many ad *layout* variations (banner top vs bottom,
native in-feed, interstitial, rewarded). Visual content of the page or the
creative itself must not invent a new placement — uniqueness is:

    page + ad_type + relative position + relative size + trigger action

Relative coordinates are used so different device densities stay comparable.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import logging
import math
import re
from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field
from typing import Any, Sequence

from app.core.config import settings
from app.modules.exploration.ui_element import UIElement

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

AdTypeName = str  # banner | interstitial | native | rewarded | app_open | unknown
AdPositionName = str  # top | bottom | middle | fullscreen | unknown

_AD_CLASS_HINTS = re.compile(
    r"(adview|ads\.|AudienceNetwork|AdActivity|ads\.Ad|Rewarded|"
    r"Interstitial|NativeAd|PublisherAdView|AdFrame|"
    r"com\.google\.android\.gms\.ads|com\.unity3d\.services\.ads|"
    r"com\.facebook\.ads|com\.applovin|com\.ironsource|com\.vungle|"
    r"com\.mbridge|com\.bytedance\.sdk\.openadsdk)",
    re.IGNORECASE,
)
# Generic WebView only counts with an ad-ish id/text — bare WebView is app chrome.
_WEBVIEW_CLASS = re.compile(r"webview", re.IGNORECASE)
_AD_ID_HINTS = re.compile(
    r"(^|[/_.])(ad|ads|banner|interstitial|nativead|rewarded|appopen|app_open)([_/.-]|$)",
    re.IGNORECASE,
)
_REWARD_HINTS = re.compile(r"reward|video.?ad|watch.?ad|earn.?coin", re.IGNORECASE)
_INTERSTITIAL_HINTS = re.compile(r"interstitial|fullscreen.?ad|full.?screen.?ad", re.IGNORECASE)
_NATIVE_HINTS = re.compile(r"native.?ad|feed.?ad|content.?ad", re.IGNORECASE)
_BANNER_HINTS = re.compile(r"banner|adview|ad_frame|ad_container", re.IGNORECASE)
# Gate / setup screens — never treat their chrome as ad placements.
_GATE_ACTIVITY = re.compile(
    r"(default.?app|onboarding|splash|permission|consent|gdpr|welcome|"
    r"intro|tutorial|login|signup|sign.?in|set.?default)",
    re.IGNORECASE,
)
_GENERIC_CONTAINER = re.compile(
    r"(FrameLayout|LinearLayout|RelativeLayout|ConstraintLayout|ViewGroup|"
    r"ScrollView|RecyclerView|ViewPager|DecorView|ContentFrame)",
    re.IGNORECASE,
)

# Labels that often open rewarded / interstitial flows.
AD_TRIGGER_LABELS = re.compile(
    r"(watch|reward|video|play|continue|start|free\s*coin|earn|claim|"
    r"unlock|spin|bonus|ad\b|show\s*ad)",
    re.IGNORECASE,
)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class AdPlacementFingerprint:
    """One meaningful advertisement placement variation.

    ``relative_bbox`` is ``[left, top, width, height]`` in ``[0, 1]`` of the
    screen (example bottom banner: ``[0.0, 0.82, 1.0, 0.18]``).
    """

    page: str
    ad_detected: bool
    ad_type: AdTypeName
    position: AdPositionName
    relative_bbox: tuple[float, float, float, float]
    uniqueness_key: str = ""
    trigger_action: str | None = None
    visual_state_id: str | None = None
    screenshot_path: str | None = None
    evidence: tuple[str, ...] = ()
    run_index: int = 0

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        payload = asdict(self)
        payload["relative_bbox"] = list(self.relative_bbox)
        payload["evidence"] = list(self.evidence)
        return payload


@dataclass
class AdPlacementRecord:
    """Retained unique placement plus discovery metadata."""

    fingerprint: AdPlacementFingerprint
    first_seen_run: int = 0
    seen_count: int = 1

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "fingerprint": self.fingerprint.to_dict(),
            "first_seen_run": self.first_seen_run,
            "seen_count": self.seen_count,
        }


@dataclass
class AdDiscoveryLimits:
    target_ad_variations_per_page: int = 5
    max_ad_variations_per_page: int = 10
    max_exploration_runs: int = 5
    bbox_quantize: float = 0.05

    @classmethod
    def from_settings(cls) -> "AdDiscoveryLimits":
        return cls(
            target_ad_variations_per_page=settings.exploration_target_ad_variations_per_page,
            max_ad_variations_per_page=settings.exploration_max_ad_variations_per_page,
            max_exploration_runs=settings.exploration_max_runs,
            bbox_quantize=settings.exploration_ad_bbox_quantize,
        )


class AdPlacementCatalog:
    """Deduplicated store of ad-placement variations across one or more runs."""

    def __init__(self, limits: AdDiscoveryLimits | None = None) -> None:
        self.limits = limits or AdDiscoveryLimits.from_settings()
        self._by_key: dict[str, AdPlacementRecord] = {}
        self._by_page: dict[str, list[str]] = {}

    @property
    def placements(self) -> list[AdPlacementRecord]:
        return list(self._by_key.values())

    def count_for_page(self, page: str) -> int:
        return len(self._by_page.get(_normalize_page(page), []))

    def strong_count_for_page(self, page: str) -> int:
        """Count placements with SDK/class/id evidence (used for target early-stop)."""
        page_key = _normalize_page(page)
        keys = self._by_page.get(page_key, [])
        return sum(
            1
            for key in keys
            if is_strong_ad_evidence(self._by_key[key].fingerprint.evidence)
        )

    def pages(self) -> list[str]:
        return sorted(self._by_page.keys())

    def has_reached_target(self, page: str) -> bool:
        return self.strong_count_for_page(page) >= self.limits.target_ad_variations_per_page

    def has_reached_max(self, page: str) -> bool:
        return self.count_for_page(page) >= self.limits.max_ad_variations_per_page

    def observe(self, fingerprint: AdPlacementFingerprint) -> tuple[bool, AdPlacementRecord]:
        """Insert if unique and under the per-page max. Returns (is_new, record)."""
        if not fingerprint.ad_detected:
            key = fingerprint.uniqueness_key or uniqueness_key_for(fingerprint)
            empty = AdPlacementRecord(fingerprint=fingerprint)
            return False, empty

        page = _normalize_page(fingerprint.page)
        key = fingerprint.uniqueness_key or uniqueness_key_for(fingerprint)
        if key in self._by_key:
            record = self._by_key[key]
            record.seen_count += 1
            logger.info(
                "[AD] duplicate placement key=%s page=%s type=%s pos=%s (seen=%s)",
                key[:16],
                page,
                fingerprint.ad_type,
                fingerprint.position,
                record.seen_count,
            )
            return False, record

        if self.has_reached_max(page):
            logger.info(
                "[AD] page=%s at MAX_AD_VARIATIONS_PER_PAGE=%s — skipping new %s/%s",
                page,
                self.limits.max_ad_variations_per_page,
                fingerprint.ad_type,
                fingerprint.position,
            )
            return False, AdPlacementRecord(fingerprint=fingerprint, seen_count=0)

        fp = AdPlacementFingerprint(
            page=page,
            ad_detected=fingerprint.ad_detected,
            ad_type=fingerprint.ad_type,
            position=fingerprint.position,
            relative_bbox=fingerprint.relative_bbox,
            uniqueness_key=key,
            trigger_action=fingerprint.trigger_action,
            visual_state_id=fingerprint.visual_state_id,
            screenshot_path=fingerprint.screenshot_path,
            evidence=fingerprint.evidence,
            run_index=fingerprint.run_index,
        )
        record = AdPlacementRecord(fingerprint=fp, first_seen_run=fp.run_index, seen_count=1)
        self._by_key[key] = record
        self._by_page.setdefault(page, []).append(key)
        logger.info(
            "[AD] NEW placement page=%s type=%s pos=%s bbox=%s trigger=%s key=%s",
            page,
            fp.ad_type,
            fp.position,
            fp.relative_bbox,
            fp.trigger_action,
            key[:16],
        )
        return True, record

    def merge(self, other: "AdPlacementCatalog") -> int:
        """Merge another catalog; returns number of newly added unique placements."""
        added = 0
        for record in other.placements:
            is_new, _ = self.observe(record.fingerprint)
            if is_new:
                added += 1
        return added

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        by_page = {
            page: [self._by_key[k].to_dict() for k in keys]
            for page, keys in self._by_page.items()
        }
        return {
            "total_unique": len(self._by_key),
            "pages": by_page,
            "limits": {
                "target_ad_variations_per_page": self.limits.target_ad_variations_per_page,
                "max_ad_variations_per_page": self.limits.max_ad_variations_per_page,
                "max_exploration_runs": self.limits.max_exploration_runs,
            },
            "placements": [r.to_dict() for r in self.placements],
        }


class AdPlacementDetector:
    """Heuristic detector: UI hierarchy + geometry → placement fingerprints."""

    def __init__(self, *, bbox_quantize: float | None = None) -> None:
        self.bbox_quantize = (
            bbox_quantize
            if bbox_quantize is not None
            else settings.exploration_ad_bbox_quantize
        )

    def detect(
        self,
        elements: Sequence[UIElement],
        *,
        screen_width: int,
        screen_height: int,
        page: str,
        trigger_action: str | None = None,
        visual_state_id: str | None = None,
        screenshot_path: str | None = None,
        activity: str | None = None,
        run_index: int = 0,
    ) -> list[AdPlacementFingerprint]:
        """Return zero or more placement fingerprints for the current frame."""
        if screen_width <= 0 or screen_height <= 0:
            return []

        found: list[AdPlacementFingerprint] = []
        seen_keys: set[str] = set()

        for item in elements:
            if not item.visible or item.width <= 0 or item.height <= 0:
                continue
            classified = self._classify(
                item,
                screen_width=screen_width,
                screen_height=screen_height,
                activity=activity,
            )
            if classified is None:
                continue
            ad_type, position, relative_bbox, evidence = classified
            fp = AdPlacementFingerprint(
                page=_normalize_page(page),
                ad_detected=True,
                ad_type=ad_type,
                position=position,
                relative_bbox=relative_bbox,
                trigger_action=_action_bucket(trigger_action),
                visual_state_id=visual_state_id,
                screenshot_path=screenshot_path,
                evidence=tuple(evidence),
                run_index=run_index,
            )
            key = uniqueness_key_for(fp, quantize=self.bbox_quantize)
            if key in seen_keys:
                continue
            seen_keys.add(key)
            found.append(
                AdPlacementFingerprint(
                    page=fp.page,
                    ad_detected=True,
                    ad_type=fp.ad_type,
                    position=fp.position,
                    relative_bbox=fp.relative_bbox,
                    uniqueness_key=key,
                    trigger_action=fp.trigger_action,
                    visual_state_id=fp.visual_state_id,
                    screenshot_path=fp.screenshot_path,
                    evidence=fp.evidence,
                    run_index=fp.run_index,
                )
            )
        return found

    def _classify(
        self,
        item: UIElement,
        *,
        screen_width: int,
        screen_height: int,
        activity: str | None,
    ) -> tuple[AdTypeName, AdPositionName, tuple[float, float, float, float], list[str]] | None:
        # Setup / default-app / splash screens are not ad surfaces.
        if activity and _GATE_ACTIVITY.search(activity):
            return None

        evidence: list[str] = []
        class_name = item.class_name or ""
        resource_id = item.resource_id or ""
        text_blob = f"{item.text} {item.content_description} {resource_id} {class_name}"

        left = item.left / screen_width
        top = item.top / screen_height
        width = item.width / screen_width
        height = item.height / screen_height
        relative_bbox = (
            _clamp01(left),
            _clamp01(top),
            _clamp01(width),
            _clamp01(height),
        )
        coverage = width * height

        class_hint = bool(_AD_CLASS_HINTS.search(class_name))
        id_hint = bool(resource_id and _AD_ID_HINTS.search(resource_id))
        text_hint = bool(
            _REWARD_HINTS.search(text_blob)
            or _INTERSTITIAL_HINTS.search(text_blob)
            or _NATIVE_HINTS.search(text_blob)
            or _BANNER_HINTS.search(text_blob)
        )
        webview = bool(_WEBVIEW_CLASS.search(class_name))
        # WebView alone is weak; require ad id/text together with it.
        hinted = class_hint or id_hint or (webview and (id_hint or text_hint))
        if class_hint:
            evidence.append(f"class:{class_name}")
        if id_hint:
            evidence.append(f"id:{resource_id}")
        if webview and (id_hint or text_hint):
            evidence.append(f"class:{class_name}")

        # Geometry only *supports* classification after a real ad hint.
        # Bare full-screen FrameLayouts / footer bands on app chrome must not count.
        geo_banner = width >= 0.7 and 0.04 <= height <= 0.22 and (top <= 0.12 or (top + height) >= 0.88)
        geo_full = width >= 0.85 and height >= 0.55
        geo_native = 0.35 <= width <= 0.98 and 0.12 <= height <= 0.45 and 0.15 <= top <= 0.75

        if not hinted:
            return None
        if _GENERIC_CONTAINER.search(class_name) and not (id_hint or text_hint or class_hint):
            return None

        if _REWARD_HINTS.search(text_blob) or (activity and _REWARD_HINTS.search(activity)):
            ad_type: AdTypeName = "rewarded"
            evidence.append("hint:rewarded")
        elif _INTERSTITIAL_HINTS.search(text_blob) or (
            hinted and (geo_full or coverage >= 0.55)
        ):
            ad_type = "interstitial"
            if geo_full or coverage >= 0.55:
                evidence.append("hint:fullscreen")
        elif _NATIVE_HINTS.search(text_blob) or (hinted and geo_native and not geo_banner):
            ad_type = "native"
        elif _BANNER_HINTS.search(text_blob) or (hinted and geo_banner):
            ad_type = "banner"
        elif hinted:
            ad_type = "unknown"
        else:
            return None

        if coverage >= 0.55 or geo_full:
            position: AdPositionName = "fullscreen"
        elif top <= 0.15 and height <= 0.30:
            position = "top"
        elif top >= 0.70 or (top + height) >= 0.88:
            position = "bottom"
        elif 0.20 <= top <= 0.70:
            position = "middle"
        else:
            position = "unknown"

        return ad_type, position, relative_bbox, evidence


def is_strong_ad_evidence(evidence: Sequence[str] | tuple[str, ...]) -> bool:
    """True when placement is backed by SDK class / ad resource id (not geometry alone)."""
    for item in evidence:
        if item.startswith("class:") or item.startswith("id:"):
            return True
    return False


def uniqueness_key_for(
    fp: AdPlacementFingerprint,
    *,
    quantize: float | None = None,
) -> str:
    """Stable key: page + type + position + quantized size/pos + action bucket."""
    step = quantize if quantize is not None else settings.exploration_ad_bbox_quantize
    left, top, width, height = fp.relative_bbox
    q = (
        f"{_q(left, step)},{_q(top, step)},{_q(width, step)},{_q(height, step)}"
    )
    material = "|".join(
        [
            _normalize_page(fp.page),
            fp.ad_type,
            fp.position,
            q,
            _action_bucket(fp.trigger_action) or "-",
        ]
    )
    return hashlib.sha256(material.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:32]


def relative_bbox_from_bounds(
    bounds: tuple[int, int, int, int] | list[int],
    *,
    screen_width: int,
    screen_height: int,
) -> tuple[float, float, float, float]:
    left, top, right, bottom = bounds
    w = max(0, right - left)
    h = max(0, bottom - top)
    if screen_width <= 0 or screen_height <= 0:
        return (0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0)
    return (
        _clamp01(left / screen_width),
        _clamp01(top / screen_height),
        _clamp01(w / screen_width),
        _clamp01(h / screen_height),
    )


def is_ad_trigger_label(text: str, resource_id: str = "", content_description: str = "") -> bool:
    blob = f"{text} {resource_id} {content_description}"
    return bool(AD_TRIGGER_LABELS.search(blob))


def _normalize_page(page: str) -> str:
    value = (page or "unknown").strip() or "unknown"
    return value[:80]


def _action_bucket(trigger: str | None) -> str | None:
    if not trigger:
        return None
    kind = trigger.split(":", 1)[0].strip().lower()
    if kind in {"swipe_up", "swipe", "scroll"} and "up" in trigger.lower():
        return "scroll_up"
    if kind in {"swipe_down", "swipe", "scroll"} and "down" in trigger.lower():
        return "scroll_down"
    if kind == "tap":
        # Keep coarse tap bucket; label detail is not part of uniqueness beyond kind.
        return "tap"
    if kind in {"open_menu", "wait", "back", "entry"}:
        return kind
    return kind[:32]


def _q(value: float, step: float) -> str:
    """Bucket a relative coordinate. Floor keeps nearby creatives in one slot."""
    step = max(0.01, float(step))
    bucket = math.floor((float(value) + 1e-9) / step) * step
    return f"{bucket:.2f}"


def _clamp01(value: float) -> float:
    return max(0.0, min(1.0, float(value)))

"""Phase 5 multi-run advertisement placement exploration.

Wraps the Phase 4 exploration engine:

* biases actions toward scroll + ad-trigger taps
* records unique :class:`AdPlacementFingerprint` values per page
* repeats up to ``MAX_EXPLORATION_RUNS`` because ads are probabilistic
* merges and deduplicates across runs
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
import time
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from app.modules.exploration.ad_discovery import (
    AdDiscoveryLimits,
    AdPlacementCatalog,
    AdPlacementDetector,
)
from app.modules.exploration.adb import AndroidADB
from app.modules.exploration.errors import ExplorationEngineError
from app.modules.exploration.explorer import (
    ExplorationEngine,
    ExplorationLimits,
    ExplorationSession,
)
from app.modules.exploration.launcher import AppLauncher
from app.modules.exploration.log_tags import log_explorer
from app.modules.exploration.prior_knowledge import (
    ExplorationPrior,
    prior_from_analysis,
    prior_from_package,
)

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


@dataclass
class AdExplorationCampaign:
    """Merged result of one or more exploration runs focused on ad placements."""

    status: str = "completed"
    stop_reason: str = ""
    package_name: str | None = None
    runs_completed: int = 0
    duration_ms: int = 0
    catalog: AdPlacementCatalog = field(default_factory=AdPlacementCatalog)
    run_sessions: list[ExplorationSession] = field(default_factory=list)
    warnings: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)

    @property
    def unique_ad_placements(self) -> int:
        return len(self.catalog.placements)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "status": self.status,
            "stop_reason": self.stop_reason,
            "package_name": self.package_name,
            "runs_completed": self.runs_completed,
            "duration_ms": self.duration_ms,
            "unique_ad_placements": self.unique_ad_placements,
            "ad_placements": self.catalog.to_dict(),
            "warnings": list(self.warnings),
            "runs": [
                {
                    "status": s.status,
                    "stop_reason": s.stop_reason,
                    "unique_states": s.unique_states,
                    "actions_performed": s.actions_performed,
                    "screenshots_captured": s.screenshots_captured,
                    "duration_ms": s.duration_ms,
                }
                for s in self.run_sessions
            ],
        }


class AdAwareExplorationEngine(ExplorationEngine):
    """Phase 4 engine that also fills an :class:`AdPlacementCatalog`."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        adb: AndroidADB,
        *,
        prior: ExplorationPrior,
        limits: ExplorationLimits | None = None,
        ui=None,
        screenshots=None,
        detector=None,
        launcher: AppLauncher | None = None,
        output_dir: str | Path | None = None,
        ad_catalog: AdPlacementCatalog | None = None,
        ad_detector: AdPlacementDetector | None = None,
        run_index: int = 0,
        prefer_ad_triggers: bool = True,
        application_intelligence: Any | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(
            adb,
            prior=prior,
            limits=limits,
            ui=ui,
            screenshots=screenshots,
            detector=detector,
            launcher=launcher,
            output_dir=output_dir,
            application_intelligence=application_intelligence,
        )
        self.ad_catalog = ad_catalog or AdPlacementCatalog()
        self.ad_detector = ad_detector or AdPlacementDetector(
            bbox_quantize=self.ad_catalog.limits.bbox_quantize
        )
        self.run_index = run_index
        self.prefer_ad_triggers = prefer_ad_triggers

    def _next_action(self, state_id: str):  # type: ignore[override]
        from app.modules.exploration.action_planner import (
            back_action,
            count_clickables,
            is_splash_like,
            plan_actions,
        )

        elements, screen_size, activity = self._dump_full()
        if self._left_target_app(activity):
            log_explorer("left target app (activity=%s) — scheduling back to recover", activity)
            return back_action()

        if is_splash_like(elements, activity=activity):
            if (
                self._splash_wait_attempt >= self.limits.splash_max_polls
                and count_clickables(elements) == 0
            ):
                log_explorer(
                    "splash still idle after %s polls activity=%s",
                    self._splash_wait_attempt,
                    activity,
                )

        candidates = plan_actions(
            elements,
            prior=self.prior,
            screen_size=screen_size,
            splash_wait_seconds=self.limits.splash_wait_seconds,
            wait_attempt=self._splash_wait_attempt,
            activity=activity,
            prefer_ad_triggers=self.prefer_ad_triggers,
        )
        page = self._page_label(activity)
        target_met = self.ad_catalog.has_reached_target(page)

        def _rank(item) -> tuple:
            if item.meta.get("is_onboarding_cta") or item.meta.get("is_close"):
                tier = 0
            elif target_met and item.kind in {"swipe_down", "swipe_up", "open_menu", "back"}:
                tier = 1
            elif item.meta.get("ad_trigger"):
                tier = 2
            elif item.kind in {"swipe_down", "swipe_up"}:
                tier = 3
            else:
                tier = 4
            return (tier, -item.priority, item.key)

        ordered = sorted(candidates, key=_rank)

        for item in ordered:
            if not self.graph.action_seen(state_id, item.key):
                return item
        return None

    def _observe(self, **kwargs):  # type: ignore[override]
        decision = super()._observe(**kwargs)
        try:
            elements, size, activity = self._dump_full()
            page = self._page_label(activity)
            if self.ad_catalog.has_reached_max(page):
                return decision
            shot_path = None
            for record in self.detector.states:
                if record.state_id == decision.state_id:
                    shot_path = record.screenshot.local_path
                    break
            placements = self.ad_detector.detect(
                elements,
                screen_width=size[0],
                screen_height=size[1],
                page=page,
                trigger_action=kwargs.get("trigger_action"),
                visual_state_id=decision.state_id,
                screenshot_path=shot_path,
                activity=activity,
                run_index=self.run_index,
            )
            for fp in placements:
                self.ad_catalog.observe(fp)
        except Exception:
            logger.exception("Ad placement detection failed (non-fatal)")
        return decision

    def _page_label(self, activity: str | None) -> str:
        if activity:
            short = activity.rsplit(".", 1)[-1].rsplit("/", 1)[-1]
            short = short.replace("Activity", "").replace("Fragment", "") or short
            return short or "unknown"
        if self.graph.current_state and self.graph.current_state.label:
            return str(self.graph.current_state.label)
        return "unknown"


def run_ad_exploration(
    adb: AndroidADB,
    *,
    analysis: Any = None,
    package_name: str | None = None,
    activity: str | None = None,
    limits: ExplorationLimits | None = None,
    ad_limits: AdDiscoveryLimits | None = None,
    output_dir: str | Path | None = None,
    max_runs: int | None = None,
    reset_between_runs: bool = True,
) -> AdExplorationCampaign:
    """Run up to N exploration passes and merge unique ad placements."""
    prior: ExplorationPrior | None = None
    if analysis is not None:
        prior = prior_from_analysis(analysis)
    if prior is None:
        if not package_name:
            raise ExplorationEngineError(
                "Ad exploration requires analysis JSON or an explicit --package."
            )
        prior = prior_from_package(package_name, activity=activity)
    elif activity and not prior.launch_activity:
        prior.launch_activity = activity

    exploration_limits = limits or ExplorationLimits.from_settings()
    discovery_limits = ad_limits or AdDiscoveryLimits.from_settings()
    runs = max_runs if max_runs is not None else discovery_limits.max_exploration_runs
    runs = max(1, runs)

    application_intelligence = None
    if analysis is not None:
        try:
            from app.modules.apk_intelligence import build_application_intelligence

            application_intelligence = build_application_intelligence(analysis)
        except Exception:
            application_intelligence = None

    catalog = AdPlacementCatalog(discovery_limits)
    campaign = AdExplorationCampaign(
        package_name=prior.package_name,
        catalog=catalog,
    )
    started = time.perf_counter()
    launcher = AppLauncher(adb)

    log_explorer(
        "ad-campaign start package=%s runs=%s target/page=%s max/page=%s",
        prior.package_name,
        runs,
        discovery_limits.target_ad_variations_per_page,
        discovery_limits.max_ad_variations_per_page,
    )

    for run_index in range(runs):
        log_explorer("ad-campaign run %s/%s", run_index + 1, runs)
        if reset_between_runs and run_index > 0:
            try:
                # Soft resume between runs — avoid kill/open thrashing.
                launcher.resume_app(prior.package_name, prior.launch_activity)
                focus = launcher.current_component() or ""
                if "/" in focus:
                    prior.launch_activity = focus.split("/", 1)[1]
                time.sleep(max(1.0, exploration_limits.action_delay_ms / 1000.0))
            except Exception as exc:
                campaign.warnings.append(f"run {run_index} reset failed: {exc}")
                logger.warning("Failed to reset app between runs: %s", exc)

        engine = AdAwareExplorationEngine(
            adb,
            prior=prior,
            limits=exploration_limits,
            output_dir=output_dir,
            ad_catalog=catalog,
            run_index=run_index,
            prefer_ad_triggers=True,
            launcher=launcher,
            application_intelligence=application_intelligence,
        )
        try:
            session = engine.run()
        except ExplorationEngineError as exc:
            campaign.warnings.append(f"run {run_index} failed: {exc}")
            campaign.status = "partial"
            break

        campaign.run_sessions.append(session)
        campaign.runs_completed += 1
        campaign.warnings.extend(session.warnings)

        pages = catalog.pages() or []
        # Early-stop only on *strong* (SDK/id) evidence meeting the per-page target.
        eligible = [p for p in pages if catalog.strong_count_for_page(p) > 0]
        if eligible and all(catalog.has_reached_target(p) for p in eligible):
            campaign.stop_reason = "target_ad_variations_per_page"
            log_explorer("ad-campaign target reached for all pages — stopping early")
            break
    else:
        if not campaign.stop_reason:
            campaign.stop_reason = "max_exploration_runs"

    if not campaign.stop_reason:
        campaign.stop_reason = "completed"
    if campaign.unique_ad_placements == 0 and campaign.runs_completed:
        campaign.status = "partial"
        campaign.warnings.append("No advertisement placements were detected across runs.")
    elif campaign.status != "partial":
        campaign.status = "completed"

    campaign.duration_ms = int((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000)
    log_explorer(
        "ad-campaign done status=%s unique_ads=%s runs=%s duration_ms=%s",
        campaign.status,
        campaign.unique_ad_placements,
        campaign.runs_completed,
        campaign.duration_ms,
    )
    return campaign


def fingerprint_to_schema_ad(fp) -> Any:
    """Map a Phase 5 fingerprint onto the public :class:`AdPlacement` schema."""
    from pathlib import Path

    from app.schemas.exploration import AdPlacement

    left, top, width, height = fp.relative_bbox
    coverage = max(0.0, min(1.0, float(width) * float(height)))
    shot = Path(fp.screenshot_path).name if fp.screenshot_path else None
    ad_type = fp.ad_type if fp.ad_type in {
        "banner",
        "interstitial",
        "native",
        "rewarded",
        "app_open",
        "unknown",
    } else "unknown"
    return AdPlacement(
        page=fp.page,
        ad_detected=fp.ad_detected,
        ad_type=ad_type,
        position=fp.position,
        relative_bbox=[float(left), float(top), float(width), float(height)],
        uniqueness_key=fp.uniqueness_key or None,
        trigger_action=fp.trigger_action,
        coverage_ratio=coverage,
        is_fullscreen=fp.position == "fullscreen" or coverage >= 0.55,
        detection_method="heuristic",
        confidence="MEDIUM" if fp.evidence else "LOW",
        state_id=fp.visual_state_id,
        screenshot_file=shot,
        evidence=list(fp.evidence),
    )


def campaign_to_exploration_result(campaign: AdExplorationCampaign):
    """Thin adapter: merged Phase 5 catalog → :class:`ExplorationResult` (no S3)."""
    from app.modules.exploration.explorer import session_to_exploration_result
    from app.schemas.exploration import ExplorationResult

    if campaign.run_sessions:
        base = session_to_exploration_result(campaign.run_sessions[-1])
    else:
        base = ExplorationResult(
            status="failed" if campaign.status == "failed" else "partial",
            reason=campaign.stop_reason or None,
            package_name=campaign.package_name,
        )

    placements = [
        fingerprint_to_schema_ad(record.fingerprint) for record in campaign.catalog.placements
    ]
    summary = base.summary.model_copy(
        update={
            "ads_detected": len(placements),
            "duration_ms": campaign.duration_ms or base.summary.duration_ms,
        }
    )
    status = campaign.status if campaign.status in {"completed", "partial", "skipped", "failed"} else base.status
    warnings = list(dict.fromkeys([*base.warnings, *campaign.warnings]))
    return ExplorationResult(
        status=status,
        reason=campaign.stop_reason or base.reason,
        package_name=campaign.package_name or base.package_name,
        launch_activity=base.launch_activity,
        device=base.device,
        summary=summary,
        states=base.states,
        screenshots=base.screenshots,
        ad_placements=placements,
        warnings=warnings,
    )

"""Phase 12G — Goal-driven ad exploration (deterministic goals + evaluation).

Static ApplicationIntelligence creates hypotheses (goals).
Runtime AdPlacementDetector / Observation.detected_ads confirm discovery.
AI may only select ActionPlanner candidates — never invoke SDK methods.

    "ANY",

    "REWARDED",
    "NATIVE",
    "APP_OPEN",
]

    "GOAL_NOT_MET",
    "GOAL_PROGRESS",
    "GOAL_FOUND",
    "GOAL_BLOCKED",

_FORMAT_PRIORITY: dict[str, int] = {
    "REWARDED": 10,
    "INTERSTITIAL": 20,
    "APP_OPEN": 30,
    "NATIVE": 40,
    "BANNER": 50,
    "ANY": 60,
}


def _utcnow_iso() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")


def _clamp(value: float) -> float:
    try:
        v = float(value)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return 0.0
    return max(0.0, min(1.0, v))


def normalize_ad_type(raw: str | None) -> str:
    text = (raw or "").strip().upper().replace("-", "_").replace(" ", "_")
    aliases = {
        "REWARDED_VIDEO": "REWARDED",
        "REWARD": "REWARDED",
        "FULLSCREEN": "INTERSTITIAL",
        "APPOPEN": "APP_OPEN",
        "APP_OPEN_AD": "APP_OPEN",
    }
    text = aliases.get(text, text)
    if text in {"BANNER", "INTERSTITIAL", "REWARDED", "NATIVE", "APP_OPEN", "ANY", "UNKNOWN"}:
        return text
    return "UNKNOWN"


@dataclass
class AdPlacementDiscovery:
    """One unique runtime ad placement with optional trigger path."""

    placement_id: str
    ad_type: str
    state_id: str | None = None
    activity: str | None = None
    screenshot: str | None = None
    detection: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    trigger_path: list[dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=list)
    first_seen: str = field(default_factory=_utcnow_iso)
    confidence: float = 0.0
    goal_id: str | None = None
    uniqueness_key: str | None = None

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "placement_id": self.placement_id,
            "ad_type": self.ad_type,
            "state_id": self.state_id,
            "activity": self.activity,
            "screenshot": self.screenshot,
            "detection": dict(self.detection),
            "trigger_path": list(self.trigger_path),
            "first_seen": self.first_seen,
            "confidence": _clamp(self.confidence),
            "goal_id": self.goal_id,
            "uniqueness_key": self.uniqueness_key,
        }

class AdGoalGenerator:
    """Deterministic goals from ApplicationIntelligence (no LLM)."""

    def generate(
        self,
        application_intelligence: Any | None,
        *,
        include_any: bool = False,
        explicit_targets: Sequence[str] | None = None,
    ) -> list[AgentGoal]:
        goals: list[AgentGoal] = []
        targets: list[tuple[str, float]] = []

        if explicit_targets:
            for t in explicit_targets:
                nt = normalize_ad_type(t)
                if nt and nt != "UNKNOWN":
                    targets.append((nt, 0.99))
        elif application_intelligence is not None:
            ads = getattr(application_intelligence, "ads", None)
            if isinstance(ads, dict):
                formats = ads.get("ad_formats") or []
            elif hasattr(application_intelligence, "to_dict"):
                formats = (application_intelligence.to_dict().get("ads") or {}).get(
                    "ad_formats"
                ) or []
            else:
                formats = []
            for item in formats:
                if not isinstance(item, dict):
                    continue
                fmt = normalize_ad_type(item.get("format"))
                if fmt in {"UNKNOWN", ""}:
                    continue
                conf = _clamp(float(item.get("confidence") or 0.5))
                targets.append((fmt, conf))

        # Deduplicate keeping highest confidence.
        best: dict[str, float] = {}
        for fmt, conf in targets:
            best[fmt] = max(conf, best.get(fmt, 0.0))

        if not best and include_any:
            best["ANY"] = 0.5

        for fmt, conf in sorted(
            best.items(),
            key=lambda kv: (_FORMAT_PRIORITY.get(kv[0], 100), -kv[1]),
        ):
            priority = _FORMAT_PRIORITY.get(fmt, 80)
            # Stronger static confidence → slightly higher priority (lower number).
            if conf >= 0.9:
                priority = max(1, priority - 5)
            goals.append(
                AgentGoal(
                    id=f"ad_{fmt.lower()}",
                    title=f"Find {fmt.lower().replace('_', ' ')} advertisement",
                    status="active",
                    goal_type="AD_DISCOVERY",
                    priority=priority,
                    target_ad_type=fmt,
                    reason=f"static_signal confidence={conf:.2f}",
                )
            )
            logger.info(
                "[AD-GOAL] generated target=%s priority=%s confidence=%.2f",
                fmt,
                priority,
                conf,
            )
        return goals


class GoalEvaluator:
    """Deterministic evaluation: runtime ads confirm goals (never static alone)."""

    def __init__(self, *, min_confidence: float | None = None) -> None:
        self.min_confidence = float(
            min_confidence
            if min_confidence is not None
            else getattr(settings, "ad_detection_min_confidence", 0.45) or 0.45
        )

    def evaluate(
        self,
        goal: AgentGoal | None,
        *,
        observation: Observation | None,
        agent_state: AgentState | None = None,
        discovery_mode: DiscoveryMode | None = None,
    ) -> GoalEvaluation:
        if goal is None:
            return GoalEvaluation(outcome="GOAL_NOT_MET", reason="no_goal")
        if goal.goal_type != "AD_DISCOVERY":
            return GoalEvaluation(
                outcome="GOAL_NOT_MET",
                goal_id=goal.id,
                reason="not_ad_goal",
            )
        if goal.status in {"found", "completed", "exhausted", "failed"}:
            return GoalEvaluation(
                outcome="GOAL_FOUND" if goal.status in {"found", "completed"} else "GOAL_NOT_MET",
                goal_id=goal.id,
                reason=f"already_{goal.status}",
            )

        if observation is not None and observation.hitl_required:
            return GoalEvaluation(
                outcome="GOAL_BLOCKED",
                goal_id=goal.id,
                reason="hitl_required",
            )

        target = normalize_ad_type(goal.target_ad_type or "ANY")
        runtime_ads = list((observation.detected_ads if observation else None) or [])
        matched = self._match_runtime_ad(runtime_ads, target)
        if matched is None:
            # Progress: recent successful transition while pursuing ad goal.
            progress = False
            if agent_state is not None:
                for entry in reversed(agent_state.history[-5:]):
                    if entry.action_kind == "transition" and entry.next_state_id:
                        progress = True
                        break
                    if (
                        entry.success
                        and entry.next_state_id
                        and entry.state_id
                        and entry.next_state_id != entry.state_id
                    ):
                        progress = True
                        break
            return GoalEvaluation(
                outcome="GOAL_PROGRESS" if progress else "GOAL_NOT_MET",
                goal_id=goal.id,
                reason="no_runtime_ad_match",
            )

        conf = _clamp(float(matched.get("confidence") or 0.0))
        if conf < self.min_confidence:
            return GoalEvaluation(
                outcome="GOAL_PROGRESS",
                goal_id=goal.id,
                reason=f"low_confidence:{conf:.2f}",
                matched_ad=matched,
            )

        path = self._trigger_path(agent_state)
        uniq = self._uniqueness_key(matched, observation)
        placement_id = f"plc_{uniq[:16]}" if uniq else f"plc_{_utcnow_iso()}"
        discovery = AdPlacementDiscovery(
            placement_id=placement_id,
            ad_type=normalize_ad_type(matched.get("type")),
            state_id=observation.state_id if observation else None,
            activity=observation.activity if observation else None,
            screenshot=(
                observation.screenshot_path or observation.screenshot_url
                if observation
                else None
            ),
            detection=dict(matched),
            trigger_path=path,
            confidence=conf,
            goal_id=goal.id,
            uniqueness_key=uniq,
        )
        mode = discovery_mode or _configured_discovery_mode()
        logger.info(
            "[AD-GOAL] FOUND target=%s type=%s confidence=%.2f mode=%s",
            target,
            discovery.ad_type,
            conf,
            mode,
        )
        return GoalEvaluation(
            outcome="GOAL_FOUND",
            goal_id=goal.id,
            reason="runtime_ad_confirmed",
            matched_ad=matched,
            discovery=discovery,
        )

    def _match_runtime_ad(
        self, ads: list[dict[str, Any]], target: str
    ) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        best: dict[str, Any] | None = None
        best_conf = -1.0
        for ad in ads:
            if not isinstance(ad, dict) or not ad.get("detected"):
                continue
            ad_type = normalize_ad_type(ad.get("type"))
            if target != "ANY" and ad_type != target:
                continue
            conf = _clamp(float(ad.get("confidence") or 0.0))
            if conf > best_conf:
                best = ad
                best_conf = conf
        return best

    def _trigger_path(self, agent_state: AgentState | None) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        if agent_state is None:
            return []
        path: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
        for entry in agent_state.history[-20:]:
            if entry.action_kind in {None, "transition"}:
                continue
            path.append(
                {
                    "action": entry.action_kind,
                    "target": (entry.action_label or entry.action_key or "")[:80],
                    "state_id": entry.state_id,
                    "next_state_id": entry.next_state_id,
                    "success": entry.success,
                }
            )
        return path[-12:]

    def _uniqueness_key(
        self, ad: dict[str, Any], observation: Observation | None
    ) -> str:
        parts = [
            normalize_ad_type(ad.get("type")),
            str(ad.get("position") or ""),
            str((observation.state_id if observation else None) or ""),
            str((observation.activity if observation else None) or ""),
            str(ad.get("image_path") or (observation.screenshot_id if observation else "") or ""),
        ]
        bbox = ad.get("bounding_box") or ad.get("relative_bbox") or ""
        parts.append(str(bbox))
        digest = hashlib.sha1("|".join(parts).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
        return digest


def apply_goal_evaluation(
    agent_state: AgentState,
    evaluation: GoalEvaluation,
    *,
    discovery_mode: DiscoveryMode | None = None,
) -> None:
    """Update AgentState goals / discoveries from an evaluation result."""
    if evaluation.outcome == "GOAL_BLOCKED":
        goal = _find_goal(agent_state, evaluation.goal_id)
        if goal is not None and goal.status == "active":
            goal.status = "blocked"
            goal.reason = evaluation.reason
        return

    if evaluation.outcome != "GOAL_FOUND" or evaluation.discovery is None:
        return

    discovery = evaluation.discovery
    # Deduplicate placements.
    existing_keys = {
        d.uniqueness_key for d in agent_state.discovered_ad_placements if d.uniqueness_key
    }
    if discovery.uniqueness_key and discovery.uniqueness_key in existing_keys:
        agent_state.bump_reliability("duplicate_discoveries_suppressed")
        return
    agent_state.discovered_ad_placements.append(discovery)
    if len(agent_state.discovered_ad_placements) > 50:
        del agent_state.discovered_ad_placements[
            : len(agent_state.discovered_ad_placements) - 50
        ]

    mode = discovery_mode or _configured_discovery_mode()
    goal = _find_goal(agent_state, evaluation.goal_id)
    if goal is None:
        return
    if mode == "first_match":
        goal.status = "found"
        goal.reason = evaluation.reason
        agent_state.bump_reliability("goals_found")
        # Move to completed_goals list if still active.
        if goal in agent_state.active_goals:
            agent_state.active_goals = [g for g in agent_state.active_goals if g.id != goal.id]
            agent_state.completed_goals.append(goal)
        # Activate next pending AD_DISCOVERY goal if any.
        _activate_next_ad_goal(agent_state)
    else:
        # discover_all: record placement but keep goal active until exhausted.
        goal.reason = f"found_placement:{discovery.placement_id}"
        agent_state.bump_reliability("goals_found")


def seed_ad_goals_from_intelligence(
    agent_state: AgentState,
    application_intelligence: Any | None,
) -> list[AgentGoal]:
    """Replace/augment AD_DISCOVERY seed goals using static intelligence."""
    generated = AdGoalGenerator().generate(application_intelligence)
    if not generated:
        return []
    # Remove generic discover_ad_placements seed if present; keep specific targets.
    agent_state.active_goals = [
        g
        for g in agent_state.active_goals
        if not (g.goal_type == "AD_DISCOVERY" and g.id == "discover_ad_placements")
    ]
    existing_ids = {g.id for g in agent_state.active_goals}
    added: list[AgentGoal] = []
    for goal in generated:
        if goal.id in existing_ids:
            continue
        agent_state.active_goals.append(goal)
        added.append(goal)
    # Sort so highest-priority ad goals come first among actives.
    agent_state.active_goals.sort(key=lambda g: (g.priority, g.id))
    return added


def active_ad_goal(agent_state: AgentState | None) -> AgentGoal | None:
    if agent_state is None:
        return None
    ad_goals = [
        g
        for g in agent_state.active_goals
        if g.goal_type == "AD_DISCOVERY" and g.status in {"active", "pending"}
    ]
    if not ad_goals:
        return None
    return sorted(ad_goals, key=lambda g: (g.priority, g.id))[0]


def fingerprints_to_ad_results(
    fingerprints: Sequence[Any],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    """Convert AdPlacementFingerprint objects into Observation ad_results dicts."""
    out: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    for fp in fingerprints or []:
        try:
            ad_type = normalize_ad_type(getattr(fp, "ad_type", None)).lower()
            if ad_type == "unknown":
                ad_type = "unknown"
            # Map APP_OPEN to unknown for Phase 6 AdTypeName if needed — keep string.
            if ad_type == "app_open":
                type_name = "unknown"
                evidence_extra = ["format:app_open"]
            else:
                type_name = ad_type if ad_type in {
                    "banner", "native", "interstitial", "rewarded", "unknown"
                } else "unknown"
                evidence_extra = []
            evidence = list(getattr(fp, "evidence", ()) or [])
            evidence.extend(evidence_extra)
            # UI-hierarchy heuristic confidence (not vision).
            conf = 0.78 if evidence else 0.65
            if any("reward" in str(e).lower() for e in evidence):
                conf = 0.82
            if any("interstitial" in str(e).lower() or "fullscreen" in str(e).lower() for e in evidence):
                conf = max(conf, 0.80)
            out.append(
                {
                    "detected": True,
                    "type": type_name if type_name != "unknown" or ad_type == "unknown" else ad_type,
                    "confidence": conf,
                    "position": getattr(fp, "position", "unknown"),
                    "provider": "ui_hierarchy_heuristic",
                    "image_path": getattr(fp, "screenshot_path", None),
                    "evidence": evidence[:12],
                    "relative_bbox": list(getattr(fp, "relative_bbox", ()) or []),
                    "uniqueness_key": getattr(fp, "uniqueness_key", None),
                    "visual_state_id": getattr(fp, "visual_state_id", None),
                    "page": getattr(fp, "page", None),
                }
            )
        except Exception:
            continue
    return out


def _find_goal(agent_state: AgentState, goal_id: str | None) -> AgentGoal | None:
    if not goal_id:
        return None
    for g in agent_state.active_goals + agent_state.completed_goals + agent_state.failed_goals:
        if g.id == goal_id:
            return g
    return None


def _activate_next_ad_goal(agent_state: AgentState) -> None:
    pending = [
        g
        for g in agent_state.active_goals
        if g.goal_type == "AD_DISCOVERY" and g.status == "pending"
    ]
    if not pending:
        return
    nxt = sorted(pending, key=lambda g: (g.priority, g.id))[0]
    nxt.status = "active"


def _configured_discovery_mode() -> DiscoveryMode:
    raw = str(
        getattr(settings, "exploration_ad_discovery_mode", None) or "discover_all"
    ).strip().lower()
    if raw in {"first_match", "first", "first-match"}:
        return "first_match"
    return "discover_all"


def goal_context_for_ai(agent_state: AgentState | None) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
    goal = active_ad_goal(agent_state)
    if goal is None:
        return None
    return {
        "type": goal.goal_type,
        "target": goal.target_ad_type or "ANY",
        "status": (goal.status or "active").upper(),
        "goal_id": goal.id,
        "title": goal.title,
        "priority": goal.priority,
        "discoveries": len(
            [
                d
                for d in (agent_state.discovered_ad_placements if agent_state else [])
                if d.goal_id == goal.id
            ]
        ),
        "mode": _configured_discovery_mode(),
        "note": "STATIC signals are hypotheses; runtime detection confirms FOUND",
    }

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
import os
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
import time
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from functools import lru_cache
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Callable, Sequence

from app.core.config import settings
from app.modules.exploration.errors import (
    AdbCommandError,
    AdbTimeoutError,
    AdbUnavailableError,
    NoDeviceError,
)
from app.schemas.exploration import DeviceInfo

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

_DEVICE_LINE = re.compile(r"^(\S+)\s+(device|offline|unauthorized|bootloader|recovery)\b")
_WM_SIZE = re.compile(r"Physical size:\s*(\d+)x(\d+)")
_WM_DENSITY = re.compile(r"Physical density:\s*(\d+)")

# Windows executables need the .exe suffix; keep the ordering platform agnostic.
_ADB_NAMES = ("adb.exe", "adb") if os.name == "nt" else ("adb", "adb.exe")


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class CommandResult:
    """Captured outcome of a single subprocess invocation."""

    args: tuple[str, ...]
    returncode: int
    stdout: str
    stderr: str
    duration_ms: int

    @property
    def ok(self) -> bool:
        return self.returncode == 0

    @property
    def command(self) -> str:
        return " ".join(self.args)

    @property
    def output(self) -> str:
        """Combined stream, for adb commands that report errors on stdout."""
        return f"{self.stdout}\n{self.stderr}".strip()

    def fail_message(self, prefix: str) -> str:
        detail = (self.stderr or self.stdout or "").strip().replace("\r", "")
        return f"{prefix} (exit {self.returncode}): {detail[:500]}"


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class AdbDevice:
    serial: str
    state: str

    @property
    def is_ready(self) -> bool:
        return self.state == "device"

    @property
    def is_emulator(self) -> bool:
        return self.serial.startswith("emulator-")


Runner = Callable[[Sequence[str], int], CommandResult]


def _default_runner(args: Sequence[str], timeout: int) -> CommandResult:
    """Execute a command, capturing both streams. Raises only on timeout/OS errors."""
    started = time.perf_counter()
    try:
        completed = subprocess.run(
            list(args),
            check=False,
            capture_output=True,
            text=True,
            encoding="utf-8",
            errors="replace",
            timeout=timeout,
        )
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as exc:
        raise AdbTimeoutError(
            f"`{' '.join(args)}` timed out after {timeout}s."
        ).with_output(command=" ".join(args), stdout=_as_text(exc.stdout), stderr=_as_text(exc.stderr)) from exc
    except OSError as exc:
        raise AdbCommandError(f"`{' '.join(args)}` could not be executed: {exc}") from exc
    duration_ms = int((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000)
    return CommandResult(
        args=tuple(args),
        returncode=completed.returncode,
        stdout=completed.stdout or "",
        stderr=completed.stderr or "",
        duration_ms=duration_ms,
    )


def _as_text(value: object) -> str:
    if value is None:
        return ""
    if isinstance(value, bytes):
        return value.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
    return str(value)


def _repair_png_bytes(data: bytes) -> bytes:
    """Fix the common Windows ``adb exec-out`` CRLF corruption of PNG streams."""
    if not data:
        return data
    if data.startswith(b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n") or data.startswith(b"\x89PNG\n"):
        return data
    # Some hosts expand LF to CRLF inside the binary stream.
    fixed = data.replace(b"\r\n", b"\n")
    if fixed.startswith(b"\x89PNG"):
        return fixed
    return data


@lru_cache(maxsize=1)
def find_adb() -> str | None:
    """Locate adb from ADB_PATH, PATH, then the Android SDK layout.

    Nothing is hardcoded and Android Studio is never required; only the
    platform-tools directory of an SDK install is needed.
    """
    configured = (settings.adb_path or "").strip()
    if configured and configured.lower() not in {"adb", "adb.exe"}:
        candidate = Path(configured)
        if candidate.is_file():
            return str(candidate)
        logger.warning("ADB_PATH=%s does not point to a file; falling back.", configured)
    for name in _ADB_NAMES:
        found = shutil.which(name)
        if found:
            return found
    for root in _sdk_roots():
        for name in _ADB_NAMES:
            candidate = root / "platform-tools" / name
            if candidate.is_file():
                return str(candidate)
    return None


def _sdk_roots() -> list[Path]:
    """Candidate SDK roots, in priority order."""
    raw = [
        (settings.android_sdk_root or "").strip(),
        os.environ.get("ANDROID_SDK_ROOT", ""),
        os.environ.get("ANDROID_HOME", ""),
    ]
    roots: list[Path] = []
    for value in raw:
        if not value:
            continue
        path = Path(value)
        if path.is_dir() and path not in roots:
            roots.append(path)
    return roots


def adb_available() -> bool:
    return find_adb() is not None


class AndroidADB:
    """Thin, testable wrapper around the adb executable.

    Every method surfaces captured stdout/stderr on failure rather than
    swallowing it. Instances may be bound to a serial via :meth:`for_serial`.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        binary: str | None = None,
        serial: str | None = None,
        timeout: int | None = None,
        runner: Runner | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self._binary = binary
        self.serial = serial
        self.timeout = timeout or settings.adb_command_timeout_seconds
        self._runner = runner or _default_runner

    # -- plumbing ------------------------------------------------------------

    @property
    def binary(self) -> str:
        if self._binary:
            return self._binary
        found = find_adb()
        if found is None:
            raise AdbUnavailableError(
                "adb was not found. Set ADB_PATH or ANDROID_SDK_ROOT, or install "
                "Android platform-tools and add it to PATH."
            )
        self._binary = found
        return found

    def for_serial(self, serial: str) -> "AndroidADB":
        return AndroidADB(
            binary=self._binary,
            serial=serial,
            timeout=self.timeout,
            runner=self._runner,
        )

    def run(
        self,
        args: Sequence[str],
        *,
        timeout: int | None = None,
        check: bool = True,
        with_serial: bool = True,
    ) -> CommandResult:
        command: list[str] = [self.binary]
        if with_serial and self.serial:
            command += ["-s", self.serial]
        command += list(args)
        result = self._runner(command, timeout or self.timeout)
        logger.debug("adb %s -> %s in %sms", " ".join(args), result.returncode, result.duration_ms)
        if check and not result.ok:
            raise AdbCommandError(result.fail_message(f"adb {' '.join(args)} failed")).with_output(
                command=result.command, stdout=result.stdout, stderr=result.stderr
            )
        return result

    def shell(
        self,
        command: str,
        *,
        timeout: int | None = None,
        check: bool = True,
    ) -> CommandResult:
        return self.run(["shell", command], timeout=timeout, check=check)

    def shell_text(self, command: str, *, timeout: int | None = None) -> str:
        return self.shell(command, timeout=timeout).stdout.strip()

    def run_binary(
        self,
        args: Sequence[str],
        *,
        timeout: int | None = None,
        with_serial: bool = True,
    ) -> bytes:
        """Run an adb command and return raw stdout bytes (for screencap, pull, etc.).

        The normal :meth:`run` path decodes as UTF-8, which corrupts PNG payloads.
        """
        command: list[str] = [self.binary]
        if with_serial and self.serial:
            command += ["-s", self.serial]
        command += list(args)
        limit = timeout or self.timeout
        started = time.perf_counter()
        try:
            completed = subprocess.run(
                command,
                check=False,
                capture_output=True,
                timeout=limit,
            )
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as exc:
            raise AdbTimeoutError(
                f"`{' '.join(command)}` timed out after {limit}s."
            ).with_output(command=" ".join(command), stdout="", stderr=_as_text(exc.stderr)) from exc
        except OSError as exc:
            raise AdbCommandError(f"`{' '.join(command)}` could not be executed: {exc}") from exc

        duration_ms = int((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000)
        logger.debug(
            "adb binary %s -> %s (%s bytes, %sms)",
            " ".join(args),
            completed.returncode,
            len(completed.stdout or b""),
            duration_ms,
        )
        if completed.returncode != 0:
            stderr = _as_text(completed.stderr)
            raise AdbCommandError(
                f"adb {' '.join(args)} failed (exit {completed.returncode}): {stderr[:500]}"
            ).with_output(command=" ".join(command), stdout="", stderr=stderr)
        return completed.stdout or b""

    def screencap_png(self, *, timeout: int | None = None) -> bytes:
        """Capture the framebuffer as PNG bytes via ``adb exec-out screencap -p``."""
        raw = self.run_binary(["exec-out", "screencap", "-p"], timeout=timeout or 60)
        return _repair_png_bytes(raw)

    # -- device discovery ----------------------------------------------------

    def devices(self) -> list[AdbDevice]:
        """Parse `adb devices`. Returns an empty list when adb is missing."""
        if find_adb() is None and self._binary is None:
            return []
        result = self.run(["devices"], check=False, with_serial=False)
        found: list[AdbDevice] = []
        for line in result.stdout.splitlines()[1:]:
            match = _DEVICE_LINE.match(line.strip())
            if match:
                found.append(AdbDevice(serial=match.group(1), state=match.group(2)))
        return found

    def ready_devices(self) -> list[AdbDevice]:
        return [item for item in self.devices() if item.is_ready]

    def emulators(self) -> list[AdbDevice]:
        return [item for item in self.devices() if item.is_emulator]

    def pick_device(self, preferred: str | None = None) -> str:
        wanted = (preferred or settings.emulator_serial or "").strip()
        ready = self.ready_devices()
        if wanted:
            for item in ready:
                if item.serial == wanted:
                    return item.serial
            raise NoDeviceError(f"Device '{wanted}' is not connected or not ready.")
        if not ready:
            raise NoDeviceError(
                "No ready Android device found. Start an emulator first "
                "(see EmulatorManager.start or `emulator -avd <name>`)."
            )
        for item in ready:
            if item.is_emulator:
                return item.serial
        return ready[0].serial

    def wait_for_device(self, timeout: int = 120) -> CommandResult:
        return self.run(["wait-for-device"], timeout=timeout)

    def start_server(self) -> CommandResult:
        return self.run(["start-server"], check=False, with_serial=False)

    def kill_server(self) -> CommandResult:
        return self.run(["kill-server"], check=False, with_serial=False)

    # -- device state --------------------------------------------------------

    def getprop(self, name: str) -> str | None:
        result = self.shell(f"getprop {name}", timeout=15, check=False)
        if not result.ok:
            return None
        value = result.stdout.strip()
        return value or None

    def is_boot_completed(self) -> bool:
        return self.getprop("sys.boot_completed") == "1"

    def is_boot_animation_stopped(self) -> bool:
        # Some images never expose this; treat "unknown" as stopped.
        value = self.getprop("init.svc.bootanim")
        return value in (None, "stopped")

    def is_package_manager_ready(self) -> bool:
        result = self.shell("pm path android", timeout=20, check=False)
        return result.ok and "package:" in result.stdout

    def describe(self) -> DeviceInfo:
        """Collect identifying properties for the analysis report."""
        serial = self.serial or ""
        sdk_raw = self.getprop("ro.build.version.sdk")
        try:
            sdk_int = int(sdk_raw) if sdk_raw else None
        except ValueError:
            sdk_int = None

        width = height = density = None
        size = self.shell("wm size", timeout=15, check=False)
        if size.ok:
            match = _WM_SIZE.search(size.stdout)
            if match:
                width, height = int(match.group(1)), int(match.group(2))
        dens = self.shell("wm density", timeout=15, check=False)
        if dens.ok:
            match = _WM_DENSITY.search(dens.stdout)
            if match:
                density = int(match.group(1))

        return DeviceInfo(
            serial=serial or None,
            avd_name=self.avd_name(),
            android_version=self.getprop("ro.build.version.release"),
            sdk_int=sdk_int,
            screen_width=width,
            screen_height=height,
            density=density,
            is_emulator=serial.startswith("emulator-") or self.getprop("ro.kernel.qemu") == "1",
        )

    def avd_name(self) -> str | None:
        for prop in ("ro.boot.qemu.avd_name", "ro.kernel.qemu.avd_name", "ro.boot.avd_name"):
            value = self.getprop(prop)
            if value:
                return value.replace(" ", "_")
        result = self.run(["emu", "avd", "name"], check=False)
        if result.ok:
            first = result.stdout.strip().splitlines()
            if first and first[0].strip().upper() != "OK":
                return first[0].strip()
        return None

    def emu_kill(self) -> CommandResult:
        return self.run(["emu", "kill"], check=False, timeout=30)


# --- Health reporting --------------------------------------------------------


@dataclass
class _Capability:
    enabled: bool = False
    adb_available: bool = False
    adb_path: str | None = None
    devices: list[dict] = field(default_factory=list)
    ready: bool = False


def capability_report() -> dict:
    """Non-throwing snapshot for the /health endpoint."""
    from app.modules.exploration.emulator import find_emulator

    binary = find_adb()
    devices: list[AdbDevice] = []
    if binary is not None:
        try:
            devices = AndroidADB(binary=binary).devices()
        except Exception:  # never break liveness checks
            logger.debug("adb devices failed during health check", exc_info=True)
    emulator_binary = find_emulator()
    return {
        "enabled": settings.exploration_enabled,
        "adb_available": binary is not None,
        "adb_path": binary,
        "emulator_available": emulator_binary is not None,
        "emulator_path": emulator_binary,
        "avd_name": settings.avd_name,
        "devices": [{"serial": item.serial, "state": item.state} for item in devices],
        "ready": bool(
            settings.exploration_enabled
            and binary is not None
            and any(item.is_ready for item in devices)
        ),
    }

================================================================================
