"""Phase 12B — Unified AgentState (read-only orchestration memory).

AgentState answers what the explorer knows / has done / has left — it does NOT
execute ADB, UI actions, or LLM calls. NavigationGraph remains the topology
source of truth; Observation (Phase 12A) remains the screen snapshot.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from enum import Enum
from typing import Any, Literal

from app.modules.exploration.observation import Observation


def _utcnow_iso() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")


class AgentStatus(str, Enum):
    IDLE = "idle"
    EXPLORING = "exploring"
    BLOCKED = "blocked"
    COMPLETED = "completed"
    FAILED = "failed"


GoalStatus = Literal[
    "pending",
    "active",
    "completed",
    "failed",
    "found",
    "blocked",
    "exhausted",
]


@dataclass
class AgentGoal:
    """Exploration goal (Phase 12B/12E/12G — runtime only)."""

    id: str
    title: str
    status: GoalStatus = "active"
    reason: str | None = None
    goal_type: str = "GENERAL_EXPLORATION"
    priority: int = 1
    target_ad_type: str | None = None  # REWARDED / INTERSTITIAL / ... for AD_DISCOVERY

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "id": self.id,
            "title": self.title,
            "status": self.status,
            "reason": self.reason,
            "goal_type": self.goal_type,
            "priority": self.priority,
            "target_ad_type": self.target_ad_type,
        }


@dataclass
class HistoryEntry:
    """One step in the exploration journey (compact, serializable)."""

    timestamp: str
    state_id: str | None = None
    action_kind: str | None = None
    action_key: str | None = None
    action_label: str | None = None
    result: str | None = None
    next_state_id: str | None = None
    success: bool = True
    failure_reason: str | None = None
    observation_id: str | None = None

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "timestamp": self.timestamp,
            "state_id": self.state_id,
            "action_kind": self.action_kind,
            "action_key": self.action_key,
            "action_label": self.action_label,
            "result": self.result,
            "next_state_id": self.next_state_id,
            "success": self.success,
            "failure_reason": self.failure_reason,
            "observation_id": self.observation_id,
        }


@dataclass
class FailedActionRecord:
    action_key: str
    action_kind: str | None = None
    state_id: str | None = None
    reason: str | None = None
    timestamp: str = field(default_factory=_utcnow_iso)
    attempt_count: int = 1

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "action_key": self.action_key,
            "action_kind": self.action_kind,
            "state_id": self.state_id,
            "reason": self.reason,
            "timestamp": self.timestamp,
            "attempt_count": self.attempt_count,
        }


@dataclass
class RecoveryRecord:
    """Compact Supervisor recovery event (Phase 12D)."""

    timestamp: str
    decision: str
    reason: str | None = None
    action_id: str | None = None
    action_key: str | None = None
    state_id: str | None = None
    attempt: int = 0

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "timestamp": self.timestamp,
            "decision": self.decision,
            "reason": self.reason,
            "action_id": self.action_id,
            "action_key": self.action_key,
            "state_id": self.state_id,
            "attempt": self.attempt,
        }


@dataclass
class AgentState:
    """Authoritative runtime memory for the exploration agent (Phase 12B)."""

    status: AgentStatus = AgentStatus.IDLE
    package_name: str | None = None

    current_observation: Observation | None = None
    current_state_id: str | None = None
    current_activity: str | None = None
    current_package: str | None = None
    current_depth: int = 0

    # Reference only — NavigationGraph owns visited_states / visited_actions / edges.
    navigation_graph: Any | None = None

    history: list[HistoryEntry] = field(default_factory=list)
    active_goals: list[AgentGoal] = field(default_factory=list)
    completed_goals: list[AgentGoal] = field(default_factory=list)
    failed_goals: list[AgentGoal] = field(default_factory=list)

    discovered_ads: list[dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=list)
    failed_actions: list[FailedActionRecord] = field(default_factory=list)
    recovery_history: list[RecoveryRecord] = field(default_factory=list)

    blocked: bool = False
    blocked_reason: str | None = None
    hitl_required: bool = False
    hitl: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=lambda: {"required": False})

    # Budgets mirror ExplorationLimits / session counters (source of truth elsewhere).
    actions_used: int = 0
    max_actions: int = 200
    states_discovered: int = 0
    max_states: int = 25
    max_depth: int = 20

    stop_reason: str | None = None
    job_id: str | None = None

    # Phase 12E — compact AI planner telemetry (runtime only).
    last_ai_decision: dict[str, Any] | None = None
    ai_decision_count: int = 0
    ai_fallback_count: int = 0
    last_planner_source: str | None = None

    # Phase 12F — static APK intelligence (reference; built once per job).
    application_intelligence: Any | None = None
    # Phase 12G — unique runtime ad placement discoveries (bounded).
    discovered_ad_placements: list[Any] = field(default_factory=list)
    # Phase 12H — compact reliability telemetry (runtime / in-memory only).
    reliability: dict[str, int] = field(
        default_factory=lambda: {
            "actions_attempted": 0,
            "actions_succeeded": 0,
            "actions_failed": 0,
            "retries": 0,
            "backtracks": 0,
            "relaunches": 0,
            "hitl_pauses": 0,
            "ai_failures": 0,
            "goals_found": 0,
            "goals_exhausted": 0,
            "duplicate_discoveries_suppressed": 0,
            "observations": 0,
            "waits": 0,
            "skips": 0,
            "stops": 0,
        }
    )

    _max_history: int = 200
    _prev_state_id: str | None = field(default=None, repr=False)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ factory

    @classmethod
    def create_initial(
        cls,
        *,
        package_name: str | None,
        navigation_graph: Any | None = None,
        max_actions: int = 200,
        max_states: int = 25,
        max_depth: int = 20,
        job_id: str | None = None,
        seed_goals: bool = True,
        application_intelligence: Any | None = None,
    ) -> "AgentState":
        state = cls(
            status=AgentStatus.EXPLORING,
            package_name=package_name,
            current_package=package_name,
            navigation_graph=navigation_graph,
            max_actions=max_actions,
            max_states=max_states,
            max_depth=max_depth,
            job_id=job_id,
            application_intelligence=application_intelligence,
        )
        if seed_goals:
            state.add_goal(
                "discover_all_reachable_screens",
                "Discover reachable screens",
                goal_type="GENERAL_EXPLORATION",
                priority=90,
            )
            state.add_goal(
                "discover_ad_placements",
                "Discover ad placements when available",
                goal_type="AD_DISCOVERY",
                priority=65,
                target_ad_type="ANY",
            )
        return state

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ derived

    @property
    def remaining_actions(self) -> int:
        return max(0, int(self.max_actions) - int(self.actions_used))

    @property
    def remaining_states(self) -> int:
        return max(0, int(self.max_states) - int(self.states_discovered))

    @property
    def remaining_depth(self) -> int:
        return max(0, int(self.max_depth) - int(self.current_depth))

    @property
    def visited_state_ids(self) -> list[str]:
        graph = self.navigation_graph
        if graph is None:
            return []
        return list(getattr(graph, "visited_states", {}) or {})

    @property
    def parent_state_id(self) -> str | None:
        graph = self.navigation_graph
        if graph is None:
            return None
        return getattr(graph, "parent_state_id", None)

    def navigation_summary(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Compact NavigationGraph summary — does not dump ScreenStateRecord objects."""
        graph = self.navigation_graph
        if graph is None:
            return {
                "current_state_id": None,
                "parent_state_id": None,
                "state_count": 0,
                "edge_count": 0,
                "visited_states": [],
                "visited_actions": {},
                "depth": 0,
            }
        visited_actions_raw = getattr(graph, "visited_actions", {}) or {}
        visited_actions = {
            sid: sorted(keys) for sid, keys in visited_actions_raw.items()
        }
        return {
            "current_state_id": getattr(graph, "current_state_id", None),
            "parent_state_id": getattr(graph, "parent_state_id", None),
            "state_count": len(getattr(graph, "visited_states", {}) or {}),
            "edge_count": len(getattr(graph, "edges", []) or []),
            "visited_states": list(getattr(graph, "visited_states", {}) or {}),
            "visited_actions": visited_actions,
            "depth": int(self.current_depth),
            "max_depth_reached": (
                int(graph.max_depth()) if hasattr(graph, "max_depth") else self.current_depth
            ),
        }

    def discovered_screens(self) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        """Screens derived from NavigationGraph + latest observation ids when known."""
        graph = self.navigation_graph
        if graph is None:
            return []
        out: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
        labels = getattr(graph, "labels", {}) or {}
        for sid, record in (getattr(graph, "visited_states", {}) or {}).items():
            activity = None
            screenshot_path = None
            try:
                activity = record.visual.activity
                screenshot_path = getattr(record.screenshot, "local_path", None)
            except Exception:
                pass
            out.append(
                {
                    "state_id": sid,
                    "activity": activity,
                    "label": labels.get(sid),
                    "screenshot_path": screenshot_path,
                    "observation_id": (
                        self.current_observation.observation_id
                        if self.current_observation
                        and self.current_observation.state_id == sid
                        else None
                    ),
                }
            )
        return out

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ updates

    def update_observation(self, observation: Observation | None) -> None:
        if observation is None:
            return
        self.bump_reliability("observations")
        prev = self.current_state_id
        self.current_observation = observation
        self.current_state_id = observation.state_id
        self.current_activity = observation.activity
        self.current_package = observation.package_name or self.package_name
        if observation.hitl_required:
            self.hitl_required = True
            self.hitl = dict(observation.hitl or {"required": True})
            # Record only — do not change HITL pause behavior.
        else:
            self.hitl_required = False
            self.hitl = dict(observation.hitl or {"required": False})

        # Merge ads without inventing — only store non-empty detections.
        for ad in observation.detected_ads or []:
            if isinstance(ad, dict) and ad.get("detected"):
                self.record_ad(ad)

        if self.navigation_graph is not None and observation.state_id:
            try:
                self.current_depth = int(self.navigation_graph.depth_of(observation.state_id))
            except Exception:
                pass
            self.states_discovered = len(
                getattr(self.navigation_graph, "visited_states", {}) or {}
            )

        if prev and observation.state_id and prev != observation.state_id:
            self.record_state_transition(prev, observation.state_id)

        self._prev_state_id = observation.state_id

    def sync_budgets(
        self,
        *,
        actions_used: int | None = None,
        states_discovered: int | None = None,
        current_depth: int | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        if actions_used is not None:
            self.actions_used = int(actions_used)
        if states_discovered is not None:
            self.states_discovered = int(states_discovered)
        if current_depth is not None:
            self.current_depth = int(current_depth)

    def record_action(
        self,
        *,
        action_kind: str | None,
        action_key: str | None,
        action_label: str | None = None,
        state_id: str | None = None,
        next_state_id: str | None = None,
        success: bool = True,
        failure_reason: str | None = None,
        observation_id: str | None = None,
        result: str | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        entry = HistoryEntry(
            timestamp=_utcnow_iso(),
            state_id=state_id or self.current_state_id,
            action_kind=action_kind,
            action_key=action_key,
            action_label=action_label,
            result=result or ("ok" if success else "failed"),
            next_state_id=next_state_id,
            success=success,
            failure_reason=failure_reason,
            observation_id=observation_id
            or (self.current_observation.observation_id if self.current_observation else None),
        )
        self.history.append(entry)
        if len(self.history) > self._max_history:
            del self.history[: len(self.history) - self._max_history]
        self.bump_reliability("actions_attempted")
        if success:
            self.bump_reliability("actions_succeeded")
        else:
            self.bump_reliability("actions_failed")
        if not success and action_key:
            self.record_action_failure(
                action_key=action_key,
                action_kind=action_kind,
                state_id=state_id or self.current_state_id,
                reason=failure_reason or "action_failed",
            )

    def record_action_success(
        self,
        *,
        action_kind: str | None,
        action_key: str | None,
        action_label: str | None = None,
        state_id: str | None = None,
        next_state_id: str | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self.record_action(
            action_kind=action_kind,
            action_key=action_key,
            action_label=action_label,
            state_id=state_id,
            next_state_id=next_state_id,
            success=True,
        )

    def record_action_failure(
        self,
        *,
        action_key: str,
        action_kind: str | None = None,
        state_id: str | None = None,
        reason: str | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        for item in self.failed_actions:
            if item.action_key == action_key and item.state_id == state_id:
                item.attempt_count += 1
                item.reason = reason or item.reason
                item.timestamp = _utcnow_iso()
                return
        self.failed_actions.append(
            FailedActionRecord(
                action_key=action_key,
                action_kind=action_kind,
                state_id=state_id,
                reason=reason,
            )
        )
        if len(self.failed_actions) > 100:
            del self.failed_actions[: len(self.failed_actions) - 100]

    def record_state_transition(self, from_state_id: str, to_state_id: str) -> None:
        self.history.append(
            HistoryEntry(
                timestamp=_utcnow_iso(),
                state_id=from_state_id,
                action_kind="transition",
                result="state_change",
                next_state_id=to_state_id,
                success=True,
                observation_id=(
                    self.current_observation.observation_id
                    if self.current_observation
                    else None
                ),
            )
        )
        if len(self.history) > self._max_history:
            del self.history[: len(self.history) - self._max_history]

    def add_goal(
        self,
        goal_id: str,
        title: str,
        *,
        goal_type: str = "GENERAL_EXPLORATION",
        priority: int = 1,
        target_ad_type: str | None = None,
        status: GoalStatus = "active",
    ) -> AgentGoal:
        for goal in self.active_goals:
            if goal.id == goal_id:
                return goal
        goal = AgentGoal(
            id=goal_id,
            title=title,
            status=status,
            goal_type=goal_type,
            priority=priority,
            target_ad_type=target_ad_type,
        )
        self.active_goals.append(goal)
        return goal

    def active_goal(self) -> AgentGoal | None:
        """Highest-priority active goal (ad goals prefer lower priority number)."""
        active = [g for g in self.active_goals if g.status in {"active", "pending"}]
        if not active:
            return None
        return sorted(active, key=lambda g: (g.priority, g.id))[0]

    def complete_goal(self, goal_id: str, *, reason: str | None = None) -> None:
        remaining: list[AgentGoal] = []
        for goal in self.active_goals:
            if goal.id == goal_id:
                goal.status = "completed"
                goal.reason = reason
                self.completed_goals.append(goal)
            else:
                remaining.append(goal)
        self.active_goals = remaining

    def fail_goal(self, goal_id: str, *, reason: str | None = None) -> None:
        remaining: list[AgentGoal] = []
        for goal in self.active_goals:
            if goal.id == goal_id:
                goal.status = "failed"
                goal.reason = reason
                self.failed_goals.append(goal)
            else:
                remaining.append(goal)
        self.active_goals = remaining

    def record_ad(self, ad: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        if not ad or not ad.get("detected"):
            return
        # Deduplicate loosely by type+position+image_path.
        key = (
            ad.get("type"),
            ad.get("position"),
            ad.get("image_path") or ad.get("screenshot_id"),
        )
        for existing in self.discovered_ads:
            ek = (
                existing.get("type"),
                existing.get("position"),
                existing.get("image_path") or existing.get("screenshot_id"),
            )
            if ek == key:
                return
        payload = dict(ad)
        payload.pop("raw", None)
        self.discovered_ads.append(payload)

    def set_blocked(self, reason: str | None, *, hitl: dict[str, Any] | None = None) -> None:
        self.blocked = True
        self.blocked_reason = reason
        self.hitl_required = True
        if hitl is not None:
            self.hitl = dict(hitl)
        if self.status == AgentStatus.EXPLORING:
            self.status = AgentStatus.BLOCKED

    def clear_blocked(self) -> None:
        self.blocked = False
        self.blocked_reason = None
        self.hitl_required = False
        self.hitl = {"required": False}
        if self.status == AgentStatus.BLOCKED:
            self.status = AgentStatus.EXPLORING

    def mark_completed(self, *, reason: str | None = None) -> None:
        self.status = AgentStatus.COMPLETED
        self.stop_reason = reason
        self.clear_blocked()
        # Phase 12G: budget / exhaustion → mark remaining ad goals exhausted.
        budgetish = {
            "max_exploration_actions",
            "max_exploration_time",
            "target_meaningful_states_found",
            "budget_actions_exhausted",
            "budget_states_exhausted",
            "completed",
        }
        if reason in budgetish or (reason or "").startswith("budget_"):
            for goal in self.active_goals:
                if goal.goal_type == "AD_DISCOVERY" and goal.status in {"active", "pending"}:
                    if goal.status != "found":
                        goal.status = "exhausted"
                        goal.reason = reason or "exploration_exhausted"
                        self.bump_reliability("goals_exhausted")

    def mark_failed(self, *, reason: str | None = None) -> None:
        self.status = AgentStatus.FAILED
        self.stop_reason = reason

    def bump_reliability(self, key: str, amount: int = 1) -> None:
        """Increment a Phase 12H reliability counter (bounded keys only)."""
        if not self.reliability:
            self.reliability = {}
        if key not in self.reliability:
            self.reliability[key] = 0
        self.reliability[key] = int(self.reliability[key]) + int(amount)

    def record_recovery(
        self,
        *,
        decision: str,
        reason: str | None = None,
        action_id: str | None = None,
        action_key: str | None = None,
        state_id: str | None = None,
        attempt: int = 0,
    ) -> None:
        self.recovery_history.append(
            RecoveryRecord(
                timestamp=_utcnow_iso(),
                decision=decision,
                reason=reason,
                action_id=action_id,
                action_key=action_key,
                state_id=state_id or self.current_state_id,
                attempt=attempt,
            )
        )
        if len(self.recovery_history) > 100:
            del self.recovery_history[: len(self.recovery_history) - 100]
        # Phase 12H telemetry
        d = (decision or "").upper()
        if d == "RETRY":
            self.bump_reliability("retries")
        elif d == "BACKTRACK":
            self.bump_reliability("backtracks")
        elif d == "RELAUNCH":
            self.bump_reliability("relaunches")
        elif d == "PAUSE_HITL":
            self.bump_reliability("hitl_pauses")
        elif d == "WAIT":
            self.bump_reliability("waits")
        elif d == "SKIP":
            self.bump_reliability("skips")
        elif d == "STOP":
            self.bump_reliability("stops")

    def record_ai_decision(
        self,
        *,
        used: bool,
        meta: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
        planner_source: str | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        payload = dict(meta or {})
        source = planner_source or payload.get("planner_source")
        self.last_planner_source = source
        if used:
            self.ai_decision_count += 1
            self.last_ai_decision = {
                "key": payload.get("ai_key"),
                "reason": (payload.get("ai_reason") or "")[:200],
                "confidence": payload.get("ai_confidence"),
                "policy": payload.get("policy"),
                "planner_source": source or "AI",
            }
        else:
            if payload.get("fallback") or (source or "").startswith("DETERMINISTIC"):
                self.ai_fallback_count += 1
            if payload.get("ai_error") or payload.get("fallback"):
                self.bump_reliability("ai_failures")
            if payload:
                self.last_ai_decision = {
                    "ai_used": False,
                    "fallback": payload.get("fallback"),
                    "error": payload.get("ai_error") or payload.get("validation_error"),
                    "policy": payload.get("policy"),
                    "planner_source": source or "DETERMINISTIC",
                }

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Compact JSON-serializable summary (no ScreenStateRecord / image bytes)."""
        obs = self.current_observation
        return {
            "status": self.status.value if isinstance(self.status, AgentStatus) else str(self.status),
            "package_name": self.package_name,
            "job_id": self.job_id,
            "stop_reason": self.stop_reason,
            "current_observation_id": obs.observation_id if obs else None,
            "current_observation": obs.to_dict() if obs else None,
            "current_state_id": self.current_state_id,
            "current_activity": self.current_activity,
            "current_package": self.current_package,
            "current_depth": self.current_depth,
            "navigation": self.navigation_summary(),
            "discovered_screens": self.discovered_screens(),
            "discovered_ads": list(self.discovered_ads),
            "history": [h.to_dict() for h in self.history[-50:]],
            "history_count": len(self.history),
            "active_goals": [g.to_dict() for g in self.active_goals],
            "completed_goals": [g.to_dict() for g in self.completed_goals],
            "failed_goals": [g.to_dict() for g in self.failed_goals],
            "failed_actions": [f.to_dict() for f in self.failed_actions],
            "recovery_history": [r.to_dict() for r in self.recovery_history[-30:]],
            "blocked": self.blocked,
            "blocked_reason": self.blocked_reason,
            "hitl_required": self.hitl_required,
            "hitl": dict(self.hitl),
            "last_ai_decision": self.last_ai_decision,
            "ai_decision_count": self.ai_decision_count,
            "ai_fallback_count": self.ai_fallback_count,
            "last_planner_source": self.last_planner_source,
            "application_intelligence": (
                self.application_intelligence.to_ai_summary()
                if self.application_intelligence is not None
                and hasattr(self.application_intelligence, "to_ai_summary")
                else None
            ),
            "active_goal": (self.active_goal().to_dict() if self.active_goal() else None),
            "discovered_ad_placements": [
                d.to_dict() if hasattr(d, "to_dict") else d
                for d in self.discovered_ad_placements[-20:]
            ],
            "reliability": dict(self.reliability or {}),
            "budget": {
                "actions_used": self.actions_used,
                "max_actions": self.max_actions,
                "remaining_actions": self.remaining_actions,
                "states_discovered": self.states_discovered,
                "max_states": self.max_states,
                "remaining_states": self.remaining_states,
                "current_depth": self.current_depth,
                "max_depth": self.max_depth,
                "remaining_depth": self.remaining_depth,
            },
        }

================================================================================
FILE: backend/app/modules/exploration/apk_manager.py

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
import re
from pathlib import Path

from app.core.config import settings
from app.modules.exploration.adb import AndroidADB, CommandResult
from app.modules.exploration.errors import (
    ApkInstallError,
    ApkUninstallError,
    PackageNotFoundError,
)

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

_INSTALL_FAILURE = re.compile(r"(Failure|Error)\s*\[?([A-Z_0-9]+)?\]?", re.IGNORECASE)
_VERSION_NAME = re.compile(r"versionName=(\S+)")


class APKManager:
    """Installs and removes packages on a connected device."""

    def __init__(self, adb: AndroidADB) -> None:
        self.adb = adb

    # -- queries -------------------------------------------------------------

    def list_packages(self, *, third_party_only: bool = False) -> list[str]:
        flag = "-3" if third_party_only else ""
        result = self.adb.shell(f"pm list packages {flag}".strip(), timeout=60)
        names: list[str] = []
        for line in result.stdout.splitlines():
            line = line.strip()
            if line.startswith("package:"):
                names.append(line[len("package:") :].strip())
        return names

    def is_installed(self, package_name: str) -> bool:
        """Exact-match installation check.

        Uses `pm path`, which avoids the substring false positives that
        `pm list packages <name>` produces.
        """
        if not package_name:
            return False
        result = self.adb.shell(f"pm path {package_name}", timeout=30, check=False)
        if result.ok and "package:" in result.stdout:
            return True
        # Some images return exit 0 with empty output; fall back to an exact scan.
        listing = self.adb.shell(
            f"pm list packages {package_name}", timeout=30, check=False
        )
        if not listing.ok:
            return False
        return any(
            line.strip() == f"package:{package_name}"
            for line in listing.stdout.splitlines()
        )

    def version_name(self, package_name: str) -> str | None:
        result = self.adb.shell(f"dumpsys package {package_name}", timeout=45, check=False)
        if not result.ok:
            return None
        match = _VERSION_NAME.search(result.stdout)
        return match.group(1) if match else None

    def require_installed(self, package_name: str) -> None:
        if not self.is_installed(package_name):
            raise PackageNotFoundError(
                f"Package '{package_name}' is not installed on {self.adb.serial or 'the device'}."
            )

    # -- mutations -----------------------------------------------------------

    def install(
        self,
        apk_path: str | Path,
        *,
        reinstall: bool = True,
        grant_permissions: bool = True,
        allow_test: bool = True,
        allow_downgrade: bool = True,
        timeout: int | None = None,
    ) -> CommandResult:
        """Install an APK, raising with captured output on failure."""
        path = Path(apk_path)
        if not path.is_file():
            raise ApkInstallError(f"APK not found at {path}.")

        args = ["install"]
        if reinstall:
            args.append("-r")
        if allow_test:
            args.append("-t")
        if grant_permissions:
            args.append("-g")
        if allow_downgrade:
            args.append("-d")
        args.append(str(path))

        result = self.adb.run(
            args,
            timeout=timeout or settings.apk_install_timeout_seconds,
            check=False,
        )
        self._assert_install_ok(result, path)
        logger.info("Installed %s in %sms", path.name, result.duration_ms)
        return result

    def _assert_install_ok(self, result: CommandResult, path: Path) -> None:
        """`adb install` can exit 0 while reporting Failure, so inspect the text."""
        combined = result.output
        succeeded = result.ok and "success" in combined.lower()
        if succeeded:
            return
        match = _INSTALL_FAILURE.search(combined)
        reason = match.group(2) if match and match.group(2) else None
        hint = _INSTALL_HINTS.get(reason or "", "")
        message = f"Installing {path.name} failed"
        if reason:
            message += f" [{reason}]"
        if hint:
            message += f". {hint}"
        raise ApkInstallError(message).with_output(
            command=result.command, stdout=result.stdout, stderr=result.stderr
        )

    def ensure_installed(
        self,
        apk_path: str | Path,
        package_name: str | None = None,
        *,
        force_reinstall: bool = False,
    ) -> bool:
        """Install only when needed. Returns True if an install was performed."""
        if package_name and not force_reinstall and self.is_installed(package_name):
            logger.info("Package %s is already installed; skipping install.", package_name)
            return False
        self.install(apk_path)
        if package_name:
            self.require_installed(package_name)
        return True

    def uninstall(self, package_name: str, *, keep_data: bool = False) -> CommandResult:
        args = ["uninstall"]
        if keep_data:
            args.append("-k")
        args.append(package_name)
        result = self.adb.run(args, timeout=120, check=False)
        if not (result.ok and "success" in result.output.lower()):
            raise ApkUninstallError(
                f"Uninstalling {package_name} failed."
            ).with_output(command=result.command, stdout=result.stdout, stderr=result.stderr)
        return result

    def clear_data(self, package_name: str) -> CommandResult:
        """Reset the app to a first-run state without reinstalling."""
        result = self.adb.shell(f"pm clear {package_name}", timeout=90, check=False)
        if not (result.ok and "success" in result.output.lower()):
            raise ApkInstallError(
                f"Clearing data for {package_name} failed."
            ).with_output(command=result.command, stdout=result.stdout, stderr=result.stderr)
        return result


_INSTALL_HINTS = {
    "INSTALL_FAILED_NO_MATCHING_ABIS": "The APK has native libraries incompatible with the emulator ABI; use an x86_64 system image.",
    "INSTALL_FAILED_OLDER_SDK": "The APK's minSdkVersion is higher than the emulator's Android version.",
    "INSTALL_FAILED_INSUFFICIENT_STORAGE": "The emulator is out of disk space; increase the AVD data partition.",
    "INSTALL_FAILED_UPDATE_INCOMPATIBLE": "A build with a different signature is installed; uninstall it first.",
    "INSTALL_FAILED_VERSION_DOWNGRADE": "A newer version is installed; uninstall it or install with -d.",
    "INSTALL_PARSE_FAILED_NO_CERTIFICATES": "The APK is unsigned.",
    "INSTALL_FAILED_INVALID_APK": "The APK is malformed, or it is a split/AAB rather than a standalone APK.",
}

================================================================================
FILE: backend/app/modules/exploration/blueprint.py
================================================================================
"""Deterministic Exploration Blueprint mined from static APK analysis.

Builds a *per-upload* navigation map from activity/SDK names — no hardcoded
app domains (alarm/timer/etc.). Feature tokens come from *this* APK's
activity short names. Optional LLM enricher turns the map into a human-like
ordered journey (onboard → create → home → sidebar → settings → ads).
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import re
from typing import Any

from app.schemas.exploration import (
    AdType,
    ExplorationBlueprint,
    ExplorationCoverage,
    ExplorationGoal,
    GoalCoverageItem,
    GoalKind,
    NavigationStep,
)

_CAMEL_SPLIT = re.compile(r"(?<!^)(?=[A-Z])")
_NOISE = {
    "activity",
    "fragment",
    "screen",
    "main",
    "launcher",
    "splash",
    "app",
    "base",
    "ui",
    "view",
    "page",
    "com",
    "android",
}

# Generic UI verbs — NOT product domains (no alarm/timer/shopping hardcoding).
_CREATE_RX = re.compile(
    r"\b(create|add|new|edit|compose|writer|editor|form)\b|"
    r"(^|[^a-z])(set)(?!tings)([A-Z_]|$)",
    re.I,
)
_SETTINGS_RX = re.compile(r"settings|preference|option|config", re.I)
_ONBOARD_RX = re.compile(
    r"onboard|welcome|intro|tutorial|consent|gdpr|permission|login|signin|sign_in",
    re.I,
)
_HOME_RX = re.compile(r"\b(home|dashboard|main|launcherhome)\b", re.I)
_MENU_RX = re.compile(r"\b(menu|drawer|sidebar|navigation|navdrawer)\b", re.I)
_CREATE_VERBS = {"create", "add", "new", "edit", "compose", "set", "make", "write"}

# Static SDK name → expected runtime ad types.
_AD_SDK_EXPECTATIONS: dict[str, tuple[AdType, ...]] = {
    "google admob": ("banner", "interstitial", "rewarded", "native", "app_open"),
    "facebook audience network": ("banner", "interstitial", "native", "rewarded"),
    "ironsource": ("banner", "interstitial", "rewarded"),
    "unity ads": ("banner", "interstitial", "rewarded"),
    "applovin": ("banner", "interstitial", "rewarded", "native"),
    "vungle": ("interstitial", "rewarded"),
    "chartboost": ("interstitial", "rewarded"),
}

_REWARDED_SDKS = {"ironsource", "unity ads", "applovin", "vungle", "chartboost", "google admob"}

_DEFAULT_AD_TRIGGERS = (
    "watch",
    "reward",
    "video",
    "earn",
    "unlock",
    "claim",
    "bonus",
    "free coin",
)

_SIDEBAR_LABELS = (
    "menu",
    "drawer",
    "navigation",
    "open navigation",
    "sidebar",
    "hamburger",
)

# Human-like journey order (lower first).
_KIND_STEP_ORDER: dict[str, int] = {
    "onboarding": 10,
    "create": 20,
    "home": 30,
    "sidebar": 40,
    "destination": 50,
    "feature": 55,
    "settings": 60,
    "ad_trigger": 70,
}


def _as_dict(value: Any) -> dict:
    if hasattr(value, "model_dump"):
        return value.model_dump()
    return value if isinstance(value, dict) else {}


def _activity_short(name: str) -> str:
    return name.rsplit(".", 1)[-1] if name else ""


def _tokens(name: str) -> list[str]:
    short = re.sub(
        r"(Activity|Fragment|Screen|Page)$",
        "",
        _activity_short(name),
        flags=re.IGNORECASE,
    )
    parts = _CAMEL_SPLIT.sub(" ", short).replace("_", " ").replace("-", " ").split()
    out: list[str] = []
    for part in parts:
        token = part.strip().lower()
        if len(token) >= 3 and token not in _NOISE:
            out.append(token)
    return out


def _uniq(items: list[str]) -> list[str]:
    seen: set[str] = set()
    ordered: list[str] = []
    for item in items:
        key = (item or "").strip().lower()
        if not key or key in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(key)
        ordered.append(key)
    return ordered


def _feature_slug(tokens: list[str]) -> str:
    """Derive feature name from *this* APK's tokens (not a fixed domain list)."""
    rest = [t for t in tokens if t not in _CREATE_VERBS and t not in _NOISE]
    if not rest:
        return "item"
    return "_".join(rest[:2])[:32]


def _build_nav_path(goals: list[ExplorationGoal]) -> list[NavigationStep]:
    ordered = sorted(goals, key=lambda g: (g.step_order, -g.priority, g.id))
    return [
        NavigationStep(goal_id=g.id, order=i, summary=g.title)
        for i, g in enumerate(ordered)
    ]


def mine_blueprint(analysis: Any) -> ExplorationBlueprint:
    """Build a deterministic per-app blueprint from AnalysisResponse / data dict."""
    payload = _as_dict(analysis)
    data = _as_dict(payload.get("data")) or payload
    apk = _as_dict(data.get("apk"))
    manifest = _as_dict(data.get("manifest"))
    package = apk.get("package_name") or manifest.get("package") or data.get("package_name")
    app_label = manifest.get("app_label") or apk.get("file_name")

    activities_raw = data.get("activities") or []
    activity_names: list[str] = []
    for raw in activities_raw:
        entry = _as_dict(raw)
        name = entry.get("name")
        if name and entry.get("enabled") is not False:
            activity_names.append(str(name))

    code = _as_dict(data.get("code_analysis"))
    sdk_usage = code.get("third_party_sdk_usage") or []
    sdk_names: list[str] = []
    for item in sdk_usage:
        entry = _as_dict(item) if not isinstance(item, str) else {"name": item}
        name = entry.get("name") or entry.get("sdk") or entry.get("package")
        if name:
            sdk_names.append(str(name))

    # Richer static: app class simple names act like extra "pages" (no domain lists).
    for raw_cls in code.get("classes") or []:
        entry = _as_dict(raw_cls) if not isinstance(raw_cls, str) else {"name": raw_cls}
        if entry.get("is_app_code") is False:
            continue
        cname = str(entry.get("name") or "")
        if not cname:
            continue
        short = _activity_short(cname)
        lowered = short.lower()
        if any(
            token in lowered
            for token in (
                "activity",
                "fragment",
                "screen",
                "page",
                "menu",
                "drawer",
                "setting",
                "create",
                "edit",
                "compose",
                "home",
                "main",
            )
        ):
            # Synthetic activity path so token mining can see it.
            synthetic = cname if "." in cname else f"{package or 'app'}.{short}"
            if synthetic not in activity_names:
                activity_names.append(synthetic)

    # Path-like tokens from network_strings → preferred labels / destinations (generic).
    route_tokens: list[str] = []
    for item in code.get("network_strings") or []:
        entry = _as_dict(item) if not isinstance(item, str) else {"value": item}
        value = str(entry.get("value") or entry.get("string") or "")
        if not value or len(value) > 120:
            continue
        if "://" in value:
            # Keep path segments after host only.
            value = value.split("://", 1)[-1]
            if "/" in value:
                value = value.split("/", 1)[-1]
            else:
                continue
        for part in re.split(r"[/\-_?&=]+", value):
            token = part.strip().lower()
            if (
                4 <= len(token) <= 24
                and token.isalpha()
                and token not in _NOISE
                and token not in {"http", "https", "www", "api", "com", "json"}
            ):
                route_tokens.append(token)

    ad_sdk_names: list[str] = []
    ad_expectations: list[AdType] = []
    seen_types: set[str] = set()
    for name in sdk_names:
        key = name.lower()
        for sdk_key, types in _AD_SDK_EXPECTATIONS.items():
            if sdk_key in key or key in sdk_key:
                ad_sdk_names.append(name)
                for ad_type in types:
                    if ad_type not in seen_types:
                        seen_types.add(ad_type)
                        ad_expectations.append(ad_type)
                break

    goals: list[ExplorationGoal] = []
    preferred: list[str] = ["add", "create", "new", "save", "home", "menu", "settings"]
    goal_ids: set[str] = set()
    feature_words: list[str] = []

    def _add_goal(goal: ExplorationGoal) -> None:
        if goal.id in goal_ids:
            return
        goal_ids.add(goal.id)
        if goal.step_order == 50 and goal.kind in _KIND_STEP_ORDER:
            goal.step_order = _KIND_STEP_ORDER[goal.kind]
        goals.append(goal)
        preferred.extend(goal.ui_labels)

    for name in activity_names:
        short = _activity_short(name)
        tokens = _tokens(name)
        blob = f"{short} {' '.join(tokens)}"
        if "splash" in blob.lower():
            continue
        feature_words.extend(tokens)

        if _ONBOARD_RX.search(blob):
            _add_goal(
                ExplorationGoal(
                    id=f"onboard_{'_'.join(tokens[:2]) or short.lower()}"[:40],
                    kind="onboarding",
                    title=f"Complete onboarding ({short})",
                    activity_hints=[short, name],
                    ui_labels=_uniq(
                        ["continue", "next", "agree", "allow", "get started", "skip"] + tokens[:4]
                    ),
                    priority=95,
                    step_order=_KIND_STEP_ORDER["onboarding"],
                    why=f"Activity {short} suggests onboarding/consent",
                )
            )
        elif _CREATE_RX.search(blob):
            slug = _feature_slug(tokens)
            labels = _uniq(["create", "add", "new", "save", "done", "ok"] + tokens[:6])
            _add_goal(
                ExplorationGoal(
                    id=f"create_{slug}",
                    kind="create",
                    title=f"Create / set up ({slug.replace('_', ' ')})",
                    activity_hints=[short, name],
                    ui_labels=labels,
                    priority=90,
                    step_order=_KIND_STEP_ORDER["create"],
                    why=f"Activity {short} suggests a create/edit flow for this app",
                )
            )
        elif _SETTINGS_RX.search(blob):
            _add_goal(
                ExplorationGoal(
                    id="settings",
                    kind="settings",
                    title="Open Settings",
                    activity_hints=[short, name],
                    ui_labels=_uniq(["settings", "preference", "options"] + tokens[:3]),
                    expected_ad_types=["banner"] if ad_expectations else [],
                    priority=55,
                    step_order=_KIND_STEP_ORDER["settings"],
                    why=f"Activity {short} looks like settings",
                )
            )
        elif _MENU_RX.search(blob):
            _add_goal(
                ExplorationGoal(
                    id="sidebar_menu",
                    kind="sidebar",
                    title="Open navigation drawer / sidebar",
                    activity_hints=[short, name],
                    ui_labels=_uniq(list(_SIDEBAR_LABELS) + tokens[:3]),
                    priority=70,
                    step_order=_KIND_STEP_ORDER["sidebar"],
                    why=f"Activity {short} suggests drawer/menu navigation",
                )
            )
        elif _HOME_RX.search(blob):
            _add_goal(
                ExplorationGoal(
                    id="home",
                    kind="home",
                    title="Return to / explore home",
                    activity_hints=[short, name],
                    ui_labels=_uniq(["home", "main", "dashboard"] + tokens[:3]),
                    expected_ad_types=["banner"] if "banner" in seen_types else [],
                    priority=75,
                    step_order=_KIND_STEP_ORDER["home"],
                    why=f"Activity {short} looks like home/main",
                )
            )
        elif tokens:
            gid = f"dest_{'_'.join(tokens[:2])}"[:40]
            _add_goal(
                ExplorationGoal(
                    id=gid,
                    kind="destination",
                    title=f"Explore {short}",
                    activity_hints=[short, name],
                    ui_labels=_uniq(tokens[:6]),
                    priority=45,
                    step_order=_KIND_STEP_ORDER["destination"],
                    why=f"Manifest activity {short} — visit this section",
                )
            )

    # Always plan to open the drawer/sidebar if the app has multiple destinations.
    dest_count = sum(1 for g in goals if g.kind in {"destination", "settings", "feature", "home"})
    if "sidebar_menu" not in goal_ids and dest_count >= 1:
        _add_goal(
            ExplorationGoal(
                id="sidebar_menu",
                kind="sidebar",
                title="Open sidebar / menu and explore each section",
                ui_labels=list(_SIDEBAR_LABELS),
                priority=70,
                step_order=_KIND_STEP_ORDER["sidebar"],
                why="Multi-section app — explore drawer/menu like a human",
            )
        )

    # Route tokens from static strings → soft destination hints (this APK only).
    for token in _uniq(route_tokens)[:6]:
        gid = f"dest_{token}"[:40]
        if gid in goal_ids:
            continue
        _add_goal(
            ExplorationGoal(
                id=gid,
                kind="destination",
                title=f"Explore '{token}' (from static strings)",
                ui_labels=[token],
                priority=40,
                step_order=_KIND_STEP_ORDER["destination"],
                why=f"Static string/path token '{token}' in this APK",
            )
        )
        preferred.append(token)

    if "home" not in goal_ids:
        _add_goal(
            ExplorationGoal(
                id="home",
                kind="home",
                title="Reach home / main screen",
                ui_labels=["home", "main"],
                expected_ad_types=["banner"] if "banner" in seen_types else [],
                priority=75,
                step_order=_KIND_STEP_ORDER["home"],
                why="Always return to home between sections when possible",
            )
        )

    needs_rewarded = any(t in seen_types for t in ("rewarded", "interstitial"))
    if needs_rewarded or any(any(s in n.lower() for s in _REWARDED_SDKS) for n in ad_sdk_names):
        _add_goal(
            ExplorationGoal(
                id="ad_triggers",
                kind="ad_trigger",
                title="Trigger rewarded / interstitial ads",
                ui_labels=list(_DEFAULT_AD_TRIGGERS),
                expected_ad_types=[t for t in ("rewarded", "interstitial") if t in seen_types]
                or ["rewarded"],
                priority=50,
                step_order=_KIND_STEP_ORDER["ad_trigger"],
                why="Ad SDK present — visit pages/actions that show ads after core flows",
            )
        )

    if ad_expectations:
        _add_goal(
            ExplorationGoal(
                id="ad_surfaces",
                kind="feature",
                title="Visit pages likely to show ads",
                ui_labels=_uniq(["home", "settings", "main"] + list(_SIDEBAR_LABELS)[:3]),
                expected_ad_types=list(ad_expectations[:4]),
                priority=48,
                step_order=65,
                why="Ad SDK present — cover main chrome after create/home/sidebar",
            )
        )

    # App summary from package/label + distinctive activity tokens (no domain hardcoding).
    distinctive = _uniq([t for t in feature_words if t not in _CREATE_VERBS])[:8]
    summary_bits = []
    if app_label:
        summary_bits.append(str(app_label))
    if package:
        summary_bits.append(str(package))
    if distinctive:
        summary_bits.append("features: " + ", ".join(distinctive))
    if ad_sdk_names:
        summary_bits.append("ads: " + ", ".join(_uniq(ad_sdk_names)[:4]))

    ad_trigger_labels = list(_DEFAULT_AD_TRIGGERS) if needs_rewarded else []
    preferred_labels = _uniq(preferred + list(_SIDEBAR_LABELS) + list(ad_trigger_labels))
    nav_path = _build_nav_path(goals)
    goals.sort(key=lambda g: (g.step_order, -g.priority, g.id))

    return ExplorationBlueprint(
        package_name=str(package) if package else None,
        app_summary="; ".join(summary_bits) if summary_bits else None,
        goals=goals,
        nav_path=nav_path,
        ad_expectations=ad_expectations,
        ad_sdk_names=_uniq(ad_sdk_names),
        preferred_labels=preferred_labels,
        ad_trigger_labels=ad_trigger_labels,
        source="deterministic",
    )


def apply_blueprint_to_prior(prior: Any, blueprint: ExplorationBlueprint) -> None:
    """Merge blueprint labels/goals/nav_path onto an ExplorationPrior in place."""
    if prior is None or blueprint is None:
        return
    prior.goals = [g.model_dump() for g in blueprint.goals]
    prior.ad_expectations = list(blueprint.ad_expectations)
    prior.ad_trigger_labels = list(blueprint.ad_trigger_labels)
    prior.nav_path = [s.model_dump() for s in blueprint.nav_path]
    prior.blueprint = blueprint.model_dump()
    merged = _uniq(list(blueprint.preferred_labels) + list(prior.preferred_labels or []))
    prior.preferred_labels = merged
    extras = dict(prior.extras or {})
    extras["blueprint_source"] = blueprint.source
    extras["ad_sdk_names"] = list(blueprint.ad_sdk_names)
    extras["app_summary"] = blueprint.app_summary
    prior.extras = extras


def build_coverage(
    blueprint: ExplorationBlueprint | dict[str, Any] | None,
    *,
    covered_goal_ids: set[str] | dict[str, list[str]] | None = None,
    ad_types_found: list[str] | None = None,
) -> ExplorationCoverage:
    """Summarize goal / ad-type coverage for the job result."""
    if blueprint is None:
        return ExplorationCoverage()
    if isinstance(blueprint, dict):
        bp = ExplorationBlueprint.model_validate(blueprint)
    else:
        bp = blueprint

    evidence_map: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
    covered_set: set[str] = set()
    if isinstance(covered_goal_ids, dict):
        evidence_map = {k: list(v) for k, v in covered_goal_ids.items()}
        covered_set = set(evidence_map)
    elif covered_goal_ids:
        covered_set = set(covered_goal_ids)

    found = _uniq([str(t) for t in (ad_types_found or []) if t and t != "unknown"])
    expected = [str(t) for t in bp.ad_expectations]
    missing = [t for t in expected if t not in found]

    items: list[GoalCoverageItem] = []
    for goal in bp.goals:
        covered = goal.id in covered_set or goal.covered
        items.append(
            GoalCoverageItem(
                goal_id=goal.id,
                title=goal.title,
                kind=goal.kind,
                covered=covered,
                evidence=evidence_map.get(goal.id, []),
            )
        )
    covered_count = sum(1 for item in items if item.covered)
    return ExplorationCoverage(
        goals=items,
        ad_types_expected=expected,
        ad_types_found=found,
        ad_types_missing=missing,
        goals_covered=covered_count,
        goals_total=len(items),
    )


def match_goals_for_screen(
    goals: list[dict[str, Any]] | list[ExplorationGoal],
    *,
    activity: str | None,
    ui_blob: str = "",
    action_kind: str | None = None,
    last_label: str | None = None,
    screen_role: str | None = None,
) -> list[str]:
    """Return goal ids that appear matched by current activity / UI text.

    Kind-based strictness (domain-agnostic):
    - create: needs create/edit activity OR (save/done/create submit evidence)
    - sidebar: needs drawer-open evidence (not bare 'menu')
    - destination/feature: label or activity hint
    """
    matched: list[str] = []
    act = (activity or "").lower()
    blob = f"{act} {ui_blob}".lower()
    last = (last_label or "").lower()
    action = (action_kind or "").lower()
    role = (screen_role or "").lower()

    for raw in goals:
        goal = raw if isinstance(raw, ExplorationGoal) else ExplorationGoal.model_validate(raw)
        hit = False
        activity_hit = False
        for hint in goal.activity_hints:
            if hint and hint.lower() in act:
                activity_hit = True
                hit = True
                break

        if goal.kind == "create":
            submit_evidence = any(
                token in blob or token in last
                for token in ("save", "done", "create", "submit")
            )
            # Strict: create/edit activity with submit chrome, or explicit Save/Done tap.
            if activity_hit and (submit_evidence or "create" in act or "edit" in act):
                hit = True
            elif ("save" in last or "done" in last) and (
                activity_hit
                or any(
                    lab.lower() in blob
                    for lab in goal.ui_labels
                    if lab and lab.lower() not in {"new", "add", "ok", "item"}
                )
            ):
                hit = True
            else:
                hit = False

        elif goal.kind == "sidebar":
            hit = False
            if role == "drawer_open" or any(
                token in blob
                for token in (
                    "drawer",
                    "navigation drawer",
                    "nav_drawer",
                    "nav_view",
                    "sidebar",
                    "open_menu",
                )
            ):
                hit = True
            if action == "open_menu":
                hit = True

        elif goal.kind == "onboarding":
            if activity_hit:
                hit = True
            elif any(
                lab and len(lab) >= 3 and lab.lower() in blob
                for lab in goal.ui_labels
            ) and any(t in blob for t in ("continue", "next", "agree", "allow", "started")):
                hit = True

        elif goal.kind == "home":
            if activity_hit or role == "home":
                hit = True
            elif "home" in blob and (
                action == "tap" or "home" in last or "main" in act
            ):
                hit = True
            else:
                hit = activity_hit

        elif goal.kind == "settings":
            if activity_hit or "setting" in act:
                hit = True
            elif "setting" in last or (
                "setting" in blob and action == "tap"
            ):
                hit = True
            else:
                hit = False

        elif goal.kind in {"destination", "feature"}:
            hit = activity_hit
            if not hit:
                for label in goal.ui_labels:
                    if label and len(label) >= 3 and label.lower() in blob:
                        hit = True
                        break
            # Section goals: require the section label itself, not weak substrings.
            if goal.id.startswith("section_") and not activity_hit:
                hit = any(
                    lab and len(lab) >= 2 and lab.lower() in (last or blob)
                    for lab in goal.ui_labels
                )

        elif goal.kind == "ad_trigger":
            hit = any(
                lab and len(lab) >= 3 and lab.lower() in blob for lab in goal.ui_labels
            )

        elif not hit and goal.kind != "sidebar":
            for label in goal.ui_labels:
                if label and len(label) >= 3 and label.lower() in blob:
                    hit = True
                    break

        if hit:
            matched.append(goal.id)
    return matched


def tag_ad_placement(
    placement: Any,
    *,
    blueprint: ExplorationBlueprint | dict[str, Any] | None,
    activity: str | None = None,
) -> None:
    """Annotate an AdPlacement (model or dict-like) with blueprint expectations."""
    if placement is None or blueprint is None:
        return
    bp = (
        ExplorationBlueprint.model_validate(blueprint)
        if isinstance(blueprint, dict)
        else blueprint
    )
    ad_type = getattr(placement, "ad_type", None)
    if ad_type is None and isinstance(placement, dict):
        ad_type = placement.get("ad_type")
    ad_type_s = str(ad_type or "unknown")
    expected = ad_type_s in {str(t) for t in bp.ad_expectations}
    matched: list[str] = []
    for goal in bp.goals:
        if ad_type_s in {str(t) for t in goal.expected_ad_types}:
            matched.append(goal.id)
        elif goal.kind == "ad_trigger" and ad_type_s in {"rewarded", "interstitial"}:
            matched.append(goal.id)
        elif goal.kind in {"settings", "destination", "feature", "home", "sidebar"} and ad_type_s == "banner":
            if any(
                h and activity and h.lower() in activity.lower()
                for h in goal.activity_hints
            ) or goal.kind in {"home", "sidebar", "feature"}:
                matched.append(goal.id)
    matched = _uniq(matched)
    if hasattr(placement, "expected_from_sdk"):
        placement.expected_from_sdk = expected
        placement.matched_goals = matched
    elif isinstance(placement, dict):
        placement["expected_from_sdk"] = expected
        placement["matched_goals"] = matched

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import time
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from functools import lru_cache
from pathlib import Path

from app.core.config import settings
from app.modules.exploration.adb import AndroidADB, _sdk_roots
from app.modules.exploration.errors import (
    AvdNotFoundError,
    EmulatorBootTimeoutError,
    EmulatorStartError,
    EmulatorStopError,
    EmulatorUnavailableError,
)

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

_EMULATOR_NAMES = ("emulator.exe", "emulator") if os.name == "nt" else ("emulator", "emulator.exe")

BOOT_POLL_SECONDS = 3
STOP_POLL_SECONDS = 1


@lru_cache(maxsize=1)
def find_emulator() -> str | None:
    """Locate the emulator binary from EMULATOR_PATH, PATH, then the SDK layout."""
    configured = (settings.emulator_path or "").strip()
    if configured:
        candidate = Path(configured)
        if candidate.is_file():
            return str(candidate)
        logger.warning("EMULATOR_PATH=%s does not point to a file; falling back.", configured)
    for name in _EMULATOR_NAMES:
        found = shutil.which(name)
        if found:
            return found
    for root in _sdk_roots():
        for relative in ("emulator", "tools"):
            for name in _EMULATOR_NAMES:
                candidate = root / relative / name
                if candidate.is_file():
                    return str(candidate)
    return None


def emulator_available() -> bool:
    return find_emulator() is not None


def _log_dir() -> Path:
    path = Path(settings.temp_root) / "emulator"
    path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    return path


def _detached_flags() -> int:
    """Keep the emulator alive independently of the worker process."""
    if os.name != "nt":
        return 0
    new_group = getattr(subprocess, "CREATE_NEW_PROCESS_GROUP", 0)
    detached = getattr(subprocess, "DETACHED_PROCESS", 0)
    return new_group | detached


class EmulatorManager:
    """Owns the Android emulator lifecycle: detect, start, wait, stop, reset.

    Intended to run inside the analysis worker, never inside an HTTP request:
    booting an emulator takes minutes.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        adb: AndroidADB | None = None,
        avd_name: str | None = None,
        emulator_binary: str | None = None,
        preferred_serial: str | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self.preferred_serial = (preferred_serial or "").strip() or None
        self.adb = adb or AndroidADB(serial=self.preferred_serial)
        self.avd_name = (avd_name or settings.avd_name or "").strip() or None
        self._binary = emulator_binary
        self._process: subprocess.Popen | None = None
        self._serial: str | None = self.preferred_serial
        self._started_by_us = False
        self._log_path: Path | None = None

    # -- discovery -----------------------------------------------------------

    @property
    def binary(self) -> str:
        if self._binary:
            return self._binary
        found = find_emulator()
        if found is None:
            raise EmulatorUnavailableError(
                "The Android emulator binary was not found. Set EMULATOR_PATH or "
                "ANDROID_SDK_ROOT (expected <sdk>/emulator/emulator)."
            )
        self._binary = found
        return found

    @property
    def serial(self) -> str | None:
        return self._serial

    @property
    def started_by_us(self) -> bool:
        return self._started_by_us

    def list_avds(self) -> list[str]:
        """Return configured AVD names via `emulator -list-avds`."""
        from app.modules.exploration.adb import _default_runner

        result = _default_runner([self.binary, "-list-avds"], 60)
        if not result.ok:
            raise EmulatorStartError(
                result.fail_message("emulator -list-avds failed")
            ).with_output(command=result.command, stdout=result.stdout, stderr=result.stderr)
        names: list[str] = []
        for line in result.stdout.splitlines():
            name = line.strip()
            # The emulator prints incidental warnings to stdout on some builds.
            if name and not name.startswith(("INFO", "WARNING", "ERROR", "handleCpuAcceleration")):
                names.append(name)
        return names

    def resolve_avd(self, avd_name: str | None = None) -> str:
        """Pick and validate the AVD to boot."""
        wanted = (avd_name or self.avd_name or "").strip()
        available = self.list_avds()
        if not available:
            raise AvdNotFoundError(
                "No AVDs are defined. Create one with avdmanager, e.g. "
                "`avdmanager create avd -n androguard -k \"system-images;android-34;google_apis;x86_64\"`."
            )
        if not wanted:
            if len(available) == 1:
                return available[0]
            raise AvdNotFoundError(
                "AVD_NAME is not set and multiple AVDs exist: " + ", ".join(available)
            )
        for name in available:
            if name.lower() == wanted.lower():
                return name
        raise AvdNotFoundError(
            f"AVD '{wanted}' does not exist. Available: {', '.join(available)}"
        )

    # -- state ---------------------------------------------------------------

    def running_serial(self) -> str | None:
        """Serial of a booted emulator matching our AVD, if any."""
        candidates = [item for item in self.adb.devices() if item.is_emulator and item.is_ready]
        if not candidates:
            return None
        if self.avd_name:
            for item in candidates:
                name = self.adb.for_serial(item.serial).avd_name()
                if name and name.lower() == self.avd_name.lower():
                    return item.serial
            # An emulator is up but not the requested AVD; reuse it only if unnamed.
        return candidates[0].serial

    def is_running(self) -> bool:
        return self.running_serial() is not None

    # -- lifecycle -----------------------------------------------------------

    def start(self, avd_name: str | None = None, *, wait: bool = True) -> str:
        """Start the AVD unless a suitable emulator is already running.

        Idempotent: an existing emulator is reused and will not be stopped by
        :meth:`stop` unless ``force=True``.
        """
        existing = self.running_serial()
        if existing:
            logger.info("Reusing running emulator %s", existing)
            self._serial = existing
            self._started_by_us = False
            return existing

        resolved = self.resolve_avd(avd_name)
        known = {item.serial for item in self.adb.devices()}
        args = self._build_args(resolved)
        stamp = datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%S")
        self._log_path = _log_dir() / f"{resolved}-{stamp}.log"

        logger.info("Starting emulator AVD=%s: %s", resolved, " ".join(args))
        try:
            handle = self._log_path.open("wb")
        except OSError as exc:
            raise EmulatorStartError(f"Could not open emulator log file: {exc}") from exc
        try:
            self._process = subprocess.Popen(
                args,
                stdout=handle,
                stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
                stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                cwd=str(Path(self.binary).parent),
                creationflags=_detached_flags(),
                close_fds=True,
            )
        except OSError as exc:
            handle.close()
            raise EmulatorStartError(f"Could not launch the emulator: {exc}") from exc
        finally:
            # The child keeps its own descriptor; the parent does not need ours.
            handle.close()

        self._started_by_us = True
        self.adb.start_server()
        if not wait:
            return ""
        return self.wait_until_ready(known_serials=known)

    def _build_args(self, avd: str) -> list[str]:
        args = [self.binary, "-avd", avd, "-no-boot-anim", "-no-snapshot-save"]
        if settings.emulator_headless:
            args.append("-no-window")
        if settings.emulator_cold_boot:
            args.append("-no-snapshot-load")
        if settings.emulator_wipe_data:
            args.append("-wipe-data")
        gpu = (settings.emulator_gpu_mode or "").strip()
        if gpu:
            args += ["-gpu", gpu]
        args += ["-netdelay", "none", "-netspeed", "full"]
        extra = (settings.emulator_extra_args or "").strip()
        if extra:
            args += extra.split()
        return args

    def wait_until_ready(
        self,
        *,
        timeout: int | None = None,
        known_serials: set[str] | None = None,
    ) -> str:
        """Block until Android has fully booted, then return the serial.

        Readiness requires three signals, not just device presence:
        ``sys.boot_completed``, a stopped boot animation, and a responsive
        package manager (needed before any install can succeed).
        """
        limit = timeout or settings.emulator_boot_timeout_seconds
        deadline = time.monotonic() + limit
        previous = known_serials or set()
        serial = self._serial
        last_state = "waiting for device"

        while time.monotonic() < deadline:
            self._assert_process_alive()

            if serial is None:
                for item in self.adb.devices():
                    if item.is_emulator and (item.serial not in previous or item.is_ready):
                        serial = item.serial
                        break
            if serial is not None:
                device = self.adb.for_serial(serial)
                if not device.is_boot_completed():
                    last_state = "sys.boot_completed != 1"
                elif not device.is_boot_animation_stopped():
                    last_state = "boot animation still running"
                elif not device.is_package_manager_ready():
                    last_state = "package manager not responding"
                else:
                    self._serial = serial
                    self.adb.serial = serial
                    logger.info("Emulator %s is ready.", serial)
                    return serial
            time.sleep(BOOT_POLL_SECONDS)

        raise EmulatorBootTimeoutError(
            f"Emulator did not become ready within {limit}s (last state: {last_state})."
        ).with_output(command="emulator boot", stderr=self._log_tail())

    def _assert_process_alive(self) -> None:
        if self._process is None:
            return
        code = self._process.poll()
        if code is not None:
            raise EmulatorStartError(
                f"The emulator process exited early with code {code}."
            ).with_output(command="emulator", stderr=self._log_tail())

    def _log_tail(self, limit: int = 4000) -> str:
        if self._log_path is None or not self._log_path.is_file():
            return ""
        try:
            return self._log_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")[-limit:]
        except OSError:
            return ""

    def ensure_ready(self, avd_name: str | None = None) -> str:
        """Reuse a running emulator or boot one, returning a ready serial."""
        if self.preferred_serial:
            serial = self.preferred_serial
            self._serial = serial
            self.adb.serial = serial
            device = self.adb.for_serial(serial)
            # If the preferred device is already online, wait until ready.
            online = {item.serial for item in self.adb.devices()}
            if serial in online:
                if device.is_boot_completed() and device.is_package_manager_ready():
                    return serial
                return self.wait_until_ready()
            # Preferred serial not online yet — start AVD then bind to it.
            return self.start(avd_name)

        existing = self.running_serial()
        if existing:
            self._serial = existing
            self.adb.serial = existing
            device = self.adb.for_serial(existing)
            if device.is_boot_completed() and device.is_package_manager_ready():
                return existing
            return self.wait_until_ready()
        return self.start(avd_name)

    def stop(self, *, force: bool = False) -> bool:
        """Shut down the emulator. Returns True when a shutdown was issued.

        By default only an emulator this manager started is stopped, so a
        developer's manually launched emulator survives. Pass ``force=True``
        to override.
        """
        if self._serial is None:
            return False
        if not self._started_by_us and not force:
            logger.info("Leaving emulator %s running (not started by us).", self._serial)
            return False

        serial = self._serial
        logger.info("Stopping emulator %s", serial)
        result = self.adb.for_serial(serial).emu_kill()
        if not result.ok:
            logger.warning("adb emu kill failed: %s", result.fail_message("emu kill"))

        deadline = time.monotonic() + 45
        while time.monotonic() < deadline:
            if all(item.serial != serial for item in self.adb.devices()):
                self._finalize_stop()
                return True
            time.sleep(STOP_POLL_SECONDS)

        if self._process is not None and self._process.poll() is None:
            logger.warning("Emulator %s did not exit; terminating process.", serial)
            self._process.terminate()
            try:
                self._process.wait(timeout=20)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                self._process.kill()
            self._finalize_stop()
            return True

        raise EmulatorStopError(
            f"Emulator {serial} did not shut down within 45s."
        ).with_output(command="adb emu kill", stderr=self._log_tail())

    def _finalize_stop(self) -> None:
        self._process = None
        self._serial = None
        self._started_by_us = False

    def reset(self, *, wipe_data: bool = False) -> str:
        """Return the device to a clean state.

        ``wipe_data`` performs a factory reset by restarting the AVD with
        ``-wipe-data``, which requires that we own the emulator process.
        """
        if wipe_data:
            avd = self.avd_name
            self.stop(force=True)
            find_emulator.cache_clear()
            resolved = self.resolve_avd(avd)
            known = {item.serial for item in self.adb.devices()}
            args = self._build_args(resolved)
            if "-wipe-data" not in args:
                args.append("-wipe-data")
            stamp = datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%S")
            self._log_path = _log_dir() / f"{resolved}-wipe-{stamp}.log"
            with self._log_path.open("wb") as handle:
                self._process = subprocess.Popen(
                    args,
                    stdout=handle,
                    stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
                    stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                    cwd=str(Path(self.binary).parent),
                    creationflags=_detached_flags(),
                    close_fds=True,
                )
            self._started_by_us = True
            return self.wait_until_ready(known_serials=known)

        serial = self._serial or self.adb.pick_device()
        device = self.adb.for_serial(serial)
        # Dismiss the keyguard and return to the launcher.
        device.shell("input keyevent KEYCODE_WAKEUP", check=False)
        device.shell("wm dismiss-keyguard", check=False)
        device.shell("input keyevent KEYCODE_HOME", check=False)
        return serial

    # -- context manager -----------------------------------------------------

    def __enter__(self) -> "EmulatorManager":
        self.ensure_ready()
        return self

    def __exit__(self, *_exc: object) -> None:
        if settings.emulator_stop_when_done:
            try:
                self.stop()
            except EmulatorStopError:
                logger.warning("Emulator shutdown failed during cleanup", exc_info=True)

from __future__ import annotations

from app.core.errors import AppError


class ExplorationError(AppError):
    """Base error for the dynamic exploration stage.

    Exploration is a best-effort enrichment: static APK analysis must still be
    returned when the emulator layer fails. Callers should therefore catch these
    and degrade to ``ExplorationResult.failed(...)`` rather than failing the request.
    """

    def __init__(self, code: str, message: str, http_status: int = 500) -> None:
        super().__init__(code, message, http_status=http_status)
        self.stdout: str | None = None
        self.stderr: str | None = None
        self.command: str | None = None

    def with_output(
        self,
        command: str | None = None,
        stdout: str | None = None,
        stderr: str | None = None,
    ) -> "ExplorationError":
        """Attach captured process output so failures are never silent."""
        self.command = command
        self.stdout = stdout
        self.stderr = stderr
        return self

    def details(self) -> dict[str, str]:
        body: dict[str, str] = {"code": self.code, "message": self.message}
        if self.command:
            body["command"] = self.command
        if self.stdout:
            body["stdout"] = self.stdout[-2000:]
        if self.stderr:
            body["stderr"] = self.stderr[-2000:]
        return body
