FILE: backend/app/modules/hitl/hitl_state.py
================================================================================
"""Snapshot of exploration progress taken when HITL pauses the agent."""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Any


def _now() -> datetime:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc)


@dataclass
class ExplorationCheckpoint:
    """Frozen explorer position so Continue resumes the same in-memory run.

    The worker thread stays alive and holds the emulator lock; this checkpoint is
    also exposed on the job record for the frontend / debugging.
    """

    job_id: str
    intervention_id: str
    current_state_id: str | None = None
    parent_state_id: str | None = None
    current_activity: str | None = None
    current_package: str | None = None
    depth: int = 0
    actions_performed: int = 0
    screenshots_captured: int = 0
    unique_states: int = 0
    visited_states: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    visited_actions: dict[str, list[str]] = field(default_factory=dict)
    navigation_graph: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    activity_trail: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    blocked_fingerprint: str | None = None
    blocked_visible_text: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    created_at: datetime = field(default_factory=_now)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        payload = asdict(self)
        payload["created_at"] = self.created_at.isoformat()
        return payload

    @classmethod
    def from_dict(cls, data: dict[str, Any]) -> "ExplorationCheckpoint":
        created = data.get("created_at")
        if isinstance(created, str):
            try:
                created_at = datetime.fromisoformat(created)
            except ValueError:
                created_at = _now()
        elif isinstance(created, datetime):
            created_at = created
        else:
            created_at = _now()
        return cls(
            job_id=str(data.get("job_id") or ""),
            intervention_id=str(data.get("intervention_id") or ""),
            current_state_id=data.get("current_state_id"),
            parent_state_id=data.get("parent_state_id"),
            current_activity=data.get("current_activity"),
            current_package=data.get("current_package"),
            depth=int(data.get("depth") or 0),
            actions_performed=int(data.get("actions_performed") or 0),
            screenshots_captured=int(data.get("screenshots_captured") or 0),
            unique_states=int(data.get("unique_states") or 0),
            visited_states=list(data.get("visited_states") or []),
            visited_actions={
                str(k): list(v) for k, v in (data.get("visited_actions") or {}).items()
            },
            navigation_graph=dict(data.get("navigation_graph") or {}),
            activity_trail=list(data.get("activity_trail") or []),
            blocked_fingerprint=data.get("blocked_fingerprint"),
            blocked_visible_text=list(data.get("blocked_visible_text") or []),
            created_at=created_at,
        )

================================================================================
FILE: backend/app/modules/hitl/intervention_detector.py
================================================================================
"""Detect screens that require a human decision before exploration continues."""

from __future__ import annotations

import re
from typing import Sequence

from app.core.config import settings
from app.modules.exploration.ui_element import UIElement
from app.modules.hitl.guidance import build_guidance, summarize_inputs
from app.modules.hitl.intervention_rules import (
    ACTIVITY_HINTS,
    ALL_RULE_GROUPS,
    BLOCKING_CTA,
    DEFAULT_SYSTEM_PACKAGES,
    NORMAL_CONTENT_HINTS,
    RulePattern,
)
from app.modules.hitl.intervention_types import DetectionResult, InterventionType


def _package_of(activity: str | None, package: str | None) -> str | None:
    if package:
        return package
    if activity and "/" in activity:
        return activity.split("/", 1)[0]
    return None


def _visible_corpus(elements: Sequence[UIElement]) -> str:
    chunks: list[str] = []
    for el in elements:
        for value in (el.text, el.content_description, el.resource_id):
            if value and value.strip():
                chunks.append(value.strip())
    return "\n".join(chunks)


def _visible_labels(elements: Sequence[UIElement], *, limit: int = 40) -> list[str]:
    labels: list[str] = []
    seen: set[str] = set()
    for el in elements:
        for value in (el.text, el.content_description):
            text = (value or "").strip()
            if not text:
                continue
            key = text.lower()
            if key in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(key)
            labels.append(text)
            if len(labels) >= limit:
                return labels
    return labels


class InterventionDetector:
    """Rule-based HITL detector over UIAutomator dumps + activity/package."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        system_packages: Sequence[str] | None = None,
        target_package: str | None = None,
        enable_unknown_blocking: bool | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        configured = getattr(settings, "hitl_system_packages", None)
        if system_packages is not None:
            pkgs = list(system_packages)
        elif configured:
            pkgs = [p.strip() for p in str(configured).split(",") if p.strip()]
        else:
            pkgs = list(DEFAULT_SYSTEM_PACKAGES)
        self.system_packages = {p.lower() for p in pkgs}
        self.target_package = target_package
        if enable_unknown_blocking is None:
            enable_unknown_blocking = bool(
                getattr(settings, "hitl_unknown_blocking_enabled", True)
            )
        self.enable_unknown_blocking = enable_unknown_blocking

    def is_system_package(self, package: str | None) -> bool:
        if not package:
            return False
        lowered = package.lower()
        if lowered in self.system_packages:
            return True
        markers = (
            "permissioncontroller",
            "packageinstaller",
            "systemui",
            "vpndialogs",
        )
        if any(marker in lowered for marker in markers):
            return True
        if lowered.endswith(".settings") or lowered == "com.android.settings":
            return True
        return False

    def detect(
        self,
        *,
        elements: Sequence[UIElement],
        package: str | None = None,
        activity: str | None = None,
        screenshot_path: str | None = None,
    ) -> DetectionResult:
        """Return whether the current screen requires human intervention.

        ``screenshot_path`` is accepted for API symmetry; classification is
        driven by hierarchy text + package/activity (no vision required).
        """
        _ = screenshot_path
        pkg = _package_of(activity, package)
        corpus = _visible_corpus(elements)
        labels = _visible_labels(elements)
        is_system = self.is_system_package(pkg)

        # 1) Activity / package name hints.
        activity_hit = self._match_activity(activity, elements=elements, labels=labels)
        if activity_hit is not None:
            activity_hit.is_system_ui = is_system or activity_hit.is_system_ui
            return activity_hit

        # 2) Visible-text rule groups (most specific first via ALL_RULE_GROUPS order).
        text_hit = self._match_rules(
            corpus, labels, elements=elements, is_system=is_system
        )
        if text_hit is not None:
            return text_hit

        # 3) Structural form / create / select screens (keyboard or picker needed).
        structural = self._match_structural_input(
            elements, corpus=corpus, labels=labels, is_system=is_system
        )
        if structural is not None:
            return structural

        # 4) System UI that still looks like a decision dialog.
        if is_system and self._looks_like_system_decision(elements, corpus):
            return self._guided(
                InterventionType.SYSTEM_SETTINGS,
                title="System UI decision",
                elements=elements,
                labels=labels,
                evidence=[f"system_package:{pkg}"] + labels[:8],
                confidence=0.7,
                is_system_ui=True,
                base_suggested="Complete the system prompt in the emulator",
            )

        # 5) Unknown blocking: consent-like CTAs with little other content.
        if self.enable_unknown_blocking and self._looks_unknown_blocking(
            elements, corpus, labels, package=pkg
        ):
            return self._guided(
                InterventionType.UNKNOWN_BLOCKING_SCREEN,
                title="Unknown blocking screen",
                elements=elements,
                labels=labels,
                evidence=labels[:10],
                confidence=0.55,
                is_system_ui=is_system,
                base_suggested="Clear the blocking screen in the emulator (tap/type/select), then Continue",
            )

        return DetectionResult(required=False)

    def still_blocked(
        self,
        *,
        elements: Sequence[UIElement],
        package: str | None,
        activity: str | None,
        previous: DetectionResult | None = None,
        previous_fingerprint: str | None = None,
        current_fingerprint: str | None = None,
    ) -> bool:
        """True when Continue was clicked but the blocking screen remains."""
        again = self.detect(elements=elements, package=package, activity=activity)
        if again.required:
            if previous is None or again.type == previous.type:
                return True
            return True
        if (
            previous_fingerprint
            and current_fingerprint
            and previous_fingerprint == current_fingerprint
            and previous
            and previous.required
        ):
            return True
        return False

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ helpers

    def _guided(
        self,
        kind: InterventionType,
        *,
        title: str,
        elements: Sequence[UIElement],
        labels: list[str],
        evidence: list[str],
        confidence: float,
        is_system_ui: bool,
        base_suggested: str | None = None,
    ) -> DetectionResult:
        message, suggested, steps = build_guidance(
            kind=kind,
            title=title,
            elements=elements,
            labels=labels,
            base_suggested=base_suggested,
        )
        return DetectionResult(
            required=True,
            type=kind,
            title=title,
            message=message,
            evidence=evidence,
            confidence=confidence,
            is_system_ui=is_system_ui,
            suggested_action=suggested,
            steps=steps,
        )

    def _match_activity(
        self,
        activity: str | None,
        *,
        elements: Sequence[UIElement],
        labels: list[str],
    ) -> DetectionResult | None:
        if not activity:
            return None
        lowered = activity.lower()
        for itype, title, pattern in ACTIVITY_HINTS:
            if pattern.search(lowered):
                return self._guided(
                    itype,
                    title=title,
                    elements=elements,
                    labels=labels,
                    evidence=[f"activity:{activity}"],
                    confidence=0.85,
                    is_system_ui=False,
                )
        return None

    def _match_rules(
        self,
        corpus: str,
        labels: list[str],
        *,
        elements: Sequence[UIElement],
        is_system: bool,
    ) -> DetectionResult | None:
        if not corpus.strip():
            return None
        best: tuple[float, RulePattern, str] | None = None
        for group in ALL_RULE_GROUPS:
            for rule in group:
                match = rule.pattern.search(corpus)
                if not match:
                    continue
                score = rule.weight
                if rule.intervention_type is InterventionType.LOGIN:
                    if not self._login_looks_blocking(corpus, labels):
                        continue
                    score *= 0.85
                if rule.intervention_type is InterventionType.CREATE_CONTENT:
                    # Home "Add alarm" FABs are not create forms yet — need fields/pickers
                    # or explicit "enter name" copy.
                    summary = summarize_inputs(elements)
                    if not summary["fields"] and not summary["selectors"]:
                        if not re.search(
                            r"enter\s+(a\s+)?(name|title|label)|give\s+it\s+a\s+name|"
                            r"what\s+should\s+we\s+call|fill\s+(in|out)",
                            corpus,
                            re.I,
                        ):
                            continue
                if rule.intervention_type is InterventionType.FORM_INPUT:
                    summary = summarize_inputs(elements)
                    if not summary["fields"] and not re.search(
                        r"enter\s+(your\s+)?(name|email|phone|title)|fill\s+(in|out)",
                        corpus,
                        re.I,
                    ):
                        continue
                if rule.intervention_type is InterventionType.SELECTION:
                    summary = summarize_inputs(elements)
                    # Require picker-ish controls or clear choose/select heading + options.
                    if not summary["selectors"] and len(labels) < 3:
                        continue
                if best is None or score > best[0]:
                    best = (score, rule, match.group(0))
            if best is not None and best[0] >= 0.9:
                break
        if best is None:
            return None
        score, rule, snippet = best
        return self._guided(
            rule.intervention_type,
            title=rule.title,
            elements=elements,
            labels=labels,
            evidence=[f"text:{snippet}"] + labels[:6],
            confidence=min(0.99, 0.6 + 0.2 * score),
            is_system_ui=is_system,
            base_suggested=rule.suggested_action,
        )

    def _match_structural_input(
        self,
        elements: Sequence[UIElement],
        *,
        corpus: str,
        labels: list[str],
        is_system: bool,
    ) -> DetectionResult | None:
        """Detect create/select/type screens from EditText / picker structure."""
        if is_system:
            return None
        summary = summarize_inputs(elements)
        fields = summary["fields"]
        selectors = summary["selectors"]
        ctas = summary["ctas"]
        createish = bool(
            re.search(
                r"\b(create|add\s+new|new\s+alarm|new\s+event|set\s+alarm|set\s+timer|"
                r"enter\s+name|give\s+it\s+a\s+name)\b",
                corpus,
                re.I,
            )
        )
        search_only = bool(fields) and all(
            re.search(r"search|query|find", f, re.I) for f in fields
        )
        if createish and (fields or selectors):
            return self._guided(
                InterventionType.CREATE_CONTENT,
                title="Create or set up something",
                elements=elements,
                labels=labels,
                evidence=["structural:create"] + fields[:3] + selectors[:3] + ctas[:2],
                confidence=0.78,
                is_system_ui=False,
            )
        if len(fields) >= 1 and ctas and not search_only:
            # Form with Save/Next — needs keyboard, not blind tapping.
            return self._guided(
                InterventionType.FORM_INPUT,
                title="Type required information",
                elements=elements,
                labels=labels,
                evidence=["structural:edittext"] + fields[:4] + ctas[:2],
                confidence=0.72,
                is_system_ui=False,
            )
        if len(selectors) >= 1 and (
            ctas
            or re.search(r"\b(select|choose|pick|language|country)\b", corpus, re.I)
        ):
            return self._guided(
                InterventionType.SELECTION,
                title="Select an option",
                elements=elements,
                labels=labels,
                evidence=["structural:selector"] + selectors[:4] + ctas[:2],
                confidence=0.7,
                is_system_ui=False,
            )
        return None

    def _login_looks_blocking(self, corpus: str, labels: list[str]) -> bool:
        lowered = corpus.lower()
        has_password = "password" in lowered or "username" in lowered or "email" in lowered
        has_sign_cta = any(
            re.search(r"^(log\s*in|sign\s*in|continue)$", (lab or "").strip(), re.I)
            for lab in labels
        )
        fieldish = sum(
            1
            for lab in labels
            if re.search(r"password|email|username|phone", lab, re.I)
        )
        return bool(has_password or (has_sign_cta and fieldish >= 1) or fieldish >= 2)

    def _looks_like_system_decision(
        self, elements: Sequence[UIElement], corpus: str
    ) -> bool:
        if not corpus.strip():
            return False
        has_choice = any(
            re.search(
                r"^(allow|deny|while using|only this time|accept|cancel|ok)$",
                (el.text or "").strip(),
                re.I,
            )
            for el in elements
            if el.clickable and el.text
        )
        return has_choice or bool(
            re.search(r"allow|permission|default|settings", corpus, re.I)
        )

    def _looks_unknown_blocking(
        self,
        elements: Sequence[UIElement],
        corpus: str,
        labels: list[str],
        *,
        package: str | None,
    ) -> bool:
        if self.target_package and package and package != self.target_package:
            if not self.is_system_package(package):
                return True
        if NORMAL_CONTENT_HINTS.search(corpus) and not BLOCKING_CTA.search(corpus):
            return False
        clickables = [el for el in elements if el.clickable and el.enabled and el.visible]
        cta_hits = [
            el
            for el in clickables
            if BLOCKING_CTA.match((el.text or el.content_description or "").strip())
        ]
        if not cta_hits:
            return False
        legalish = bool(
            re.search(r"terms|privacy|policy|consent|agree|accept|continue", corpus, re.I)
        )
        return legalish and len(labels) <= 25

================================================================================
FILE: backend/app/modules/hitl/intervention_manager.py
================================================================================
"""Coordinate pause / continue / skip / stop for HITL interventions."""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
import threading
import time
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Callable

from app.core.config import settings
from app.jobs.models import JobStage, JobStatus
from app.jobs.store import get_job_store
from app.modules.hitl.hitl_state import ExplorationCheckpoint
from app.modules.hitl.intervention_detector import InterventionDetector
from app.modules.hitl.intervention_store import InterventionStore, get_intervention_store
from app.modules.hitl.intervention_types import (
    DetectionResult,
    HumanDecision,
    Intervention,
    InterventionStatus,
    new_intervention_id,
)

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


def _now() -> datetime:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc)


class InterventionManager:
    """Blocks the exploration worker until a human Continues, Skips, or Stops.

    The worker thread remains associated with the job and keeps the emulator
    lock. Continue does **not** auto-tap consent/permission buttons.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        job_id: str,
        *,
        run_id: str | None = None,
        store: InterventionStore | None = None,
        timeout_seconds: float | None = None,
        detector: InterventionDetector | None = None,
        artifact_dir: str | Path | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self.job_id = job_id
        self.run_id = run_id or job_id
        self.store = store or get_intervention_store()
        self.timeout_seconds = float(
            timeout_seconds
            if timeout_seconds is not None
            else getattr(settings, "hitl_timeout_seconds", 1800)
        )
        self.detector = detector or InterventionDetector()
        if artifact_dir is not None:
            self.artifact_dir = Path(artifact_dir)
        else:
            from app.modules.exploration.screenshot_storage import local_hitl_dir

            self.artifact_dir = local_hitl_dir(None, job_id)
        self.artifact_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

        self._events: dict[str, threading.Event] = {}
        self._decisions: dict[str, HumanDecision] = {}
        self._lock = threading.RLock()
        self._active_intervention_id: str | None = None
        self._last_checkpoint: ExplorationCheckpoint | None = None
        self._stopped = False
        self._partial_result: dict[str, Any] | None = None

    @property
    def active_intervention_id(self) -> str | None:
        return self._active_intervention_id

    @property
    def last_checkpoint(self) -> ExplorationCheckpoint | None:
        return self._last_checkpoint

    @property
    def stopped(self) -> bool:
        return self._stopped

    def request_intervention(
        self,
        detection: DetectionResult,
        *,
        package: str | None,
        activity: str | None,
        screenshot_bytes: bytes | None = None,
        ui_dump_xml: str | None = None,
        checkpoint: ExplorationCheckpoint | None = None,
        fingerprint: str | None = None,
    ) -> tuple[Intervention, HumanDecision]:
        """Create an intervention, mark the job waiting, and block until a decision."""
        if not detection.required or detection.type is None:
            raise ValueError("DetectionResult.required must be True")

        intervention_id = new_intervention_id()
        screenshot_path = None
        screenshot_s3_key = None
        screenshot_s3_url = None
        ui_dump_path = None
        if screenshot_bytes:
            screenshot_path = str(self.artifact_dir / f"{intervention_id}.png")
            Path(screenshot_path).write_bytes(screenshot_bytes)
            # Phase 8: best-effort S3 publish for HITL screenshots.
            try:
                from app.modules.exploration.screenshot_storage import ScreenshotStorage

                storage = ScreenshotStorage(
                    app_id=package or self.job_id,
                    run_id=self.run_id,
                )
                meta = storage.upload_bytes(
                    screenshot_bytes,
                    page="hitl",
                    state_id=intervention_id,
                    kind="hitl",
                    triggering_action="hitl_pause",
                    local_path=screenshot_path,
                    screenshot_id=intervention_id,
                )
                screenshot_s3_key = meta.s3_key
                screenshot_s3_url = meta.s3_url
                if meta.upload_error:
                    logger.warning(
                        "HITL screenshot S3 upload deferred job=%s err=%s",
                        self.job_id,
                        meta.upload_error,
                    )
            except Exception:
                logger.warning(
                    "HITL screenshot S3 upload failed job=%s",
                    self.job_id,
                    exc_info=True,
                )
        if ui_dump_xml is not None:
            ui_dump_path = str(self.artifact_dir / f"{intervention_id}.xml")
            Path(ui_dump_path).write_text(ui_dump_xml, encoding="utf-8")

        timeout_at = _now() + timedelta(seconds=self.timeout_seconds)
        intervention = Intervention(
            intervention_id=intervention_id,
            job_id=self.job_id,
            run_id=self.run_id,
            type=detection.type,
            title=detection.title or detection.type.value,
            message=detection.message or "Human action required",
            package=package,
            activity=activity,
            screenshot_path=screenshot_path,
            screenshot_s3_key=screenshot_s3_key,
            screenshot_s3_url=screenshot_s3_url,
            ui_dump_path=ui_dump_path,
            status=InterventionStatus.WAITING,
            timeout_at=timeout_at,
            evidence=list(detection.evidence),
            state_id=checkpoint.current_state_id if checkpoint else None,
            parent_state_id=checkpoint.parent_state_id if checkpoint else None,
            depth=checkpoint.depth if checkpoint else 0,
            is_system_ui=detection.is_system_ui,
            confidence=detection.confidence,
            suggested_action=detection.suggested_action,
            steps=list(detection.steps or []),
            extras={
                "suggested_action": detection.suggested_action,
                "steps": list(detection.steps or []),
                "fingerprint": fingerprint,
            },
        )
        if checkpoint is None:
            checkpoint = ExplorationCheckpoint(
                job_id=self.job_id,
                intervention_id=intervention_id,
                current_activity=activity,
                current_package=package,
                blocked_fingerprint=fingerprint,
            )
        else:
            checkpoint.intervention_id = intervention_id
            checkpoint.blocked_fingerprint = fingerprint or checkpoint.blocked_fingerprint

        self.store.save(intervention)
        self.store.save_checkpoint(checkpoint)
        self._last_checkpoint = checkpoint
        try:
            from app.db.phase11_repository import persist_intervention_from_dataclass

            persist_intervention_from_dataclass(intervention)
        except Exception:
            logger.debug("Phase 11 HITL persist (create) skipped", exc_info=True)

        event = threading.Event()
        with self._lock:
            self._events[intervention_id] = event
            self._active_intervention_id = intervention_id

        self._publish_waiting(intervention, checkpoint)
        logger.info(
            "HITL pause job=%s intervention=%s type=%s timeout=%ss",
            self.job_id,
            intervention_id,
            intervention.type.value,
            self.timeout_seconds,
        )

        finished = event.wait(timeout=self.timeout_seconds)
        with self._lock:
            decision = self._decisions.pop(intervention_id, None)
            self._events.pop(intervention_id, None)
            self._active_intervention_id = None

        if not finished or decision is None:
            decision = HumanDecision.TIMEOUT
            self.store.update(
                intervention_id,
                status=InterventionStatus.TIMEOUT,
                decision=decision,
                resolved_at=_now(),
            )
            self._publish_timeout(intervention_id)
            logger.info("HITL timeout job=%s intervention=%s", self.job_id, intervention_id)
            try:
                from app.db.phase11_repository import persist_intervention_from_dataclass

                fresh_timeout = self.store.get(intervention_id)
                if fresh_timeout is not None:
                    persist_intervention_from_dataclass(fresh_timeout)
            except Exception:
                logger.debug("Phase 11 HITL persist (timeout) skipped", exc_info=True)
            return intervention, decision

        status_map = {
            HumanDecision.CONTINUE: InterventionStatus.RESOLVED,
            HumanDecision.SKIP: InterventionStatus.SKIPPED,
            HumanDecision.STOP: InterventionStatus.STOPPED,
            HumanDecision.TIMEOUT: InterventionStatus.TIMEOUT,
        }
        self.store.update(
            intervention_id,
            status=status_map.get(decision, InterventionStatus.RESOLVED),
            decision=decision,
            resolved_at=_now(),
        )
        if decision is HumanDecision.STOP:
            self._stopped = True
        elif decision in (HumanDecision.CONTINUE, HumanDecision.SKIP):
            self._publish_running()
        logger.info(
            "HITL decision job=%s intervention=%s decision=%s",
            self.job_id,
            intervention_id,
            decision.value,
        )
        # Refresh intervention object
        fresh = self.store.get(intervention_id) or intervention
        try:
            from app.db.phase11_repository import persist_intervention_from_dataclass

            persist_intervention_from_dataclass(fresh)
        except Exception:
            logger.debug("Phase 11 HITL persist (resolve) skipped", exc_info=True)
        return fresh, decision

    def signal_continue(self, intervention_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return self._signal(intervention_id, HumanDecision.CONTINUE)

    def signal_skip(self, intervention_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return self._signal(intervention_id, HumanDecision.SKIP)

    def signal_stop(self, intervention_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
        self._stopped = True
        return self._signal(intervention_id, HumanDecision.STOP)

    def verify_cleared(
        self,
        *,
        elements,
        package: str | None,
        activity: str | None,
        previous: DetectionResult | None,
        previous_fingerprint: str | None = None,
        current_fingerprint: str | None = None,
    ) -> bool:
        """Return True when the blocking screen appears gone."""
        return not self.detector.still_blocked(
            elements=elements,
            package=package,
            activity=activity,
            previous=previous,
            previous_fingerprint=previous_fingerprint,
            current_fingerprint=current_fingerprint,
        )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ internal

    def _signal(self, intervention_id: str, decision: HumanDecision) -> dict[str, Any]:
        intervention = self.store.get(intervention_id)
        if intervention is None or intervention.job_id != self.job_id:
            return {"success": False, "message": "Unknown intervention."}
        if intervention.status is not InterventionStatus.WAITING:
            return {
                "success": False,
                "message": f"Intervention is already {intervention.status.value}.",
            }
        with self._lock:
            event = self._events.get(intervention_id)
            if event is None:
                return {"success": False, "message": "No worker is waiting on this intervention."}
            self._decisions[intervention_id] = decision
            event.set()
        return {
            "success": True,
            "decision": decision.value,
            "intervention_id": intervention_id,
            "message": f"Recorded decision: {decision.value}",
        }

    def _publish_waiting(
        self, intervention: Intervention, checkpoint: ExplorationCheckpoint
    ) -> None:
        try:
            get_job_store().update(
                self.job_id,
                status=JobStatus.WAITING_FOR_HUMAN,
                stage=JobStage.WAITING_FOR_HUMAN,
                intervention=intervention.public_payload(),
                exploration_checkpoint=checkpoint.to_dict(),
            )
        except Exception:
            logger.warning("Could not publish WAITING_FOR_HUMAN for %s", self.job_id, exc_info=True)

    def _publish_running(self) -> None:
        try:
            get_job_store().update(
                self.job_id,
                status=JobStatus.RUNNING,
                stage=JobStage.EXPLORING,
                intervention=None,
            )
        except Exception:
            logger.warning("Could not publish RUNNING after HITL for %s", self.job_id, exc_info=True)

    def _publish_timeout(self, intervention_id: str) -> None:
        try:
            intervention = self.store.get(intervention_id)
            get_job_store().update(
                self.job_id,
                status=JobStatus.TIMEOUT,
                intervention=intervention.public_payload() if intervention else None,
            )
        except Exception:
            logger.warning("Could not publish TIMEOUT for %s", self.job_id, exc_info=True)


# Process-wide registry so API handlers can signal the worker that owns a job.
_MANAGERS: dict[str, InterventionManager] = {}
_MANAGERS_LOCK = threading.RLock()


def register_manager(manager: InterventionManager) -> None:
    with _MANAGERS_LOCK:
        _MANAGERS[manager.job_id] = manager


def unregister_manager(job_id: str) -> None:
    with _MANAGERS_LOCK:
        _MANAGERS.pop(job_id, None)


def get_manager(job_id: str) -> InterventionManager | None:
    with _MANAGERS_LOCK:
        return _MANAGERS.get(job_id)


def wait_poll(
    predicate: Callable[[], bool],
    *,
    timeout: float,
    interval: float = 0.25,
) -> bool:
    """Utility for tests — poll until predicate or timeout."""
    deadline = time.monotonic() + timeout
    while time.monotonic() < deadline:
        if predicate():
            return True
        time.sleep(interval)
    return False

"""In-process store for HITL intervention records."""

from __future__ import annotations

import threading
from typing import Any

from app.modules.hitl.hitl_state import ExplorationCheckpoint
from app.modules.hitl.intervention_types import Intervention, InterventionStatus


class InterventionStore:
    """Thread-safe memory store keyed by intervention id and job id.

    Jobs already have their own store; this keeps live Intervention objects and
    checkpoints without inventing a second database abstraction.
    """

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._by_id: dict[str, Intervention] = {}
        self._by_job: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
        self._checkpoints: dict[str, ExplorationCheckpoint] = {}
        self._lock = threading.RLock()

    def save(self, intervention: Intervention) -> Intervention:
        with self._lock:
            self._by_id[intervention.intervention_id] = intervention
            bucket = self._by_job.setdefault(intervention.job_id, [])
            if intervention.intervention_id not in bucket:
                bucket.append(intervention.intervention_id)
            return intervention

    def get(self, intervention_id: str) -> Intervention | None:
        with self._lock:
            return self._by_id.get(intervention_id)

    def get_active_for_job(self, job_id: str) -> Intervention | None:
        with self._lock:
            for iid in reversed(self._by_job.get(job_id, [])):
                item = self._by_id.get(iid)
                if item and item.status is InterventionStatus.WAITING:
                    return item
            return None

    def list_for_job(self, job_id: str) -> list[Intervention]:
        with self._lock:
            return [
                self._by_id[iid]
                for iid in self._by_job.get(job_id, [])
                if iid in self._by_id
            ]

    def update(self, intervention_id: str, **changes: Any) -> Intervention | None:
        with self._lock:
            item = self._by_id.get(intervention_id)
            if item is None:
                return None
            for key, value in changes.items():
                if hasattr(item, key):
                    setattr(item, key, value)
            return item

    def save_checkpoint(self, checkpoint: ExplorationCheckpoint) -> None:
        with self._lock:
            self._checkpoints[checkpoint.intervention_id] = checkpoint

    def get_checkpoint(self, intervention_id: str) -> ExplorationCheckpoint | None:
        with self._lock:
            return self._checkpoints.get(intervention_id)

    def clear_job(self, job_id: str) -> None:
        with self._lock:
            ids = self._by_job.pop(job_id, [])
            for iid in ids:
                self._by_id.pop(iid, None)
                self._checkpoints.pop(iid, None)


_STORE = InterventionStore()


def get_intervention_store() -> InterventionStore:
    return _STORE

"""Human-in-the-loop intervention type definitions (Phase 7)."""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from enum import Enum
from typing import Any
from uuid import uuid4


class InterventionType(str, Enum):
    TERMS_CONSENT = "terms_consent"
    PRIVACY_CONSENT = "privacy_consent"
    PERMISSION = "permission"
    DEFAULT_APP = "default_app"
    SYSTEM_SETTINGS = "system_settings"
    LOGIN = "login"
    OTP = "otp"
    CAPTCHA = "captcha"
    VERIFICATION = "verification"
    FORM_INPUT = "form_input"
    SELECTION = "selection"
    CREATE_CONTENT = "create_content"
    UNKNOWN_BLOCKING_SCREEN = "unknown_blocking_screen"


class InterventionStatus(str, Enum):
    WAITING = "waiting"
    RESOLVED = "resolved"
    SKIPPED = "skipped"
    STOPPED = "stopped"
    TIMEOUT = "timeout"


class HumanDecision(str, Enum):
    CONTINUE = "continue"
    SKIP = "skip"
    STOP = "stop"
    TIMEOUT = "timeout"


def _now() -> datetime:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc)


def new_intervention_id() -> str:
    return f"hitl_{uuid4().hex[:12]}"


@dataclass
class Intervention:
    """One human-intervention request attached to an analysis job."""

    intervention_id: str
    job_id: str
    run_id: str | None = None
    type: InterventionType = InterventionType.UNKNOWN_BLOCKING_SCREEN
    title: str = "Human action required"
    message: str = "Human action required"
    package: str | None = None
    activity: str | None = None
    screenshot_path: str | None = None
    screenshot_s3_key: str | None = None
    screenshot_s3_url: str | None = None
    ui_dump_path: str | None = None
    status: InterventionStatus = InterventionStatus.WAITING
    created_at: datetime = field(default_factory=_now)
    timeout_at: datetime | None = None
    resolved_at: datetime | None = None
    decision: HumanDecision | None = None
    evidence: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    state_id: str | None = None
    parent_state_id: str | None = None
    depth: int = 0
    is_system_ui: bool = False
    confidence: float = 0.0
    suggested_action: str | None = None
    steps: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    extras: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        payload = asdict(self)
        payload["type"] = self.type.value
        payload["status"] = self.status.value
        payload["decision"] = self.decision.value if self.decision else None
        payload["created_at"] = self.created_at.isoformat()
        payload["timeout_at"] = self.timeout_at.isoformat() if self.timeout_at else None
        payload["resolved_at"] = self.resolved_at.isoformat() if self.resolved_at else None
        return payload

    def public_payload(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Shape embedded in GET /analyze-apk/{job_id}."""
        # Always use same-origin API URL for the operator popup. Public S3 URLs are
        # often private / wrong and show a blank image; the API serves local or S3 bytes.
        screenshot = (
            f"/api/v1/analyze-apk/{self.job_id}/intervention/"
            f"{self.intervention_id}/screenshot"
        )

        suggested = self.suggested_action or (self.extras or {}).get("suggested_action")
        steps = list(self.steps or (self.extras or {}).get("steps") or [])
        return {
            "id": self.intervention_id,
            "type": self.type.value,
            "type_label": _type_label(self.type),
            "title": self.title,
            "message": self.message or "Please complete this action in the emulator.",
            "suggested_action": suggested
            or "Complete the required step in the emulator, then click Continue.",
            "steps": steps,
            "package": self.package,
            "activity": self.activity,
            "status": self.status.value,
            "screenshot": screenshot,
            "screenshot_s3_key": self.screenshot_s3_key,
            "screenshot_s3_url": self.screenshot_s3_url,
            "is_system_ui": self.is_system_ui,
            "evidence": list(self.evidence),
            "created_at": self.created_at.isoformat(),
            "timeout_at": self.timeout_at.isoformat() if self.timeout_at else None,
        }


def _type_label(kind: InterventionType) -> str:
    return {
        InterventionType.TERMS_CONSENT: "Terms & Conditions",
        InterventionType.PRIVACY_CONSENT: "Privacy Policy",
        InterventionType.PERMISSION: "Android Permission",
        InterventionType.DEFAULT_APP: "Default App",
        InterventionType.SYSTEM_SETTINGS: "System Settings",
        InterventionType.LOGIN: "Login / Sign in",
        InterventionType.OTP: "OTP / Verification code",
        InterventionType.CAPTCHA: "CAPTCHA",
        InterventionType.VERIFICATION: "Account verification",
        InterventionType.FORM_INPUT: "Keyboard / form input",
        InterventionType.SELECTION: "Select an option",
        InterventionType.CREATE_CONTENT: "Create / set up",
        InterventionType.UNKNOWN_BLOCKING_SCREEN: "Blocking screen",
    }.get(kind, kind.value.replace("_", " ").title())


@dataclass
class DetectionResult:
    """Output of :class:`InterventionDetector` for one screen."""

    required: bool
    type: InterventionType | None = None
    title: str = ""
    message: str = "Human action required"
    evidence: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    confidence: float = 0.0
    is_system_ui: bool = False
    suggested_action: str | None = None
    steps: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "required": self.required,
            "type": self.type.value if self.type else None,
            "title": self.title,
            "message": self.message,
            "evidence": list(self.evidence),
            "confidence": self.confidence,
            "is_system_ui": self.is_system_ui,
            "suggested_action": self.suggested_action,
            "steps": list(self.steps),
        }

from __future__ import annotations

from app.core.xmlutil import (
    android_attr,
    children_by_tag,
    find_application,
    parse_bool,
    parse_int,
)
from app.modules.apk_analyzer.aapt import prefer
from app.modules.apk_analyzer.context import ApkContext


def _label_from_apk(ctx: ApkContext) -> str | None:
    try:
        name = ctx.apk.get_app_name()
    except Exception:
        return None
    if not name:
        return None
    if isinstance(name, str) and name.startswith("@"):
        ctx.warnings.append("Application label is an unresolved resource reference.")
        return name
    return str(name)


def extract_manifest(ctx: ApkContext) -> dict:
    manifest = ctx.manifest_xml
    package = android_attr(manifest, "package") or getattr(ctx.apk, "get_package", lambda: None)()
    version_name = android_attr(manifest, "versionName")
    version_code = parse_int(android_attr(manifest, "versionCode"))
    if version_name is None:
        try:
            version_name = ctx.apk.get_androidversion_name()
        except Exception:
            version_name = None
    if version_code is None:
        try:
            version_code = parse_int(str(ctx.apk.get_androidversion_code()))
        except Exception:
            version_code = None

    app = find_application(manifest)
    app_label = None
    debuggable = None
    allow_backup = None
    extract_native = None
    uses_cleartext = None
    app_attrs: dict[str, str] = {}
    if app is not None:
        app_label = android_attr(app, "label")
        debuggable = parse_bool(android_attr(app, "debuggable"))
        allow_backup = parse_bool(android_attr(app, "allowBackup"))
        extract_native = parse_bool(android_attr(app, "extractNativeLibs"))
        uses_cleartext = parse_bool(android_attr(app, "usesCleartextTraffic"))
        for key, value in app.attrib.items():
            short = key.split("}", 1)[-1]
            if value is not None:
                app_attrs[short] = value

    if not app_label or (isinstance(app_label, str) and app_label.startswith("@")):
        resolved = _label_from_apk(ctx)
        if resolved:
            app_label = resolved

    features = []
    for el in children_by_tag(manifest, "uses-feature"):
        features.append(
            {
                "name": android_attr(el, "name"),
                "required": parse_bool(android_attr(el, "required")),
                "gl_es_version": android_attr(el, "glEsVersion"),
            }
        )

    libraries = []
    for el in children_by_tag(manifest, "uses-library"):
        libraries.append(
            {
                "name": android_attr(el, "name"),
                "required": parse_bool(android_attr(el, "required")),
            }
        )

    install_location = android_attr(manifest, "installLocation")
    shared_user_id = android_attr(manifest, "sharedUserId")

    aapt = getattr(ctx, "aapt", None) or {}
    package = prefer(aapt.get("package"), package, "package", ctx.warnings)
    version_name = prefer(aapt.get("version_name"), version_name, "version_name", ctx.warnings)
    version_code = prefer(aapt.get("version_code"), version_code, "version_code", ctx.warnings)
    if aapt.get("app_label"):
        app_label = prefer(aapt.get("app_label"), app_label, "app_label", ctx.warnings)

    return {
        "package": package,
        "app_label": app_label,
        "version_name": version_name,
        "version_code": version_code,
        "debuggable": debuggable,
        "allow_backup": allow_backup,
        "extract_native_libs": extract_native,
        "uses_cleartext_traffic": uses_cleartext,
        "install_location": install_location,
        "shared_user_id": shared_user_id,
        "uses_feature": features,
        "uses_library": libraries,
        "attributes": app_attrs,
    }

from __future__ import annotations

import logging

from app.core.xmlutil import android_attr, children_by_tag, find_application, typed_value
from app.modules.apk_analyzer.context import ApkContext

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


def extract_metadata(ctx: ApkContext) -> list[dict]:
    app = find_application(ctx.manifest_xml)
    if app is None:
        return []

    items: list[dict] = []
    for el in children_by_tag(app, "meta-data"):
        name = android_attr(el, "name")
        if not name:
            continue
        raw_value = android_attr(el, "value")
        resource = android_attr(el, "resource")
        if resource and (raw_value is None or raw_value == ""):
            value, value_type = resource, "resource"
        else:
            value, value_type = typed_value(raw_value)
            if resource and value_type == "null":
                value, value_type = resource, "resource"
        logger.debug("Extracted metadata key %s type=%s", name, value_type)
        items.append({"name": name, "value": value, "value_type": value_type})
    return items

from __future__ import annotations

from app.core.xmlutil import android_attr, children_by_tag, parse_int
from app.modules.apk_analyzer.context import ApkContext
from app.modules.permissions.aosp import aosp_protection_level

_PROTECTION_LEVEL_MAP = {
    "0": "normal",
    "1": "dangerous",
    "2": "signature",
    "3": "signatureOrSystem",
    "normal": "normal",
    "dangerous": "dangerous",
    "signature": "signature",
    "signatureorsystem": "signatureOrSystem",
    "signature|privileged": "signature|privileged",
    "privileged": "privileged",
}


def _normalize_protection(raw: str | None) -> str | None:
    if raw is None:
        return None
    key = raw.strip().lower()
    if key in _PROTECTION_LEVEL_MAP:
        return _PROTECTION_LEVEL_MAP[key]
    if raw.strip() in _PROTECTION_LEVEL_MAP:
        return _PROTECTION_LEVEL_MAP[raw.strip()]
    return raw


def extract_permissions(ctx: ApkContext) -> list[dict]:
    declared: dict[str, str | None] = {}
    for el in children_by_tag(ctx.manifest_xml, "permission"):
        name = android_attr(el, "name")
        if not name:
            continue
        declared[name] = _normalize_protection(android_attr(el, "protectionLevel"))

    results: list[dict] = []
    seen: set[str] = set()
    for el in children_by_tag(ctx.manifest_xml, "uses-permission"):
        name = android_attr(el, "name")
        if not name or name in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(name)
        max_sdk = parse_int(android_attr(el, "maxSdkVersion"))
        if name in declared and declared[name]:
            protection, source = declared[name], "manifest"
        else:
            mapped = aosp_protection_level(name)
            protection, source = (mapped, "aosp_mapping") if mapped else (None, None)
        results.append(
            {
                "name": name,
                "max_sdk_version": max_sdk,
                "protection_level": protection,
                "protection_level_source": source,
            }
        )

    if not results:
        try:
            for name in ctx.apk.get_permissions() or []:
                if name in seen:
                    continue
                seen.add(name)
                mapped = aosp_protection_level(name)
                results.append(
                    {
                        "name": name,
                        "max_sdk_version": None,
                        "protection_level": mapped,
                        "protection_level_source": "aosp_mapping" if mapped else None,
                    }
                )
        except Exception:
            pass

    aapt = getattr(ctx, "aapt", None) or {}
    added = 0
    for item in aapt.get("permissions") or []:
        name = item.get("name")
        if not name or name in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(name)
        mapped = aosp_protection_level(name)
        results.append(
            {
                "name": name,
                "max_sdk_version": item.get("max_sdk_version"),
                "protection_level": mapped,
                "protection_level_source": "aosp_mapping" if mapped else None,
            }
        )
        added += 1
    if added:
        ctx.warnings.append(f"{added} permission(s) were added from aapt dump badging.")

    return results

from __future__ import annotations

from app.core.xmlutil import android_attr, children_by_tag, parse_int
from app.modules.apk_analyzer.aapt import prefer
from app.modules.apk_analyzer.context import ApkContext
from app.modules.sdk.platforms import platform_name


def _sdk_from_apk(ctx: ApkContext, getter: str) -> int | None:
    try:
        value = getattr(ctx.apk, getter)()
    except Exception:
        return None
    return parse_int(str(value) if value is not None else None)


def extract_sdk(ctx: ApkContext) -> dict:
    min_sdk = None
    target_sdk = None
    max_sdk = None
    for uses_sdk in children_by_tag(ctx.manifest_xml, "uses-sdk"):
        min_sdk = parse_int(android_attr(uses_sdk, "minSdkVersion")) or min_sdk
        target_sdk = parse_int(android_attr(uses_sdk, "targetSdkVersion")) or target_sdk
        max_sdk = parse_int(android_attr(uses_sdk, "maxSdkVersion")) or max_sdk

    if min_sdk is None:
        min_sdk = _sdk_from_apk(ctx, "get_min_sdk_version")
    if target_sdk is None:
        target_sdk = _sdk_from_apk(ctx, "get_target_sdk_version")
    if max_sdk is None:
        max_sdk = _sdk_from_apk(ctx, "get_max_sdk_version")

    compile_sdk = parse_int(android_attr(ctx.manifest_xml, "compileSdkVersion"))
    if compile_sdk is None:
        compile_sdk = parse_int(android_attr(ctx.manifest_xml, "compileSdkVersionCodename"))

    aapt = getattr(ctx, "aapt", None) or {}
    min_sdk = prefer(aapt.get("min_sdk"), min_sdk, "min_sdk", ctx.warnings)
    target_sdk = prefer(aapt.get("target_sdk"), target_sdk, "target_sdk", ctx.warnings)
    if aapt.get("compile_sdk") is not None:
        compile_sdk = prefer(aapt.get("compile_sdk"), compile_sdk, "compile_sdk", ctx.warnings)

    return {
        "min_sdk": min_sdk,
        "target_sdk": target_sdk,
        "max_sdk": max_sdk,
        "compile_sdk": compile_sdk,
        "min_platform": platform_name(min_sdk),
        "target_platform": platform_name(target_sdk),
    }

from __future__ import annotations

from app.core.xmlutil import (
    android_attr,
    children_by_tag,
    find_application,
    parse_bool,
    resolve_component_name,
)
from app.modules.apk_analyzer.context import ApkContext
from app.modules.components.exported import resolve_exported
from app.modules.components.intent_filters import extract_intent_filters


def extract_services(ctx: ApkContext, target_sdk: int | None) -> list[dict]:
    app = find_application(ctx.manifest_xml)
    if app is None:
        return []
    package = android_attr(ctx.manifest_xml, "package") or ""
    results: list[dict] = []
    for el in children_by_tag(app, "service"):
        name = resolve_component_name(package, android_attr(el, "name"))
        if not name:
            continue
        filters = extract_intent_filters(el)
        exported, inferred, warning = resolve_exported(
            parse_bool(android_attr(el, "exported")),
            bool(filters),
            target_sdk,
        )
        if warning:
            ctx.warnings.append(f"{name}: {warning}")
        enabled = parse_bool(android_attr(el, "enabled"))
        results.append(
            {
                "name": name,
                "exported": exported,
                "exported_inferred": inferred,
                "enabled": True if enabled is None else enabled,
                "permission": android_attr(el, "permission"),
                "direct_boot_aware": parse_bool(android_attr(el, "directBootAware")),
                "process": android_attr(el, "process"),
                "foreground_service_type": android_attr(el, "foregroundServiceType"),
                "intent_filters": filters,
            }
        )
    return results

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any

from pydantic import (
    BaseModel,
    Field,
    SerializerFunctionWrapHandler,
    field_validator,
    model_serializer,
    model_validator,
)

from app.schemas.exploration import ExplorationResult


class AppSubmission(BaseModel):
    """Optional details supplied by the submitter alongside the APK upload."""

    app_name: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=200)
    app_description: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=4000)
    privacy_policy: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=1024)
    privacy_policy_kind: str | None = None
    play_store_url: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=1024)

    @field_validator("*", mode="before")
    @classmethod
    def blank_to_none(cls, value: Any) -> Any:
        if isinstance(value, str):
            return value.strip() or None
        return value

    @field_validator("play_store_url")
    @classmethod
    def http_url_only(cls, value: str | None) -> str | None:
        if value and not value.lower().startswith(("http://", "https://")):
            raise ValueError("must start with http:// or https://")
        return value

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def classify_privacy_policy(self) -> "AppSubmission":
        if not self.privacy_policy:
            self.privacy_policy_kind = None
        elif self.privacy_policy.lower().startswith(("http://", "https://")):
            self.privacy_policy_kind = "url"
        else:
            self.privacy_policy_kind = "file_path"
        return self

class CodeAnalysis(BaseModel):
    summary: CodeAnalysisSummary = Field(default_factory=CodeAnalysisSummary)
    classes: list[CodeClassInfo] = Field(default_factory=list)
    methods: list[CodeMethodInfo] = Field(default_factory=list)
    api_calls: list[MappedApiCall] = Field(default_factory=list)

    network_calls: list[ApiCallInfo] = Field(default_factory=list)
    webview_usage: list[ApiCallInfo] = Field(default_factory=list)
    file_storage_operations: list[ApiCallInfo] = Field(default_factory=list)
    telephony_calls: list[ApiCallInfo] = Field(default_factory=list)
    data_access_indicators: list[ApiCallInfo] = Field(default_factory=list)
    dynamic_code_loading: list[ApiCallInfo] = Field(default_factory=list)
    third_party_sdk_usage: list[SdkUsageInfo] = Field(default_factory=list)
    network_strings: list[NetworkStringInfo] = Field(default_factory=list)
    code_findings: list[CodeFinding] = Field(default_factory=list)


class AnalysisMeta(BaseModel):
    id: str | None = None
    status: str
    analyzed_at: str
    analyzer_version: str
    duration_ms: int
    warnings: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)

class AnalysisData(BaseModel):
    apk: ApkIdentity
    submission: AppSubmission = Field(default_factory=AppSubmission)
    manifest: ManifestInfo
    permissions: list[PermissionInfo] = Field(default_factory=list)
    metadata: list[MetadataItem] = Field(default_factory=list)
    sdk: SdkInfo
    activities: list[ActivityInfo] = Field(default_factory=list)
    services: list[ServiceInfo] = Field(default_factory=list)
    # Static raster assets pulled out of the APK archive (not emulator captures).
    screenshots: list[ScreenshotInfo] = Field(default_factory=list)
    code_analysis: CodeAnalysis = Field(default_factory=CodeAnalysis)
    analysis: AnalysisMeta
    # Dynamic emulator exploration. Absent entirely on the synchronous /analyze path,
    # so existing response payloads stay unchanged.
    exploration: ExplorationResult | None = None

    @model_serializer(mode="wrap")
    def _omit_absent_exploration(self, handler: SerializerFunctionWrapHandler) -> Any:
        data = handler(self)
        if isinstance(data, dict) and data.get("exploration") is None:
            data.pop("exploration", None)
        return data

    schema_version: str
    status: str
    data: AnalysisData

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime

from pydantic import BaseModel, EmailStr, Field, field_validator


class SignupRequest(BaseModel):
    full_name: str = Field(min_length=2, max_length=120)
    company_name: str = Field(min_length=2, max_length=160)
    email: EmailStr
    # bcrypt only reads the first 72 bytes of a password.
    password: str = Field(min_length=8, max_length=72)

    @field_validator("full_name", "company_name")
    @classmethod
    def not_blank(cls, value: str) -> str:
        cleaned = value.strip()
        if len(cleaned) < 2:
            raise ValueError("must be at least 2 characters")
        return cleaned


class LoginRequest(BaseModel):
    email: EmailStr
    password: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=72)

    id: str
    full_name: str
    company_name: str
    email: str
    created_at: datetime | None = None


class AuthResponse(BaseModel):
    access_token: str
    token_type: str = "bearer"
    expires_in: int
    user: UserProfile

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any, Literal

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

# NOTE: These models describe screenshots captured from a *running* app on an emulator.
# They are intentionally separate from `ScreenshotInfo` in app.schemas.analysis, which
# describes static raster assets extracted from inside the APK archive.

ExplorationStatus = Literal["completed", "partial", "skipped", "failed"]
AdType = Literal["banner", "interstitial", "native", "rewarded", "app_open", "unknown"]
DetectionMethod = Literal["ui_tree", "vision", "heuristic", "manifest_hint"]
Confidence = Literal["HIGH", "MEDIUM", "LOW"]


class Bounds(BaseModel):
    """Pixel rectangle on the device screen, matching UIAutomator's bounds format."""

    left: int
    top: int
    right: int
    bottom: int

    @property
    def width(self) -> int:
        return max(0, self.right - self.left)

    @property
    def height(self) -> int:
        return max(0, self.bottom - self.top)

    @property
    def area(self) -> int:
        return self.width * self.height


class DeviceInfo(BaseModel):
    serial: str | None = None
    avd_name: str | None = None
    android_version: str | None = None
    sdk_int: int | None = None
    screen_width: int | None = None
    screen_height: int | None = None
    density: int | None = None
    is_emulator: bool = True

class AdPlacement(BaseModel):

    Phase 5 uniqueness is driven by page + ad_type + relative geometry + trigger,
    not by screenshot pixel identity. ``relative_bbox`` is
    ``[left, top, width, height]`` in ``[0, 1]`` of the screen.
    """

    page: str | None = None
    ad_detected: bool = True
    ad_type: AdType = "unknown"
    position: str | None = Field(
        default=None,
        description="Coarse band: top | bottom | middle | fullscreen | unknown.",
    )
    relative_bbox: list[float] | None = Field(
        default=None,
        description="[left, top, width, height] relative to the screen (0..1).",
    )
    uniqueness_key: str | None = None
    trigger_action: str | None = None
    network: str | None = None
    sdk_class: str | None = None
    bounds: Bounds | None = None
    coverage_ratio: float | None = Field(
        default=None,

    confidence: Confidence = "LOW"
    state_id: str | None = None

    )

        description="True when this ad_type was expected from static SDK analysis.",
    )

    """The dynamic-analysis counterpart to the static APK analysis payload."""

    status: ExplorationStatus = "skipped"

        default=None,
        description="Why exploration was skipped or failed, when not completed.",
    )

    ad_placements: list[AdPlacement] = Field(default_factory=list)

    coverage: ExplorationCoverage | None = None
    warnings: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    # Phase 8 metadata (URLs / keys only — never base64 image bodies).
    screenshot_records: list[dict[str, Any]] = Field(default_factory=list)
    # Phase 12A — latest unified observation (optional; backward compatible).
    current_observation: dict[str, Any] | None = None
    observation_count: int = 0
    # Phase 12B — compact agent memory summary (optional; runtime only).
    agent_state: dict[str, Any] | None = None
    # Phase 12G — active ad-discovery goal + unique placement discoveries (optional).
    active_goal: dict[str, Any] | None = None
    ad_discoveries: list[dict[str, Any]] = Field(default_factory=list)

    @classmethod
    def skipped(cls, reason: str) -> "ExplorationResult":
        return cls(status="skipped", reason=reason)

    @classmethod
    def failed(cls, reason: str) -> "ExplorationResult":
        return cls(status="failed", reason=reason)

================================================================================
