"""Phase 4/5 CLI: deterministic exploration (+ optional ad-placement campaign).

Examples::

    python -m app.main --explore --package com.example.app
    python -m app.main --explore-ads --package com.example.app --max-runs 3
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import logging
import sys
from pathlib import Path

from app.core.logging import setup_logging
from app.modules.exploration.adb import AndroidADB, find_adb
from app.modules.exploration.ad_discovery import AdDiscoveryLimits
from app.modules.exploration.ad_explorer import run_ad_exploration
from app.modules.exploration.errors import AdbUnavailableError, ExplorationError
from app.modules.exploration.explorer import ExplorationLimits, run_exploration

logger = logging.getLogger("explore_cli")


def build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        prog="python -m app.main --explore|--explore-ads",
        description="Deterministic UI exploration (Phase 4) and ad placement discovery (Phase 5).",
    )
    parser.add_argument("--explore", action="store_true", help=argparse.SUPPRESS)
    parser.add_argument("--explore-ads", action="store_true", help=argparse.SUPPRESS)
    parser.add_argument("--serial", help="adb device serial.")
    parser.add_argument("--package", help="Target package (required without --analysis).")
    parser.add_argument("--activity", help="Optional launch activity.")
    parser.add_argument(
        "--analysis",
        help="Path to existing APK analysis JSON (uses activities/package as prior knowledge).",
    )
    parser.add_argument("--out-dir", help="Screenshot output directory.")
    parser.add_argument("--max-actions", type=int, default=None)
    parser.add_argument("--max-time", type=int, default=None, help="Seconds per run.")
    parser.add_argument("--max-depth", type=int, default=None)
    parser.add_argument("--max-states", type=int, default=None)
    parser.add_argument("--target-per-page", type=int, default=None)
    parser.add_argument("--max-runs", type=int, default=None, help="Phase 5: MAX_EXPLORATION_RUNS.")
    parser.add_argument(
        "--target-ad-per-page",
        type=int,
        default=None,
        help="Phase 5: TARGET_AD_VARIATIONS_PER_PAGE.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--max-ad-per-page",
        type=int,
        default=None,
        help="Phase 5: MAX_AD_VARIATIONS_PER_PAGE.",
    )
    parser.add_argument("--json", action="store_true", help="Emit JSON only.")
    parser.add_argument("--verbose", action="store_true")
    return parser


def _load_analysis(path: str) -> dict:
    data = json.loads(Path(path).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if not isinstance(data, dict):
        raise ValueError("Analysis JSON must be an object.")
    return data


def _print(label: str, value: object) -> None:
    print(f"  {label:<24} {value}")


def _bind_adb(serial: str | None) -> AndroidADB:
    if find_adb() is None:
        raise AdbUnavailableError("adb was not found. Set ADB_PATH or ANDROID_SDK_ROOT.")
    base = AndroidADB()
    return base.for_serial(base.pick_device(serial))


def _limits_from_args(args: argparse.Namespace) -> ExplorationLimits:
    limits = ExplorationLimits.from_settings()
    if args.max_actions is not None:
        limits.max_actions = args.max_actions
    if args.max_time is not None:
        limits.max_time_seconds = args.max_time
    if args.max_depth is not None:
        limits.max_depth = args.max_depth
    if args.max_states is not None:
        limits.max_unique_states = args.max_states
    if args.target_per_page is not None:
        limits.target_states_per_page = args.target_per_page
    return limits


def cmd_explore(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    analysis = _load_analysis(args.analysis) if args.analysis else None
    if analysis is None and not args.package:
        print("Provide --package or --analysis.", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2

    adb = _bind_adb(args.serial)
    session = run_exploration(
        adb,
        analysis=analysis,
        package_name=args.package,
        activity=args.activity,
        limits=_limits_from_args(args),
        output_dir=args.out_dir,
    )
    payload = session.to_dict()

    if args.json:
        print(json.dumps(payload, indent=2))
        return 0 if session.status != "failed" else 1

    print("\nExploration (Phase 4)")
    _print("status", session.status)
    _print("stop reason", session.stop_reason)
    _print("package", session.package_name)
    _print("launch activity", session.launch_activity)
    _print("unique states", session.unique_states)
    _print("screenshots", session.screenshots_captured)
    _print("actions", session.actions_performed)
    _print("duration_ms", session.duration_ms)
    _print("max depth", session.graph.max_depth())
    print("\nNavigation tree")
    print(session.graph.ascii_tree())
    if session.warnings:
        print("\nWarnings")
        for warning in session.warnings:
            print(f"  - {warning}")
    return 0 if session.status != "failed" else 1


def cmd_explore_ads(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    analysis = _load_analysis(args.analysis) if args.analysis else None
    if analysis is None and not args.package:
        print("Provide --package or --analysis.", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2

    adb = _bind_adb(args.serial)
    ad_limits = AdDiscoveryLimits.from_settings()
    if args.max_runs is not None:
        ad_limits.max_exploration_runs = args.max_runs
    if args.target_ad_per_page is not None:
        ad_limits.target_ad_variations_per_page = args.target_ad_per_page
    if args.max_ad_per_page is not None:
        ad_limits.max_ad_variations_per_page = args.max_ad_per_page

    campaign = run_ad_exploration(
        adb,
        analysis=analysis,
        package_name=args.package,
        activity=args.activity,
        limits=_limits_from_args(args),
        ad_limits=ad_limits,
        output_dir=args.out_dir,
        max_runs=args.max_runs,
    )
    payload = campaign.to_dict()

    if args.json:
        print(json.dumps(payload, indent=2))
        return 0 if campaign.status != "failed" else 1

    print("\nAd placement exploration (Phase 5)")
    _print("status", campaign.status)
    _print("stop reason", campaign.stop_reason)
    _print("package", campaign.package_name)
    _print("runs", campaign.runs_completed)
    _print("unique ads", campaign.unique_ad_placements)
    _print("duration_ms", campaign.duration_ms)
    print("\nPlacements")
    if not campaign.catalog.placements:
        print("  (none detected)")
    for record in campaign.catalog.placements:
        fp = record.fingerprint
        print(
            f"  - page={fp.page} type={fp.ad_type} pos={fp.position} "
            f"bbox={list(fp.relative_bbox)} trigger={fp.trigger_action} "
            f"seen={record.seen_count}"
        )
    if campaign.warnings:
        print("\nWarnings")
        for warning in campaign.warnings:
            print(f"  - {warning}")
    return 0 if campaign.status != "failed" else 1


def run_explore_cli(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    setup_logging()
    parser = build_parser()
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    if args.verbose:
        logging.getLogger().setLevel(logging.DEBUG)
    try:
        if args.explore_ads:
            return cmd_explore_ads(args)
        return cmd_explore(args)
    except ExplorationError as exc:
        logger.error("%s: %s", exc.code, exc.message)
        print(f"ERROR [{exc.code}] {exc.message}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    except Exception:
        logger.exception("explore CLI failed")
        raise


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    return run_explore_cli(argv)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

"""Debug helper: dump the current device UI hierarchy via UIAutomator.

Invoked as::

    python -m app.main --inspect-ui

Or directly::

    python -m app.workers.inspect_ui
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import logging
import sys

from app.core.logging import setup_logging
from app.modules.exploration.adb import AndroidADB, find_adb
from app.modules.exploration.errors import ExplorationError
from app.modules.exploration.ui_controller import UIController
from app.modules.exploration.ui_dump import filter_elements

logger = logging.getLogger("inspect_ui")


def _print(label: str, value: object) -> None:
    print(f"  {label:<22} {value}")


def build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        prog="python -m app.main --inspect-ui",
        description="Dump and summarize the UI hierarchy of a connected Android device.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--inspect-ui",
        action="store_true",
        help="Dump the current UI hierarchy (required when run via app.main).",
    )
    parser.add_argument("--serial", help="adb device serial (default: first ready emulator/device).")
    parser.add_argument("--package", help="Keep only nodes belonging to this package name.")
    parser.add_argument(
        "--clickable",
        action="store_true",
        help="Only list clickable, enabled nodes.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--limit",
        type=int,
        default=40,
        help="Max elements to print in the human-readable view (default: 40).",
    )
    parser.add_argument("--json", action="store_true", help="Emit the full dump as JSON.")
    parser.add_argument("--verbose", action="store_true", help="Enable debug logging.")
    return parser


def inspect_ui(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    parser = build_parser()
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    setup_logging()
    if args.verbose:
        logging.getLogger("app").setLevel(logging.DEBUG)

    if find_adb() is None:
        print("adb was not found. Set ADB_PATH or ANDROID_SDK_ROOT.")
        return 1

    try:
        adb = AndroidADB()
        serial = adb.pick_device(args.serial)
        device = adb.for_serial(serial)
        controller = UIController(device)
        dump = controller.dump_ui(package=args.package)
        size = controller.screen_size()
    except ExplorationError as exc:
        print(f"\nUI inspect failed: {exc.message}")
        details = exc.details()
        for key in ("command", "stderr", "stdout"):
            if details.get(key):
                print(f"  {key}: {details[key][:500]}")
        return 1
    except Exception as exc:  # pragma: no cover - unexpected device errors
        logger.exception("Unexpected inspect failure")
        print(f"\nUI inspect failed: {exc}")
        return 1

    elements = dump.elements
    if args.clickable:
        elements = filter_elements(elements, clickable_only=True, enabled_only=True)

    if args.json:
        payload = dump.to_dict()
        payload["screen_size"] = list(size)
        if args.clickable:
            payload["elements"] = [item.to_dict() for item in elements]
            payload["element_count"] = len(elements)
        print(json.dumps(payload, indent=2))
        return 0

    print("\nUI hierarchy")
    _print("serial", serial)
    _print("dump path", dump.path)
    _print("screen", f"{size[0]}x{size[1]}")
    _print("nodes", len(dump.elements))
    _print("clickable", len(dump.clickable()))
    _print("duration", f"{dump.duration_ms} ms")
    if dump.package_filter:
        _print("package filter", dump.package_filter)

    print("\nElements" + (" (clickable only)" if args.clickable else ""))
    if not elements:
        print("  (none)")
        return 0

    shown = elements[: max(0, args.limit)]
    for index, item in enumerate(shown, start=1):
        flags = []
        if item.clickable:
            flags.append("clickable")
        if item.scrollable:
            flags.append("scrollable")
        if not item.enabled:
            flags.append("disabled")
        if not item.visible:
            flags.append("hidden")
        flag_text = f" [{', '.join(flags)}]" if flags else ""
        print(f"  {index:>3}. {item.label()}{flag_text}")
        _print("class", item.class_name or "(none)")
        if item.resource_id:
            _print("resource-id", item.resource_id)
        if item.content_description and item.content_description != item.text:
            _print("content-desc", item.content_description)
        if item.package:
            _print("package", item.package)
        _print("bounds", list(item.bounds))
        _print("center", list(item.center))
        print()

    remaining = len(elements) - len(shown)
    if remaining > 0:
        print(f"  ... {remaining} more (raise --limit to see them)")

    return 0


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    return inspect_ui(argv)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

"""Phase 12I — Job runner: worker lifecycle around existing analysis pipeline.

Invokes ``run_analysis_job`` (unchanged exploration intelligence). Adds:
device slot acquisition, heartbeat, cancel, job timeout, cleanup, retries.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
import threading
import time
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Callable

from app.core.config import settings
from app.jobs.models import JobStage, JobStatus
from app.jobs.store import get_job_store
from app.workers.device_pool import device_session, get_device_pool
from app.workers.device_session import AndroidDeviceSession
from app.workers.registry import (
    WorkerHealth,
    WorkerLifecycle,
    get_worker_registry,
)
from app.workers.retry import classify_failure, is_retryable_job_failure

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


def _job_timeout_seconds() -> float:
    # Worker timeout slightly above exploration so cleanup can run.
    base = float(settings.job_timeout_seconds or 1800)
    explore = float(settings.exploration_timeout_seconds or 300)
    return max(base, explore + 120)


def _max_attempts() -> int:
    return max(1, int(getattr(settings, "exploration_job_max_attempts", None) or 2))


def _cleanup_timeout() -> float:
    return max(5.0, float(getattr(settings, "exploration_cleanup_timeout_seconds", None) or 60))


def run_job_with_worker(
    *,
    worker_id: str,
    job_id: str,
    attempt: int = 1,
    runner: Callable[..., dict] | None = None,
    **kwargs: Any,
) -> dict | None:
    """Execute one job attempt under a worker identity + exclusive device slot."""
    registry = get_worker_registry()
    store = get_job_store()
    registry.assign_job(worker_id, job_id, attempt=attempt)
    registry.heartbeat(
        worker_id,
        health=WorkerHealth.BUSY,
        lifecycle=WorkerLifecycle.RESERVED,
        job_id=job_id,
    )
    logger.info("[WORKER] %s job=%s state=RESERVED attempt=%s", worker_id, job_id, attempt)

    outcome = "failed"
    result: dict | None = None
    cancel_flag = threading.Event()
    watchdog_stop = threading.Event()

    def _watch_cancel_and_timeout() -> None:
        started = time.monotonic()
        limit = _job_timeout_seconds()
        while not watchdog_stop.wait(1.0):
            registry.heartbeat(worker_id, job_id=job_id)
            if registry.is_cancel_requested(job_id):
                cancel_flag.set()
                logger.info("[JOB] job=%s cancel observed by watchdog", job_id)
                return
            if time.monotonic() - started >= limit:
                cancel_flag.set()
                registry.request_cancel(job_id)
                logger.warning("[JOB] job=%s worker timeout after %.0fs", job_id, limit)
                try:
                    store.update(
                        job_id,
                        status=JobStatus.TIMEOUT,
                        error_code="JOB_TIMEOUT",
                        error_message=f"Job exceeded {limit:.0f}s worker timeout.",
                        finished_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc),
                    )
                except Exception:
                    pass
                return

    watcher = threading.Thread(
        target=_watch_cancel_and_timeout,
        name=f"watch-{job_id[:8]}",
        daemon=True,
    )
    watcher.start()

    try:
        if cancel_flag.is_set() or registry.is_cancel_requested(job_id):
            store.update(
                job_id,
                status=JobStatus.CANCELLED,
                stage=JobStage.DONE,
                progress=100,
                finished_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc),
                error_code="CANCELLED",
                error_message="Cancelled before execution.",
            )
            outcome = "cancelled"
            return None

        registry.heartbeat(worker_id, lifecycle=WorkerLifecycle.STARTING_EMULATOR)
        logger.info("[EMULATOR] job=%s starting", job_id)

        with device_session(job_id) as slot:
            session = AndroidDeviceSession(
                job_id=job_id,
                worker_id=worker_id,
                device_id=slot.slot_id,
                adb_serial=slot.adb_serial or (settings.emulator_serial or "auto"),
                emulator_id=slot.slot_id,
                avd_name=slot.avd_name,
                temp_dir=str(Path(settings.temp_root) / "jobs" / job_id),
            )
            registry.heartbeat(
                worker_id,
                lifecycle=WorkerLifecycle.RUNNING,
                device_id=session.device_id,
                adb_serial=session.adb_serial,
            )
            logger.info(
                "[WORKER] %s job=%s state=RUNNING device=%s",
                worker_id,
                job_id,
                session.adb_serial,
            )

            # Prefer configured serial for this slot when present.
            if slot.adb_serial and "apk_path" in kwargs:
                # Stash for downstream device stage via thread-local / kwargs.
                kwargs = dict(kwargs)
                kwargs["_device_session"] = session

            if cancel_flag.is_set():
                raise _JobCancelled()

            run = runner
            if run is None:
                from app.services.analysis_pipeline import run_analysis_job

                run = run_analysis_job

            registry.heartbeat(worker_id, lifecycle=WorkerLifecycle.RUNNING)
            result = run(job_id, **{k: v for k, v in kwargs.items() if not k.startswith("_")})

            if cancel_flag.is_set() or registry.is_cancel_requested(job_id):
                record = store.get(job_id)
                if record and record.status == JobStatus.TIMEOUT:
                    outcome = "timeout"
                else:
                    outcome = "cancelled"
                    store.update(
                        job_id,
                        status=JobStatus.CANCELLED,
                        finished_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc),
                    )
            else:
                record = store.get(job_id)
                status = record.status if record else JobStatus.COMPLETED
                if status == JobStatus.TIMEOUT:
                    outcome = "timeout"
                elif status == JobStatus.CANCELLED:
                    outcome = "cancelled"
                elif status == JobStatus.FAILED:
                    outcome = "failed"
                else:
                    outcome = "completed"

            registry.heartbeat(worker_id, lifecycle=WorkerLifecycle.FINALIZING)
            logger.info("[JOB] job=%s finalizing outcome=%s", job_id, outcome)

    except _JobCancelled:
        outcome = "cancelled"
        try:
            store.update(
                job_id,
                status=JobStatus.CANCELLED,
                stage=JobStage.DONE,
                progress=100,
                finished_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc),
                error_code="CANCELLED",
                error_message="Cancelled by request.",
            )
        except Exception:
            pass
    except Exception as exc:
        outcome = "failed"
        info = classify_failure(exc=exc)
        logger.exception("[JOB] job=%s failed category=%s", job_id, info["category"])
        try:
            store.mark_failed(job_id, "WORKER_ERROR", str(exc)[:500])
        except Exception:
            pass
        # Bounded job-level retry for infrastructure failures.
        if (
            attempt < _max_attempts()
            and is_retryable_job_failure(exc=exc)
            and not registry.is_cancel_requested(job_id)
        ):
            registry.job_retries_bump = True  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
            try:
                rec = registry.get(worker_id)
                if rec:
                    rec.job_retries += 1
            except Exception:
                pass
            logger.info(
                "[JOB] job=%s scheduling retry attempt=%s",
                job_id,
                attempt + 1,
            )
            # Re-enqueue via pool if available (best-effort).
            try:
                from app.workers.pool import get_worker_pool

                pool = get_worker_pool()
                with pool._lock:
                    from app.workers.pool import QueuedJob

                    # Only if not already active/queued
                    if job_id not in pool._active and not any(
                        q.job_id == job_id for q in pool._queue
                    ):
                        pool._queue.append(
                            QueuedJob(
                                job_id=job_id,
                                kwargs={
                                    k: v
                                    for k, v in kwargs.items()
                                    if not k.startswith("_")
                                },
                                attempt=attempt + 1,
                            )
                        )
                pool._pump()
            except Exception:
                logger.warning("[JOB] job=%s retry enqueue failed", job_id, exc_info=True)
    finally:
        watchdog_stop.set()
        registry.heartbeat(worker_id, lifecycle=WorkerLifecycle.CLEANING)
        logger.info("[EMULATOR] job=%s cleanup start", job_id)
        _bounded_cleanup(job_id, worker_id)
        registry.release_job(worker_id, job_id, outcome=outcome)
        logger.info("[WORKER] %s idle after job=%s outcome=%s", worker_id, job_id, outcome)

    return result


def _bounded_cleanup(job_id: str, worker_id: str) -> None:
    """Best-effort cleanup with a hard time bound."""
    done = threading.Event()

    def _work() -> None:
        try:
            # Ensure device slot released even if context manager aborted.
            get_device_pool().release(job_id)
            if settings.emulator_stop_when_done and settings.exploration_enabled:
                try:
                    from app.modules.exploration.emulator import EmulatorManager

                    # Only stop if this environment owns a dedicated serial;
                    # shared single-AVD hosts may keep the process warm.
                    serials = (getattr(settings, "exploration_emulator_serials", None) or "").strip()
                    if serials:
                        EmulatorManager().stop()
                except Exception:
                    logger.warning(
                        "[EMULATOR] job=%s stop during cleanup failed",
                        job_id,
                        exc_info=True,
                    )
                    rec = get_worker_registry().get(worker_id)
                    if rec:
                        rec.cleanup_failures += 1
            # Temp APK removal is handled by analysis_pipeline finally.
        finally:
            done.set()

    thread = threading.Thread(target=_work, name=f"cleanup-{job_id[:8]}", daemon=True)
    thread.start()
    if not done.wait(timeout=_cleanup_timeout()):
        logger.error("[RELIABILITY] job=%s cleanup timed out", job_id)
        rec = get_worker_registry().get(worker_id)
        if rec:
            rec.cleanup_failures += 1


class _JobCancelled(Exception):
    pass


def is_job_cancel_requested(job_id: str) -> bool:
    return get_worker_registry().is_cancel_requested(job_id)

"""Phase 12I — Bounded exploration worker pool (queue + concurrency).

Reuses the existing ``run_analysis_job`` pipeline. Does not implement a second
exploration engine. Enforces: one active job per worker slot / device.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
import threading
import time
import uuid
from concurrent.futures import Future, ThreadPoolExecutor
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Callable

from app.core.config import settings
from app.jobs.models import JobStatus
from app.jobs.store import get_job_store
from app.workers.device_pool import DeviceSlot, get_device_pool
from app.workers.device_session import AndroidDeviceSession
from app.workers.registry import (
    WorkerHealth,
    WorkerLifecycle,
    get_worker_registry,
)
from app.workers.retry import classify_failure, is_retryable_job_failure

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


def _utcnow() -> datetime:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc)


@dataclass
class QueuedJob:
    job_id: str
    kwargs: dict[str, Any]
    attempt: int = 1
    enqueued_at: float = field(default_factory=time.monotonic)
    future: Future | None = None


class ExplorationWorkerPool:
    """In-process queue with bounded worker concurrency.

    API enqueues; workers claim jobs up to ``exploration_worker_concurrency``
    (and available device slots). Extra jobs remain queued.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        concurrency: int | None = None,
        worker_id_prefix: str | None = None,
        runner: Callable[..., dict] | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self.concurrency = max(
            1,
            int(
                concurrency
                if concurrency is not None
                else getattr(settings, "exploration_worker_concurrency", None)
                or settings.job_max_workers
                or 1
            ),
        )
        # Align with device pool capacity (safe default: 1 shared AVD).
        pool_cap = get_device_pool().capacity
        self.concurrency = min(self.concurrency, max(1, pool_cap))
        self.worker_id_prefix = worker_id_prefix or "worker"
        self._runner = runner
        self._executor = ThreadPoolExecutor(
            max_workers=self.concurrency,
            thread_name_prefix="explore-worker",
        )
        self._lock = threading.RLock()
        self._queue: list[QueuedJob] = []
        self._active: dict[str, QueuedJob] = {}
        self._draining = False
        self._metrics = {
            "jobs_enqueued": 0,
            "jobs_started": 0,
            "jobs_finished": 0,
            "duplicate_rejects": 0,
        }
        # Pre-register worker identities.
        registry = get_worker_registry()
        for i in range(self.concurrency):
            registry.register(f"{self.worker_id_prefix}-{i+1:02d}")

    @property
    def queued_count(self) -> int:
        with self._lock:
            return len(self._queue)

    @property
    def active_count(self) -> int:
        with self._lock:
            return len(self._active)

    def snapshot(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        with self._lock:
            return {
                "concurrency": self.concurrency,
                "queued": len(self._queue),
                "active": len(self._active),
                "draining": self._draining,
                "active_job_ids": list(self._active.keys()),
                "queued_job_ids": [q.job_id for q in self._queue],
                "metrics": dict(self._metrics),
                "device_pool": get_device_pool().snapshot(),
                "workers": get_worker_registry().list_workers(),
            }

    def enqueue(self, job_id: str, **kwargs: Any) -> bool:
        """Queue a job for a worker. Returns False if duplicate active/queued."""
        with self._lock:
            if self._draining:
                logger.warning("[QUEUE] reject enqueue job=%s reason=draining", job_id)
                return False
            if job_id in self._active or any(q.job_id == job_id for q in self._queue):
                self._metrics["duplicate_rejects"] += 1
                logger.info("[QUEUE] duplicate delivery ignored job=%s", job_id)
                return False
            item = QueuedJob(job_id=job_id, kwargs=dict(kwargs), attempt=1)
            self._queue.append(item)
            self._metrics["jobs_enqueued"] += 1
            logger.info(
                "[QUEUE] enqueued job=%s queue_depth=%s active=%s",
                job_id,
                len(self._queue),
                len(self._active),
            )
        self._pump()
        return True

    def request_cancel(self, job_id: str) -> bool:
        registry = get_worker_registry()
        registry.request_cancel(job_id)
        store = get_job_store()
        record = store.get(job_id)
        if record is None:
            return False
        if record.status in {
            JobStatus.COMPLETED,
            JobStatus.FAILED,
            JobStatus.CANCELLED,
            JobStatus.TIMEOUT,
            JobStatus.PARTIAL,
        }:
            return False
        # Soft signal — worker honors between stages.
        logger.info("[JOB] cancel requested job=%s", job_id)
        return True

    def drain(self) -> None:
        with self._lock:
            self._draining = True
            for i in range(self.concurrency):
                get_worker_registry().set_draining(f"{self.worker_id_prefix}-{i+1:02d}")
        logger.info("[WORKER] pool draining")

    def shutdown(self, *, wait: bool = True) -> None:
        self.drain()
        self._executor.shutdown(wait=wait, cancel_futures=False)

    def _pump(self) -> None:
        with self._lock:
            while self._queue and len(self._active) < self.concurrency and not self._draining:
                item = self._queue.pop(0)
                worker_id = self._pick_idle_worker_locked()
                self._active[item.job_id] = item
                self._metrics["jobs_started"] += 1
                future = self._executor.submit(self._run_wrapped, worker_id, item)
                item.future = future

                def _done(fut: Future, jid: str = item.job_id) -> None:
                    exc = fut.exception()
                    if exc is not None:
                        logger.error(
                            "[WORKER] job=%s ended with %s: %s",
                            jid,
                            type(exc).__name__,
                            exc,
                        )
                    with self._lock:
                        self._active.pop(jid, None)
                        self._metrics["jobs_finished"] += 1
                    self._pump()

                future.add_done_callback(_done)
                logger.info(
                    "[WORKER] %s assigned job=%s attempt=%s",
                    worker_id,
                    item.job_id,
                    item.attempt,
                )

    def _pick_idle_worker_locked(self) -> str:
        registry = get_worker_registry()
        for i in range(self.concurrency):
            wid = f"{self.worker_id_prefix}-{i+1:02d}"
            rec = registry.get(wid)
            if rec is None or rec.current_job_id is None:
                return wid
        return f"{self.worker_id_prefix}-{uuid.uuid4().hex[:4]}"

    def _run_wrapped(self, worker_id: str, item: QueuedJob) -> dict | None:
        from app.workers.job_runner import run_job_with_worker

        return run_job_with_worker(
            worker_id=worker_id,
            job_id=item.job_id,
            attempt=item.attempt,
            runner=self._runner,
            **item.kwargs,
        )


_POOL_INSTANCE: ExplorationWorkerPool | None = None
_POOL_INSTANCE_LOCK = threading.Lock()


def get_worker_pool() -> ExplorationWorkerPool:
    global _POOL_INSTANCE
    with _POOL_INSTANCE_LOCK:
        if _POOL_INSTANCE is None:
            _POOL_INSTANCE = ExplorationWorkerPool()
        return _POOL_INSTANCE


def reset_worker_pool_for_tests(**kwargs: Any) -> ExplorationWorkerPool:
    global _POOL_INSTANCE
    with _POOL_INSTANCE_LOCK:
        if _POOL_INSTANCE is not None:
            try:
                _POOL_INSTANCE.shutdown(wait=False)
            except Exception:
                pass
        _POOL_INSTANCE = ExplorationWorkerPool(**kwargs)
        return _POOL_INSTANCE

"""Phase 12I — Worker registry, heartbeat, and health (in-process).

Does not introduce a new database. Runtime visibility for API enrichment and
stuck-worker detection.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import threading
import time
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from enum import Enum
from typing import Any


def _utcnow() -> datetime:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc)


class WorkerHealth(str, Enum):
    IDLE = "IDLE"
    BUSY = "BUSY"
    STARTING = "STARTING"
    UNHEALTHY = "UNHEALTHY"
    DRAINING = "DRAINING"
    STOPPED = "STOPPED"


class WorkerLifecycle(str, Enum):
    IDLE = "IDLE"
    RESERVED = "RESERVED"
    STARTING_EMULATOR = "STARTING_EMULATOR"
    INSTALLING_APK = "INSTALLING_APK"
    RUNNING = "RUNNING"
    FINALIZING = "FINALIZING"
    CLEANING = "CLEANING"
    FAILED = "FAILED"


@dataclass
class WorkerRecord:
    worker_id: str
    health: WorkerHealth = WorkerHealth.IDLE
    lifecycle: WorkerLifecycle = WorkerLifecycle.IDLE
    current_job_id: str | None = None
    device_id: str | None = None
    adb_serial: str | None = None
    last_heartbeat: float = field(default_factory=time.monotonic)
    started_at: datetime = field(default_factory=_utcnow)
    jobs_received: int = 0
    jobs_completed: int = 0
    jobs_failed: int = 0
    jobs_cancelled: int = 0
    jobs_timed_out: int = 0
    job_retries: int = 0
    emulator_failures: int = 0
    cleanup_failures: int = 0

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "worker_id": self.worker_id,
            "health": self.health.value,
            "lifecycle": self.lifecycle.value,
            "current_job_id": self.current_job_id,
            "device_id": self.device_id,
            "adb_serial": self.adb_serial,
            "last_heartbeat_age_s": round(time.monotonic() - self.last_heartbeat, 2),
            "started_at": self.started_at.isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z"),
            "metrics": {
                "jobs_received": self.jobs_received,
                "jobs_completed": self.jobs_completed,
                "jobs_failed": self.jobs_failed,
                "jobs_cancelled": self.jobs_cancelled,
                "jobs_timed_out": self.jobs_timed_out,
                "job_retries": self.job_retries,
                "emulator_failures": self.emulator_failures,
                "cleanup_failures": self.cleanup_failures,
            },
        }


class WorkerRegistry:
    """Thread-safe in-process registry of exploration workers."""

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._lock = threading.RLock()
        self._workers: dict[str, WorkerRecord] = {}
        self._job_to_worker: dict[str, str] = {}
        self._cancel_requested: set[str] = set()
        self._active_attempts: dict[str, int] = {}  # job_id -> attempt

    def register(self, worker_id: str) -> WorkerRecord:
        with self._lock:
            if worker_id not in self._workers:
                self._workers[worker_id] = WorkerRecord(worker_id=worker_id)
            return self._workers[worker_id]

    def heartbeat(
        self,
        worker_id: str,
        *,
        health: WorkerHealth | None = None,
        lifecycle: WorkerLifecycle | None = None,
        job_id: str | None = None,
        device_id: str | None = None,
        adb_serial: str | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        with self._lock:
            rec = self.register(worker_id)
            rec.last_heartbeat = time.monotonic()
            if health is not None:
                rec.health = health
            if lifecycle is not None:
                rec.lifecycle = lifecycle
            if job_id is not None:
                rec.current_job_id = job_id
            if device_id is not None:
                rec.device_id = device_id
            if adb_serial is not None:
                rec.adb_serial = adb_serial

    def assign_job(self, worker_id: str, job_id: str, *, attempt: int = 1) -> None:
        with self._lock:
            # Idempotency: same job already assigned to this worker.
            existing = self._job_to_worker.get(job_id)
            if existing is not None and existing != worker_id:
                raise RuntimeError(
                    f"job {job_id} already assigned to {existing}, cannot assign to {worker_id}"
                )
            rec = self.register(worker_id)
            rec.current_job_id = job_id
            rec.health = WorkerHealth.BUSY
            rec.lifecycle = WorkerLifecycle.RESERVED
            rec.jobs_received += 1
            self._job_to_worker[job_id] = worker_id
            self._active_attempts[job_id] = attempt
            rec.last_heartbeat = time.monotonic()

    def release_job(
        self,
        worker_id: str,
        job_id: str,
        *,
        outcome: str = "completed",
    ) -> None:
        with self._lock:
            rec = self._workers.get(worker_id)
            if rec is not None:
                if outcome == "completed":
                    rec.jobs_completed += 1
                elif outcome == "failed":
                    rec.jobs_failed += 1
                elif outcome == "cancelled":
                    rec.jobs_cancelled += 1
                elif outcome == "timeout":
                    rec.jobs_timed_out += 1
                if rec.current_job_id == job_id:
                    rec.current_job_id = None
                    rec.device_id = None
                    rec.adb_serial = None
                if rec.health not in {WorkerHealth.DRAINING, WorkerHealth.STOPPED}:
                    rec.health = WorkerHealth.IDLE
                    rec.lifecycle = WorkerLifecycle.IDLE
            self._job_to_worker.pop(job_id, None)
            self._active_attempts.pop(job_id, None)
            self._cancel_requested.discard(job_id)

    def request_cancel(self, job_id: str) -> bool:
        with self._lock:
            self._cancel_requested.add(job_id)
            return job_id in self._job_to_worker or True

    def is_cancel_requested(self, job_id: str) -> bool:
        with self._lock:
            return job_id in self._cancel_requested

    def clear_cancel(self, job_id: str) -> None:
        with self._lock:
            self._cancel_requested.discard(job_id)

    def worker_for_job(self, job_id: str) -> str | None:
        with self._lock:
            return self._job_to_worker.get(job_id)

    def attempt_for_job(self, job_id: str) -> int:
        with self._lock:
            return int(self._active_attempts.get(job_id) or 1)

    def get(self, worker_id: str) -> WorkerRecord | None:
        with self._lock:
            return self._workers.get(worker_id)

    def list_workers(self) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        with self._lock:
            return [w.to_dict() for w in self._workers.values()]

    def mark_stale(self, *, stale_after_seconds: float) -> list[str]:
        """Mark workers with stale heartbeats unhealthy. Returns affected job ids."""
        orphaned: list[str] = []
        now = time.monotonic()
        with self._lock:
            for rec in self._workers.values():
                if rec.health in {WorkerHealth.IDLE, WorkerHealth.STOPPED}:
                    continue
                if now - rec.last_heartbeat > stale_after_seconds:
                    rec.health = WorkerHealth.UNHEALTHY
                    if rec.current_job_id:
                        orphaned.append(rec.current_job_id)
        return orphaned

    def set_draining(self, worker_id: str) -> None:
        with self._lock:
            rec = self.register(worker_id)
            rec.health = WorkerHealth.DRAINING

    def snapshot_for_job(self, job_id: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        with self._lock:
            wid = self._job_to_worker.get(job_id)
            if not wid:
                return None
            rec = self._workers.get(wid)
            if rec is None:
                return None
            return {
                "worker_id": wid,
                "lifecycle": rec.lifecycle.value,
                "health": rec.health.value,
                "device_id": rec.device_id,
                "adb_serial": rec.adb_serial,
                "attempt": self._active_attempts.get(job_id, 1),
            }


_REGISTRY = WorkerRegistry()


def get_worker_registry() -> WorkerRegistry:
    return _REGISTRY


def reset_worker_registry_for_tests() -> WorkerRegistry:
    """Test helper — replace the global registry."""
    global _REGISTRY
    _REGISTRY = WorkerRegistry()
    return _REGISTRY

FILE: backend/app/workers/retry.py

"""Phase 12I — Job-level retry classification (infrastructure vs APK).

Distinct from Phase 12H action/supervisor recovery.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any


# Infrastructure / transient — may retry the whole job on a fresh emulator.
_RETRYABLE_TOKENS = (
    "emulator",
    "boot",
    "adb",
    "device offline",
    "device_unavailable",
    "no devices",
    "disconnected",
    "timeout waiting",
    "not found",
    "connection reset",
    "temporary",
    "unavailable",
    "worker",
)

# APK / deterministic — do not burn retries.
_NON_RETRYABLE_TOKENS = (
    "invalid_file",
    "invalid apk",
    "corrupt",
    "install_failed",
    "installation failed",
    "signature",
    "incompatible",
    "unsupported",
    "parse",
    "manifest",
    "not an apk",
)


def is_retryable_job_failure(
    *,
    error_code: str | None = None,
    error_message: str | None = None,
    exc: BaseException | None = None,
) -> bool:
    """Return True when a fresh job attempt on another/clean emulator may help."""
    blob = " ".join(
        str(x).lower()
        for x in (error_code, error_message, type(exc).__name__ if exc else "", str(exc) if exc else "")
        if x
    )
    if not blob.strip():
        return False
    if any(token in blob for token in _NON_RETRYABLE_TOKENS):
        return False
    if any(token in blob for token in _RETRYABLE_TOKENS):
        return True
    return False


def classify_failure(
    *,
    error_code: str | None = None,
    error_message: str | None = None,
    exc: BaseException | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    retryable = is_retryable_job_failure(
        error_code=error_code, error_message=error_message, exc=exc
    )
    return {
        "retryable": retryable,
        "error_code": error_code,
        "error_message": (error_message or str(exc) if exc else None),
        "category": "infrastructure" if retryable else "application",
    }

"""Phase 3 CLI: capture and compare device screenshots / visual states.

Examples::

    python -m app.main --screenshot
    python -m app.main --screenshot --with-ui --package com.example.app
    python -m app.main --compare-screenshot
    python -m app.main --compare-screenshot --wait 2
    python -m app.main --compare-screenshot --left a.png --right b.png
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import logging
import sys
import time

from app.core.logging import setup_logging
from app.modules.exploration.adb import AndroidADB, find_adb
from app.modules.exploration.errors import AdbUnavailableError, ExplorationError
from app.modules.exploration.screenshot_manager import ScreenshotManager
from app.modules.exploration.state_detector import StateDetector
from app.modules.exploration.ui_controller import UIController

logger = logging.getLogger("screenshot_cli")


def _print(label: str, value: object) -> None:
    print(f"  {label:<24} {value}")


def build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        prog="python -m app.main --screenshot|--compare-screenshot",
        description="Capture and compare Android screenshots (Phase 3).",
    )
    parser.add_argument("--screenshot", action="store_true", help="Capture one screenshot.")
    parser.add_argument(
        "--compare-screenshot",
        action="store_true",
        help="Compare two screenshots (device captures or local files).",
    )
    parser.add_argument("--serial", help="adb device serial.")
    parser.add_argument("--package", help="Optional package filter for UI dump.")
    parser.add_argument(
        "--with-ui",
        action="store_true",
        help="Also dump UIAutomator hierarchy for structure / ad-slot fingerprints.",
    )
    parser.add_argument("--trigger", default="manual", help="trigger_action metadata label.")
    parser.add_argument("--out-dir", help="Directory for saved PNGs (default: TEMP_ROOT/screenshots).")
    parser.add_argument("--wait", type=float, default=1.5, help="Seconds between compare captures.")
    parser.add_argument("--left", help="Local PNG for compare (left).")
    parser.add_argument("--right", help="Local PNG for compare (right).")
    parser.add_argument(
        "--threshold",
        type=float,
        default=None,
        help="Override visual similarity threshold (0-1).",
    )
    parser.add_argument("--json", action="store_true", help="Emit JSON only.")
    parser.add_argument("--verbose", action="store_true")
    return parser


def _bind_device(serial: str | None) -> AndroidADB:
    if find_adb() is None:
        raise AdbUnavailableError("adb was not found. Set ADB_PATH or ANDROID_SDK_ROOT.")
    base = AndroidADB()
    return base.for_serial(base.pick_device(serial))


def _dump_elements(adb: AndroidADB, package: str | None):
    controller = UIController(adb)
    return controller.dump_ui(package=package).elements


def cmd_screenshot(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    adb = _bind_device(args.serial)
    manager = ScreenshotManager(adb, output_dir=args.out_dir)
    shot = manager.capture(trigger_action=args.trigger)

    elements = None
    decision = None
    if args.with_ui:
        elements = _dump_elements(adb, args.package)
        detector = StateDetector(similarity_threshold=args.threshold)
        decision = detector.observe(
            shot,
            elements=elements,
            trigger_action=args.trigger,
            retain=True,
            is_entry_point=True,
        )

    payload = {
        "screenshot": shot.to_dict(),
        "state": decision.to_dict() if decision else None,
        "element_count": len(elements) if elements is not None else None,
    }
    if args.json:
        print(json.dumps(payload, indent=2))
        return 0

    print("\nScreenshot")
    _print("state_id", shot.state_id)
    _print("local_path", shot.local_path)
    _print("size", f"{shot.width}x{shot.height}")
    _print("image_hash", shot.image_hash)
    _print("timestamp", shot.timestamp)
    _print("activity", shot.activity or "(unknown)")
    _print("trigger_action", shot.trigger_action)
    _print("sha256", shot.sha256[:16] + "…")
    if decision:
        print("\nState detection")
        _print("is_new", decision.is_new)
        _print("visual hash", decision.visual.ui_structure_hash or "(no ui)")
        _print("ad layout hash", decision.ad_placement.layout_hash or "(none)")
        _print("ad slot count", decision.ad_placement.slot_count)
        _print("reason", decision.reason)
    return 0


def cmd_compare(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    detector = StateDetector(similarity_threshold=args.threshold)

    if args.left or args.right:
        if not (args.left and args.right):
            print("Provide both --left and --right for file comparison.")
            return 2
        # Local-file mode does not need a device for hashing, but ScreenshotManager
        # still requires an adb handle for construction — use a dummy binary path.
        adb = AndroidADB(binary=find_adb() or "adb", serial=None)
        manager = ScreenshotManager(adb, output_dir=args.out_dir)
        left = manager.hash_file(args.left)
        right = manager.hash_file(args.right)
        left_elements = right_elements = None
    else:
        adb = _bind_device(args.serial)
        manager = ScreenshotManager(adb, output_dir=args.out_dir)
        left = manager.capture(trigger_action=f"{args.trigger}:a")
        left_elements = _dump_elements(adb, args.package) if args.with_ui else None
        time.sleep(max(0.0, float(args.wait)))
        right = manager.capture(trigger_action=f"{args.trigger}:b")
        right_elements = _dump_elements(adb, args.package) if args.with_ui else None

    result = detector.compare_screenshots(
        left,
        right,
        left_elements=left_elements,
        right_elements=right_elements,
    )
    # Also run observe twice to show retain/dedupe behaviour when UI is available.
    retain_demo = None
    if left_elements is not None and right_elements is not None:
        demo = StateDetector(similarity_threshold=args.threshold)
        first = demo.observe(left, elements=left_elements, retain=True, trigger_action="compare:a")
        second = demo.observe(right, elements=right_elements, retain=True, trigger_action="compare:b")
        retain_demo = {
            "first": first.to_dict(),
            "second": second.to_dict(),
            "unique_states_retained": len(demo.states),
        }

    payload = {
        "comparison": result,
        "left_screenshot": left.to_dict(),
        "right_screenshot": right.to_dict(),
        "retain_demo": retain_demo,
    }
    if args.json:
        print(json.dumps(payload, indent=2))
        return 0

    print("\nCompare screenshots")
    _print("left", left.local_path)
    _print("right", right.local_path)
    _print("visual similarity", f"{result['visual_similarity']:.3f}")
    _print("threshold", result["threshold"])
    _print("same visual state", result["same_visual_state"])
    _print("UI structure match", result["ui_structure_match"])
    _print("same ad-placement", result["same_ad_placement_state"])
    if retain_demo:
        print("\nRetain demo")
        _print("first is_new", retain_demo["first"]["is_new"])
        _print("second is_new", retain_demo["second"]["is_new"])
        _print("unique retained", retain_demo["unique_states_retained"])
        _print("second reason", retain_demo["second"]["reason"])
    return 0


def run_screenshot_cli(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    parser = build_parser()
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    setup_logging()
    if args.verbose:
        logging.getLogger("app").setLevel(logging.DEBUG)

    try:
        if args.screenshot:
            return cmd_screenshot(args)
        if args.compare_screenshot:
            return cmd_compare(args)
        parser.print_help()
        return 2
    except ExplorationError as exc:
        print(f"\nFailed: {exc.message}")
        details = exc.details()
        for key in ("command", "stderr", "stdout"):
            if details.get(key):
                print(f"  {key}: {str(details[key])[:500]}")
        return 1
    except Exception as exc:  # pragma: no cover
        logger.exception("screenshot CLI failed")
        print(f"\nFailed: {exc}")
        return 1


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    return run_screenshot_cli(argv)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

"""Minimal smoke test for the Phase 1 emulator layer.

    APK -> start emulator -> wait for boot -> install -> launch -> success

Usage (from the backend/ directory, with the venv active):

    python -m app.workers.smoke_emulator --check
    python -m app.workers.smoke_emulator --apk path\\to\\app.apk
    python -m app.workers.smoke_emulator --apk app.apk --avd Pixel_6_API_34 --keep-emulator

Exits 0 on success and 1 on failure.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import logging
import sys
from pathlib import Path

from app.core.config import settings
from app.core.logging import setup_logging
from app.jobs.models import JobStage
from app.modules.exploration.adb import AndroidADB, find_adb
from app.modules.exploration.emulator import EmulatorManager, find_emulator
from app.workers.emulator_stage import run_device_stage

logger = logging.getLogger("smoke_emulator")


def _print(label: str, value: object) -> None:
    print(f"  {label:<22} {value}")


def check_environment() -> bool:
    """Report tool detection without touching a device."""
    adb_path = find_adb()
    emulator_path = find_emulator()

    print("\nEnvironment")
    _print("ANDROID_SDK_ROOT", settings.android_sdk_root or "(unset)")
    _print("ADB_PATH", settings.adb_path or "(unset)")
    _print("EMULATOR_PATH", settings.emulator_path or "(unset)")
    _print("AVD_NAME", settings.avd_name or "(unset)")
    _print("EXPLORATION_ENABLED", settings.exploration_enabled)

    print("\nDetected tools")
    _print("adb", adb_path or "NOT FOUND")
    _print("emulator", emulator_path or "NOT FOUND")

    if adb_path is None:
        print("\nadb was not found. Install Android platform-tools, then set ADB_PATH")
        print("or ANDROID_SDK_ROOT (expected <sdk>\\platform-tools\\adb.exe).")
        return False

    devices = AndroidADB().devices()
    print("\nConnected devices")
    if not devices:
        _print("(none)", "start an emulator or run with --apk to boot one")
    for device in devices:
        _print(device.serial, device.state)

    if emulator_path is None:
        print("\nThe emulator binary was not found. Set EMULATOR_PATH or ANDROID_SDK_ROOT")
        print("(expected <sdk>\\emulator\\emulator.exe).")
        return False

    try:
        avds = EmulatorManager().list_avds()
        print("\nAvailable AVDs")
        if not avds:
            _print("(none)", "create one with avdmanager")
        for name in avds:
            marker = "  <- AVD_NAME" if name == settings.avd_name else ""
            _print(name, marker)
        return bool(avds)
    except Exception as exc:
        print(f"\nCould not list AVDs: {exc}")
        return False


def build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        prog="python -m app.workers.smoke_emulator",
        description="Boot an emulator, install an APK and launch it.",
    )
    parser.add_argument("--apk", help="Path to the APK to install and launch.")
    parser.add_argument("--avd", help="AVD name (defaults to AVD_NAME).")
    parser.add_argument("--package", help="Override the package name.")
    parser.add_argument("--activity", help="Override the launch activity.")
    parser.add_argument(
        "--check",
        action="store_true",
        help="Only report tool/AVD detection, then exit.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--keep-emulator",
        action="store_true",
        help="Leave the emulator running after the test.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--keep-app",
        action="store_true",
        help="Do not force-stop the app afterwards.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--reinstall",
        action="store_true",
        help="Reinstall even when the package is already present.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--uninstall-after",
        action="store_true",
        help="Uninstall the package after a successful launch.",
    )
    parser.add_argument("--json", action="store_true", help="Emit the result as JSON.")
    parser.add_argument("--verbose", action="store_true", help="Enable debug logging.")
    return parser


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    args = build_parser().parse_args(argv)
    setup_logging()
    if args.verbose:
        logging.getLogger("app").setLevel(logging.DEBUG)

    if args.check or not args.apk:
        ok = check_environment()
        if not args.apk:
            if not args.check:
                print("\nPass --apk <path> to run the full boot/install/launch flow.")
            return 0 if ok else 1
        if not ok:
            return 1

    apk_path = Path(args.apk).expanduser()
    if not apk_path.is_file():
        print(f"APK not found: {apk_path}")
        return 1

    print(f"\nSmoke test: {apk_path.name}")

    def on_progress(stage: JobStage) -> None:
        print(f"  -> {stage.value}")

    result = run_device_stage(
        apk_path,
        package_name=args.package,
        activity=args.activity,
        avd_name=args.avd,
        progress=on_progress,
        force_reinstall=args.reinstall,
        stop_emulator=not args.keep_emulator,
        uninstall_after=args.uninstall_after,
        keep_app_running=args.keep_app,
    )

    if args.json:
        print(json.dumps(result.to_dict(), indent=2))
    else:
        _report(result)

    return 0 if result.ok else 1


def _report(result) -> None:
    print("\nResult")
    _print("status", result.status)
    if result.target:
        _print("package", result.target.package_name)
        _print("activity", result.target.activity or "(resolved on device)")
        _print("target source", result.target.source)
    if result.device:
        _print("serial", result.device.serial)
        _print("android", f"{result.device.android_version} (SDK {result.device.sdk_int})")
        _print("screen", f"{result.device.screen_width}x{result.device.screen_height}")
    _print("already installed", result.already_installed)
    _print("installed now", result.installed_now)
    if result.launch:
        _print("launched via", result.launch.method)
        _print("component", result.launch.component or "(monkey)")
        _print("foreground", result.launch.foreground)
    _print("duration", f"{result.duration_ms} ms")

    for warning in result.warnings:
        print(f"  warning: {warning}")

    if result.error:
        print("\nError")
        for key, value in result.error.items():
            _print(key, value)

    print("\nSUCCESS" if result.ok else "\nFAILED")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

"""CLI entry for Phase 12I exploration workers.

The API process embeds the worker pool by default. This module documents the
standalone entrypoint and can be used for health dumps:

    python -m app.workers.worker --health
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import logging
import time

from app.workers.pool import get_worker_pool
from app.workers.registry import get_worker_registry

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="AndroGuard exploration worker")
    parser.add_argument("--health", action="store_true", help="Print worker pool health JSON")
    parser.add_argument("--drain", action="store_true", help="Drain pool (stop accepting jobs)")
    parser.add_argument("--watch", type=float, default=0, help="Watch health for N seconds")
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)

    logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO)
    pool = get_worker_pool()

    if args.drain:
        pool.drain()
        logger.info("[WORKER] draining")

    if args.health or args.watch:
        deadline = time.monotonic() + max(0.0, args.watch)
        while True:
            print(json.dumps(pool.snapshot(), indent=2))
            if args.watch <= 0 or time.monotonic() >= deadline:
                break
            time.sleep(min(5.0, args.watch or 5.0))
        return 0

    logger.info(
        "[WORKER] pool ready concurrency=%s workers=%s",
        pool.concurrency,
        len(get_worker_registry().list_workers()),
    )
    logger.info("Workers run inside the API process via POST /analyze-apk enqueue.")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

from __future__ import annotations

import time

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

APK_MIME = "application/vnd.android.package-archive"
TERMINAL = {"completed", "failed", "cancelled", "timeout", "partial"}


def _poll(client: TestClient, job_id: str, timeout: float = 20.0) -> dict:
    """Wait for the background worker to reach a terminal state."""
    deadline = time.monotonic() + timeout
    body: dict = {}
    while time.monotonic() < deadline:
        response = client.get(f"/api/v1/analyze-apk/{job_id}")
        assert response.status_code == 200
        body = response.json()
        if body["status"] in TERMINAL:
            return body
        time.sleep(0.2)
    raise AssertionError(f"Job {job_id} did not finish; last state: {body}")


def test_rejects_non_apk_extension(client: TestClient) -> None:
    response = client.post(
        "/api/v1/analyze-apk",
        files={"file": ("notes.txt", b"hello", "text/plain")},
    )
    assert response.status_code == 400
    assert response.json()["error"]["code"] == "INVALID_FILE"


def test_rejects_empty_upload(client: TestClient) -> None:
    response = client.post(
        "/api/v1/analyze-apk",
        files={"file": ("empty.apk", b"", APK_MIME)},
    )
    assert response.status_code == 400
    assert response.json()["error"]["code"] == "INVALID_FILE"


def test_missing_file_returns_invalid_file(client: TestClient) -> None:
    response = client.post("/api/v1/analyze-apk", data={"app_name": "x"})
    assert response.status_code == 400
    assert response.json()["error"]["code"] == "INVALID_FILE"


def test_accepted_upload_returns_job_id_immediately(client: TestClient) -> None:
    response = client.post(
        "/api/v1/analyze-apk",
        files={"file": ("fake.apk", b"not-an-apk", APK_MIME)},
    )
    assert response.status_code == 200
    body = response.json()
    assert body["success"] is True
    assert body["job_id"]
    assert body["status"] == "processing"
    assert body["status_url"].endswith(body["job_id"])


def test_job_reports_failure_for_invalid_apk(client: TestClient) -> None:
    created = client.post(
        "/api/v1/analyze-apk",
        files={"file": ("fake.apk", b"not-an-apk", APK_MIME)},
    ).json()
    body = _poll(client, created["job_id"])
    assert body["status"] == "failed"
    assert body["error"]["code"] == "INVALID_APK"
    assert body["progress"] >= 0


def test_unknown_job_returns_404(client: TestClient) -> None:

    assert response.status_code == 404
    assert response.json()["error"]["code"] == "NOT_FOUND"


def test_malformed_job_id_returns_404(client: TestClient) -> None:

    assert response.status_code == 404


def test_existing_sync_endpoint_still_works(client: TestClient) -> None:
    """The original endpoint must keep its synchronous contract."""
    response = client.post(
        "/api/v1/analyze",
        files={"file": ("fake.apk", b"not-an-apk", APK_MIME)},
    )
    assert response.status_code == 400
    assert response.json()["error"]["code"] == "INVALID_APK"
    assert "job_id" not in response.json()

import io
import time
import zipfile

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

from app.core.config import settings
from app.core.errors import AppError


def test_apk_too_large(client: TestClient, monkeypatch) -> None:
    monkeypatch.setattr(settings, "max_apk_size_mb", 0)
    response = client.post(
        "/api/v1/analyze",
        files={"file": ("big.apk", b"PK\x03\x04" + b"x" * 64, "application/vnd.android.package-archive")},
    )
    assert response.status_code == 413
    assert response.json()["error"]["code"] == "APK_TOO_LARGE"


def test_analysis_timeout(client: TestClient, monkeypatch) -> None:
    monkeypatch.setattr(settings, "analysis_timeout_seconds", 0.01)

    def _slow(*_args, **_kwargs):
        time.sleep(0.2)
        raise AssertionError("analyze_apk should have been cancelled by timeout")

    monkeypatch.setattr("app.api.v1.analyze.analyze_apk", _slow)
    buffer = io.BytesIO()
    with zipfile.ZipFile(buffer, "w") as archive:
        archive.writestr("AndroidManifest.xml", b"not-binary-axml")
    response = client.post(
        "/api/v1/analyze",
        files={"file": ("slow.apk", buffer.getvalue(), "application/vnd.android.package-archive")},
    )
    assert response.status_code == 504
    assert response.json()["error"]["code"] == "ANALYSIS_TIMEOUT"


def test_aab_is_unsupported(client: TestClient) -> None:
    buffer = io.BytesIO()
    with zipfile.ZipFile(buffer, "w") as archive:
        archive.writestr("BundleConfig.pb", b"bundle")
        archive.writestr("base/manifest/AndroidManifest.xml", b"x")
    response = client.post(
        "/api/v1/analyze",
        files={"file": ("app.apk", buffer.getvalue(), "application/vnd.android.package-archive")},
    )
    assert response.status_code == 400
    assert response.json()["error"]["code"] == "UNSUPPORTED_APK"


def test_corrupt_manifest_zip(client: TestClient) -> None:
    buffer = io.BytesIO()
    with zipfile.ZipFile(buffer, "w") as archive:
        archive.writestr("AndroidManifest.xml", b"not a binary android manifest")
    response = client.post(
        "/api/v1/analyze",
        files={"file": ("badmanifest.apk", buffer.getvalue(), "application/vnd.android.package-archive")},
    )
    assert response.status_code == 400
    assert response.json()["error"]["code"] in {"CORRUPT_APK", "MANIFEST_INVALID"}


def test_unknown_file_404(client: TestClient) -> None:
    response = client.get("/api/v1/files/11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111/missing.png")
    assert response.status_code == 404
    assert response.json()["error"]["code"] == "INVALID_FILE"

"""Phase 12H — test doubles for reliability / failure injection (tests only)."""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Any, Callable
from unittest.mock import MagicMock

from app.modules.exploration.actions import Action, ActionResult
from app.modules.exploration.observation_builder import build_observation
from app.modules.exploration.ui_element import UIElement


def make_element(
    text: str = "OK",
    *,
    y0: int = 100,
    y1: int = 180,
    package: str = "com.example.app",
    clickable: bool = True,
) -> UIElement:
    return UIElement(
        text=text,
        resource_id="btn",
        content_description="",
        class_name="android.widget.Button",
        package=package,
        bounds=(40, y0, 400, y1),
        clickable=clickable,
        enabled=True,
        scrollable=False,
        visible=True,
        selected=False,
        checked=False,
        focused=False,
        focusable=True,
    )


class FailingUIController:
    """UIController stand-in that fails or succeeds deterministically."""

    def __init__(self, *, fail_kinds: set[str] | None = None, fail_n: int = 0) -> None:
        self.fail_kinds = fail_kinds or set()
        self.fail_n = fail_n
        self.calls: list[str] = []
        self._fail_remaining = fail_n

    def perform(self, action: Action) -> ActionResult:
        kind = getattr(action, "kind", type(action).__name__)
        self.calls.append(str(kind))
        if kind in self.fail_kinds or self._fail_remaining > 0:
            if self._fail_remaining > 0:
                self._fail_remaining -= 1
            return ActionResult(kind=str(kind), ok=False, error="injected_ui_failure")
        return ActionResult(kind=str(kind), ok=True)

    def wait(self, seconds: float = 0.5) -> None:
        self.calls.append(f"wait:{seconds}")


class DelayedObservationProvider:
    """Yields a sequence of observations; later frames may include ads."""

    def __init__(self, frames: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> None:
        self.frames = list(frames)
        self.index = 0

    def next(self) -> Any:
        if self.index >= len(self.frames):
            frame = self.frames[-1] if self.frames else {}
        else:
            frame = self.frames[self.index]
            self.index += 1
        return build_observation(**frame)


class DelayedAdDetector:
    """Returns no ads for N calls, then returns injected runtime ads."""

    def __init__(self, ads_after: int, ads: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> None:
        self.ads_after = ads_after
        self.ads = ads
        self.calls = 0

    def detect(self, *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> list[Any]:
        self.calls += 1
        if self.calls <= self.ads_after:
            return []
        return list(self.ads)


class FailingAIProvider:
    """Raises or returns invalid payloads for AI resilience tests."""

    def __init__(self, mode: str = "timeout") -> None:
        self.mode = mode
        self.calls = 0

    def __call__(self, *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> Any:
        self.calls += 1
        if self.mode == "timeout":
            raise TimeoutError("ai_timeout")
        if self.mode == "invalid_json":
            return "not-json{{"
        if self.mode == "low_confidence":
            return {
                "action": "tap",
                "target": "tap:A",
                "text": None,
                "confidence": 0.01,
                "reason": "guess",
            }
        if self.mode == "invalid_candidate":
            return {
                "action": "tap",
                "target": "tap:DOES_NOT_EXIST",
                "text": None,
                "confidence": 0.99,
                "reason": "invented",
            }
        if self.mode == "shell":
            return {
                "action": "shell",
                "target": "adb shell am start",
                "text": None,
                "confidence": 0.99,
                "reason": "hack",
            }
        raise RuntimeError("provider_unavailable")


@dataclass
class SimulatedScreen:
    state_id: str
    activity: str
    labels: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    ads: list[dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=list)
    hitl: dict[str, Any] | None = None
    crash: bool = False


class ExplorationSimulator:
    """Deterministic exploration loop for soak / invariant tests (no emulator)."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        screens: dict[str, SimulatedScreen],
        *,
        transitions: dict[tuple[str, str], str],
        seed: int = 12345,
    ) -> None:
        self.screens = screens
        self.transitions = transitions
        self.seed = seed
        self.current = next(iter(screens))
        self.app_running = True
        self.observations: list[Any] = []

    def observe(self) -> Any:
        screen = self.screens[self.current]
        if screen.crash:
            self.app_running = False
        els = [make_element(t, y0=80 + i * 90) for i, t in enumerate(screen.labels)]
        obs = build_observation(
            package_name="com.example.app" if self.app_running else None,
            activity=screen.activity if self.app_running else None,
            elements=els,
            state_id=screen.state_id,
            screen_size=(1080, 2400),
            ad_results=list(screen.ads) if self.app_running else None,
            hitl=screen.hitl,
        )
        self.observations.append(obs)
        return obs

    def apply_action(self, label: str) -> bool:
        key = (self.current, label)
        nxt = self.transitions.get(key)
        if nxt is None:
            return False
        self.current = nxt
        self.app_running = not self.screens[nxt].crash
        return True


def mock_ui_success() -> MagicMock:
    ui = MagicMock()
    ui.perform.return_value = ActionResult(kind="tap", ok=True)
    ui.wait = MagicMock()
    return ui

from app.modules.apk_analyzer.aapt import parse_badging, prefer
from app.modules.manifest.extract import extract_manifest
from app.modules.permissions.extract import extract_permissions
from app.modules.sdk.extract import extract_sdk
from tests.unit.test_extractors import _ctx

SAMPLE = """
package: name='com.example.app' versionCode='9' versionName='2.0' compileSdkVersion='34' compileSdkVersionCodename='14'
sdkVersion:'24'
targetSdkVersion:'34'
uses-permission: name='android.permission.INTERNET'
uses-permission: name='android.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION' maxSdkVersion='32'
application-label:'Aapt Label'
"""


def test_parse_badging() -> None:
    parsed = parse_badging(SAMPLE)
    assert parsed["package"] == "com.example.app"
    assert parsed["version_code"] == 9
    assert parsed["version_name"] == "2.0"
    assert parsed["compile_sdk"] == 34
    assert parsed["min_sdk"] == 24
    assert parsed["target_sdk"] == 34
    assert parsed["app_label"] == "Aapt Label"
    perms = {item["name"]: item for item in parsed["permissions"]}
    assert perms["android.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION"]["max_sdk_version"] == 32


def test_prefer_uses_aapt_and_warns() -> None:
    warnings: list[str] = []
    assert prefer("com.aapt", "com.ag", "package", warnings) == "com.aapt"
    assert warnings
    assert prefer(None, "com.ag", "package", []) == "com.ag"


def test_extractors_prefer_aapt() -> None:
    ctx = _ctx(aapt=parse_badging(SAMPLE))
    manifest = extract_manifest(ctx)
    sdk = extract_sdk(ctx)
    permissions = {item["name"]: item for item in extract_permissions(ctx)}
    assert manifest["package"] == "com.example.app"
    assert manifest["app_label"] == "Aapt Label"
    assert manifest["version_code"] == 9
    assert sdk["min_sdk"] == 24
    assert sdk["target_sdk"] == 34
    assert sdk["compile_sdk"] == 34
    assert "android.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION" in permissions
    assert any("mismatch" in warning for warning in ctx.warnings)

"""Unit tests for Phase 6 screenshot advertisement detection."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
from pathlib import Path

from PIL import Image

from app.modules.ad_detection import (
    AdDetectionResult,
    AdDetector,
    BoundingBox,
    HeuristicAdProvider,
    OpenAIVisionProvider,
    ProviderNotConfiguredError,
    build_provider,
    infer_position,
    normalize_ad_type,
)
from app.modules.ad_detection.providers.vision_common import parse_vision_json


def _write_png(path: Path, *, width: int = 1080, height: int = 2400, band: str | None = "bottom") -> Path:
    image = Image.new("RGB", (width, height), (245, 245, 245))
    pixels = image.load()
    assert pixels is not None
    if band == "bottom":
        for y in range(int(height * 0.84), height):
            for x in range(width):
                pixels[x, y] = (220, 40, 40) if (x + y) % 7 else (30, 30, 200)
    elif band == "top":
        for y in range(0, int(height * 0.12)):
            for x in range(width):
                pixels[x, y] = (40, 180, 40) if (x + y) % 5 else (200, 200, 40)
    image.save(path, format="PNG")
    return path


def test_normalize_and_infer_position():
    assert normalize_ad_type("Rewarded Video") == "rewarded"
    assert normalize_ad_type("full-screen") == "interstitial"
    box = BoundingBox(x=0, y=2000, width=1080, height=200)
    assert infer_position(box, image_width=1080, image_height=2400) == "bottom"


def test_heuristic_detects_bottom_banner(tmp_path: Path):
    shot = _write_png(tmp_path / "banner.png", band="bottom")
    detector = AdDetector(HeuristicAdProvider(min_confidence=0.4), min_confidence=0.4)
    result = detector.detect(shot)
    assert result.detected is True
    assert result.type in {"banner", "native", "interstitial"}
    assert result.bounding_box is not None
    assert result.bounding_box.width > 0
    assert result.position in {"bottom", "middle", "fullscreen", "top"}
    payload = result.to_dict()
    assert "detected" in payload and "bounding_box" in payload


def test_heuristic_plain_screen_may_be_empty(tmp_path: Path):
    shot = _write_png(tmp_path / "plain.png", band=None)
    detector = AdDetector(HeuristicAdProvider(min_confidence=0.9), min_confidence=0.9)
    result = detector.detect(shot)
    # High threshold → often none on flat grey.
    assert result.detected in {True, False}
    assert result.provider == "heuristic"


def test_openai_provider_requires_key():
    provider = OpenAIVisionProvider(api_key=None)
    try:
        provider.analyze("missing.png")
        assert False, "expected ProviderNotConfiguredError"
    except ProviderNotConfiguredError:
        pass
    except FileNotFoundError:
        # Key check should happen first; if file check wins, still fail clearly.
        raise AssertionError("expected ProviderNotConfiguredError before file IO")


def test_build_provider_heuristic():
    provider = build_provider("heuristic")
    assert provider.name == "heuristic"


def test_parse_vision_json_primary_shape():
    text = json.dumps(
        {
            "ads": [
                {
                    "detected": True,
                    "type": "banner",
                    "confidence": 0.95,
                    "bounding_box": {"x": 20, "y": 1680, "width": 1040, "height": 180},
                    "position": "bottom",
                }
            ]
        }
    )
    results = parse_vision_json(
        text,
        provider="openai",
        image_path="/tmp/a.png",
        image_width=1080,
        image_height=2400,
    )
    assert len(results) == 1
    item = results[0]
    assert item.detected is True
    assert item.type == "banner"
    assert abs(item.confidence - 0.95) < 1e-6
    assert item.bounding_box == BoundingBox(x=20, y=1680, width=1040, height=180)
    assert item.position == "bottom"


def test_detection_result_example_shape():
    result = AdDetectionResult(
        detected=True,
        type="banner",
        confidence=0.95,
        bounding_box=BoundingBox(x=20, y=1680, width=1040, height=180),

    assert payload["bounding_box"] == {"x": 20, "y": 1680, "width": 1040, "height": 180}
    assert payload["position"] == "bottom"

from __future__ import annotations
