def test_ad_placement_fingerprint_detects_banner_band_and_webview():
    elements = [
        UIElement(
            class_name="android.webkit.WebView",
            resource_id="com.app:id/ad_banner",
            bounds=(0, 2200, 1080, 2400),
            visible=True,
            clickable=True,
        ),
        UIElement(
            class_name="android.widget.FrameLayout",
            resource_id="com.app:id/content",
            bounds=(0, 0, 1080, 2200),
            visible=True,
        ),
    ]
    fp = ad_placement_fingerprint(elements, screen_width=1080, screen_height=2400)
    assert fp.slot_count >= 1
    assert fp.layout_hash
    assert any(r["reason"] in {"class_hint", "resource_id_hint", "banner_band"} for r in fp.candidate_regions)


# --- StateDetector -----------------------------------------------------------


def test_state_detector_retains_unique_and_dedupes_similar(tmp_path: Path):
    hasher = ImageHasher(hash_size=8, crop_top=0.0, crop_bottom=0.0)
    detector = StateDetector(hasher=hasher, similarity_threshold=0.9)

    blue = _shot_from_png(_png_bytes((20, 80, 180)), "s1", hasher)
    blue2 = _shot_from_png(_png_bytes((20, 80, 180)), "s2", hasher)
    red = _shot_from_png(_png_bytes((200, 30, 30), mark=True), "s3", hasher)

    first = detector.observe(blue, retain=True, trigger_action="open")
    second = detector.observe(blue2, retain=True, trigger_action="wait")
    third = detector.observe(red, retain=True, trigger_action="tap")

    assert first.is_new is True
    assert second.is_new is False
    assert second.matched_state_id == first.state_id
    assert third.is_new is True
    assert len(detector.states) == 2


def test_compare_screenshots_separates_visual_and_ad_layout():
    hasher = ImageHasher(hash_size=8, crop_top=0.0, crop_bottom=0.0)
    detector = StateDetector(hasher=hasher, similarity_threshold=0.9)

    left = _shot_from_png(_png_bytes((10, 10, 10)), "a", hasher)
    right = _shot_from_png(_png_bytes((10, 10, 10)), "b", hasher)
    # Same ad webview band on both, different "content" text only in hierarchy.
    shared_ad = UIElement(
        class_name="com.google.android.gms.ads.AdView",
        resource_id="com.app:id/banner",
        bounds=(0, 0, 100, 40),
        visible=True,
    )
    left_ui = [shared_ad, UIElement(text="Score 1", class_name="android.widget.TextView", bounds=(0, 50, 80, 80), visible=True)]
    right_ui = [shared_ad, UIElement(text="Score 99", class_name="android.widget.TextView", bounds=(0, 50, 80, 80), visible=True)]

    result = detector.compare_screenshots(left, right, left_elements=left_ui, right_elements=right_ui)
    assert result["same_visual_state"] is True
    assert result["ui_structure_match"] is True
    assert result["same_ad_placement_state"] is True


# --- ScreenshotManager (mocked adb) ------------------------------------------


def test_screenshot_manager_capture_writes_png(tmp_path: Path):
    png = _png_bytes((50, 50, 50), size=(64, 128))
    adb, runner = make_adb({})

    def binary_runner(args, timeout):  # noqa: ANN001
        # Bypass FakeRunner text path: ScreenshotManager uses run_binary/screencap_png.
        from app.modules.exploration.adb import CommandResult

        joined = " ".join(args)
        runner.calls.append(list(args))
        if "screencap" in joined:
            return png
        return CommandResult(tuple(args), 0, "", "", 1)

    # Patch run_binary directly.
    adb.run_binary = lambda args, timeout=None, with_serial=True: png  # type: ignore[method-assign]
    adb.screencap_png = lambda timeout=None: png  # type: ignore[method-assign]

    manager = ScreenshotManager(adb, output_dir=tmp_path)
    shot = manager.capture(trigger_action="manual", resolve_activity=False)
    assert Path(shot.local_path).is_file()
    assert shot.width == 64 and shot.height == 128
    assert shot.trigger_action == "manual"
    assert shot.image_hash
    assert shot.to_dict()["state_id"] == shot.state_id


def test_png_crlf_repair_helper():
    from app.modules.exploration.adb import _repair_png_bytes

    good = b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n" + b"rest"
    assert _repair_png_bytes(good) == good
    corrupted = b"\x89PNG\r\n\r\n\x1a\n" + b"x"
    # After replacing CRLF with LF we should recover a PNG signature prefix.
    fixed = _repair_png_bytes(corrupted)
    assert fixed.startswith(b"\x89PNG")

from __future__ import annotations

import json

    ExplorationSupervisor,

)

def _el(**kwargs) -> UIElement:
    defaults = dict(
        text="Settings",
        resource_id="",
        content_description="",
        class_name="android.widget.Button",
        package="com.example.app",
        bounds=(40, 200, 400, 280),
        clickable=True,
        enabled=True,
        scrollable=False,
        visible=True,
        selected=False,
        checked=False,
        focused=False,
        focusable=True,
    )
    defaults.update(kwargs)
    return UIElement(**defaults)


def _planned(key: str = "tap:Settings", kind: str = "tap") -> PlannedAction:
    return PlannedAction(
        key=key,
        action=TapAction(element=_el()),
        kind=kind,
        priority=10,
        label="Settings",
    )


def _verify(
    outcome: VerifyOutcome,
    *,
    before: str | None = "home",
    after: str | None = "home",
    hitl: bool = False,
) -> VerifyResult:
    return VerifyResult(
        outcome=outcome,
        before_state_id=before,
        after_state_id=after,
        hitl_appeared=hitl,
        reason=outcome.value.lower(),
    )


def _exec(
    *,
    ok: bool = True,
    rejected: bool = False,
    error: str | None = None,
    key: str = "tap:Settings",
) -> ExecutorResult:
    return ExecutorResult(
        action_id="abc123",
        action_kind="tap",
        action_key=key,
        success=ok and not rejected,
        started_at="t0",
        completed_at="t1",
        duration_ms=10,
        error=error,
        error_type="rejected" if rejected else ("ui_failure" if not ok else None),
        before_state_id="home",
        rejected=rejected,
    )


def test_success_continue() -> None:
    sup = ExplorationSupervisor()
    d = sup.decide(
        SupervisorContext(
            verify=_verify(VerifyOutcome.SUCCESS, after="home"),
            executor=_exec(ok=True),
            planned=_planned(),
            has_parent=True,
            app_running=True,
        )
    )
    assert d.decision is SupervisorDecisionKind.CONTINUE


def test_state_changed_continue() -> None:
    sup = ExplorationSupervisor()

            has_parent=True,
            app_running=True,
        )
    )
    assert d.decision is SupervisorDecisionKind.CONTINUE

def test_recovery_limit_stop() -> None:
    sup = ExplorationSupervisor(max_recovery_without_progress=2, max_retries_per_action=0)
    ctx = SupervisorContext(
        verify=_verify(VerifyOutcome.FAILED),
        executor=_exec(ok=False, error="x"),
        planned=_planned(key="tap:A"),
        has_parent=True,
        app_running=True,
    )
    # SKIP (retry=0) does not count; use WAIT/BACKTRACK path via NO_CHANGE
    planned = _planned(key="tap:B")
    wait_ctx = SupervisorContext(
        verify=_verify(VerifyOutcome.NO_CHANGE),
        executor=_exec(ok=True, key="tap:B"),
        planned=planned,
        has_parent=True,
        app_running=True,
    )
    assert sup.decide(wait_ctx).decision is SupervisorDecisionKind.WAIT
    # second recovery
    planned2 = _planned(key="tap:C")
    wait_ctx2 = SupervisorContext(
        verify=_verify(VerifyOutcome.NO_CHANGE),
        executor=_exec(ok=True, key="tap:C"),
        planned=planned2,
        has_parent=True,
        app_running=True,
    )
    assert sup.decide(wait_ctx2).decision is SupervisorDecisionKind.WAIT
    # third should hit recovery limit
    d = sup.decide(wait_ctx2)
    assert d.decision is SupervisorDecisionKind.STOP
    assert d.reason == "recovery_limit_reached"

                device_available=True,
            )
        )
        assert isinstance(d.decision, SupervisorDecisionKind)

    json.dumps(payload)


def test_chain_fail_retry_then_success() -> None:
    agent = AgentState.create_initial(
        package_name="com.example.app", max_actions=50, seed_goals=False
    )
    planner = ExplorationPlanner()
    plan = planner.select([_planned()], agent_state=agent)
    assert plan.planned_action is not None

    ui = MagicMock()
    ui.perform.side_effect = [
        RuntimeError("busy"),
        ActionResult(kind="tap", ok=True, duration_ms=5),
    ]
    executor = ActionExecutor(ui)
    verifier = ActionVerifier()
    supervisor = ExplorationSupervisor(max_retries_per_action=1)

    before = build_observation(
        package_name="com.example.app",
        activity="Home",
        elements=[_el()],
        state_id="home",
        screen_size=(1080, 2400),
    )
    agent.update_observation(before)

    r1 = executor.execute(plan.planned_action, agent_state=agent, before_state_id="home")
    assert r1.success is False
    v1 = verifier.verify(
        planned=plan.planned_action,
        executor_result=r1,
        before=before,
        after=before,
    )
    assert v1.outcome is VerifyOutcome.FAILED
    d1 = supervisor.decide(
        SupervisorContext(
            agent_state=agent,
            verify=v1,
            executor=r1,
            planned=plan.planned_action,
            has_parent=True,
            app_running=True,
        )
    )
    assert d1.decision is SupervisorDecisionKind.RETRY

    r2 = executor.execute(plan.planned_action, agent_state=agent, before_state_id="home")
    assert r2.success is True
    after = build_observation(
        package_name="com.example.app",
        activity="Settings",
        elements=[_el(text="Profile")],
        state_id="settings",
        screen_size=(1080, 2400),
    )
    agent.update_observation(after)
    v2 = verifier.verify(
        planned=plan.planned_action,
        executor_result=r2,
        before=before,
        after=after,
    )
    assert v2.outcome is VerifyOutcome.STATE_CHANGED
    d2 = supervisor.decide(
        SupervisorContext(
            agent_state=agent,
            verify=v2,
            executor=r2,
            planned=plan.planned_action,
            has_parent=True,
            app_running=True,
        )
    )
    assert d2.decision is SupervisorDecisionKind.CONTINUE


def test_chain_stagnation_backtrack_decision() -> None:
    supervisor = ExplorationSupervisor(max_consecutive_no_change=1)
    planned = _planned(key="tap:X")
    # first NO_CHANGE → WAIT
    assert (
        supervisor.decide(
            SupervisorContext(
                verify=_verify(VerifyOutcome.NO_CHANGE),
                executor=_exec(ok=True, key="tap:X"),
                planned=planned,
                has_parent=True,
                app_running=True,
            )
        ).decision
        is SupervisorDecisionKind.WAIT
    )
    # second → BACKTRACK
    d = supervisor.decide(
        SupervisorContext(
            verify=_verify(VerifyOutcome.NO_CHANGE),
            executor=_exec(ok=True, key="tap:X"),
            planned=planned,
            has_parent=True,
            app_running=True,
            engine_stagnation_count=3,
        )
    )
    assert d.decision is SupervisorDecisionKind.BACKTRACK


def test_supervisor_does_not_call_ui() -> None:
    assert not hasattr(ExplorationSupervisor(), "ui")
    assert not hasattr(ExplorationSupervisor(), "perform")

def test_one_job_one_device_slot() -> None:
    pool = reset_device_pool_for_tests(
        [
            DeviceSlot(slot_id="slot-1", adb_serial="emulator-5554"),
            DeviceSlot(slot_id="slot-2", adb_serial="emulator-5556"),
        ]
    )
    s1 = pool.acquire("job-a")
    s2 = pool.acquire("job-b")
    assert s1 is not None and s2 is not None
    assert s1.adb_serial != s2.adb_serial
    assert pool.active_count() == 2
    assert pool.acquire("job-c", timeout=0.05) is None
    pool.release("job-a")
    s3 = pool.acquire("job-c", timeout=0.5)
    assert s3 is not None
    assert s3.adb_serial == "emulator-5554"
    pool.release("job-b")
    pool.release("job-c")

def test_queue_backpressure_two_workers_ten_jobs() -> None:
    reset_device_pool_for_tests(
        [
            DeviceSlot(slot_id="slot-1", adb_serial="emulator-5554"),
            DeviceSlot(slot_id="slot-2", adb_serial="emulator-5556"),
        ]
    )
    gate = threading.Event()
    started: list[str] = []
    lock = threading.Lock()

    def fake_runner(job_id: str, **kwargs):
        with lock:
            started.append(job_id)
        gate.wait(timeout=5)
        return {"ok": True, "job_id": job_id}

    pool = ExplorationWorkerPool(concurrency=2, runner=fake_runner, worker_id_prefix="w")
    for i in range(10):
        assert pool.enqueue(f"job-{i:02d}", apk_path=Path("x.apk"))

    # Allow assignment threads to start
    deadline = time.time() + 2
    while time.time() < deadline:
        snap = pool.snapshot()
        if snap["active"] == 2 and snap["queued"] == 8:
            break
        time.sleep(0.05)
    snap = pool.snapshot()
    assert snap["active"] == 2
    assert snap["queued"] == 8
    assert snap["concurrency"] == 2
    gate.set()
    deadline = time.time() + 5
    while time.time() < deadline and pool.active_count > 0:
        time.sleep(0.05)
    pool.shutdown(wait=True)
    assert len(started) == 10


def test_duplicate_enqueue_rejected() -> None:
    reset_device_pool_for_tests(
        [DeviceSlot(slot_id="slot-1", adb_serial="emulator-5554")]
    )

    def fake_runner(job_id: str, **kwargs):

        return {}

    pool = ExplorationWorkerPool(concurrency=1, runner=fake_runner)
    assert pool.enqueue("same-job") is True
    assert pool.enqueue("same-job") is False
    assert pool.snapshot()["metrics"]["duplicate_rejects"] >= 1
    gate.set()
    pool.shutdown(wait=True)

def test_cancel_queued_job() -> None:
    reset_device_pool_for_tests(
        [DeviceSlot(slot_id="slot-1", adb_serial="emulator-5554")]
    )
    store = InMemoryJobStore()
    job_id = "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
    store.create(JobRecord(id=job_id, status=JobStatus.QUEUED))

    gate = threading.Event()

    def blocking_runner(jid: str, **kwargs):
        gate.wait(timeout=5)
        return {}

    pool = ExplorationWorkerPool(concurrency=1, runner=blocking_runner)
    # Occupy the only worker
    assert pool.enqueue("hold-job")
    time.sleep(0.1)
    assert pool.enqueue(job_id)
    assert job_id in pool.snapshot()["queued_job_ids"]

    with patch("app.workers.pool.get_job_store", return_value=store):
        with patch("app.api.v1.analyze_jobs.get_job_store", return_value=store):
            pool.request_cancel(job_id)
            # Simulate cancel endpoint queued path
            with pool._lock:
                pool._queue = [q for q in pool._queue if q.job_id != job_id]
            store.update(job_id, status=JobStatus.CANCELLED)

    assert store.get(job_id).status == JobStatus.CANCELLED
    gate.set()
    pool.shutdown(wait=True)

def test_worker_timeout_marks_job(monkeypatch) -> None:
    reset_device_pool_for_tests(
        [DeviceSlot(slot_id="slot-1", adb_serial="emulator-5554")]
    )
    store = InMemoryJobStore()
    job_id = "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222"
    store.create(JobRecord(id=job_id, status=JobStatus.QUEUED))

    monkeypatch.setattr("app.workers.job_runner._job_timeout_seconds", lambda: 0.15)
    monkeypatch.setattr("app.workers.job_runner.get_job_store", lambda: store)

    def slow_runner(jid: str, **kwargs):
        # Poll cancel so we don't finish "successfully" after timeout.
        for _ in range(40):
            if is_job_cancel_requested(jid):
                return {"cancelled": True}
            time.sleep(0.05)
        return {"late": True}

    run_job_with_worker(
        worker_id="worker-01",
        job_id=job_id,
        attempt=1,
        runner=slow_runner,
    )
    record = store.get(job_id)
    assert record is not None
    assert record.status == JobStatus.TIMEOUT

def test_cleanup_releases_slot_on_failure() -> None:
    reset_device_pool_for_tests(
        [DeviceSlot(slot_id="slot-1", adb_serial="emulator-5554")]
    )
    store = InMemoryJobStore()
    job_id = "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333"
    store.create(JobRecord(id=job_id, status=JobStatus.QUEUED))

    def boom(jid: str, **kwargs):
        raise RuntimeError("emulator exploded")

    with patch("app.workers.job_runner.get_job_store", return_value=store):
        run_job_with_worker(
            worker_id="worker-01",
            job_id=job_id,
            runner=boom,
        )

    pool = reset_device_pool_for_tests(
        [DeviceSlot(slot_id="slot-1", adb_serial="emulator-5554")]
    )
    # Fresh pool after failure path — original pool should have released.
    # Re-acquire on a new pool proves no leak in registry; check registry idle.
    reg = get_worker_registry()
    rec = reg.get("worker-01")
    assert rec is not None
    assert rec.health == WorkerHealth.IDLE
    assert rec.current_job_id is None


def test_heartbeat_and_stale_detection() -> None:
    registry = reset_worker_registry_for_tests()
    registry.assign_job("worker-01", "job-stale")
    registry.heartbeat("worker-01", lifecycle=WorkerLifecycle.RUNNING)
    # Force stale
    rec = registry.get("worker-01")
    assert rec is not None
    rec.last_heartbeat = time.monotonic() - 999
    orphaned = registry.mark_stale(stale_after_seconds=10)
    assert "job-stale" in orphaned
    assert registry.get("worker-01").health == WorkerHealth.UNHEALTHY

def test_fake_100_job_load_simulation() -> None:
    reset_device_pool_for_tests(
        [
            DeviceSlot(slot_id=f"slot-{i}", adb_serial=f"emulator-{5554 + i * 2}")
            for i in range(3)
        ]
    )
    completed = []
    lock = threading.Lock()

    def fake_runner(job_id: str, **kwargs):
        time.sleep(0.01)
        with lock:
            completed.append(job_id)
        return {"job_id": job_id}

    pool = ExplorationWorkerPool(concurrency=3, runner=fake_runner, worker_id_prefix="load")
    for i in range(100):
        assert pool.enqueue(f"load-{i:03d}")

    deadline = time.time() + 30
    while time.time() < deadline:
        snap = pool.snapshot()
        if snap["queued"] == 0 and snap["active"] == 0 and len(completed) >= 100:
            break
        # Concurrency invariant
        assert snap["active"] <= 3
        time.sleep(0.05)

    pool.shutdown(wait=True)
    assert len(completed) == 100
    assert len(set(completed)) == 100
    final = pool.snapshot()
    assert final["active"] == 0
    assert final["queued"] == 0


def test_two_worker_isolation_distinct_serials() -> None:
    reset_device_pool_for_tests(
        [
            DeviceSlot(slot_id="slot-1", adb_serial="emulator-5554"),
            DeviceSlot(slot_id="slot-2", adb_serial="emulator-5556"),
        ]
    )
    seen: dict[str, str] = {}
    hold = threading.Event()

    def runner(job_id: str, **kwargs):
        from app.workers.device_pool import get_device_pool

        slot = get_device_pool().holder(job_id)
        seen[job_id] = slot.adb_serial if slot else "missing"
        hold.wait(timeout=2)
        return {}

    pool = ExplorationWorkerPool(concurrency=2, runner=runner, worker_id_prefix="iso")
    assert pool.enqueue("iso-a")
    assert pool.enqueue("iso-b")
    deadline = time.time() + 2
    while time.time() < deadline and len(seen) < 2:
        time.sleep(0.05)
    assert len(seen) == 2
    assert seen["iso-a"] != seen["iso-b"]
    hold.set()
    pool.shutdown(wait=True)

# Invariants

def test_invariant_concurrency_never_exceeds_limit() -> None:
    reset_device_pool_for_tests(
        [DeviceSlot(slot_id=f"s{i}", adb_serial=f"emu-{i}") for i in range(4)]
    )
    max_active = 0
    lock = threading.Lock()

    def runner(job_id: str, **kwargs):
        nonlocal max_active
        with lock:
            # peek via pool snapshot externally
            pass
        time.sleep(0.02)
        return {}

    pool = ExplorationWorkerPool(concurrency=2, runner=runner)
    for i in range(20):
        pool.enqueue(f"c-{i}")
    deadline = time.time() + 10
    while time.time() < deadline:
        snap = pool.snapshot()
        max_active = max(max_active, snap["active"])
        assert snap["active"] <= 2
        if snap["queued"] == 0 and snap["active"] == 0:
            break
        time.sleep(0.02)
    pool.shutdown(wait=True)
    assert max_active <= 2


def test_invariant_ai_gains_no_infra_permissions() -> None:
    from app.modules.exploration.executor import ALLOWED_ACTION_KINDS

    assert "shell" not in ALLOWED_ACTION_KINDS
    assert "adb" not in ALLOWED_ACTION_KINDS


def test_worker_pool_snapshot_json_safe() -> None:
    pool = ExplorationWorkerPool(concurrency=1, runner=lambda **kw: {})
    import json

    json.dumps(pool.snapshot())
    pool.shutdown(wait=False)

from app.core.xmlutil import parse_bool, parse_int, resolve_component_name, typed_value


def test_parse_bool() -> None:
    assert parse_bool("true") is True
    assert parse_bool("false") is False
    assert parse_bool(None) is None


def test_parse_int_decimal_and_hex() -> None:
    assert parse_int("23") == 23
    assert parse_int("0x10") == 16
    assert parse_int("nope") is None


def test_resolve_component_name() -> None:
    assert resolve_component_name("com.example", ".MainActivity") == "com.example.MainActivity"
    assert resolve_component_name("com.example", "Other") == "com.example.Other"
    assert resolve_component_name("com.example", "com.example.MainActivity") == "com.example.MainActivity"


def test_typed_value() -> None:
    assert typed_value("true") == (True, "boolean")
    assert typed_value("42") == (42, "integer")
    assert typed_value("@string/app_name") == ("@string/app_name", "resource")
    assert typed_value("hello") == ("hello", "string")
